jobs.description:
Covetrus is a global animal-health technology and services leader dedicated to empowering veterinary practice partners to drive improved health and financial outcomes. We bring together products, services, and technology into a single platform that connects our customers to the solutions and insights they need to work best. Our passion for the well-being of animals and those who care for them drives us to advance the world of veterinary medicine.

Managing DIrector, Calibra Pet Nutritition

Location: Remote-based, with regular travel to Brno, Czech Republic

The opportunity


Calibra is entering an important new stage of its growth.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Managing Director to lead the business, strengthen its position and take the brand into new markets, channels and customer segments.


This is a true business leadership role with full P&L accountability. You will own the strategy, financial performance and future direction of Calibra, balancing ambitious growth with strong commercial discipline and operational delivery. You will also be part of the Executive Leadership Team, working collaboratively across the wider Covetrus organisation.


The opportunity goes well beyond growing through existing Covetrus relationships. A core priority will be expanding Calibra’s presence across specialist retail, e-commerce, marketplaces and selected external distribution partnerships, while protecting the credibility and positioning of the brand.


What you will lead

You will:

  • Own and execute the Calibra business strategy, creating a prioritised European expansion plan supported by clear market-level business cases.
  • Take full responsibility for revenue, gross margin, profitability and EBITDA growth.
  • Identify where Calibra can win and make commercially disciplined decisions about the markets, channels and partnerships worth pursuing.
  • Build the retail and e-commerce strategy, including marketplaces, retailer platforms and direct-to-consumer opportunities where commercially viable.
  • Develop the right pricing, margin, trade-term and channel models to support profitable growth without undermining existing veterinary and Covetrus channels.
  • Strengthen brand awareness and preference among both pet owners and pet professionals.
  • Shape the product portfolio and innovation pipeline in partnership with Product Development and Quality.
  • Ensure Manufacturing, Quality and Customer Service can support growth reliably, efficiently and at the right cost.
  • Use data, market insight and AI-enabled technology to accelerate marketing, product development and decision-making.
  • Lead, develop and strengthen a multidisciplinary team across commercial, marketing, operations, production, customer service, project management, product development and quality.
  • Contribute actively to the Executive Leadership Team, providing clear forecasts, transparent reporting.

What success will look like

You will:


  • Established a clear growth strategy and agreed the priority market sequence and supporting business cases.
  • Defined the retail and e-commerce strategy, selected priority partners and launched the first new retail and online channels.
  • Delivered against revenue, gross margin and EBITDA commitments, with a credible path to sustainable year-on-year growth.

What you will bring


We are looking for a commercially sharp and entrepreneurial leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution.


You will bring:

  • At least 10 years of senior leadership experience, including full P&L responsibility.
  • Strong experience within the animal health industry.
  • A proven record of expanding a business or brand into new international markets.
  • Direct experience of growing brand sales through retail and e-commerce, not solely through owned or group distribution channels.
  • International leadership experience, including responsibility for geographically dispersed teams.
  • Confidence operating within a complex matrix organisation.
  • Experience building investment cases and presenting recommendations for senior approval.

Experience within pet food manufacturing, whether directly operated or outsourced, would be advantageous. Czech language capability would also be beneficial but is not essential.


You will combine:

  • Commercial judgement: The ability to identify where Calibra can genuinely win and focus investment on the opportunities that matter.
  • Financial discipline: A strong grasp of returns, margins, pricing and the economics behind growth.
  • Brand leadership: An understanding of what makes a brand relevant to customers and how to communicate that proposition with clarity.
  • Decisive people leadership: The confidence to set expectations, develop talent and address performance or capability gaps early.
  • Influence and collaboration: The ability to build trusted relationships across functions, countries and external partners.
  • Cultural agility: Comfort leading across markets, cultures and competing priorities without losing momentum.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of an established animal health brand at a pivotal point in its journey.

You will have the platform of Covetrus behind you, together with the freedom and accountability to shape where Calibra goes next. The opportunity is significant: strengthen the core business, expand into new markets, build new retail and digital channels, and make Calibra increasingly relevant to pet owners and pet professionals.


If you are a commercially ambitious leader who understands animal health, brand growth and international expansion, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the next chapter of Calibra Pet Nutrition.

jobs.description:
Your Opportunity as the Manager, Responsible Sourcing Program

Help shape and lead Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing Program, supporting the prevention and mitigation of social compliance and human rights risks across our global supply chains. Guide program strategy and governance, lead human rights due diligence and risk-management activities, engage suppliers, build strategic partnerships, and support public reporting and external communications. Work across the organization and with key external stakeholders to translate complex human rights considerations, evolving regulations, and social compliance standards into practical actions that protect people, strengthen our supply chain, and support Smucker’s commitments.


Location: Working Remote U.S.


Work Arrangements: Remote with 15% annual travel, ability to work with colleagues on eastern standard time.


In this role you will:


Responsible Sourcing Strategy and Governance

  • Guide Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing strategy, program priorities, governance, and decision-making practices.
  • Lead the development and ongoing maintenance of Smucker’s Supplier Code and related standards, expectations, and guidance.
  • Interpret human rights and social compliance frameworks and translate them into practical expectations for suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor evolving regulations, standards, and emerging human rights issues, coordinating cross-functional input and recommending appropriate program changes.

Human Rights Due Diligence and Risk Management

  • Assess human rights and Responsible Sourcing risks using regulatory information, supplier data, Sedex, audit findings, and other available sources.
  • Recommend and coordinate appropriate due diligence, preventive, corrective, remediation, and risk-mitigation actions.
  • Evaluate and escalate significant social compliance and human rights concerns based on severity and potential business impact.
  • Partner with suppliers and internal stakeholders to monitor corrective actions and remediation, escalating issues or recommending additional action when needed.
  • Apply sound judgment to determine when Responsible Sourcing should lead, support, engage another function, or escalate an issue.

Supplier Engagement, Internal Support, and Partnerships

  • Engage suppliers to communicate Responsible Sourcing expectations, address identified risks, and support education and capability building.
  • Provide Responsible Sourcing expertise and practical guidance to Strategic Business Areas, including Green Coffee, and other internal teams.
  • Develop and deliver training and awareness materials tailored to relevant audiences and business needs.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sustainability, Ethics and Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, Procurement, International Trade Compliance, and business teams on Responsible Sourcing and human rights matters.
  • Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers, industry groups, investors, nongovernmental organizations, and other external partners.
  • Represent Smucker in relevant industry collaborations and initiatives, including the Seafood Task Force and Tuna Responsible Business Alliance Program activities.

Public Reporting and External Communications

  • Lead or support Responsible Sourcing reporting, assessments, and disclosures, including EcoVadis, Walmart Project Gigaton, the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil, and other applicable programs.
  • Coordinate Responsible Sourcing information and supporting evidence for leadership updates, regulatory disclosures, corporate reporting, and investor inquiries.
  • Maintain Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing microsite in partnership with Corporate Communications.
  • Support key corporate disclosures, including the California Transparency in Supply Chains Act disclosure, annual Corporate Impact Report, and Canada’s annual supply chain reporting requirements.
  • Provide oversight to Smucker internal site social compliance program (SMETA).

KnowTheChain Benchmark

  • Own Smucker’s end-to-end KnowTheChain benchmark process, conducted every other year.
  • Monitor methodology changes and assess implications for Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing Program and disclosures.
  • Manage relationships and communication with the KnowTheChain team throughout the benchmark process.
  • Coordinate the Additional Disclosure, including gathering required information and supporting evidence from internal stakeholders and ensuring timely submission.
  • Evaluate benchmark results and feedback to identify opportunities to strengthen Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing Program.

What we are looking for:

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field
  • 5+ years of experience across at least two areas such as responsible sourcing, human rights or social compliance, sustainability, legal or regulatory compliance, human resources, or supply chain/procurement.
  • 5+ years of experience assessing human rights, social compliance, supplier, or supply chain risks and recommending appropriate actions.
  • Experience engaging suppliers and partnering across functions to address complex issues and influence outcomes.
  • Ability to interpret standards, policies, regulations, and external frameworks and translate them into practical business actions.
  • Working knowledge of Sedex and SMETA 7.0, including social compliance due diligence, audit findings, and corrective-action follow-up.
  • Strong critical thinking and judgment, with the ability to evaluate complex or incomplete information, navigate ambiguity, and determine an appropriate path forward.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex topics for leaders, internal stakeholders, suppliers, and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines based on risk and business impact.
  • Flexibility to occasionally adjust working hours to effectively engage with international suppliers and partners.

Additional skills and experience that we think would make someone successful in this role

  • Experience leading or supporting a Responsible Sourcing or human rights due diligence program, including supplier corrective action or remediation.
  • Knowledge of global human rights regulations, social compliance standards, and evolving supply chain due diligence expectations.
  • Experience with external assessments, benchmarks, or disclosures such as KnowTheChain, EcoVadis, Walmart Project Gigaton, or the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil.
  • Experience preparing sustainability, human rights, corporate responsibility, or regulatory disclosures.
  • Experience working within complex global supply chains, particularly food, agriculture, seafood, coffee, or consumer products.
  • Experience participating in industry collaborations, nongovernmental organizations, working groups, or multistakeholder initiatives.
  • Strong learning agility and resourcefulness, with the ability to quickly build expertise, leverage available resources, and solve problems without an established playbook.

Remote · Part-time (4–6 hours/day) · Pacific Time, 9:00 AM–2:00 PM

About the role

Our client is a vacation rental business that needs a detail-oriented, tech-savvy bookkeeper to keep their books accurate and up to date. You'll own the day-to-day accounting, from reconciliations to owner payouts, and work directly with the owner, with support from an external accountant and a CPA at tax time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership, catches small details before they become problems, and looks for ways to work faster and with fewer errors, using integrations, copy-paste and automation instead of manual data entry.

Requirements

  • Manage the daily bookkeeping in QuickBooks, including transactions coming in from booking platform integrations.
  • Complete bank and account reconciliations accurately and on time.
  • Prepare owner payouts each month, which is the busiest week of the month.
  • Maintain the balance sheet and track the P&L so the owner always has a clear view of the business.
  • Support the CPA with tax preparation, organizing documents and records.
  • Check in daily and send an end-of-day report with what was completed, what's pending and any issues.
  • Spot errors and inconsistencies early and propose better ways to keep the books clean.

What success looks like

  • First month: You've taken ownership of the day-to-day books, you catch the small details, and the owner can trust your accounting work.
  • By month 3: Owner payouts and reconciliations are completed on time, and the balance sheet and P&L are up to date.
  • By month 6: You're supporting the CPA with tax preparation.
  • Tools you will use
    • QuickBooks: primary accounting tool, with integrations from booking platforms
    • Property management system
    • Google Sheets and Google Drive
    • Slack and WhatsApp: daily communication
  • Who you are
    • Experienced bookkeeper or accountant: solid accounting knowledge and hands-on experience with reconciliations, balance sheets and P&L.
    • QuickBooks proficient: comfortable working in QuickBooks every day, including bank feeds and integrations.
    • Strong in spreadsheets: confident with Google Sheets for tracking, reconciling and reporting.
    • Tech-savvy and accurate: you avoid manual entry errors by using integrations, copy-paste and smart workflows.
    • Proactive and self-directed: you take ownership, flag issues before you're asked, and keep the owner informed.
    • Clear communicator: strong written and spoken English, and comfortable sending concise daily updates.
    • Available on Pacific Time from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
  • Strong plus: US tax experience.
  • Nice to have: accounting experience in real estate, vacation rentals (Airbnb, VRBO) or hotels, including owner payouts.
  • Schedule
    • Part-time, 4–6 hours per day, tentatively 9:00 AM–2:00 PM Pacific Time.
    • Steady workload, with one busier week each month during owner payout preparation.
    • Part-time in the long term, with openness to revisit hours as the business grows.

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Weekly pay

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, we understand that a clear, organized, and reliable patient experience is an important part of healthcare technology. We value people who communicate thoughtfully, pay attention to details, and take initiative to improve everyday processes. Our teams work to make complex workflows easier to understand while maintaining appropriate boundaries between administrative support and clinical care.

About the Role

We're looking for a Patient Experience Intern to support non-clinical patient experience activities and help improve the organization, communication, and documentation of patient-facing processes.

This internship is designed for someone interested in healthcare technology, patient experience, customer support, or healthcare operations.

You'll work under the guidance of experienced team members to learn how patient-facing workflows operate within a telehealth technology environment.

You'll gain practical experience with administrative support, communication processes, internal documentation, and service improvement projects.

Bask Health provides software that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform connects patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and merchant operations.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Assistant
jobs.excerpt: Ana Luisa is a Brooklyn-based e-commerce jewelry brand with a simple, but clearcut idea that high quality jewelry shouldn't cost the planet.
jobs.description:
Ana Luisa is a Brooklyn-based e-commerce jewelry brand with a simple, but clearcut idea that high quality jewelry shouldn't cost the planet. We believe that how we create our pieces matters just as much as why people wear them and that luxury shouldn't be defined so narrowly and designed for so few. We design, craft and deliver exceptional everyday pieces for everyone, priced fairly and produced ethically to create a positive impact for both people and the planet.

Title: Senior Sales Assistant
Department: Wholesale
Reports to: VP of Wholesale
Works closely with: Wholesale Support Manager and Director of Sales
Travel: 6–8 trade shows and markets per year. Must be located in Eastern or Central Timezone

About the Role

The Senior Sales Assistant is the operational backbone of our wholesale business and a trusted partner to our retail accounts. Reporting to the VP of Wholesale and partnering with the Director of Sales, you will own order accuracy, account service, product data, sample and showroom logistics, and market readiness, while also driving process improvements and supporting the growth of our wholesale accounts.

You will act as the day-to-day point of contact for buyers, manage a portfolio of assigned accounts with a high degree of independence, and collaborate with Production, Operations, Merchandising, and Sales. You will also be expected to set standards, train and support teammates, and escalate and resolve issues before they reach the buyer.

Key Responsibilities

Account Management & Buyer Partnership

  • Serve as the primary operational contact for an assigned portfolio of wholesale accounts, proactively communicating order status, availability, payments, shipping updates, and required documents.
  • Build strong relationships with buyers and anticipate their needs ahead of key selling windows and seasonal launches.
  • Partner with the VP of Wholesale and the Wholesale Support Manager on account strategy, identifying reorder opportunities, assortment gaps, and growth potential.
  • Handle shipping extensions, reorders, returns, exchanges, and account escalations, and resolve issues with minimal oversight.

Order Management & EDI

  • Own the full order lifecycle, from order placeholders through EDI transmission, ensuring SKUs, pricing, and quantities are accurate in purchase orders and sales orders.
  • Send order confirmations to accounts before EDI transmission to validate details and keep orders on schedule.
  • Review EDI orders for accuracy, manage transmission approvals, and lead follow-up and issue resolution.
  • Track open POs from receipt through delivery, monitor shipments, and follow up on outstanding or delayed orders, flagging risks to leadership early.
  • Maintain the Master Data and audit order data regularly to protect accuracy across systems.

Inventory, ATS & Sales Reporting

  • Track and regularly update inventory and available-to-sell (ATS) positions, partnering with Production, Operations, and Merchandising to align availability with demand.
  • Pull weekly selling data from key retailers, analyze trends, and review findings and opportunities with the VP of Sales.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards (Excel and related tools) that translate sales results and KPIs into clear recommendations.

Product & Collection Management

  • Own product listings in Shopify and MarketTime end to end: creating, updating, and maintaining them.
  • Build and manage collections on both platforms so assortments stay accurate, current, and aligned with seasonal launches.
  • Generate product and collection barcodes for new assortments and maintain product data integrity across platforms.
  • Document and improve product setup processes so launches run on time and error-free.

Samples & Showroom

  • Oversee the organization and shipment of samples to buyers, including showroom and top-of-production (TOP) samples for wholesale accounts.
  • Maintain a complete log of all samples sent and returned, and ensure timely follow-up and recovery.

Markets & Trade Shows

  • Play a leading role in preparation, on-site execution, and follow-up for 6–8 trade shows and markets per year.
  • Coordinate line sheets, samples, order writing, and logistics, and ensure leads and orders captured at market are processed promptly.

Account Development & CRM

  • Conduct outreach to prospective wholesale accounts and support the pipeline from first contact through onboarding.
  • Keep internal CRM boards current so customer and lead records reflect the latest internal and external decisions.
  • Support the Wholesale Support Manager across all business functions for assigned accounts, and lead special projects as assigned.

Leadership, Process & Collaboration

  • Act as a subject matter expert on wholesale order processes, EDI, and platforms
  • Identify gaps and recommend and implement process improvements that increase accuracy, speed, and buyer satisfaction.
  • Serve as a cross-functional partner to Production, Operations, Merchandising, and Sales, keeping teams aligned on timelines and priorities.

What You Bring

  • 4–6 years of experience in wholesale, sales support, retail operations, or order management, ideally in jewelry, accessories, or fashion.
  • Advanced working knowledge of EDI and the wholesale order lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical skills: comfort reading sales results and KPIs, with advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience with Shopify, MarketTime, and NuORDER is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage buyer relationships and resolve escalations independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with buyers and internal teams.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Proactive when planning ahead, responsive when things change, and collaborative by default.
  • Experience mentoring or training teammates is preferred.
  • Ability to travel to 6–8 trade shows per year.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer, Pharmacy Integrations to help build and maintain the backend systems connecting Bask Health's telehealth platform with pharmacy partners and fulfillment operations.

You'll develop APIs, backend services, and integration workflows that support prescription routing, pharmacy orders, fulfillment updates, and the exchange of information between Bask and external systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with experience building production backend applications and integrating third-party services. You'll work on meaningful features, troubleshoot integration issues, and help improve the reliability of systems used by our pharmacy operations teams.

Our backend stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with tools such as Prisma and Drizzle used across the platform.

You'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, and pharmacy operations teams to turn operational requirements into reliable technical solutions.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving integration challenges, pays attention to data accuracy, and takes responsibility for the quality of their work.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain backend services connecting Bask's platform with pharmacy partners and external systems.

  • Work with AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge to support background jobs and asynchronous processing.

  • Follow appropriate security practices when handling sensitive patient and prescription information.
  • Contribute to internal tools that help teams investigate pharmacy order issues and integration failures.
  • Document APIs, integration behavior, and important technical workflows.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to support development, debugging, and testing while reviewing generated code carefully.
  • Take ownership of assigned features from development through testing, deployment, and follow-up.

  • Familiarity with Git, code reviews, and modern software development workflows.
  • Ability to independently complete assigned features and collaborate with senior engineers on complex projects.

Nice to Have

jobs.excerpt: About Acoustic At Acoustic, we believe people can feel when a brand is paying attention.
jobs.description:
About Acoustic

At Acoustic, we believe people can feel when a brand is paying attention. Our customer engagement platform helps B2C marketers put that belief into practice by bringing customer behavior, product insights, campaign context, and messaging tools like email, SMS, WhatsApp, and mobile push together in one place. This helps busy marketers understand what deserves their attention now and act while it still matters.

Our audience knows marketing. They recognize a good idea, notice the details, and have seen plenty of software companies make the same promises. That gives us a creative challenge worth taking on: tell Acoustic’s story clearly and distinctively, with copy and visuals that reflect the people, decisions, and everyday realities behind the work.

About the role

You notice when a typeface changes the mood or an unexpected image makes an idea click. You’ve rewatched a video just to figure out how they pulled off that transition. As our Senior Brand Designer, you’ll put those instincts to work for an audience of marketers who know good work when they see it and expect us to make some.

We rebranded this year and now comes the fun part: discovering everything our brand can do. We want to push the boundaries of B2B marketing with work our audience looks forward to seeing. You’ll have real room to shape how we get there. Motion graphics and video will be central to your work, along with design for our website, campaigns, social media, and events.

You’ll report to the Director of Brand & Content, who owns brand strategy and creative direction. As a close creative partner, you’ll turn that direction into design: pitching ideas, adapting our visual identity for new formats and channels, and taking projects from concept through production. Bring your opinions. We want to hear them.

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States. A portfolio is required: show us work that makes you proud, including motion and video, and tell us which parts you owned.

What you'll do

  • Own projects from brief to delivery. Turn briefs into distinctive concepts for campaigns, product launches, email, thought leadership, sales presentations, and more. Bring the same care to everyday requests, from asset updates and resizes to recurring production work. Partner with writers so the words and visuals work together for each audience and channel.
  • Explain our product and technology visually. With Product and Product Marketing, tell our product story in ways that are clear and interesting to look at. Find the visual explanation, UI mockup, or demo that helps people quickly see what Acoustic does and why it matters.
  • Make motion and video a defining part of our brand. Shape how the brand moves and create animated explainers, product videos, and social content people watch to the end. Edit interviews, screen recordings, and raw footage using tools like After Effects, Jitter, CapCut, and Descript.
  • Keep our brand fresh and consistent. Adapt our visual identity for new channels, formats, and trends while working within our brand strategy. Build templates and guidelines that help teams across the company use the brand well, and review work so everything we publish meets the same bar for craft and accuracy.
  • Create for social and the web. Design carousels, static graphics, and video for organic social that fit how people use each platform. Work with Web and Content on page designs, imagery, and reusable components that help visitors quickly understand what Acoustic offers.
  • Design for events and in-person experiences. Develop creative for booths and activations, and work with vendors on production specs. Connect each event to what people see before and after, and find ways to give the creative a longer life.
  • Use results to sharpen the work. Partner with Demand & Growth to develop and test creative for paid social, display, and other programs. Learn which ideas get the right people to click, watch, or reply, then recommend what to try next and explain
  • Improve how creative gets made. Experiment with AI tools in concept development and production, and decide where hands-on design and editing make the work stronger. Give freelance designers clear direction and feedback, work with teams across the company to clarify needs, and explain your decisions.

Requirements

You would be a great match if you:

  • Have 7+ years of experience in brand design, graphic design, or art direction, in-house or at an agency, ideally for both B2B and B2C brands.
  • Love making video, with strong motion design or editing skills.
  • Sweat the details. You have sharp judgment in typography, layout, color, and composition, and you’re fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Have helped build or evolve a visual identity, including guidelines and templates other people use successfully.
  • Can talk about what happened after the work launched, and how results or feedback shaped what you did next.
  • Use AI with judgment and can explain where it helped and where you stepped in.
  • Ask good questions, explain your work to people outside design, and handle feedback and competing deadlines without losing the details.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Designed for events, conferences, or trade shows.
  • Made complex technology or products feel clear and engaging.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology, customer engagement, or data platforms.
  • Developed and tested creative for paid social or digital ads.
  • Art-directed photography or illustration.
  • Used Claude Design or Sanity.

This role may not be a match if you:

  • Do your best work from a fully defined brief. Here, you’ll often help shape it.
  • Find it hard to let go of a concept when feedback shows it isn’t working.
  • Want the big campaign and identity work but not the everyday requests and production that keep a brand consistent.
  • Would rather not experiment with short-form video or AI tools. Both are a real part of this job.

Benefits

The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $145,000.

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-sponsored short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) program with company match
  • Flexible PTO: take what you need, when you need it
  • Parental leave: 16 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents

Acoustic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. This is a remote position.

Technical Support Engineer: Backup and Disaster Recovery
Location:Remote, South Africa

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Technical Support Engineer to provide overnight support for a growing technology company serving Managed Service Providers.

This position is suited to a strong Tier 2 technician or developing Tier 3 engineer with experience in Windows Server, networking, virtualization, backup, and disaster recovery technologies.

You will be responsible for responding to technical support requests, assessing urgent incidents, performing initial troubleshooting, and escalating critical issues with complete and accurate technical information. During quieter periods, you will assist with general technical support cases and ongoing ticket resolution.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, communicating with experienced IT professionals, and remaining calm during urgent technical situations.

Key Responsibilities
  • Respond to technical support requests received by phone, email, and ticketing systems
  • Assess backup, recovery, and disaster recovery incidents to determine their severity and urgency
  • Perform initial troubleshooting across servers, backups, virtualization, storage, and networking environments
  • Determine whether an issue can be resolved directly or requires escalation to a senior engineer
  • Gather complete and accurate technical information before escalating critical incidents
  • Follow documented troubleshooting procedures, technical playbooks, and escalation processes
  • Assist with backup failures, data restoration requests, and recovery related support cases
  • Independently manage assigned tickets and maintain clear communication throughout the support process
  • Document troubleshooting steps, findings, actions, and escalations accurately
  • Communicate professionally with Managed Service Providers and other technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and support team members to move cases toward resolution
  • Assist with general technical support tickets during periods of lower emergency call volume

Requirements

Minimum Requirements
  • At least three years of experience in technical support, systems administration, infrastructure support, or a related technical role
  • Strong hands on experience supporting Windows Server environments
  • Practical knowledge of backup, data restoration, and disaster recovery concepts
  • Experience troubleshooting servers, virtualization platforms, networking, and storage systems
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and NAT
  • Experience managing technical support tickets from initial assessment through resolution or escalation
  • Ability to assess urgent incidents and make sound escalation decisions
  • Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and technical documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently during overnight hours
  • Reliable availability for the required working schedule

Preferred Experience
  • Previous experience working for a Managed Service Provider
  • Experience supporting Managed Service Providers or other technical business clients
  • Experience with backup and disaster recovery products, appliances, or platforms
  • Experience with image based backups, data restores, recovery testing, or cloud failover
  • Experience supporting VMware ESXi or Microsoft Hyper V environments

• Working knowledge of Ubuntu Linux

  • Familiarity with storage technologies such as RAID, SMB, iSCSI, or ZFS
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, Bash, or Python
  • Relevant Microsoft, VMware, Linux, or CompTIA certifications

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a dependable and technically capable support engineer who can communicate confidently with experienced IT professionals.

You should be able to distinguish between a routine support request and a genuine technical emergency. You must be comfortable gathering technical information, following established procedures, and escalating issues appropriately when senior engineering assistance is required.

This role will suit someone who enjoys technical troubleshooting, wants to deepen their knowledge of backup and disaster recovery, and is interested in developing into a more advanced engineering position.

Personal Attributes

• Calm and professional under pressure

  • Strong analytical and problem solving ability

• Clear and confident communicator

• Detail oriented and process driven

• Comfortable working independently

  • Accountable for assigned tickets and responsibilities

• Willing to learn and ask questions

  • Interested in long term technical development

Remote Working Requirements

Applicants must have:

  • A quiet and professional home working environment
  • Reliable fibre internet with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps
  • Backup power for their computer and internet connection
  • A modern computer suitable for technical support work
  • At least 8 GB of RAM, with 16 GB preferred

• A reliable noise cancelling headset

  • Consistent availability throughout the required working hours

Application Process

Applicants should submit an updated CV clearly outlining their experience with Windows Server, backup and disaster recovery, virtualization, networking, and technical support.

Shortlisted applicants may be required to complete a technical assessment and participate in multiple interviews.

jobs.title: State Government Affairs Associate (West)
jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEWThe Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA)is hiring a State Government Affairs Associate (West) to keep our reform campaigns moving across our Western states.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

The Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA)is hiring a State Government Affairs Associate (West) to keep our reform campaigns moving across our Western states. In this role, you’ll work alongside our State Government Affairs Directors to track bills, manage follow-up with lawmakers, and build materials for the 2027 sessions.

This role is built for someone who wants to win policy fights in more than one state at a time. You’ll have a hand in every Western portfolio, from digging into bill data to pitching legislators in statehouses across the region.

The ideal candidate brings three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work. This role is remote and reports to the Senior Director of State Affairs for the Western states. Expect frequent travel, especially during session.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at FGA are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five Core Values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of the following questions, you may be a fit.

1)Candid to Solve: Being willing to have tough conversations in order to solve issues and build trust.

  • Do you seek out constructive feedback—and provide it to others—to solve issues and build trust with coworkers?

2)Grow or Die: We don’t have a neutral gear; we must consistently challenge ourselves and each other to grow in our talents and skills.

  • Are you aware of your strengths and weaknesses, and do you seek out complementary skills and growth in order to mitigate your weaknesses?

3)Politically Savvy:Policy doesn’t change in a vacuum, but in a political reality that we must understand and account for.

  • Do you agree that embracing the realities of politics is necessary to change public policy?

4)Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.

  • Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?

5)Bought in to Win: We’re at FGA because we want to change policy. No one is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes, that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.

  • Do you fully support FGA’s mission and believe that lives are improved through work, not welfare, and that free markets create more freedom and opportunity than government control?

These values shape how we hire and how we work together. Expect to talk about them openly during the interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As State Government Affairs Associate (West), you will have four primary areas of responsibility:

1) Support the State Government Affairs Directors

  • Manage bill tracking, meeting follow-up, and back-end data.
  • Build and send the materials directors need for lawmakers and partners.

2) Represent FGA in the States

  • Join stakeholder and committee meetings at the direction of the Senior Director of State Affairs to advance FGA’s reforms.
  • Travel with directors on state trips to meet lawmakers and present FGA’s reforms.

3) Work with FGA’s In-State Contractors

  • Build working relationships with the in-state contractors in each director’s portfolio.
  • Join update and strategy calls and manage the follow-up.

4) Build State Plans and Session Reports

  • Work with the directors on pre-session plans for each state.
  • Draft post-session reports once the 2027 sessions close.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work.
  • Working knowledge of how bills move through a statehouse, from committee to the governor’s desk.
  • Strong communicator with lawmakers, partners, and teammates.
  • Comfortable using AI to speed up research, drafting, and data work. Quorum or other bill tracking experience a plus.
  • Live in or near the Western states region for frequent travel, especially during session.
  • Match FGA’s Core Values (described above).

TIMING, LOCATION, AND COMPENSATION

FGA is seeking to fill this position as soon as possible. Beyond travel to the states, expect legislative fly-ins and quarterly team meetings.

FGA’s headquarters are in Naples, FL, but nearly all of our staff work remotely from across the country. We build our systems and culture around clarity, flexibility, and strong communication. Key elements include:

  • Quarterly in-person team meetings at which you’ll build deeper relationships, set clear goals aligned with FGA’s big vision, and brainstorm how to seize new opportunities
  • An intensive 90-day orientation to familiarize you with the FGA team, our policies, and how we operate
  • Home office setup, including equipment and communication tools you need to hit the ground running

FGA offers a competitive salary between $90,000–$120,000, depending on experience and qualifications, along with a benefits package that includes a six percent retirement match, health benefits, and generous paid leave.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

jobs.description:
We're looking for an Investor Outreach Specialist to be the first voice real estate investors and homebuyers hear at a growing U.S. mortgage brokerage. You will call warm inbound leads who have asked about investment property or short-term rental financing, build trust quickly, qualify their goals and timeline, and book consultations with the mortgage team while you are still on the phone.

This is a relationship-first sales role, not a dialing-volume role. The leads are warm, and the quality of the conversation is what turns them into attended appointments and funded loans. You will not be reading a script. You will ask good questions, listen, handle objections naturally, and make people feel they are talking to a person who understands their plans. The licensed mortgage team handles loan terms and advice, and your job is to qualify interest and set up the consultation. If you naturally connect with people, think on your feet, and take ownership of results in a performance-driven environment, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Performance incentives on top of base pay, including commission for attended consultations and for funded loans from your appointments
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours, with the main calling window in the late afternoon and early evening Eastern Time
  • Work with a growing, relationship-focused brokerage serving real estate investors
  • Ongoing coaching, and a role where quality of conversation matters more than call counts

What You'll Work On

Warm Lead Conversations

  • Contact warm inbound leads who have requested information about investment properties or short-term rentals
  • Build trust and rapport within the first few minutes of every conversation
  • Ask thoughtful discovery questions to understand each prospect's goals and timeline
  • Handle common objections calmly and naturally without sounding scripted

Qualification and Booking

  • Qualify prospective borrowers and investors before scheduling appointments
  • Schedule qualified consultations directly on the mortgage specialist's calendar while still on the phone
  • Coordinate with the mortgage team to give them useful context before every consultation

Follow-Up and CRM

  • Maintain detailed, accurate CRM notes after every interaction
  • Follow structured follow-up sequences with prospects who are not ready yet
  • Keep pipeline records organized so nothing is lost between a first call and a funded loan

How Success Is Measured

  • High-quality conversations and qualified appointments booked
  • Appointment show rate
  • CRM accuracy, organization, and consistent follow-up
  • Professional communication and contribution to funded loans
  • Quality always comes before quantity

What You Bring

  • Fluent English with excellent verbal communication skills
  • A confident, warm, conversational voice that does not sound robotic or overly scripted
  • The ability to build rapport quickly with strangers, think on your feet, and adapt the conversation naturally
  • Strong questioning and listening skills
  • Calm, professional objection handling
  • Organized habits and a record of documenting every interaction accurately
  • Coachability: you learn quickly and enjoy feedback
  • Ownership of results and comfort in a performance-driven environment
  • Dependable, punctual, and highly professional
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet work environment
  • Available to work full-time during US business hours, including the late afternoon and early evening Eastern Time calling window

Nice to Have

  • Experience as an SDR, appointment setter, or in inside sales or high-ticket sales
  • Experience in real estate sales, the mortgage industry, loan processing, or real estate investing
  • Experience in business development, investor relations, or financial services
  • Experience with CRMs such as Bonzo, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or Salesforce

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself in your natural speaking voice, describing your sales or phone experience, and explaining how you would build trust in the first minute of a call with a stranger

Shortlisted candidates will take part in an initial interview and a live role-play over Zoom or Google Meet, where you handle a realistic prospect conversation. We are not looking for perfection or prior mortgage expertise. We are evaluating how you build rapport, think on your feet, ask good questions, and handle objections.

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you genuinely enjoy talking with people, can earn someone's trust quickly, and want a role where your communication skills directly drive your results, this role gives you the coaching and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.description:
Associate Director, AP New Course Product Development

College Board – AP&I

Location:

  • This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type:

  • This is a full-time term position that will last for 2 years from the start date.

About the Team

AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. With 40+ courses in a wide variety of subject areas, AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level.

Through the New Course Initiative, the AP Publications team is partnering with the larger AP Program to expand the course portfolio, with several new courses currently in development. The team consists of professionals with expertise in a variety of domains that are integral to the editorial development and production of AP course products. The team builds the publications that bring each new course to life: Course Frameworks (CFs), Course and Exam Descriptions (CEDs), Practice Exams (PEs), and teacher- and student-facing course resources such as project-based learning (PBL) implementation guides and project guides. The team partners closely with course experts, development committees, editors, and outside vendors to deliver clear, accurate, high-quality materials on schedule.

About the Opportunity

As Associate Director, AP New Course Product Development, you will play a key role in moving new AP course publications from early drafts through final page proofs. You will build and prepare turnover manuscripts for CFs, CEDs, and course resources; keep publication schedules accurate and visible to everyone who depends on them; plan and support meetings with course stakeholders; and serve as a reliable point of contact for AP colleagues and outside vendors. As priorities shift, you will also lend the same type of support to existing AP courses.

This is an ideal opportunity for a highly organized, detail-oriented early career professional who enjoys the craft of publishing, thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, and is motivated by mission-driven work in service of expanding access to college-level learning.

In this role, you will:

Build Manuscripts, Support Page Reviews, and Deliver Final Files for New Course Publications and Resources (40%)

  • Prepare and assemble turnover manuscripts for CFs, CEDs, PE, and course resources (PBL guides, project guides, and related materials) using approved templates, styles, and AP editorial conventions
  • Incorporate content, reviewer, and editorial revisions accurately across iterative drafts, maintaining clean version control
  • Track and prepare supporting elements, such as graphics requests, permissions, and sample exam item delivery, so manuscripts are complete at handoff
  • Perform quality checks, including copy-to-copy comparisons and consistency checks, before manuscripts move to editorial review or paging
  • Perform cross-check reviews of PDF page proofs to verify that edits from prior rounds were made accurately and completely
  • Consolidate stakeholder and leadership review comments onto a single revision PDF for the external vendor, flagging conflicting feedback for resolution and ensuring each edit is clear and actionable
  • Close the loop on each publication by delivering final approved content and files to the appropriate teams for posting

Manage Schedules and Coordinate Stakeholder Meetings (25%)

  • Track and maintain publication schedules for assigned new courses, keeping milestones, dependencies, and owners current in Smartsheet
  • Flag schedule risks early and propose options to keep milestones on track
  • Plan and coordinate meetings with key course stakeholders, including course experts and cross-divisional collaborators; prepare agendas and materials, capture notes, and follow up on action items
  • Document decisions in a shared, easy-to-find location so course teams can access current information independently

Maintain Stakeholder and Vendor Correspondence (20%)

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for AP stakeholders and outside vendors (such as compositors and production partners), ensuring consistent communication, tracking of deliverables, and clarity of ownership
  • Prepare turnovers, review requests, and revision instructions; confirm receipt and track turnaround times
  • Maintain correspondence and decision logs for each assigned course
  • Elevate issues to the appropriate lead and help steer them to resolution

Support Revised AP Courses and Continuous Improvement (15%)

  • Provide manuscript, page review, scheduling, and coordination support for revised AP courses as priorities and capacity require
  • Deliver final approved content and files for revised courses to the appropriate teams for posting
  • Ramp quickly into unfamiliar course content and conventions as assignments shift
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by building checklists, job aids, and templates, and by exploring approved generative AI tools that make manuscript work more efficient and consistent

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 3+ years of experience in publishing, editorial, or project coordination, ideally with educational materials, and a bachelor's degree
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and project coordination skills and the demonstrated ability to move forward multiple projects in concert while meeting timelines
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat, and Smartsheet (working knowledge of Adobe InDesign and SharePoint is preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills 
  • Strong attention to detail
  • A growth mindset and flexibility when working through ambiguity and shifting priorities in a dynamic, collaborative setting 
  • Ability to operate independently, anticipate needs, and take initiative while building strong partnerships across teams and levels of seniority 
  • The ability to travel 2-4 times per year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $56,000–$85,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.description:
SUMMARY:

The Investigative Services Unit Specialist is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on potential fraud cases and related investigative activities affecting AF Group. The primary function of the ISU Specialist is to detect and deter insurance fraud and to use developed knowledge, skills, and abilities to support the mission of AF Group and comply with state regulatory requirements. The Specialist will effectively manage day-to-day investigative assignments by providing timely, quality, and cost-effective investigative results to field staff. When potential fraud cases are identified, the Specialist will conduct thorough investigations, document results, coordinate mitigation strategies, make appropriate recommendations, and required notifications.

Under the direction of the ISU Director, this position is responsible for fraud investigations, compliance with state regulatory requirements, liaison with law enforcement, anti-fraud training, and ISU quality assurance. Investigations could include complex financial fraud and organized fraud-ring schemes. The ISU Specialist directs vendor investigations, examines investigative reports, reviews surveillance video, and determines if further investigation is warranted. The Investigative Specialist will review vendor invoices for accuracy and contract compliance. The Specialist collaborates with stakeholders to coordinate mitigation strategies and risk management. The ISU Specialist is responsible for educating internal and external customers on the department’s capabilities and effectiveness and provides training on reporting potential fraud.

RESPONSIBILITIES/TASKS:

  • Communicates and collaborates with departmental stakeholders to promote open lines of communication and appropriate referrals for investigation.
  • Assess, triage, and prioritize referrals received to develop investigative plan.
  • Direct, communicate, and manage work assigned to investigative vendors.
  • Analyze intelligence information and make determination for further investigation utilizing available resources, knowledge of fraud schemes and investigation strategies.
  • Conduct investigations to include desk and field investigations, and interviews of involved parties. Obtain, review, and analyze relevant documents and records.
  • Fraud investigations conducted to include claimants, medical and ancillary providers, premium avoidance, and other schemes related to workers compensation, property, casualty, commercial auto, trucking, and surplus coverage.
  • Coordinate and direct onsite investigation of catastrophic claim incidents as requested by claim adjustors.
  • Prepares comprehensive investigation reports and documents all findings and developments in the case management system.
  • Comply with all state regulations related to reporting potential fraud.
  • Conducts follow-up on fraud referrals and monitors the status of a case through prosecution. Testifies in court proceedings when required.
  • Responds to subpoena and other external record requests in accordance with AF Group procedures.
  • Determines loss incurred and seek restitution or civil recovery.
  • Assesses investigative results to determine savings achieved.
  • Establishes and maintains external relationships with law enforcement, trade organizations and others involved in the investigation of insurance fraud.
  • Consistently monitors workflows to maximize efficiency.
  • Monitor vendor performance standards and service levels. May make recommendations for metrics used to measure vendor performance.
  • Analyzes trends and completes comprehensive and detailed reports.
  • Reconcile vendor billing and follow up with accounts payable/vendors regarding vendor accounting issues.
  • Evaluates training needs and designs and develops training modules, materials and evaluations related to fraud for internal and external customers as needed.
  • Maintains up-to-date technical knowledge of investigative core functions.
  • Deliver presentations as needed.
  • Use independent judgment in all areas of responsibility, while considering department and division priorities.
  • Coordinates with enterprise companies in the development and management of ISU.
  • Additional duties and projects assigned.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the job. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

EMPLOYMENT QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION OR EQUIVALENT EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree in business, criminal justice, law enforcement, insurance, or related field of education required. Knowledge of insurance fraud and other relevant civil and criminal laws is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of degree, preference given to degree. Continuous learning required, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy. Certification, or progress toward, highly preferred and encouraged.

EXPERIENCE:

With proper education credentials, minimum of seven years of law enforcement and/or insurance claims investigations required. Workers’ compensation experience and/or experience in a property/casualty insurance organization preferred.

SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES (SKA) REQUIRED:

  1. Strong interpersonal and superior communication skills Must be customer oriented and able to represent the department in meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
  2. Strong writing skills with proven ability to synthesize and document complex case investigation results and prepare presentations.
  3. Demonstrated leadership abilities.
  4. Ability to work independently and collaborate on group projects.
  5. Strong knowledge of laws, regulations, and compliance requirements related to insurance.
  6. Demonstrated technical knowledge of insurance administration, claims management, or relevant insurance expertise.
  7. Strong background in word processing, spreadsheets, and graphics programs required with knowledge of Microsoft applications preferred.
  8. Ability to analyze and synthesize large data sets and complex policy, financial and medical records.
  9. Ability to analyze and interpret documents for accuracy in reference to technical, legal, and financial information.
  10. Ability to effectively exchange information clearly and concisely, present ideas, report facts, and other information, and respond to questions as appropriate, both in oral and written communications.
  11. Ability to quickly make decisions and comprehend the consequences of various problem situations and take appropriate actions and/or refer problems for necessary decision making.
  12. Ability to organize and prioritize multiple assignments.
  13. Ability to maintain confidentiality,
  14. Ability to perform other assignments at locations outside the office.
  15. Ability to work with minimal supervision.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work is performed in a home setting with no unusual hazards. Occasional travel required. Must possess a valid driver’s license with a record that meets corporate standards. Work is required at various times of the day and sometimes weekend work may be required.

PAY RANGE:
Actual compensation decision relies on the consideration of internal equity, candidate’s skills and professional experience, geographic location, market, and other potential factors. It is not standard practice for an offer to be at or near the top of the range, and therefore a reasonable estimate for this role is between $73,600 - $123,200.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment in any form. Candidates for the position stated above are hired on an "at will" basis. Nothing herein is intended to create a contract.

#AFG

The qualifications listed above are intended to represent the minimum education, experience, skills, knowledge, and ability levels associated with performing the duties and responsibilities contained in this job description.

jobs.description:
Freight Dispatcher — Load Exceptions & Service Recovery

Full-Time | Remote — United States | U.S. Freight Operations

When Freight Plans Change, Keep the Operation Moving

We are hiring a Freight Dispatcher — Load Exceptions & Service Recovery to support U.S. trucking operations with a focus on shipment delays, service exceptions, changing appointments, driver communication, and operational follow-up.

Freight does not always move according to the original plan. Drivers encounter facility delays, appointment changes, traffic, weather, equipment problems, Hours-of-Service limitations, and other situations that require accurate information and timely coordination.

This position may be a strong fit for transportation professionals, including experienced or former CDL-A drivers, who understand how quickly operating conditions can change and how important clear communication becomes when they do.

Previous employment specifically under the title of Freight Dispatcher is not required. Applicants must have relevant U.S. trucking, transportation, logistics, fleet, or closely related operational experience.

Load Exception Management

  • Monitor active freight for delays, missed check-ins, appointment changes, and service exceptions.
  • Identify missing information and determine what additional details are needed.
  • Gather accurate updates from drivers, brokers, shippers, receivers, and authorized transportation personnel.
  • Document delays and changing shipment conditions promptly.
  • Identify situations requiring operational, safety, compliance, or management escalation.
  • Maintain clear records of outstanding issues and required follow-up.
  • Continue monitoring assigned exceptions until the appropriate operational action has been completed.

Service Recovery & Coordination

  • Assist with coordinating revised pickup or delivery appointments when authorized.
  • Communicate verified changes to drivers and applicable transportation personnel.
  • Evaluate how delays may affect subsequent appointments or freight assignments.
  • Assist with identifying workable next steps when an original transportation plan changes.
  • Coordinate routine recovery actions within assigned authority.
  • Escalate decisions requiring additional authorization.
  • Avoid making commitments regarding freight, appointments, rates, or service outcomes outside assigned authority.

Driver & Broker Communication

  • Communicate professionally with U.S. CDL-A drivers, freight brokers, shippers, receivers, and transportation personnel.
  • Request accurate driver and shipment-status information.
  • Communicate verified appointment and operational changes.
  • Maintain professional telephone, email, and digital communication.
  • Document significant communications and outstanding actions.
  • Escalate broker-verification, safety, service, documentation, or compliance concerns when appropriate.

Freight & Load Support

  • Use DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable U.S. freight load boards when assigned.
  • Review available freight according to lane, equipment type, mileage, appointments, and operating requirements.
  • Calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, total trip mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Consider driver availability and Hours of Service when evaluating alternative freight options.
  • Present appropriate freight information for authorized review and booking.
  • Negotiate freight rates only when specifically authorized.

Transportation Documentation

  • Maintain accurate load and dispatch records.
  • Review rate confirmations and applicable shipment instructions.
  • Maintain bills of lading, proof-of-delivery documents, and related transportation records.
  • Document appointment changes, delays, detention, layover, TONU, and other applicable freight exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate communication histories and operational notes.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent information requiring follow-up.

Required Transportation Background

Relevant professional experience may include:

  • CDL-A truck driving
  • Freight dispatch support
  • Fleet operations
  • Carrier operations
  • Transportation coordination
  • Logistics operations
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Shipment tracking
  • Load planning
  • Comparable U.S. trucking operations

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Ability to recognize and manage routine transportation exceptions.
  • Familiarity with U.S. freight load boards.
  • Understanding of pickup and delivery appointments.
  • Working knowledge of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Ability to calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Ability to communicate calmly and accurately during changing transportation conditions.
  • Fluent professional spoken and written English.
  • Strong professional telephone and email communication.
  • Strong organization, documentation, and follow-up skills.
  • Computer and spreadsheet proficiency.
  • Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Helpful Additional Experience

Experience with shipment tracking, ELD systems, detention and layover documentation, TONU situations, appointment rescheduling, transportation-management systems, broker verification, freight documentation, or active-load exception management is beneficial.

Work Arrangement & Schedule

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. freight operations.

Primary hiring location: Columbus, Ohio, United States.
Hiring market: Remote — United States.

Qualified applicants may be considered throughout the United States.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align.
