jobs.title: Real Estate Executive VA - Administrative Operations & CRM Support
jobs.excerpt: ROLE TITLEReal Estate Executive VA - Administrative Operations & CRM SupportReady to be the person who keeps three busy real estate partners organized, their leads moving, and their business running smoothly behind the scenes?
jobs.description:
ROLE TITLE

Real Estate Executive VA - Administrative Operations & CRM Support

Ready to be the person who keeps three busy real estate partners organized, their leads moving, and their business running smoothly behind the scenes?

We're looking for a sharp, proactive, and experienced Real Estate Executive VA who can take ownership of administrative operations, manage Compass CRM, and ensure important opportunities don't get lost in the day-to-day workload.

If you know your way around Compass, can manage multiple moving pieces without constant reminders, and take pride in keeping every lead, follow-up, document, and task accounted for, this could be your next role.

Pro tip: Applications that include a short introduction video highlighting your real estate experience and hands-on Compass CRM background are strongly encouraged. Be prepared to demonstrate your actual Compass knowledge during the selection process.

This is a fully remote role supporting a U.S.-based residential real estate team. You'll communicate professionally with three managing partners and coordinate closely with their existing ISA and Transaction Coordinator during the client's designated U.S. business hours.

This is not an entry-level real estate VA position. STK will provide orientation on its internal processes and team procedures, but will not provide foundational Compass training. You must have actual, hands-on experience using Compass CRM and be able to work with it confidently from the start. Candidates without this experience should not apply.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Executive and Administrative Support

  • When emails and correspondence arrive for the three managing partners, review, organize, prioritize, and flag items requiring their attention.
  • Draft routine client and business communications for review or coordination, using the team's established communication practices.
  • When appointments, meetings, or scheduling requests arise, coordinate calendars and communicate scheduling details to the appropriate people.
  • Track pending administrative assignments, identify approaching deadlines, and follow up before outstanding items become overdue.
  • Maintain organized records, business documents, and operational information so the partners can retrieve what they need without searching through scattered communications.
  • When routine administrative needs arise, identify the next action and handle it within your authority instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions.
  • Escalate matters requiring a managing partner's judgment rather than making unauthorized client, business, or transaction decisions.

2. Compass CRM Management and Administration

  • Independently navigate and operate Compass CRM and the associated Compass platforms used by the team.
  • When new contacts, prospects, or leads enter the business, create or update the appropriate CRM records and maintain accurate contact information.
  • Monitor leads generated through website inquiries, QR codes, property signage, and other sources.
  • When a lead enters the CRM, review its available information, maintain the appropriate record, and ensure the required follow-up activity is documented.
  • Create and manage CRM tasks, reminders, activities, and follow-up records according to established workflows.
  • Maintain contact notes and communication histories so the managing partners can understand previous interactions and outstanding next steps.
  • Set up buyer property searches and appropriate notifications using the team's established Compass workflows.
  • Support the team's existing CRM processes and ensure that leads, contact records, and follow-up activities are not left incomplete.
  • Review assigned CRM records for missing information, outdated details, and outstanding activities, and correct issues within your authority.

Mandatory execution standard: You must already know how to use Compass CRM in a real estate operating environment. General CRM experience, familiarity with other real estate platforms, or willingness to learn Compass does not meet this requirement.

3. Lead Management and Follow-Up Coordination

  • Monitor incoming buyer and seller inquiries and ensure they are recorded and directed to the appropriate real estate partner.
  • Organize prospects according to their current status, interaction history, and required follow-up.
  • When prospects are not immediately ready to transact, maintain their follow-up schedules and coordinate longer-term nurturing activities.
  • Assist with approved email outreach and client communications.
  • Maintain follow-up schedules for networking contacts, referrals, and prospective clients.
  • When a prospect requires partner involvement, communicate the relevant context and next action rather than simply forwarding an unorganized contact record.
  • Track assigned follow-up activities and identify overdue or missed engagements before they become neglected leads.
  • Maintain consistent engagement throughout the sales pipeline using the team's approved processes.

This role requires active follow-through. Updating a CRM record without ensuring that its required next action is accounted for is not sufficient.

4. Inside Sales Agent (ISA) Support

  • When the ISA requires prospecting information, research and compile relevant contact lists for the team's existing lead-generation activities.
  • Prepare organized prospect lists covering potential sellers, distressed properties, builders, attorneys, and other relevant real estate contacts.
  • Maintain accurate prospect information and corresponding lead records in Compass CRM.
  • Coordinate prospect list delivery, corrections, and updates with the existing ISA.
  • Track administrative aspects of lead-generation activities and maintain the information needed for reporting.

Scope clarification: You are supporting the ISA's administrative and prospecting requirements. You are not replacing the team's existing cold-calling function.

5. Real Estate Listing and Buyer Support

  • When new property listings need administrative preparation, enter and update listing information using the team's approved systems.
  • Organize property details, listing information, and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain listing records and make administrative updates as required.
  • When a prospective buyer needs property options, set up and maintain the appropriate buyer searches in Compass.
  • Prepare real estate forms, contracts, and related documentation using approved templates and under the appropriate supervision.
  • Coordinate required information and document handoffs with the existing Transaction Coordinator.
  • Monitor administrative requirements associated with new listings and buyer inquiries, and follow up on missing information or incomplete handoffs.
  • Keep administrative records organized so that listing and buyer-related work can progress without avoidable documentation delays.

6. Email Marketing and Client Nurturing

  • Assist with creating, scheduling, and managing email marketing campaigns.
  • Build and maintain email nurturing sequences using Flodesk and other approved platforms.
  • Organize client and prospect lists for targeted communications.
  • Support email blasts, action plans, and recurring client engagement campaigns.
  • Execute approved marketing workflows and configure practical automation for repetitive communications where applicable.
  • Coordinate campaign content and scheduling with the team.
  • Maintain accurate audience lists and follow the team's approved campaign instructions.

7. Process Execution and Workflow Improvement

  • Follow the team's established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) when completing recurring administrative and operational activities.
  • Execute documented workflows consistently rather than creating individual workarounds that bypass established procedures.
  • When repetitive administrative work creates unnecessary manual effort, identify the activity and suggest practical opportunities for automation or process improvement.
  • Use approved AI-assisted tools, including Claude where applicable, to improve administrative efficiency.
  • Maintain operational checklists and tracking systems used to monitor recurring responsibilities.
  • Coordinate with Scale Virtually's Process Engineering Team when process updates or workflow adjustments are required.
  • Communicate workflow issues when existing instructions are incomplete, conflicting, or preventing accurate execution.

8. Reporting and Accountability

  • Submit structured Start-of-Day (SOD) and End-of-Day (EOD) reports.
  • At the start of the workday, communicate priorities and identify outstanding items requiring attention.
  • At the end of the workday, report completed activities, pending tasks, and outstanding follow-ups.
  • Maintain visibility into CRM updates, lead management activities, and important administrative responsibilities.
  • Track assigned work through completion and communicate potential delays before deadlines are affected.
  • Escalate urgent matters to the appropriate managing partner promptly.
  • Keep communication clear and specific so the partners can identify what has been completed, what remains outstanding, and where their involvement is needed.

REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

Candidates must meet ALL of the following:

  1. Hands-on Compass experience: Previous direct experience using Compass's real estate platforms, particularly Compass CRM, in an actual real estate working environment. Experience with other CRMs alone does not qualify.
  2. Immediate Compass readiness: Able to independently perform relevant Compass CRM activities without foundational platform training.
  3. Relevant real estate experience: Previous work as a Real Estate Virtual Assistant, Real Estate Executive Assistant, or Real Estate Administrative Assistant.
  4. Residential real estate knowledge: Understands residential real estate terminology and administrative workflows, including buyer inquiries, seller prospects, property listings, and transaction-related documentation.
  5. CRM and lead management: Has personally maintained CRM records, organized leads, documented interactions, and coordinated follow-up activities.
  6. Listing and buyer administration: Has experience supporting property listing administration and buyer-related workflows.
  7. Executive support capability: Can support multiple executives while keeping priorities, communications, and task ownership organized.
  8. Independent execution: Can complete established administrative workflows without daily instructions, constant checking, or repeated reminders.
  9. Professional English communication: Can communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English with managing partners, prospects, the ISA, and the Transaction Coordinator.
  10. Recordkeeping accuracy: Maintains accurate contact records, notes, documents, follow-up tasks, and operational information.
  11. SOP compliance: Can follow documented processes and identify when clarification or escalation is necessary.
  12. Professional judgment: Can handle sensitive client information discreetly and recognize when a matter requires partner approval.

Important: Candidates who have never used Compass CRM hands-on will not proceed, regardless of their general real estate VA experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting a multi-agent residential real estate team.
  • Experience using Flodesk or similar email marketing platforms.
  • Familiarity with Claude or other AI-assisted productivity tools.
  • Experience with lead nurturing campaigns and CRM automation.
  • Previous coordination with Inside Sales Agents and Transaction Coordinators.
  • Familiarity with buyer searches, MLS-related workflows, and listing administration.
  • Experience working within structured, process-driven real estate organizations.

TOOLS

Required proficiency:

  • Compass CRM
  • Associated Compass real estate platforms used by the team

Additional platforms and tools:

  • Flodesk
  • Claude
  • Other approved AI-assisted productivity tools
  • Other approved email marketing and administrative platforms

Candidates must distinguish between tools they have actually used and tools they have only encountered or studied.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

  • You can use Compass without being taught the basics. You have performed real CRM work and can explain exactly how you managed contacts, leads, activities, and buyer searches.
  • You close administrative loops. When a lead needs follow-up, a document is missing, or an appointment needs coordination, you track it until the next required action is completed or properly escalated.
  • You can manage three partners without creating three times the supervision. You organize competing priorities and make routine decisions within your authority.
  • Your CRM records are reliable. The partners and ISA can look at a record and understand the prospect's history, current status, and next action.
  • You communicate problems before they become operational failures. You do not wait until a missed deadline or neglected lead becomes someone else's emergency.
  • You execute consistently and improve intelligently. You follow SOPs, maintain reporting discipline, and identify practical opportunities to reduce repetitive work.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • This is not a general virtual assistant position for someone whose only experience is calendar management, inbox management, or basic data entry.
  • This is not a Compass training opportunity. Candidates who need someone to teach them how Compass CRM works are not qualified.
  • This is not an Inside Sales Agent or cold-calling position. The team already has an ISA.
  • This is not a Transaction Coordinator position. You will support listing and buyer administration and coordinate documentation handoffs with the existing Transaction Coordinator.
  • This is not a passive administrative role. You are expected to own assigned workflows, monitor outstanding tasks, and follow through without constant supervision.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Work Arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Employment Structure: Virtual Assistant / independent contractor engagement.
  • Preferred Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week.
  • Alternative Schedule: Part-time, 20 hours per week, may be considered.
  • Working Hours: Must be available during STK's designated U.S. business hours. The applicable U.S. time zone and agreed schedule will be confirmed during engagement.
  • Weekend Availability: May be requested depending on operational requirements and the mutually agreed schedule.
  • Work Environment: Performance-driven, remote, and process-oriented. The role requires consistent communication, structured reporting, independent task ownership, and coordination across multiple team members.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Applications must demonstrate actual, hands-on Compass experience.

Please submit:

  1. Your updated resume, including the real estate teams or professionals you have supported and the administrative responsibilities you personally handled.
  2. A description of your direct experience with Compass CRM. Specify how you used it to manage contacts, incoming leads, follow-up tasks, buyer searches, and listing administration.
  3. The approximate duration and context of your Compass experience. State whether you used Compass directly in a professional role or only encountered it through training or demonstrations.
  4. Your experience supporting multiple real estate agents, partners, or executives.
  5. Your experience with Flodesk, email nurturing, lead management, and coordination with ISAs or Transaction Coordinators.
  6. Your availability for 20 or 40 hours per week and your ability to work during the client's designated U.S. business hours.

Compass proficiency will be validated during recruitment through a practical assessment using a permitted demonstration environment or a scenario-based walkthrough. Candidates must be able to explain their actual platform experience. STK will not provide foundational Compass software training.

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

Success in this role will be evaluated through observable execution:

  1. Immediate Compass readiness: Performs assigned Compass-related activities independently without basic platform instruction.
  2. Administrative efficiency: Reliably assumes recurring administrative responsibilities from all three managing partners.
  3. CRM accuracy: Maintains complete, accurate, and organized contact and prospect records.
  4. Lead follow-up consistency: Ensures assigned leads have documented follow-up activities and appropriate next steps.
  5. Operational reliability: Completes assigned work on schedule and escalates issues before they affect operations.
  6. Communication: Coordinates effectively with the managing partners, ISA, and Transaction Coordinator.
  7. Process compliance: Follows established workflows, documentation standards, and reporting requirements.

POSITION OBJECTIVE

Provide STK's three managing partners with a dependable, experienced, Compass-proficient Real Estate Executive VA who can immediately take ownership of recurring administrative operations, maintain reliable CRM records, coordinate lead management, and support listing and buyer administration.

The intended result is fewer administrative interruptions for the partners, more consistent prospect follow-up, reliable operational records, and stronger execution across the team's existing real estate workflows.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • HMO
  • Fully Remote Work

This role supports the research mission of the University of Miami, MSOM, and the goals of the Executive Dean for Research Office. Applicants must have relevant federal grant administration experience with federal sponsors such as: NIH, DOD, NSF, to be considered for this role.


The Senior Manager, Sponsored Programs directs and oversees all administrative and financial aspects of the Sponsored Programs division at the assigned facilities. The Senior Manager, Sponsored Programs operates with the goals of increasing sponsored funding levels and the output of funding proposal, as well as maximizing the use and efficacy of existing research funding dollars. Department Specific Functions

Bachelor’s degree in relevant field

Minimum 7 years of relevant experience.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, product marketing plays an important role in connecting what we build with the businesses that use it. We value clear communication, a strong understanding of our customers, and the ability to turn complex product capabilities into practical value.

About the Role

We're looking for an Associate Product Marketing Manager, New Grad to support product marketing initiatives across Bask Health's software platform.

This is an entry-level opportunity for someone who is interested in the intersection of technology, business, customer research, and marketing.

You'll help our team communicate what Bask Health's products do, why they matter, and how customers can use them to build and manage their telehealth businesses.

You'll work with experienced product marketers and collaborate with product managers, engineers, designers, sales, customer success, and other internal stakeholders.

You'll gain exposure to different areas of the Bask Health platform, including merchant tools, website creation, clinical and pharmacy workflows, AI-enabled features, analytics, and monetization capabilities.

A major part of this role will involve learning how our products work and translating that understanding into clear, accurate customer-facing materials.

You'll support the development of product messaging, feature descriptions, launch announcements, presentations, and educational resources.

You'll help research our customers, including entrepreneurs, e-commerce businesses, healthcare providers, and organizations building direct-to-consumer telehealth experiences.

You'll learn how different customers evaluate software platforms, what problems they're trying to solve, and which capabilities matter most to them.

You'll conduct competitive research to understand how other SaaS, e-commerce, and healthcare technology companies position their products.

You'll help organize research findings into summaries that product marketing and other teams can use.

You'll support product launches by coordinating deliverables, preparing draft materials, tracking timelines, and gathering feedback from stakeholders.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior UX Researcher, Patient & Provider Experience to lead research that helps Bask Health better understand the needs, behaviors, and challenges of patients and healthcare providers using our platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient onboarding, digital questionnaires, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools.

These experiences involve different types of users with different goals. Patients need to navigate digital healthcare experiences clearly and confidently, while providers need efficient, reliable workflows that support their responsibilities.

As a Senior UX Researcher, you'll help us understand how these users interact with the platform, where they experience friction, and what opportunities exist to improve the product.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role that combines qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, behavioral analysis, and product strategy. You'll own research projects from defining questions and selecting methodologies through participant recruitment, study execution, analysis, and communication of findings.

Your work will focus on patient and provider experiences, including onboarding, intake questionnaires, clinical workflow interfaces, patient communications, and other interactions that influence usability and operational efficiency.

You'll conduct interviews, usability studies, concept testing, surveys, and observational research to understand user needs and evaluate existing or proposed product experiences.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, product designers, engineers, content designers, and operational stakeholders to ensure research addresses meaningful product questions and informs decisions throughout development.

You'll also help connect qualitative findings with available product analytics and operational data, giving teams a clearer understanding of both what users do and why they do it.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, research must be conducted with appropriate attention to privacy, informed participation, sensitive information, and the boundaries of approved clinical workflows.

You'll help establish repeatable research practices, maintain organized findings, and make insights accessible to teams across the company.

We're looking for a researcher who is comfortable navigating complex product environments, can independently lead studies, and knows how to turn user evidence into practical recommendations that improve real experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end UX research for patient-facing and provider-facing experiences across Bask Health.
  • Develop research plans that address product questions, user needs, and business objectives.
  • Conduct qualitative interviews with patients, providers, and other authorized research participants.
  • Plan and execute moderated and unmoderated usability studies.
  • Evaluate patient onboarding, intake questionnaires, and multi-step digital workflows.
  • Research provider experiences involving clinical and administrative platform tools.
  • Conduct concept testing to evaluate proposed product features and interaction patterns.
  • Develop surveys and structured feedback methods to understand user needs.
  • Use observational research to identify workflow inefficiencies and usability problems.
  • Analyze qualitative findings to identify patterns, motivations, and unmet needs.
  • Incorporate quantitative product data where appropriate to strengthen research conclusions.
  • Develop research questions, hypotheses, and study objectives in collaboration with product teams.
  • Recruit and screen appropriate research participants using approved processes.
  • Create interview guides, usability tasks, and research discussion materials.
  • Evaluate navigation, terminology, comprehension, and task completion across digital experiences.
  • Identify sources of confusion, unnecessary friction, and workflow abandonment.
  • Research how patients understand instructions, status updates, and next steps.
  • Study how providers interact with platform tools during approved operational workflows.
  • Develop journey maps, research summaries, and evidence-based opportunity assessments.
  • Present findings and recommendations to product managers, designers, engineers, and leadership.
  • Collaborate with product designers to validate concepts and improve proposed solutions.
  • Work with content designers to evaluate language comprehension and information clarity.
  • Partner with product managers to prioritize research opportunities.
  • Support iterative testing throughout product development and after feature launches.
  • Help establish research standards, documentation practices, and reusable study templates.
  • Maintain organized research findings and make insights accessible to relevant teams.
  • Ensure research activities respect participant privacy, consent, and appropriate data-handling requirements.
  • Independently own complex research initiatives from planning through synthesis and actionable recommendations.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in UX research, user research, product research, human-computer interaction, or a closely related field.

  • Experience recruiting and screening research participants.
  • Strong understanding of research ethics and participant consent.
  • Experience synthesizing qualitative findings into actionable insights.
  • Ability to identify behavioral patterns, usability problems, and unmet user needs.
  • Familiarity with user-centered design and product development processes.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product designers and product managers.
  • Ability to communicate research findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: As a Security Engineer at Stacks Labs, you'll work with the CTO to help building secure systems, including the sBTC signer network, the Stacks node, our smart contracts, and the infrastructure and release pipeline that ship them.
jobs.description:
As a Security Engineer at Stacks Labs, you'll work with the CTO to help building secure systems, including the sBTC signer network, the Stacks node, our smart contracts, and the infrastructure and release pipeline that ship them.

You'll operate autonomously in a fully remote role, embedded with a globally distributed engineering team. This is a hands-on role for someone who would rather find and fix the bug instead of writing a slide about it.

Outcomes You'll Drive

  • We find our vulnerabilities before anyone else does
    You hunt through code, infrastructure, and deployments with an attacker's mindset. The things you find get triaged, remediated, fixed.
  • Security that ships as code
    Your work produces pull requests, hardened configs, detection rules, and tests. Engineers see you as someone who makes their systems better, not someone who slows them down.
  • A hardened perimeter where it matters
    Key custody, secrets management, access control, CI/CD, and the software supply chain are locked down against the realistic threats to a system securing crypto-assets.
  • An AI-augmented security practice
    LLMs and coding agents multiply your reach across code review, fuzzing, triage, and log analysis. You know exactly where they help, where they lie, and how to build systems that leverage them to scale things up.
  • Calm, rehearsed incident response
    When something goes wrong there's a playbook, a clear owner, and a blameless postmortem that leaves the system stronger than before.

What You'll Do

Offense

  • Threat model and attack our software, infrastructure, and contracts. Write exploits against our own systems before adversaries do.
  • Build and run fuzzing, property-based, and adversarial test harnesses.
  • Run internal red-team exercises and coordinate external audits and bug bounty programs, triaging and validating what comes back.

Defense

  • Detection and monitoring: what does "compromised" look like, and how do we know within minutes rather than days?
  • Harden hosts, CI/CD, and the software supply chain. Audit dependencies and design reproducible builds and signed/attested releases.
  • Support incident response and post-incident reviews.

Engineering & Tooling

  • Review security-sensitive PRs across the codebase and pair with engineers on secure design.
  • Build AI-driven security tooling: agents for code review and dependency triage, LLM-assisted log analysis, automated first-pass audits of new contracts and integrations.
  • Write clear, actionable findings and advisories for internal teams, external signers, and partners.

What We're Looking For

  • Security is what you do for fun, not just for work. CTFs, bug bounties, side research, reading advisories at breakfast.
  • 5+ years in software engineering and ****a meaningful portion of it in security. Red team, blue team, appsec, detection engineering, or security research.
  • Solid programming foundation. You read and write production code (Rust, Go, C, TypeScript, Python, or similar), and you understand systems, networking, and cryptography.
  • Hands-on offensive or defensive experience: exploit development, pentesting, incident response, detection engineering, or hardening production systems.
  • Pragmatism. You measure yourself in closed attack paths and shipped fixes. You know risk matrices exist, but you don't lead with them.
  • Fluency with AI tooling. You use LLMs and coding agents daily in security work, you've built something with them, and you have grounded opinions about their failure modes.
  • Strong written communication. Findings, advisories, and design reviews that people actually read and act on.
  • Comfort working remotely and autonomously across time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Expertise in Rust, our primary language.
  • Bitcoin protocol internals, or experience auditing smart contracts (Clarity, Solidity, or similar).
  • Threshold signatures, MPC, or applied cryptography.
  • Security of distributed systems and consensus protocols.
  • Cloud and infrastructure security.
  • Experience building AI agents for security workflows, or securing systems that integrate LLMs.
  • A public track record: CVEs, published research, notable CTF placings, or bug bounty history.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation including $160,000-$200,000 USD base salary.
  • Stacks (STX) tokens - STX is the native cryptocurrency of the Stacks network.
  • Comprehensive health coverage and free life and disability insurance.
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave to support you through one of life's biggest transitions.
  • Monthly stipends for your home office or co-working space of choice.
  • Annual learning and development stipend to keep growing your skills.
  • An open vacation policy, take the days you need when you need.
  • 401(k) with a 3% match.
  • A high-ownership role shaping some of the most critical infrastructure in the Stacks ecosystem.
  • A fast-moving, focused team where strong engineering judgment is valued and where your work will ship quickly and visibly.
  • The chance to define engineering standards for one of the most ambitious Bitcoin L2 ecosystems, shaping how Bitcoin moves in and out of smart contracts.
  • A remote-first culture with flexibility, autonomy, and deep collaboration with product and engineering.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, we understand that helping a customer launch is only the beginning. Long-term success comes from helping businesses adopt the platform, understand its capabilities, and continue getting value as their operations evolve. We value people who take initiative, understand how online businesses work, build strong relationships, and identify practical ways to improve customer retention.

About the Role

We're looking for a Merchant Adoption & Retention Manager to help e-commerce businesses successfully adopt Bask Health's telehealth platform, maintain consistent engagement, and continue seeing value from the software.

This is a hands-on post-sale customer success position with a specialized focus on merchant activation, adoption, retention, and reducing preventable customer churn.

You'll work with entrepreneurs, online merchants, and growing businesses to understand how they use Bask Health, where they encounter challenges, and what support they need to remain successful.

You'll help identify the factors that contribute to strong customer engagement and the warning signs that a merchant may be struggling or considering leaving.

Bask Health provides software that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a strong understanding of the merchant-facing platform experience and the steps involved in successfully adopting supported capabilities.

You'll work with merchants at different stages of their customer lifecycle.

You'll help recently onboarded merchants transition from initial setup into active platform usage.

You'll identify situations where customers have completed onboarding but are not consistently using the platform.

You'll help merchants understand the next practical steps they can take to improve adoption.

You'll work with Customer Success Managers and other internal teams to identify obstacles that may be limiting customer engagement.

You'll help develop structured adoption plans based on each merchant's business goals and current platform usage.

You'll provide approved guidance on platform capabilities that may be relevant to a merchant's needs.

You'll recognize that different merchants have different business models, operating experience, and growth priorities.

You'll adapt your communication and support approach based on the customer's level of experience and business needs.

You'll build relationships with entrepreneurs, founders, and business owners.

You'll take time to understand what each merchant is trying to accomplish with Bask Health.

You'll identify whether a merchant's challenges relate to product understanding, operational processes, technical issues, or unmet expectations.

You'll work with the appropriate teams to address those challenges.

You'll proactively engage merchants who appear to be struggling with activation or ongoing adoption.

You'll help customers understand how supported platform workflows fit into their business operations.

You'll coordinate with onboarding and customer success teams to improve transitions between customer lifecycle stages.

You'll identify recurring onboarding issues that may lead to long-term disengagement.

You'll share practical recommendations for improving the merchant onboarding experience.

You'll work with customers to identify realistic next steps for addressing their concerns.

You'll help identify customers who could benefit from adopting additional existing platform capabilities.

You'll recommend relevant adoption opportunities based on actual merchant needs.

You'll focus on sustainable customer engagement rather than unnecessary upselling.

You'll work with product and engineering teams to communicate recurring adoption barriers.

You'll identify patterns in customer feedback that may indicate opportunities for product improvements.

You'll contribute to customer education resources that make it easier for merchants to use supported platform features.

You'll help improve onboarding guides, adoption checklists, and merchant-facing instructional materials.

You'll participate in developing repeatable engagement and retention playbooks.

You'll help identify effective communication strategies for merchants at different stages of their lifecycle.

You'll contribute ideas for re-engaging inactive or low-engagement customers.

You'll help distinguish between customers who need additional education and those experiencing broader product or business challenges.

You'll work with customer success leadership to prioritize retention initiatives.

You'll help identify opportunities to improve customer lifecycle processes.

You'll contribute to the development of practical customer health indicators.

You'll help track metrics such as activation progress, feature adoption, customer engagement, churn risk, and retention.

You'll use available customer data to identify patterns and recommend appropriate actions.

You'll help prepare summaries of adoption trends and recurring retention concerns.

You'll contribute to discussions about customer churn reasons and opportunities to prevent avoidable cancellations.

You'll help improve how the team documents and categorizes customer disengagement.

You'll participate in customer business reviews when adoption or retention concerns require additional attention.

Benefits

  • Recent, substantive experience working with e-commerce merchants, online stores, or merchant-facing commerce software.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Researcher to help Bask Health better understand how people use our software, what challenges they experience, and where opportunities exist to build better products.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools.

As a Product Researcher, you'll investigate the needs, behaviors, and expectations of the people who interact with these products. Your findings will help inform product strategy, feature development, workflow improvements, and design decisions.

This is a hands-on research role combining qualitative and quantitative methods, product discovery, usability evaluation, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll help teams understand both what users are doing and why they behave the way they do.

Your work will span multiple areas of Bask Health's platform. You may research how merchants configure their businesses, how patients navigate onboarding, how users interact with complex workflows, or how new product concepts address existing problems.

You'll conduct user interviews, surveys, usability studies, concept evaluations, and other research activities to identify unmet needs and evaluate product experiences.

You'll also help connect research findings with available product analytics, customer feedback, and operational observations. By combining different sources of evidence, you'll help teams distinguish isolated complaints from recurring problems and meaningful product opportunities.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers to define research questions, prioritize studies, and identify where additional evidence is needed before making product decisions.

You'll work with product designers and content designers to evaluate prototypes, improve usability, and validate whether proposed solutions address actual user needs.

You'll also partner with engineers and customer-facing teams to understand technical constraints, recurring support issues, and the operational context behind product behavior.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, research must be conducted with appropriate attention to privacy, participant consent, sensitive information, and the boundaries of approved clinical workflows.

You'll help document research findings, organize insights, and make recommendations accessible to teams across the company.

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable working with different types of users, and able to turn research evidence into practical recommendations that help teams build better software.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct product research across Bask Health's merchant-facing, patient-facing, and operational software experiences.
  • Partner with product managers to identify research questions and product discovery priorities.
  • Develop research plans that align with product goals and user needs.
  • Conduct user interviews to understand behaviors, motivations, and challenges.
  • Plan and execute moderated and unmoderated usability studies.
  • Design surveys and structured feedback activities.
  • Evaluate new product concepts before development.
  • Test prototypes to identify usability problems and opportunities for improvement.
  • Research how merchants interact with storefront configuration and business management tools.
  • Investigate user experiences across onboarding, questionnaires, and other multi-step workflows.
  • Study how users navigate complex settings, forms, and administrative interfaces.
  • Identify recurring friction points and unmet user needs.
  • Analyze qualitative research findings to identify themes and patterns.
  • Incorporate quantitative product data where appropriate.
  • Review customer feedback and operational observations to identify research opportunities.
  • Help distinguish user preferences from underlying product problems.
  • Collaborate with product designers to improve proposed solutions.
  • Work with content designers to evaluate terminology, instructions, and comprehension.
  • Partner with engineers to understand technical constraints affecting user experiences.
  • Develop interview guides, usability tasks, and research discussion materials.
  • Recruit and screen research participants through approved processes.
  • Create research summaries, journey maps, and actionable recommendations.
  • Present findings clearly to product, design, engineering, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Support research during product discovery, development, and post-launch evaluation.
  • Track recurring user problems and help teams understand changes over time.
  • Maintain organized research documentation and reusable findings.
  • Follow appropriate privacy, consent, and data-handling practices.
  • Independently manage assigned research projects from planning through analysis and presentation.

Requirements

  • Experience collaborating with product managers and product designers.
  • Ability to communicate research findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience creating interview guides, usability tasks, and research materials.
  • Familiarity with participant recruitment and screening.
  • Understanding of research ethics and informed participation.
  • Ability to evaluate complex digital workflows and user journeys.
  • Experience organizing and documenting research findings.
  • Familiarity with product analytics or behavioral data.
  • Ability to combine multiple sources of evidence to support product decisions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and research quality.
  • Ability to balance research rigor with product development timelines.
  • Ability to independently manage research projects and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Have

We are seeking experienced Ground Combat and Special Operations Subject Matter Experts to support a specialized project focused on evaluating AI systems in military-related contexts. In this role, you will apply your operational knowledge and professional judgment to develop realistic evaluation scenarios and assess AI-generated responses.

Your expertise will help improve how AI systems understand military concepts, evaluate complex situations, handle uncertainty, and recognize lawful and unlawful operational boundaries. Previous AI experience is not required; relevant military experience and domain knowledge are essential.

The Clinical Opportunity Development department leads Banner Health’s clinical registry abstraction utilizing an AI-assisted Platform. The department manages the full lifecycle of registry reporting — abstraction, QA validation, inter-rater reliability, and submission — across 16+ registries including NSQIP, CathPCI, GWTG Stroke, and Cancer COC, ensuring Banner maintains its hospital certifications and mandatory state and federal reporting obligations. Beyond compliance, the department returns national benchmark performance data to care teams, physician leaders, and nursing leadership to drive clinical quality improvement across the system. It also oversees national rankings strategy (U.S. News, Leapfrog, CMS Stars) and outcomes intelligence to position Banner’s clinical performance against peer institutions.


The Clinical Registry Reporting Specialist responsibilities include turning raw clinical documentation into reportable data that puts Banner Health’s outcomes on the national stage- then watching the same data flow back to the surgeons, cardiologists, and nurses who can act on it to improve patient care.


The ideal candidate will have RN experience for abstraction, NCDR LAAO and STS Congenital and STS General Thoracic registry experience.


Monday to Friday 8am - 4:30pm


This is a fully remote position and available if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NH, NC, ND, NE, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV & WY.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for abstracting clinical data from the Cerner electronic health record into national and state clinical registries (e.g., ACC/NCDR, STS, AHA Get with The Guidelines, ACS NSQIP, and other state-mandated registries), ensuring data accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with registry specifications. This role also performs quality assurance validation and inter-rater reliability (IRR) testing, maintains current knowledge of evolving registry and clinical guideline requirements, and translates registry benchmark data into actionable performance comparisons of Banner Health against national and peer-system outcomes.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Data Abstraction: Abstracts clinical, procedural, and outcomes data from the Cerner patient chart into assigned clinical registries per each registry's data dictionary and specifications.


2. Quality Assurance: Performs routine QA validation on abstracted records to ensure data integrity, completeness, and accuracy prior to registry submission.


3. Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR): Participates in and supports IRR testing/audits to maintain abstraction consistency across the team and meet registry-required reliability thresholds.


4. Registry Submission: Submits validated data within registry deadlines to ACC/NCDR, STS, AHA GWTG, ACS NSQIP, and other assigned registries.


5. Guideline Currency: Maintains up-to-date knowledge of registry specification changes, clinical guideline updates, and abstraction rule changes; complete required registry certifications/training.


6. Benchmarking & Reporting: Retrieves registry performance reports and translate results into clear benchmark comparisons of Banner Health performance against national and peer-system data for clinical and executive stakeholders.


7. Cross-Functional Coverage: Works flexibly across multiple registries and service lines as assigned, supporting a consistent, system-wide abstraction and benchmarking function.


8. Collaboration: Partners with physicians, service line leaders, quality teams, and registry coordinators to resolve data questions and support performance improvement initiatives.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelors degree in Nursing, Physician Assistant Studies, Medicine (MBBS, MD, DO), or equivalent working knowledge in other related clinical healthcare fields.

Requires 2 to 4 years of clinical experience in an acute care hospital setting.

Strong understanding of medical terminology, chart review, and clinical documentation, high attention to detail with demonstrated data accuracy and quality focus, Proficiency with EHR systems (Cerner Strongly Preferred).


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


Certifications in SCR (Surgical Clinical Reviewer), ODS (Oncology Data Specialist)

Prior experience with clinical registry abstraction (ACC/NCDR, STS, NSQIP, AHA GWTG, Cancer/COC or state registries), Certified clinical data abstractor credential (e.g., CCDS, RHIA/RHIT, or registry-specific certification), Experience with performance benchmarking, dashboards, or quality reporting tools (e.g., Power BI).


Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Job Title: Website Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for project deadlines and client reviews)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Website Designer to create modern, responsive, and conversion-focused websites that blend strong visual design with usability and performance. This role requires both creative design expertise and hands-on CMS implementation skills.

The Website Designer will develop wireframes, create high-fidelity mockups, build pages within CMS platforms, customize styling with HTML/CSS, and ensure websites are optimized for speed, SEO, accessibility, and user experience.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong visual storytelling with technical execution and enjoys building websites that are both beautiful and high-performing.

Responsibilities

Website Design & User Experience

  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity website designs in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch
    • Translate brand direction and business goals into responsive, user-friendly website layouts
    • Design websites optimized for usability, engagement, and conversion performance
    • Maintain visual consistency across pages, landing pages, and digital assets

CMS Development & Customization

  • Build, update, and maintain websites using platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, or Shopify
    • Customize templates and themes using HTML, CSS, and light JavaScript
    • Manage plugins, integrations, widgets, forms, and third-party tools
    • Ensure websites remain scalable, organized, and easy to maintain

Website Optimization & SEO

  • Optimize websites for speed, accessibility, responsiveness, and SEO best practices
    • Implement proper metadata, heading structures, alt text, schema markup, and internal linking
    • Run performance audits using Google PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Lighthouse, or similar tools
    • Improve Core Web Vitals and mobile responsiveness across devices

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Test websites across browsers, screen sizes, and devices to ensure flawless functionality
    • Troubleshoot formatting issues, plugin conflicts, responsiveness problems, and broken functionality
    • Ensure websites maintain high performance and visual consistency post-launch

Collaboration & Feedback

  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and development teams to align websites with campaigns and business objectives
    • Incorporate stakeholder feedback while maintaining strong design integrity and usability standards
    • Communicate design decisions clearly and professionally across teams

File Management & Website Maintenance

  • Keep website files, assets, and design systems organized and up to date
    • Ensure CMS platforms, plugins, and integrations remain updated and secure
    • Maintain backups, revisions, and organized documentation for future updates

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strong design eye paired with technical website implementation skills
    • Able to balance aesthetics, usability, performance, and SEO
    • Organized, detail-oriented, and methodical in testing and revisions
    • Collaborative communicator comfortable working across marketing, design, and development teams
    • Passionate about creating visually engaging and high-performing digital experiences

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional website design experience
    • Proficiency with Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar design tools
    • Experience building and customizing websites on WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, or Shopify

• Strong knowledge of HTML and CSS

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and modern UX/UI standards
    • Experience optimizing websites for SEO, speed, and mobile responsiveness

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience designing for e-commerce websites (Shopify, WooCommerce)
    • Basic JavaScript or front-end development knowledge
    • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and SEO optimization workflows
    • Experience supporting B2B SaaS, marketing agencies, or e-commerce brands
    • Understanding of conversion-focused landing page design and user behavior optimization

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Website Designer’s day revolves around turning design concepts into functional, optimized digital experiences. You will:

  • Design layouts, prototypes, and landing pages aligned with brand and user experience goals
    • Build and customize websites within CMS platforms using HTML/CSS enhancements
    • Run performance, responsiveness, and SEO audits to improve speed and visibility
    • Test websites across browsers and devices to ensure flawless experiences
    • Collaborate with marketing and content teams on campaigns, landing pages, and site updates
    • Maintain website security, plugins, and ongoing design consistency

In essence: you ensure websites are visually engaging, responsive, optimized, and aligned with business objectives.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of website builds, revisions, and updates
    • Page load speeds optimized to <3 seconds
    • Mobile responsiveness and accessibility scores ≥90% (Lighthouse)
    • Positive stakeholder feedback on design quality and usability
    • SEO improvements including traffic growth, rankings, and reduced bounce rates
    • Reduced website bugs, formatting issues, and responsiveness problems

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Portfolio Review + Practical Task (e.g., design and implement a landing page in WordPress or Webflow)
    • Client Interview

• Offer & Background Verification

We want to help members navigate the healthcare system in a better and safer way, and care coordination is critical to achieving this for our most vulnerable and complex members. Care coordinators serve as an advocate for these members, with support from nurse case managers, ensuring members have the necessary resources and support to achieve better health outcomes. You’ll be an important part of helping us connect members with their healthcare needs—such as appointments and durable medical equipment—through outreach and follow-up communication.

Our ideal care coordinator is caring, compassionate, solution-oriented, and enthusiastic about providing an outstanding experience for Devoted Health’s members. They are committed to integrity, excellence, and empowering our most complex members to confidently navigate the healthcare system and live healthier lives. They are ready to innovate, adaptable to a continuously evolving startup environment, and willing to start scrappy, working with the whole Devoted family to create a revolution in how care is delivered.


Responsibilities will include:

  • Calling members to review self-reported health risk assessments to get a full picture of their health and needs
  • Coordinating with provider offices and home health agencies to ensure members get what they need
  • Checking in with members over the phone to see how they’re doing and confirm they’ve received the assistance they need
  • Reviewing care plans for members to identify ways to help
  • Working hand-in-hand with other Devoted teams to address member needs
  • Escalating clinical needs to nurse case managers

  • Seeing the bigger picture of a process and identifying ways to make it better

  • Being a great team player with a “can-do” attitude

Medical Billing Account Manager – Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Standard U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Medical Billing Account Manager to support day-to-day Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations and ensure accurate, timely reimbursement across assigned client accounts.

This is an execution-focused role for a highly organized medical billing professional who can independently manage claim submissions, denial resolution, insurance follow-ups, collections, EOB/ERA review, and account management.

You’ll work within established billing workflows, manage high volumes of claims, communicate with insurance carriers and clients, and help ensure outstanding balances are resolved efficiently.

If you have hands-on medical billing and RCM experience and can independently take ownership of claims from submission through payment, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management

  • Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and Electronic Remittance Advices (ERAs) to identify:
    • Payment discrepancies
    • Claim denials
    • Rejections
    • Underpayments
    • Non-payment reasons
  • Analyze, investigate, and resolve claim denials and rejections
  • Review claims for proper diagnosis and procedure code relationships
  • Apply appropriate billing modifiers to support accurate claim adjudication
  • Perform claims scrubbing and quality assurance before submission
  • Submit:
    • Initial claims
    • Corrected claims
    • Secondary claims
  • Follow payer-specific submission requirements
  • Manage claim queues and prioritize follow-up activities
  • Maintain accurate billing records, claim notes, and account documentation
  • Follow up promptly on unpaid, rejected, or underpaid claims

Denial Management & Claims Follow-Up

  • Investigate the root causes of denied and rejected claims
  • Determine appropriate next steps for claim resolution
  • Correct billing or claim information where required
  • Track unresolved claims through final resolution
  • Follow up consistently with insurance carriers
  • Monitor claim status and reimbursement timelines
  • Help reduce preventable denials and delayed payments
  • Maintain clear documentation of all follow-up activities

Account Management & Insurance Follow-Up

  • Research payer portals and insurance websites to resolve claim issues
  • Obtain claim status and payment updates from insurance carriers
  • Communicate with payers regarding billing and reimbursement inquiries
  • Support client account management and respond to billing-related questions
  • Monitor aging accounts and support collections activities
  • Maintain consistent communication with clients and internal stakeholders
  • Ensure outstanding billing issues are followed through to resolution

Quality & Compliance

  • Maintain accuracy and compliance with payer guidelines and billing requirements
  • Meet established:
    • Productivity targets
    • Quality standards
    • Turnaround-time expectations
  • Maintain accurate and complete billing documentation
  • Identify recurring billing trends and potential process issues
  • Recommend practical improvements where appropriate
  • Work independently while maintaining a high level of accountability and accuracy

Requirements

  • Previous professional experience in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
  • Hands-on medical billing experience in a production environment
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Claim submission
    • Denial management
    • Claims follow-up
    • Collections
  • Ability to read and interpret EOBs and ERAs
  • Experience reviewing diagnosis and procedure code relationships
  • Knowledge of billing modifiers and claims scrubbing processes
  • Experience working with insurance payer portals and medical billing systems
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to independently manage billing responsibilities with minimal supervision
  • Ability to maintain accuracy while managing a high volume of claims
  • Previous remote work experience preferred
  • Availability during standard U.S. business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-volume medical billing environments
  • Experience supporting Texas-based medical practices
  • Experience with insurance verification
  • Experience managing client billing accounts
  • Strong background in denial resolution and collections
  • Experience working directly with insurance carriers and payer portals

EHR & Practice Management Systems

Experience with one or more of the following is highly preferred:

  • eClinicalWorks
  • Aprima
  • Medisoft
  • Veradigm
  • Nextech
  • CureMD
  • Office Practicum
  • NextGen

Tools & Technology

eClinicalWorks | Aprima | Medisoft | Veradigm | Nextech | CureMD | Office Practicum | NextGen | Insurance Payer Portals | EHR Systems | Practice Management Systems | Medical Billing Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have extensive hands-on experience with medical billing and RCM workflows
  • Can independently resolve claim denials and payment issues
  • Understand the full process from claim submission through reimbursement
  • Are comfortable interpreting EOBs, ERAs, codes, and payer responses
  • Know how to prioritize aging and outstanding claims
  • Can manage a high volume of claims without sacrificing accuracy
  • Follow up persistently until billing issues are resolved
  • Communicate effectively with clients, insurance providers, and internal teams
  • Take ownership without requiring constant supervision
  • Thrive in a remote environment and consistently meet productivity expectations

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing claim queues, EOBs, ERAs, and aging accounts to identify claims requiring immediate attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll submit and review claims, resolve denials, follow up with insurance carriers, research payer requirements, update billing documentation, and monitor outstanding balances across assigned accounts.

You may also communicate with clients regarding billing questions, investigate underpayments, update claim notes, and identify recurring issues that could be affecting reimbursement.

In short: you keep the revenue cycle moving by ensuring claims are accurate, denials are resolved, outstanding balances are followed up on, and payments are collected efficiently.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Clean and accurate claim submissions
  • Reduced claim denial and rejection rates
  • Timely resolution of denied claims
  • Improved claims turnaround time
  • Consistent follow-up on unpaid and underpaid claims
  • Aging accounts actively managed
  • Improved collections and reimbursement
  • Accurate account and claim documentation
  • Achievement of productivity and quality targets
  • Strong client account management
  • Reduced outstanding claim backlog
  • Consistent compliance with payer requirements

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on ownership across the medical billing and RCM lifecycle
  • Direct impact on reimbursement and revenue performance
  • Exposure to multiple payer portals and billing systems
  • Opportunity to manage client accounts independently
  • Work across claims, denials, collections, and insurance follow-up
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Medical Billing Account Manager
    • Senior RCM Specialist
    • RCM Team Lead
    • Medical Billing Manager
    • Revenue Cycle Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Initial Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer Stage

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application and completing the required Spark Hire video interview, our recruitment team will review your experience and qualifications.

Candidates whose backgrounds closely match the role may be asked about their experience with medical billing, RCM, denial management, claims follow-up, collections, payer communications, and EHR/Practice Management systems.

Candidates with experience supporting high-volume medical billing operations, particularly Texas-based practices, will receive strong consideration.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience in Medical Billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and know how to manage claims, resolve denials, follow up with payers, and improve reimbursement, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced medical billing professional who can combine accuracy, persistence, account management, and operational ownership in a remote environment.

Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Malta

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Malta. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

The Advanced Associate, Content Quality Assurance is a production technician role on the Test Materials Development team, supporting the development, production, quality assurance, and maintenance of assessment exam materials for teacher certification programs in the United States. Length of employment - 12 months

Hours: 40 hours a week

Core Competencies

  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality in assessment content production.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn and use multiple systems for content management, surveys, and item banking.
  • Organization, prioritization, and follow-through across recurring and ad hoc production tasks.
  • Clear written communication for user instructions, stakeholder updates, and review coordination.

  • Process practice test adoptions in item banking software.

  • Support blueprinting activities, including setting up fields or blueprints in item banking software before items are adopted into new fields or fields with new codes.
  • Create and edit content validation surveys using software.
  • Format test form booklets and other production materials as needed.
  • Assist with assessment bank activities, including bank reconfiguration, bank exports, and conversion of assessment banks into testlet banks.
  • Help maintain the workload planner and support schedule, status, and tracking updates as needed.
  • Take on special technical tasks as required or assigned to support production timelines and quality standards.

Work Environment and Conditions

  • Works remotely in a production-focused environment that supports assessment exams for teacher certification programs in the United States.

  • Handles secure and confidential assessment materials and must follow applicable security, access, and quality procedures.
