  • In cooperation with the Partnership Development team, identify, cultivate, and engage new strategic partners in Europe who expand PAI’s reach and multistakeholder community and advance its mission in the region.
  • Working with the Director of Development, identify and pursue European funding opportunities (including foundations, philanthropic organizations, corporate partners), and contribute to proposals and strategic fundraising tied to PAI’s European events and initiatives.

Convenings & Coordination(Est. time: 20%)

  • Drive activities to convene and support PAI’s European Steering Committee (including preparation of position papers and agendas).
  • Contribute to other relevant related committees in Europe, such as the Policy Steering Committee, by participating in their convenings and virtual events, and by providing feedback and suggestions on their composition and outputs, ensuring complementarity and cross-pollination.
  • Design, organize, and host convenings, meetings, and brainstorms with key partners and stakeholders.
  • Oversee logistics and substantive content for European events, ensuring they reflect PAI's multi-stakeholder approach and mission.
  • Represent PAI at relevant European conferences, working groups, and policy forums.

Research & Guidance Development(Est. time: 30%)

  • Identify and scope emerging, high-impact, and time-sensitive topics for PAI’s research in Europe.
  • Lead the development of guidance and research outputs aligned with PAI's global programmatic priorities, with direct relevance and resonance for the European region. Work closely with members of the Programs & Research as well as Policy teams to deliver this goal.
  • Working with the Communications team, author and co-author research papers, blogs, and op-eds in collaboration with PAI staff and Partners that build visibility around PAI research and engagement in Europe.
  • Contribute European perspectives and expertise to PAI's global research agenda.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Broader International Strategy (Est. time: 20%)

  • Work closely with internal PAI departments to ensure European insights inform global programmatic and research priorities.
  • Partner with the Managing Director, International in implementing PAI's international strategy, including the potential launch of new regional hubs.
  • Support engagement with non-Western stakeholders, including in the Global South, and represent PAI at international convenings.

Other

  • This role requires flexibility to work extended or later hours one to two days per week to accommodate meetings with colleagues in U.S. time zones, ensuring overlap with Eastern and Pacific working hours.
  • The position also involves travel of approximately 20% of the time, both within Europe and internationally, including to North America and Africa.
  • The list of responsibilities set out are not exhaustive It may be necessary to adapt tasks within the scope of the role as needed.

WHO YOU ARE / WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Masters degree or higher in related discipline or equivalent (7-10 years) workexperience required.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across a distributed, international team.
  • A strong team player, who is able to work across the organization, and coordinate between teams when designing/delivering work.
  • Significant professional experience in AI policy, governance, technology partnerships, or a related field, with a demonstrated understanding of the European AI ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of building and managing relationships with senior stakeholders across industry, civil society, academia, and/or government.
  • Experience designing and leading convenings, working groups, or multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex, multi-stakeholder input into clear guidance and research outputs.
  • Fluency in English required; additional European languages a plus.
  • Willingness to travel across Europe as needed for convenings and stakeholder meetings

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to navigate a small yet complex institution
  • Willingness to participate constructively on organizational priorities beyond the immediate focus of their work
  • Existing network of relationships with European AI policymakers, civil society organizations, and industry leaders.
  • Familiarity with PAI's mission, programmatic work, and multi-stakeholder model.
  • Experience contributing to or authoring research or guidance documents on AI governance topics.
  • Comfort with institutional change and periods of ambiguity

QUALITIES THAT ARE IMPORTANT TO US:

  • Justice: Notices and addresses inequities, includes diverse perspectives, and acts fairly in decisions and collaboration.
  • Trust: Communicates openly, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates reliability and integrity.
  • Respect: Listens fully, values others’ time and contributions, and collaborates thoughtfully.
  • Compassion: Shows empathy, patience, and care, especially when supporting colleagues or navigating challenges.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. What matters most is your commitment to PAI’s mission and the potential you bring. We are actively interested in building a diverse pool of candidates and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Compensation

PAI’s compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to fairness and equity across our distributed team. Compensation is based on role level, experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity.

The compensation range for this role depends on where you are based:

  • London, UK: £88,166 – £96,985 GBP
  • Brussels, Belgium: €109,574 – €120,534 EUR
  • Amsterdam, Netherlands: €103,764 – €120,333 EUR

In Belgium, the required 13th-month pay and double holiday pay are paid on top of this base salary range. In the Netherlands, the statutory 8% holiday allowance is paid on top of this base salary range.

Benefits

PAI offers a generous paid leave and benefits package. Time off, health, and retirement benefits are tailored to each country, with the aim of being comparable to our US package. Our benefits currently include:

Location and Work Authorization

Partnership on AI (PAI) is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and supported.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions based on qualifications, skills, experience, and organizational needs, without discrimination. Our commitment to equal opportunity extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, professional development, advancement, compensation, and benefits.

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Candidates who require reasonable adjustments or accommodations during the hiring process are encouraged to let us know.

HOW TO APPLY

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. To apply, please submit a cover letter and resume.

jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Denmark

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Denmark. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

jobs.description:
NeighborWorks as a Company and an Employer

For nearly 50 years, Neighborhood Reinvestment Corporation, a congressionally chartered national nonprofit known as NeighborWorks® America, has strived to make every community safer and more prosperous. Our network of excellence includes nearly 250 nonprofits in every state, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and on Native lands. NeighborWorks offers grant funding, peer exchange, technical assistance, evaluation tools, and access to best-in-class training as the nation’s leading trainer of housing and community development professionals. NeighborWorks network organizations build homes and apartments, expanding the supply of affordable housing in every community; provide financial counseling and coaching that increases self-sufficiency; encourage resident leadership; and collaborate with local stakeholders in the areas of health, economic development, employment, and education.

Caring for communities starts with caring for our internal community, our staff. Picture yourself in a collaborative and diverse hybrid environment surrounded by colleagues who challenge, encourage and inspire you. This opportunity offers an impressive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match of up to 12%, 11 paid holidays, generous leave (including 40 hours of paid volunteer time) and industry-leading benefits. Start your career with NeighborWorks America and take advantage of our Staff Training and Education Program (STEP), designed to support continued learning and professional development. Our benefits are designed to support staff holistically, enabling them to give their best in both work and life.

We are a mission-based organization committed to building a high-performing work culture, guided by the following core values:

  • We hold ourselves and each other accountable.
  • We act with integrity.
  • We lead with curiosity.
  • We pursue excellence with courage.
  • We respect, honor and celebrate each other.
  • We collaborate with purpose.

Work at a Glance: Drive Grants, Performance, and Change

Position Summary:

The Vice President, Impact & Operations provides strategic leadership for the Field Operations Division's grants administration, operational effectiveness, performance management, organizational learning, and change management functions. The position leads the division's Impact & Operations team and is responsible for establishing the policies, processes, and systems that support effective execution of division priorities and stewardship of corporate resources. As a member of the division's leadership team, the Vice President serves as a strategic advisor on organizational effectiveness and change management in support of the division's goals, service to the NeighborWorks network, and engagement with key stakeholders

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

1.Executive Leadership and Team management

-Participates fully as a critical member of the division’s leadership team in support of Field Operations Division strategies and goals.

-Leads the Field Operations Division Impact & Operations team, including direct supervision of Director, Grants Management, Director, Finance & Operations, and Project Manager, responsible for the division’s grantmaking, budgeting, procurement, purchasing, events planning/management, administrative support, and project management.

-Supports a “team of teams” approach within the Impact & Operations team and with colleagues across the Field Operations Division, to ensure shared expectations, goal-setting, and accountability in grants administration, operations, and project management.

2.Grant Administration, Fiscal Stewardship & Governance

-Oversees corporate grants administration, including management of the corporation’s approximately $95 million federal funds grants budget, and oversees grant-making activities for grant opportunities led by the Field Operations Division and works collaboratively with other divisions participating in the grant-making process.Assists the Senior Vice President in representing the grant processes and programs to internal and external stakeholders.

-Oversees budget activities for the Field Operations Division budget, including the federally appropriated grants fund budget.

-Maintains a system of regular review and updates of corporate policies, procedures, and relevant staff training resources relating to processes led by the division, including grants, affiliations, disaffiliations, and the NeighborWorks network charter agreement; including supervising staff responsible and collaborating with relevant internal and network stakeholders.

-Oversees the division's operational technology interfaces and business systems, including collaboration with Information Technology Services (ITS) and management of key internal and external platforms that support grants administration, performance management, operations, and service delivery.

3.Organizational Performance, Learning & Continuous Improvement

-Leads the development and implementation of strategies to intentionally support a system of reflection, evaluation, identification & capturing learnings, codifying tools, and enabling feedback loops to support a learning culture within the division, in partnership with division leadership.

-Directs and supervises the development, evaluation and revision of performance measures relating to the corporate, division, and department level scorecards for the Field Operations division.

4.Strategic Planning & Change Leadership

-Advises the Senior Vice President and colleagues across the division in effective change management practices to inform strategies and implementation across the division.

-Serves as a strategy resource for NeighborWorks network organizations to be tapped by network management team.

5.Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

-Collaborates closely with cross-divisional leadership of Finance, Financial Planning/Analysis/Contracts, Procurement, National Initiatives, Organizational Assessment, Evaluation Leadership & Peer Learning, Training, Public Policy & Legislative Affairs, and Corporate Strategy & Impact in support of corporate goals for responsible fiscal stewardship of resources, grantmaking, and service to the NeighborWorks network.

-Assists the Senior Vice President in representing the grant processes and programs to internal and external stakeholders.

6.Performs other duties as assigned.

Nature of Work Contacts:

·Oversees teams responsible for division’s operations and grantmaking, including three direct reports.

·Collaborates closely with the division’s leadership to ensure operational needs are met in a way that supports mission

·Collaborates closely with leadership and staff of the corporation’s Finance and Administration divisions in overseeing the division’s budgeting, procurement, purchasing, grantmaking, and change management efforts.

·Collaborates closely with NeighborWorks Office of General Counsel in overseeing regular updates of corporate policies within the division’s areas of responsibility.

💼 Healthcare SEO Specialist

🌍 Open to Latin America

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing, scaled direct-to-consumer telehealth company with a clear value story and strong credibility. Organic search is a key patient acquisition channel, and they're investing in owning it across both Google and AI search.

About the Role

We're looking for a Healthcare SEO Specialist to own organic search growth. You'll build and run the strategy that gets patients to find, trust, and sign up for care through Google and AI search, covering technical SEO, content, authority building, and measurement.

Health is one of the hardest categories in search. Google holds medical content to a higher standard, patients are making decisions about their health, and every claim has to be accurate and credibly sourced. The best SEOs in this space know how to grow traffic without cutting corners on trust. You'll work with clinicians, writers, and the product team to turn expertise into content that ranks and converts.

Responsibilities

  • Build and run an organic growth strategy aligned to patient acquisition goals, researching how patients search across symptoms, conditions, treatments, costs, and comparisons
  • Prioritize opportunities by traffic potential, intent, and likelihood of converting to sign-ups, and find where the brand can win against alternatives in search results
  • Develop content briefs and work with writers and clinical reviewers to produce accurate, helpful, well-sourced health content
  • Apply E-E-A-T principles through author credentials, medical review, citations, and clear sourcing, ensuring content follows health claim and advertising rules
  • Refresh and consolidate existing content to protect and grow rankings
  • Own technical SEO across crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking, schema, page speed, and Core Web Vitals, working with engineering to ship fixes
  • Earn high-quality backlinks and mentions from credible health, media, and industry sources
  • Improve visibility in AI search experiences such as AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini by structuring content so it is easy to understand and cite, and track how the brand is cited
  • Build reporting across Google Search Console, GA4, and SEO tools that ties organic traffic to sign-ups and revenue, and tell leadership clearly what is working and where to invest next

What We're Looking For

  • A record of growing organic traffic and conversions, ideally in healthcare, telehealth, or another trust-sensitive category
  • Strong technical SEO skills, including site architecture, indexation, schema, and page performance
  • Experience building content strategy around search intent, with an understanding of how medical content is evaluated by search engines
  • Familiarity with E-E-A-T and health content standards, including working with clinical reviewers
  • Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, and SEO tools such as Semrush or Ahrefs
  • Hands-on experience with link building or digital PR
  • Curiosity about AI search and a willingness to test and learn
  • A conversion-minded approach, caring about qualified sign-ups rather than traffic for its own sake
  • Strong written English and the ability to explain SEO decisions to non-SEO stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Experience in telehealth, direct-to-consumer health, or pharmacy and prescription categories
  • Experience working with medical reviewers or physician-authored content
  • Experience with programmatic or scaled content in a regulated category
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization on health landing pages
  • Experience using AI tools to speed up research, briefs, and analysis

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability during US business hours

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume
  • A portfolio or case studies showing organic growth results you have owned, with traffic, conversion, or revenue outcomes where possible
  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your SEO experience, and walking through one healthcare or trust-sensitive SEO initiative you owned and the results it produced

Only candidates who submit both examples and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Benefits

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Content Designer, AI Experiences to help shape how users interact with AI-powered capabilities across Bask Health's software platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As we explore and develop AI-assisted product experiences, clear communication becomes essential. Users need to understand what an AI feature can do, what information it uses, when its output may be incomplete, and which decisions remain their responsibility.

As a Content Designer, AI Experiences, you'll design the language and conversational patterns that make AI-powered functionality understandable, useful, and appropriately transparent.

This is a hands-on product content role combining UX writing, conversational design, interaction design, content strategy, and cross-functional product development. You'll work with product designers, product managers, engineers, and AI-focused technical teams to create content for AI-assisted workflows.

Your work may include AI-powered assistants, suggested actions, generated summaries, guided configuration experiences, automated recommendations, and other intelligent product capabilities as they are developed and approved.

You'll help define how AI features introduce themselves, explain their capabilities, ask for information, present results, communicate uncertainty, and guide users toward appropriate next steps.

You'll also design content for situations where AI cannot complete a task, produces an incomplete result, needs clarification, or requires human review. These experiences should help users understand what happened without creating unnecessary confusion or implying capabilities the system does not have.

A major part of this role will involve creating clear boundaries between AI assistance and user decisions. You'll help design messaging that distinguishes suggestions from completed actions, makes important limitations visible, and supports review before consequential changes.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll need to pay particular attention to privacy, accuracy, and appropriate clinical boundaries. You'll collaborate with relevant stakeholders to ensure AI-related content does not misrepresent medical authority, treatment eligibility, or actions requiring authorized human oversight.

You'll participate throughout the product development process, from early concept exploration and prototype writing through usability testing, implementation, and iteration.

You'll also contribute to reusable AI content patterns, including response structures, clarification prompts, confirmation language, error states, and disclosure guidelines.

You'll use user research, usability feedback, and available product data to evaluate whether people understand AI-generated content and can successfully complete their tasks.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving new product communication challenges, understands the importance of responsible AI interactions, and can translate technically complex functionality into straightforward, useful experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Design clear, intuitive content for AI-powered features across Bask Health's platform.
  • Write interface copy for AI-assisted merchant and operational workflows.
  • Develop conversational interaction patterns for assistants and guided experiences.
  • Create introductory messaging that explains what AI features can and cannot do.
  • Write prompts, suggested questions, and guided input instructions for users.
  • Design content for AI-generated summaries, recommendations, and suggested actions.
  • Help users distinguish AI-generated suggestions from verified information and completed actions.
  • Create clear explanations for automated processes and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Develop content patterns for uncertainty, incomplete information, and unavailable results.
  • Write clarification prompts that help users provide missing or ambiguous information.
  • Design confirmation messages for actions that require user review or approval.
  • Create recovery messaging for unsuccessful or interrupted AI interactions.
  • Develop appropriate handoff language when human assistance or review is required.
  • Collaborate with product designers on conversational layouts and AI interaction flows.
  • Partner with engineers to understand AI functionality, limitations, and system behavior.
  • Work with product managers to define user expectations and content requirements.
  • Participate in the design of AI-assisted merchant configuration experiences.
  • Help create understandable content for AI-generated business insights and operational summaries.
  • Review AI feature prototypes for clarity, transparency, and usability.
  • Develop reusable writing patterns for AI-related product interactions.
  • Contribute AI content standards to Bask Health's broader design system.
  • Establish consistent terminology for AI features, generated outputs, and automation states.
  • Collaborate with researchers to evaluate user understanding and trust.
  • Test whether users can identify AI limitations and appropriately review suggested actions.
  • Work with clinical and pharmacy stakeholders when AI experiences involve sensitive healthcare workflows.
  • Apply accessibility and plain-language principles to conversational and AI-generated interfaces.
  • Document content decisions, AI interaction patterns, and writing guidelines.
  • Own assigned AI content design projects from initial discovery through implementation and iteration.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in content design, UX writing, conversational design, product writing, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or work samples demonstrating content design for digital products.
  • Strong writing, editing, and information organization skills.
  • Understanding of user-centered content design principles.
  • Experience creating interface content for web or mobile applications.
  • Ability to simplify technically complex concepts into clear, actionable language.
  • Experience writing instructions, guidance, error messages, confirmations, and system states.
  • Strong understanding of information hierarchy and interaction design principles.
  • Familiarity with conversational interfaces, AI-assisted products, or automated workflows.
  • Ability to design content that sets clear user expectations.
  • Understanding of transparency and user control in automated experiences.
  • Ability to communicate uncertainty and product limitations without confusing users.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product designers and product managers.
  • Ability to work effectively with software engineers and technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Figma or comparable collaborative product design tools.
  • Understanding of accessibility and inclusive writing principles.
  • Experience maintaining consistent terminology across digital experiences.
  • Familiarity with UX writing guidelines or content design systems.
  • Ability to review prototypes and identify content-related usability problems.
  • Experience incorporating research findings and user feedback into content improvements.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to explain writing decisions and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Experience working in cross-functional product teams.
  • Ability to balance user needs, business requirements, and technical constraints.
  • Ability to independently manage assigned content design projects.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience designing content for generative AI products.
  • Experience with conversational AI assistants or chatbot interfaces.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical limitations.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted workflows for SaaS applications.
  • Understanding of prompt design and user-facing prompt guidance.
  • Experience creating content patterns for AI-generated recommendations.
  • Familiarity with human-in-the-loop review and approval workflows.
  • Experience designing interfaces that communicate AI uncertainty.
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles and transparent product communication.
  • Experience evaluating AI response quality or conversational usability.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered merchant tools or business automation products.
  • Experience designing content for complex administrative software.
  • Background in healthcare, telehealth, or patient-facing digital experiences.
  • Understanding of healthcare-related privacy considerations.
  • Experience collaborating with clinical or pharmacy stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with white-label or multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Experience developing reusable conversational design patterns.
  • Understanding of localization and accessibility challenges in AI interfaces.
  • Experience collaborating with UX researchers on AI comprehension studies.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted writing, prototyping, or development tools.

Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Latvia

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Latvia. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

Copywriter & Social Media Manager

About the Role

We are looking for a Copywriter & Social Media Manager to create compelling content, manage social channels, and help strengthen Spacestation Labs' online presence.

This role combines copywriting, social media management, Reddit community engagement, campaign coordination, and performance reporting. You’ll own content and social initiatives end-to-end while maintaining a consistent brand voice across every written touchpoint.

What You’ll Own

Content Creation

  • Write clear, compelling copy for social media posts, blog content, ad copy, and product messaging.
  • Adapt content to Spacestation Labs' voice, audience, and the requirements of each platform.
  • Adjust tone from technical and informative to conversational and witty depending on context.

Social Media Management

  • Own the day-to-day management of Spacestation Labs' social channels.
  • Schedule and publish content across platforms.
  • Monitor performance, respond to community engagement, and flag anything that requires attention.

Reddit Community

  • Build and maintain an authentic presence on Reddit.
  • Identify relevant subreddits and participate meaningfully in discussions.
  • Contribute useful content without making Spacestation Labs feel overly promotional.

Campaign Coordination

  • Manage marketing campaigns from execution through completion.
  • Coordinate timelines, assets, and deliverables across stakeholders.
  • Keep projects organized and on track while communicating proactively when priorities shift.

Brand Voice & Messaging

  • Apply and evolve Spacestation Labs' tone of voice across written content.
  • Maintain consistent messaging across product pages, social posts, Reddit discussions, and other written touchpoints.

Performance Reporting

  • Track engagement metrics and content performance across channels.
  • Review performance data and identify what is resonating with the audience.
  • Translate insights into clear takeaways that inform future content decisions.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in copywriting and social media management.
  • Portfolio demonstrating range across different content formats and platforms.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines independently.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Reddit and an understanding of how online communities operate.
  • Understanding of what drives meaningful engagement and authentic participation on Reddit.
  • Experience with social media scheduling and analytics tools such as Buffer, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or comparable platforms.
  • Excellent written English.
  • Strong ability to adapt tone across technical, informative, conversational, and witty content.
  • Strong attention to detail in both copy quality and project coordination.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy participating in online communities and bring that curiosity into your writing.
  • You take ownership of your workload from start to finish.
  • You proactively identify gaps and communicate when priorities or timelines change.
  • You are comfortable working with ambiguity and making sound editorial decisions without needing every detail defined in advance.
  • You are receptive to feedback and view revision as a natural part of the creative process.
  • You can balance creative thinking with strong organization and execution.

What Success Looks Like

  • Content is clear, engaging, and consistent with Spacestation Labs' voice.
  • Social channels are actively managed, organized, and responsive.
  • Reddit engagement feels authentic and contributes meaningfully to the brand's visibility.
  • Campaign deliverables are coordinated effectively and completed on time.
  • Performance data is regularly reviewed and translated into actionable content insights.
  • Content decisions become increasingly informed by audience engagement and performance.
  • Projects are owned proactively with clear communication and minimal supervision.

Typical Day

Your morning might start with a scan of Spacestation Labs' social channels, responding to comments and flagging anything worth escalating.

From there, you may draft a batch of posts for the week, refine copy for an upcoming campaign, or participate in a Reddit discussion where Spacestation Labs can contribute something useful.

Mid-day often involves coordinating with teammates in the Marketing department to align on campaign timelines or review assets before they go live.

You’ll wrap up by checking performance dashboards, identifying what is resonating and what needs adjustment, and updating the content calendar so the next day starts with clarity.

The role is remote and async-friendly, with touchpoints built around the team's rhythm.

We're looking for a Junior Backend Engineer, Platform to help build and improve the shared backend services and infrastructure supporting Bask Health's telehealth platform.

You'll work on APIs, reusable backend components, internal developer tools, database integrations, and infrastructure-related improvements that help our engineering team build and ship software more efficiently.

Unlike engineers focused primarily on one product area, you'll contribute to systems used across multiple parts of Bask, including patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to well-defined projects, participate in code reviews, and gradually take ownership of more complex platform improvements.

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking a crypto-native on-chain researcher to join the research team. You will support our senior researchers with real-time monitoring and attribution, helping the team keep continuous coverage of market-moving on-chain activity.

The core of this role is on-chain attribution and monitoring: identifying who is behind wallets, clusters, and flows, and doing it accurately while handling uncertainty. Accurate attribution underpins everything else we build on top of it, including the charts, alerts, and monitoring workflows the team relies on to interpret market-moving activity in real time.

This is an opportunity for a talented on-chain researcher to work in a highly collaborative environment with access to substantial data, technology and trading infrastructure.

Responsibilities

Attribution & Blockchain Analysis

  • Perform entity attribution, wallet clustering, and transaction graph analysis across account-based and UTXO-based blockchains.
  • Investigate unknown wallets and clusters, weighing the evidence and stating confidence honestly before conclusions are shared.
  • Analyze exchange flows, treasury and insider activity, token unlocks, vesting, and cross-venue capital movement.
  • Investigate unfamiliar protocols, entities, and market events quickly and report what the on-chain data does and does not show.

Real-Time Monitoring & Coverage

  • Monitor on-chain activity and market events in real time for potentially tradeable signals, and escalate them to the senior team.
  • Build and maintain monitoring workflows, dashboards, and alerts for themes and entities of interest.
  • Communicate complex blockchain activity clearly and concisely to researchers and traders, including under time pressure in volatile markets.
  • Provide coverage and backup for senior researchers when colleagues are out.

Research Support & Tooling

  • Support senior researchers on exploratory analysis across Bitcoin, EVM ecosystems, and major non-EVM blockchains.
  • Query and analyze blockchain datasets using SQL and APIs, including our internal data platforms, to validate hypotheses quickly.
  • Use modern analytical and AI-assisted tooling to speed up attribution, summarization, and ad hoc research.
  • Collaborate with engineering on datasets, monitoring systems, and research tooling.

Requirements

Must Haves

Experience & Knowledge

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in blockchain analysis, crypto research, or a related field.
  • Demonstrable, hands-on experience with on-chain attribution: wallet clustering, entity analysis, and investigating unknown addresses.
  • Publicly available research or analysis that we can review before interviews (for example, threads, reports, dashboards, or write-ups).
  • Working familiarity with Bitcoin, EVM ecosystems, and at least one major non-EVM blockchain.
  • Understanding of how on-chain activity such as exchange flows, unlocks, and treasury movements relates to market behavior.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Working proficiency in SQL and APIs, with experience querying large blockchain datasets.
  • Experience with blockchain analytics and visualization platforms such as Dune, Flipside, Arkham, Nansen, Etherscan, Solscan, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Bitcoin's UTXO model and associated transaction analysis techniques.
  • Python or a similar language for research and prototyping.
  • Good judgment about what is signal and what is noise in incomplete or fast-moving data.

Operational & Communication Skills

  • Strong attention to detail while tracking several assets and themes at once.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially under time pressure.
  • Ownership, self-direction, and intellectual curiosity.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across research, trading, and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a trading firm, hedge fund, market intelligence firm, or crypto-native research organization.
  • Experience building monitoring dashboards, alerts, or information aggregation workflows.
  • Experience interpreting real-time market events, such as unlocks, governance actions, liquidations, hacks, and bridge movements.
  • Familiarity with derivatives positioning or cross-venue flows.
  • A network within the crypto ecosystem and familiarity with key entities, protocols, and information channels.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Phone Interview – A discussion with the Talent Acquisition Partner to better understand your background, career motivations, and overall alignment.
  3. Written follow-up – A few short written questions on your on-chain research process, reviewed by the research team.
  4. First Interview – Interview with our On-chain Research Lead on your experience and general technical knowledge.
  5. Second Interview – A deeper look at your attribution methodology, how you validate on-chain signals, and your public research.
  6. CIO Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm's values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

Receptionist (Construction)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a confident, organized, and customer-focused Remote Receptionist to support a construction business focused on roofing and custom home services.

This is a highly phone-based role combining inbound lead response, outbound follow-up, cold calling, appointment booking, and call tracking. You’ll be one of the first points of contact for potential customers, helping turn inquiries into booked consultations while ensuring every interaction is properly documented.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Lead Response

  • Receive and handle calls from leads who have submitted forms through the company website.
  • Qualify their interest and understand their needs.
  • Move qualified leads toward a booked appointment with the appropriate team member.

Outbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Proactively call prospects who have expressed interest but have not yet converted.
  • Keep the pipeline warm through consistent follow-up.
  • Reduce drop-off between initial inquiry and consultation.

Cold Calling

  • Conduct structured outbound cold calling campaigns.
  • Generate new interest in roofing and custom home services.
  • Follow established scripts while adapting naturally to live conversations.

Appointment Booking

  • Schedule consultations and site visits accurately.
  • Coordinate availability with the appropriate team members.
  • Avoid double-bookings and missed opportunities.

Call Tracking & Notes

  • Log every call, outcome, and follow-up action clearly.
  • Keep lead records accurate and up to date.
  • Ensure the team always has a current view of where each lead stands.

Professional Brand Representation

  • Serve as the first voice many customers hear.
  • Communicate warmly, clearly, and professionally.
  • Speak confidently about the company's roofing and custom home offerings.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in a receptionist, call center, customer service, or inside sales role with a significant phone-based component.
  • Experience handling both inbound and outbound calls confidently.
  • Ability to conduct cold calls without heavy supervision.
  • Strong spoken and written English fluency.
  • Clear pronunciation and strong active listening skills.
  • Ability to keep callers engaged and conversations on track.
  • Comfortable using scheduling or CRM tools to log calls and manage appointments.
  • Specific platform experience is a plus.
  • Reliable home office setup with stable internet, a quality headset, and a quiet calling environment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You remain calm and professional when calls become challenging.
  • You are comfortable handling rejection and staying consistent during cold calling.
  • You take ownership of lead follow-up rather than waiting to be reminded.
  • You proactively flag unusual or important customer situations to the internal team.
  • You are organized and consistently document every interaction.
  • You can work independently while maintaining close communication with the team.

What Success Looks Like

  • New website leads are contacted promptly and professionally.
  • Qualified prospects are effectively moved toward booked appointments.
  • Follow-up leads remain warm and receive consistent outreach.
  • Cold calling generates new conversations and interest.
  • Appointments are scheduled accurately without double-bookings or missed opportunities.
  • Every call and follow-up action is properly documented.
  • The team has a clear, up-to-date view of the lead pipeline.
  • Customers receive a professional and positive first impression of the company.

Typical Day

Your day revolves around the phone. You’ll start by reviewing new form submissions and prioritizing callback attempts for fresh leads.

As calls come in, you’ll qualify callers, answer basic questions about roofing projects and custom home builds, and schedule appointments on the calendar.

Between inbound calls, you’ll run outbound sessions, following up with leads that have gone cold and working through cold calling lists to open new conversations.

You’ll log every interaction as you go, ensuring the team has a live picture of the pipeline.

The role is largely independent, but you’ll stay in close communication with the internal team to flag hot leads, reschedule appointments, and surface anything that requires their attention.

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection
