jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.title: UX Researcher
jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a UX Researcher to help Bask Health better understand how users interact with our software and identify opportunities to improve usability across the platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a UX Researcher, you'll study how people navigate these experiences, complete tasks, interpret information, and respond to different interface designs. Your findings will help product teams make informed decisions about how the platform should work.

This is a hands-on research role focused on evaluating digital experiences through user interviews, usability testing, observational studies, and other research methods. You'll help teams understand where users encounter friction, which interactions are confusing, and how proposed changes affect the overall experience.

Your work will span merchant-facing and patient-facing software. You may evaluate merchant onboarding, dashboard navigation, storefront configuration, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, account settings, or other complex workflows.

You'll work closely with product designers to test prototypes, evaluate interaction patterns, and identify opportunities to simplify interfaces before development.

You'll also collaborate with content designers and UX writers to understand how users interpret labels, instructions, error messages, and other interface content.

You'll partner with product managers to define research questions, prioritize usability concerns, and ensure studies address important product decisions.

You'll work with engineers to understand technical constraints and help evaluate how implemented experiences compare with intended designs.

You'll conduct moderated and unmoderated usability studies, user interviews, concept evaluations, and task-based assessments. You'll select appropriate methods based on the questions being investigated and the stage of product development.

You'll also analyze research findings, identify recurring patterns, and communicate recommendations that help teams make practical improvements.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll need to conduct research with appropriate attention to participant privacy, consent, sensitive information, and approved clinical workflow boundaries.

You'll help maintain organized research documentation and contribute to repeatable research practices that make usability insights accessible across the company.

We're looking for someone who is curious about how people use software, comfortable investigating complex workflows, and able to turn user observations into clear recommendations that improve product experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct UX research across Bask Health's merchant-facing and patient-facing software experiences.
  • Plan and execute usability studies for existing and proposed product features.
  • Conduct moderated user interviews to understand behaviors and usability challenges.
  • Support unmoderated usability testing and structured task evaluations.
  • Develop research plans, study objectives, and participant criteria.
  • Create usability tasks, interview guides, and research discussion materials.
  • Evaluate navigation, information architecture, and interaction patterns.
  • Test prototypes to identify usability problems before development.
  • Research how users complete multi-step onboarding and configuration workflows.
  • Evaluate merchant dashboards, settings pages, and administrative interfaces.
  • Study patient questionnaires, forms, and checkout experiences.
  • Identify confusing instructions, labels, and interface terminology.
  • Collaborate with content designers to evaluate comprehension and clarity.
  • Work with product designers to validate proposed interaction patterns.
  • Partner with product managers to prioritize usability research opportunities.
  • Recruit and screen research participants through approved processes.
  • Observe user behavior and identify recurring friction points.
  • Analyze qualitative research findings to identify patterns and themes.
  • Incorporate available behavioral data and usability metrics where appropriate.
  • Evaluate task completion, user errors, and workflow efficiency.
  • Develop research summaries and actionable design recommendations.
  • Present usability findings to product, design, and engineering teams.
  • Support iterative testing throughout product development.
  • Conduct post-launch usability evaluations when needed.
  • Help establish reusable usability testing templates and research practices.
  • Maintain organized research documentation and findings.
  • Follow appropriate participant consent, privacy, and data-handling procedures.
  • Independently manage assigned UX research projects from planning through synthesis and presentation.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in UX research, user research, human-computer interaction, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or case studies demonstrating UX research methods and findings.
  • Experience planning and conducting usability studies for digital products.
  • Strong understanding of qualitative research methods.
  • Experience conducting moderated user interviews.
  • Familiarity with unmoderated usability testing.
  • Ability to develop clear research questions and study objectives.
  • Experience creating usability tasks and research discussion guides.
  • Understanding of user-centered design principles.
  • Ability to evaluate navigation, interaction patterns, and complex workflows.
  • Experience identifying usability problems and recommending improvements.
  • Familiarity with usability metrics and task-based evaluation.
  • Experience synthesizing qualitative findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to communicate research results to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product designers and product managers.
  • Familiarity with wireframes, prototypes, and iterative product design.
  • Experience evaluating digital interfaces across different stages of development.
  • Understanding of research ethics and participant consent.
  • Familiarity with participant recruitment and screening.
  • Experience organizing and documenting research findings.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to balance research rigor with practical development timelines.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple studies.
  • Ability to independently deliver high-quality UX research work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience researching SaaS platforms or business software.
  • Familiarity with merchant-facing dashboards and administrative applications.
  • Experience evaluating e-commerce or direct-to-consumer product experiences.
  • Background in healthcare, telehealth, or patient-facing digital software.
  • Experience testing patient onboarding or intake questionnaires.
  • Familiarity with complex forms and multi-step workflows.
  • Understanding of healthcare-related privacy considerations.
  • Experience conducting research involving sensitive information.
  • Familiarity with tools such as UserTesting, Maze, Dovetail, Lookback, or comparable research platforms.
  • Experience evaluating Figma prototypes.
  • Understanding of quantitative usability measures.
  • Experience combining usability findings with product analytics.
  • Familiarity with accessibility research and inclusive testing practices.
  • Experience conducting remote usability studies.
  • Understanding of information architecture testing methods.
  • Experience with first-click testing, tree testing, or card sorting.
  • Familiarity with white-label or multi-tenant SaaS products.
  • Experience researching AI-assisted interfaces.
  • Understanding of research operations and insight repositories.
  • Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional product teams.

Builders FirstSource (BFS) is embarking on a multi-year business transformation that will enable us to outperform our competition and enable industry transformation. In connection with this initiative, BFS will harmonize our core operations on SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud. The Senior Business Analyst of SAP Financials should be a subject matter expert for Record to Report (RTR) with a concentration on the Accounts Receivables (AR) and Serrala (Cash Application) sub workstream. In this role, you will work with cross-functional teams to address and ensure quality solutions ultimately influencing individuals within and outside the IT department and making a significant impact on our business. The candidate will be responsible for the design, configuration, implementation, testing and control of the financial systems and applications. While the focus is on AR and Serrala, responsibilities could involve other areas of RTR including the following: Accounts Payable, Treasury, General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Tax (Vertex), Portfolio & Project Management (PPM), and Project Systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Analysis of SAP Financial processes, including configuration, integration, customization, master data, and reporting with an emphasis on SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable and Serrala (Cash Application). Collaborate with stakeholders to understand and document business requirements related to the SAP Accounts Receivable (AR) processes. Configure and support the SAP AR module, including setting up customer master data, invoicing, payment processing, dunning, credit management, and reporting. Identify opportunities to streamline AR processes within SAP to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention. Work on SAP AR system enhancements and automation, including the integration of third-party tools or external systems for better payment processing. Liaise with external vendors, when necessary, to ensure the smooth flow of AR data and payment processing. Perform business process analysis and translate business requirements into workable SAP solutions and/or functional designs for specific projects and changes, including development. Write functional analyses for SAP financial programs. Develop and execute functional (integration) test scripts. Work closely with process teams to facilitate project progress and ensure integrated system solutions. Collaborate with other cross functional leaders on business-driven IT initiatives, including enhancements and technical upgrades. Provide implementation support, preparing the business for system solutions. Demonstrate the ability to solve problems that allow for effective and timely resolution of system issues including but not limited to production outages. Apply design thinking and/or process redesign principles to develop innovative solutions that enhance the end-user experience across financial solutions, incorporating user feedback and insights to ensure a user-centered approach.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting related field. 7-9 years of experience of overseeing configuration of SAP Financials Multiple full-life cycle SAP implementations (ECC 6.0 or S/4HANA) Strong experience with designing, configuring and supporting the following RTR areas within SAP is a must

Accounts Receivable (In-depth knowledge of the SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable module, including invoicing, credit management, payment processing, collections and integration with other financial modules. Serrala – Cash Application (configuring, maintaining, and enhancing the system, ensuring smooth document management workflows, and delivering best practices for Serrala cash application implementations.)

Knowledge of integration with SAP Sales and Distribution module (for Billing and Revenue recognition) is a must Proficiency in creating queries or reports for AR related reporting Strong experience with IDoc processing and working knowledge of BAPI’s & BADI’s Experience with Project Systems configuration will be a plus Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

COMPETENCIES

Subject matter expert in SAP Financials including FI (Finance) and Serrala (Cash Application) Excellent verbal and written communications skills Strong self-starter and self-directed worker Excellent interpersonal, influencing and negotiation skills. Established strategic and critical analysis skills. Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships.

WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL ACTIVITY The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Subject to both typical office environment and outside locations with temperature and weather variations. Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 pounds. Ability to travel up to 25%

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Account Partners
jobs.excerpt: Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?
jobs.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

Our Global Account Partners own the relationship, retention, and growth of Syndio's customer base. As we scale, we're adding a Sr. Manager to lead a team of 6 to 7 Global Account Partners and the roughly 150 - 200 customers they serve. You'll coach the team, step into escalations and deal strategy, and make sure every account has a clear plan to renew and grow. This is a player-coach seat on a team that is changing quickly, and you'll help shape where it goes. We are looking to hire one Sr. Manager in EST & one Sr. Manager in PST.

Why this job is exciting

  • You'll lead and develop a team of 6 to 7 Global Account Partners, many of whom are growing from Customer Success into Account Management. Your coaching will directly shape their careers.
  • You'll own retention and growth across a blended book, and set the strategy for where to invest, where to upsell, and where to step in before an account is at risk.
  • You'll coach your team to sell Syndio's platform vision and grow accounts, including smaller ones that are priced below where we want them to be.
  • You'll join executive-level conversations and negotiations, helping customers see the value and return on investment of getting pay right.
  • You'll own a three-part forecast covering retention, growth, and pipeline generation, run against a defined sales process, and you'll be the person leadership relies on for an accurate call.
  • You'll help build the team: recruiting, interviewing, and hiring the next wave of Account Partners as we grow.
  • You'll work in a space that matters. Pay equity and pay governance are top of mind for HR leaders, and you'll help them make decisions they can trust.

About you

  • You have 5+ years managing and coaching account managers, sales reps, or customer success professionals, and you've helped people move into new roles or skill sets.
  • You've led a team that runs a book of business against a quota, in a software setting, and you know what it takes to carry a number.
  • You've retained a customer base with an eye on growth, and run growth motions for a new product offering.
  • You can coach deeply on gaps, including how to sell a broader platform to grow existing accounts.
  • You can explain a value story and ROI clearly, and you're comfortable leading executive-level conversations and negotiations.
  • You forecast accurately across retention, growth, and pipeline, and manage pipeline with rigor against a defined sales process.
  • You've handled customer escalations and know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let your team lead.
  • You've worked across teams, including with Sales Engineers and other go-to-market functions.
  • You've recruited and interviewed top talent, and you can spot someone who will grow with the role.
  • You've guided a team through change, including having honest performance conversations when they're needed.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at $165,000 -$175,000 base with a $275,000 - $292,000 OTE per year. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise. We take a geo neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success.
  • 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to, plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.
  • Paid parental leave
  • 🩺 Medical, Dental, Vision. Syndio pays 90% of employee premiums, and 50% for dependents.
  • 🏥 Life Insurance & Disability. Syndio covers the full premium.
  • 🏦 401(k). To help you save for your future
  • Fully remote model -

The interview overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for our Senior Manager, Account Partner position. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  • 30 min interview with a member of our Talent Team
  • 45 minute zoom interview with the Hiring Manager
  • Three video interviews with several team members (Revenue Operations, Sales Engineer, VP Sales) - 2.5 hours
  • Take home 30-60-90 project
  • Final 30-60-90 presentation - 1 hour

At Syndio, we're building a diverse team that values candor, curiosity, and community. If you share these values and are interested in joining us, we'd love to talk with you even if you don't 100% meet the "about you" listed here. We don't expect anyone to have all the answers, as long as you're willing to learn and grow with us.

Syndio is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are building an inclusive and collaborative workplace as we grow, and we welcome team members regardless of gender/identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, physical disability and age.

jobs.description:
Contract Community Editor & Strategist

3-month contract with potential to extend$25/hour, 40 hours a weekRemote-friendly (LA or NYC office optional)

BuzzFeed is seeking a Contract Community Editor & Strategist to join our dynamic team. This role blends editing, creator success, community management, and digital publishing strategy. You'll work closely with BuzzFeed's most passionate creators, helping them produce their best work while fostering an engaged, welcoming Community both on and off the site. This role is perfect for someone who loves internet culture, online communities, and helping creators succeed.

About BuzzFeed Community

BuzzFeed Community is a unique, user-powered corner of BuzzFeed.com where anyone can create an account and submit their own content — whether it’s listicles, quizzes, or personal essays. The platform is beloved by BuzzFeed’s most engaged users and often centers around fandoms, pop culture, and nostalgia.

Community content is some of the most unique and fun content on our site, thanks to the passion and creativity of our users. Community posts are not only entertaining and engaging — they are a core part of BuzzFeed’s mission to amplify diverse voices and perspectives.

What You'll Do

As a Community Editor & Strategist, you'll help shape the future of BuzzFeed Community by editing high-quality user-generated content while building relationships with the creators behind it. You'll work closely with the Community Strategy team to grow our creator ecosystem and ensure contributors have the tools and feedback they need to thrive.

You will:

  • Edit submissions from the BuzzFeed Community Creator Program (BFCCP), ensuring they meet BuzzFeed's editorial standards for quality, accuracy, and style.
  • Partner directly with Community Creators by providing thoughtful editorial feedback, coaching, and best practices to help them improve their content over time.
  • Foster an active, welcoming creator community by engaging with contributors in our Discord server, answering questions, encouraging participation, and building relationships.
  • Moderate Community content and comments to maintain a positive, inclusive environment.
  • Curate standout Community content by identifying posts with strong editorial or viral potential.
  • Use traffic and engagement data to inform editorial decisions and surface content that resonates with readers.
  • Collaborate with BuzzFeed's Audience Development and Editorial teams on creator initiatives, publishing strategy, and special projects.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve creator education, onboarding, and overall program success.

You Have:

  • A deep love for internet culture, fandom, and online communities.
  • Excellent editing, grammar, and proofreading skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to deliver thoughtful, constructive feedback to creators.
  • Experience building relationships with online communities or creators.
  • An understanding of what makes BuzzFeed-style content engaging and shareable.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort working independently while collaborating across editorial and audience teams.
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms and digital publishing workflows.
  • Interest in audience development, analytics, SEO, and social strategy is a plus.

Bonus Points For:

  • Previous experience editing user-generated or creator-produced content.
  • Experience managing online communities, including Discord servers, forums, or creator programs.
  • Experience with social media community management, including responding to comments and engaging audiences across platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or Twitter/X.
  • Experience working with creators or influencers.

If you're excited about fostering creativity, empowering users, and shaping viral internet content, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (QSR)
jobs.excerpt: Who Are Massive Rocket? Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect.
jobs.description:
Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will be responsible for finding and winning the biggest opportunities within Massive Rocket's most strategic global accounts.

This is a hunter's role built on trust. You'll build senior, multi-threaded relationships across global, regional, and local stakeholders, using those relationships to uncover opportunities across new markets, departments, and brands.

While Account Managers own the day-to-day relationship and renewal process, your focus is on identifying the next big opportunity and leading the complex enterprise sales cycle from discovery through to signed engagement.

You'll shape scopes, commercial terms, and multi-market programmes, protect margin during negotiations, and demonstrate measurable client value. As Massive Rocket continues to grow, the opportunities you create will play a key role in our commercial success.

What Will You Do?

  • Identify and develop new growth opportunities across a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Build senior, multi-threaded relationships across global, regional, and local client stakeholders.
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from initial opportunity through discovery, solution shaping, commercial negotiations, and contract signature.
  • Own account growth plans with clear revenue, margin, pipeline, and relationship objectives.
  • Shape scopes, pricing, and commercial terms for complex, multi-market engagements while protecting profitability.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and pipeline visibility for Finance and Operations.
  • Lead senior QBRs and EBRs, using client outcomes and ROI to create new growth opportunities.
  • Partner with Account Management, Delivery, PMO, and internal specialists to develop commercially strong client propositions.
  • Support major renewal discussions when commercial expertise is required, while Account Management retains ownership of renewals.
  • Mentor Account Managers and Account Executives and help establish best practices for enterprise account growth.
  • Represent Massive Rocket at senior client meetings and relevant industry events.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Strong experience managing and growing large, multi-market enterprise accounts within a CRM, MarTech, digital, agency, or consulting environment.
  • Proven experience selling complex professional services engagements rather than SaaS licences alone.
  • A track record of identifying and winning opportunities across new departments, markets, business units, or brands within global organisations.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with experience owning forecasts, shaping scopes and fees, and protecting margin during negotiations.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from initial conversation through to signed engagement.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influence teams across functions.
  • Experience working with global and geographically distributed client organisations.
  • Excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Desirable

  • Experience working with QSR, convenience, or multi-site retail brands.
  • Understanding of franchise structures, customer behaviour, loyalty economics, and customer engagement.
  • Experience growing strategic accounts across multiple markets and buying cycles.
  • A strong background in CRM, customer engagement, MarTech, or data-driven transformation.
  • Experience mentoring commercial or account management teams.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)
References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready
For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

The Role:

  • Cross-Workstream Scope: Own the end-to-end integration roadmap across three core pillars: ERP, HRIS, and IT Infrastructure.

  • Engagement Timeline: 3–4 month consulting engagement (with potential for extension) starting in early December 2026.

  • Work Mode & Travel: Executed primarily remotely, with periodic travel for key milestones and leadership meetings to client headquarters in Southern California and the acquired company’s location (East Coast or Midwest).

  • Lead ERP & HRIS Integration Workstreams: Partner with internal business owners, IT leads, and third-party vendors to align project accounting, financials, payroll, and employee lifecycle workflows between both organizations.

  • Drive Executive & Vendor Alignment: Serve as the primary bridge between client executive sponsors, internal IT teams, HR/Finance stakeholders, and external implementation partners or MSPs.

  • Protect Business Continuity: Sequence cutover activities and change management to prevent disruptions to active residential and commercial construction projects, field teams, and billing cycles

What You'll Bring

  • IT M&A Integration Track Record: Proven experience leading post-merger IT system integrations at the program level, managing multiple parallel workstreams simultaneously.

  • ERP & HRIS Implementation Leadership: Hands-on project or program management experience leading full-lifecycle ERP and/or HRIS implementations, migrations, or consolidations.

  • Industry Familiarity (Preferred): Prior experience in construction, MEP, engineering, or field-service environments (including familiarity with construction ERPs or field/union payroll complexities) is a strong plus.

Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.
With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.
At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

jobs.excerpt: At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
jobs.description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Clinical Operations Coordinator, accountable for supporting the operational delivery of a variety of contracted services in a Clinical Trial. These services include Rater Training and Monitoring activities (training deployment, management, and in-study reporting/calibration), Clinician Network Management (ensuring quality and consistency across global clinical interviews), Data Management (opening and resolving data queries), and Scale Management (binder creation, translations, logistics & shipping).

The daily workload for the above functional areas will fluctuate throughout the life cycle of a Clinical Trial. The Clinical Operations Coordinator will be cross trained to support multiple functional areas, flexibly jumping in to assist study teams according to their changing bandwidth needs.

Base Salary range - £35,000 - £42,000

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with study teams across a variety of functional areas to ease bandwidth strain on Coordinator responsibilities detailed below.
  • Processing clinician/rater forms and documenting data via status trackers and ePortal/LMS training systems.
  • Review and process submitted clinician/rater surveys and deploy applicable LMS training modules.
  • Schedule 1:1 training video conferences between site raters and Cogstate Rater Services staff
  • Hardware shipment scheduling and documentation management.
  • Documenting real time updates to applicable status trackers, coordinating high volume email correspondence, communicating status updates to clinicians/raters, electronic records filing.
  • Point of contact for clinician/rater support questions.
  • Direct communication with site coordinators at clinical settings, activity and communication tracking and general support throughout study.
  • Interact with CRAs for site monitoring activities.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or 1+ years of related experience.
  • Previous project management or administrative support experience preferable
  • Microsoft Office proficiency.

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
  • Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the
    position.
  • Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a variety of learning and development opportunities from internal and external sources focused on leadership, and professional & personal development.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

jobs.description:
Trupanion cherche un(e) coordonnateur(trice) de soutien aux partenaires, dévoué(e) et axé(e) sur le service à la clientèle, pour se joindre à son équipe de soutien aux partenaires. Dans ce rôle, vous offrirez un soutien multicanal en temps réel à nos principaux partenaires, notamment : les cliniques vétérinaires, les éleveurs, les refuges, nos partenaires régionaux (représentants sur le terrain), State Farm ainsi que les participants à nos programmes d’avantages sociaux destinés aux employés des cliniques et aux anciens combattants. Votre objectif est d'offrir un service exceptionnel, cohérent et professionnel, de renforcer les relations avec nos partenaires, d'améliorer l’expérience-client et de contribuer activement à la croissance de l’entreprise. Ce poste implique une forte présence téléphonique, la gestion de files d’attente et la capacité de gérer efficacement un volume élevé d’interactions en temps réel. Le rendement est évalué selon des indicateurs clés, notamment la productivité, la qualité du service et l’expérience globale offerte aux partenaires. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devez être à l’aise avec des situations complexes, faire preuve d'un grand souci du détail et respecter les processus établis tout en exerçant un jugement éclairé pour répondre aux besoins spécifiques des partenaires. Le profil recherché est résolument axé sur le service, doté d’excellentes habiletés de communication, d'un fort esprit de résolution de problèmes et d'un réel engagement envers la satisfaction des partenaires.

Chez Trupanion, nous croyons en un environnement de travail flexible! Les professionnels passionnés par les animaux de compagnie se trouvent partout. Ce poste est 100% en télétravail, ouvert aux candidatures partout au Canada et aux États-Unis.

Horaire :

Il s’agit d’un poste à temps plein, du lundi au vendredi, de 10 h 30 à 19 h, heure du Pacifique. L’horaire peut être ajusté en fonction des besoins opérationnels et après discussion avec votre gestionnaire.

Responsabilités:

  • Fournir une assistance en temps réel par téléphone, courriel et clavardage sur l'ensemble des canaux partenaires.
  • Gérer un volume élevé de communications entrantes et sortantes dans un environnement basé sur les files d'attente.
  • Résoudre des enjeux techniques et opérationnels, et effectuer des escalades au besoin.
  • Fournir des renseignements précis sur les produits, les couvertures, les polices, les réclamations et les programmes partenaires de Trupanion.
  • Effectuer des recherches approfondies afin de proposer des solutions adaptées à des situations complexes.
  • Faire preuve de professionnalisme, de discernement et d’une approche axée sur les solutions dans des contextes variés.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes internes afin d’assurer une expérience partenaire fluide et cohérente.
  • Atteindre ou dépasser de façon constante les objectifs de productivité, de qualité et de satisfaction des partenaires.

Qualifications:

  • Bilinguisme français et anglais requis (le français québécois est un atout important).
  • Minimum de deux ans d’expérience dans un centre de contact axé sur le service à la clientèle ou le soutien aux partenaires.
  • Au moins deux ans d’expérience en soutien multicanal à volume élevé (téléphone, courriel, clavardage).
  • Expérience dans les secteurs vétérinaire, de l’assurance pour animaux de compagnie ou des soins de santé (atout)!

Compétences:

  • Excellentes habiletés de communication orale et écrite.
  • Capacité d’apprendre rapidement et de naviguer dans plusieurs outils et systèmes (téléphonie, CRM, Excel et autres plateformes internes).
  • Grande rigueur, souci du détail et capacité à suivre des procédures opérationnelles normalisées.

Rémunération:

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer, AI Platform to build and maintain the foundational software infrastructure that supports AI-powered applications across Bask Health.

As Bask expands its use of artificial intelligence across merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and internal systems, we need reliable shared services that allow engineering teams to develop and deploy AI capabilities efficiently.

This role focuses on the platform infrastructure behind those applications. You'll build reusable APIs, model integration services, inference gateways, data access components, and operational tools that make it easier for other engineers to incorporate AI into production software.

You'll work with backend technologies, cloud infrastructure, databases, model providers, and distributed systems to develop scalable services that handle AI requests, manage application resources, and support reliable execution.

Your work may include centralized model access, request routing, usage tracking, authentication, rate limiting, prompt configuration, observability, and infrastructure that supports retrieval and agent-based applications.

You'll collaborate with applied AI engineers, machine learning engineers, product engineers, and infrastructure specialists to understand their technical requirements and develop platform capabilities that can be reused across multiple products.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll also help ensure AI infrastructure respects privacy requirements, tenant isolation, access controls, and approved data-handling practices. You'll design systems that allow teams to innovate without compromising security or reliability.

This is a hands-on engineering role with ownership over production infrastructure and shared developer capabilities. You'll write code, improve system architecture, investigate operational issues, and help establish engineering patterns that support Bask's growing AI capabilities.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys building reliable backend systems, thinks carefully about scalability and developer experience, and understands how strong infrastructure enables teams to ship better products.

What You'll Do

At First Table, we're passionate about bringing people together over incredible dining experiences while helping restaurants thrive.

This is a fully remote role for someone based in London or the surrounding area, with a January 2027 start date. So enjoy the festive season, recharge over Christmas and New Year, and get ready to kick off 2027 with an exciting career opportunity!

First, a little about us...

First Table is a global restaurant discovery and booking platform with a simple but brilliant idea: connecting diners with fantastic restaurants while helping venues fill tables that might otherwise sit empty.

Proudly established in Queenstown, New Zealand where our head office is based, we've been leading the charge in the hospitality tech industry for over a decade, with operations spanning New Zealand, Australia and the UK & Ireland, where our team and restaurant community are growing fast.

We're a passionate, collaborative bunch who love good food, great ideas and people who aren't afraid to make things happen. Our values – Win-Win-Win, Own It and Grow Together, aren't just words on a wall. They're how we work, support one another and celebrate success.

The opportunity

As a Partner Success Specialist, you'll be the person who helps our restaurant partners across UK and Ireland get the very best out of First Table. You'll build genuine relationships, understand their challenges, spot opportunities and work alongside them to make their businesses even more successful.

We're looking for someone who is curious, proactive and commercially minded. Someone who enjoys getting to know people, asking great questions and finding solutions that make a real difference.

You'll be part of a supportive, multi-skilled team managing a shared portfolio of restaurant partners, with opportunities to develop your own areas of expertise as you grow.

What you'll be doing

  • Helping partners thrive: Identify potential risks early, strengthen engagement and support long-term partner retention.
  • Owning your outcomes: Take initiative, follow things through and make a genuine impact on the success of our restaurant community.

A little about you

You're a natural relationship builder who genuinely enjoys connecting with people. You bring energy to conversations, aren't afraid to pick up the phone and love the satisfaction of turning a challenge into a positive outcome.

Why you'll love First Table

  • Fully remote working: Work from home with the flexibility and autonomy to do your best work.

jobs.description:
About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

This is a remote position.

Academic Curriculum and Content Development Manager
Remote (India) | Full-time
Also searched as: Content Development Manager, Academic Content Manager, Curriculum Manager, Curriculum Team Lead, International Curriculum Manager, Content Manager (IB / IGCSE / A-Level)
Could you run Contour's India content team across every subject, holding its work to an Australian exam standard without needing to be the expert in each one?
On a typical day you might catch a QA flag on a question set before it ships in the morning, review an AI step that drafts question variants with your Curriculum Designer after lunch, and close the afternoon agreeing with an academic owner in Melbourne what a study-design change means for next week's content.
About Contour
We operate across three brands. The India team, which falls under the Global Enablement and Support pillar, is the global capability centre (GCC) Contour is building: it runs delivery, automation, people, and operations for the whole organisation.
The Kind of People Who Thrive Here
Contour started in 2020 as one classroom in a university library. In 2022 three full-time team members ran the business on. Today we are about 600 people across Australia and India, and much of what we run was built by someone who noticed it was missing.
The work matters. More than 10,000 students rely on what we build, from the booklets they study from to the systems their families pay through. The people who do well here care about that and want to know their work made a difference to those students.
They own their work end to end, start things without being asked, and finish what they commit to. They tell the truth early, including when something is off and what they have already tried, and write decisions down so the next person can pick them up. They give direct feedback and ask for it back.
The pace is fast. Small problems are fixed the same week, bigger ones within the six-week cycle, and whoever spots the problem usually gets to lead the fix. We keep refining how we work, and you are expected to improve the processes you own.
We hire on what you have built and run yourself, and growth works the same way. Time with us counts, but scope, title and pay move with what you deliver and how much you raise the bar on what you own.
The GCC is being built now, seat by seat. This one decides how well Contour's content holds up as it grows.
About This Role
You lead Contour's India content team: the curriculum designers, content developers, question writers and markers who build what students learn from, across the Victorian (VCE), Queensland (QCE) and, from 2027, New South Wales (HSC) curricula.
Your team's work is set and signed off in Australia. The academic owners, Heads of Subject and curriculum leads, set the standard for each subject and approve what ships, and onshore curriculum leads write content too, so yours has to fit alongside theirs. The Production lead is your peer: their team designs, formats and publishes finished assets from what yours writes. Everything else is yours: the people, the workflow, and the systems that get each item there.
This is international work. Contour's students sit Australian exams, their study designs are set by Australian authorities, and the people who judge your team's output are Australian teachers and students. You need to have built content for a curriculum outside India and worked closely with academic owners in another country, so you know how an overseas exam board thinks about rigour, wording and marking.
Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, you run quality as a system. You are not expected to be an expert in every curriculum: you turn what the academic owners mean by good into checks and measures that get every specialist there consistently, so drafts don't need rewriting at the end. Second, you protect quality at speed. With a turnaround of under a week, when something is at risk you make the call early on the information you have.
We are looking for someone tech-forward. Contour runs on tools, and the India team has its own automation and Internal Product teams to build with. The strongest candidates have already used AI and automation to make a content team do more with the same people: AI drafting first versions and question variants, automated checks catching errors before a reviewer sees them, and items tagged and tracked without manual effort. You spot where a tool can take work off the team, set it up with the people who use it, and make sure quality holds.
You build on the content team already in place: Curriculum Designers, Content Developers, and the Question Writers and Markers, who write practice items and grade learners' work, all report to you. We want a player-coach who leads by example. You have enough hands-on curriculum and content experience to coach your leads and specialists, judge quality, challenge estimates and step in when needed; subject specialists hold deep expertise in their subjects. The seat may later take in UCAT (the medical-school entry test) and selective-entry school exams. Contour is scaling and hires for the long term: the scope of this seat grows with the platform, and what you deliver decides how fast.
Much of what Contour students study from passes through this team, so a gap that slips past review reaches a learner. Get the system right, and each new subject or exam builds on it.
​
What You Will Do
  • Turn the academic bar into a working system:Establish what good looks like subject by subject, against each study design, then build the checklists, KPIs and review points that keep output there.
  • Run the create-and-QA cycle:Track output on a dashboard you build, so no discipline falls behind the teaching calendar, and step in ahead of any slip.
  • Keep up with study-design changes:When VCAA, QCAA or NESA update a study design or exam format, map what changes, plan the rework and land it before the term that needs it.
  • Mark on schedule:Return marked assignments within the turnaround promised to learners, and run calibration sessions so feedback reads the same whoever marked it.
  • Keep the academic owners close:When their expectations change, agree what that means before writing starts, and brief the whole group the same week, across the India–Australia time difference.
  • Supercharge the team with AI and automation:AI-drafted question variants, automated answer and formatting checks, tagging every item to its syllabus point, with tracking in Notion or Monday, and keep finding the next manual step to remove. Specialists keep the final call on every item.
  • Coach directly:Run structured 1:1s and performance conversations with every designer, developer, writer and marker, and make sure everyone knows why their work matters.
  • Decide how the function grows:When Contour adds a subject, a format or volume, choose which lever to pull, hire where the answer is headcount, and prepare what it needs in advance.
  • Fix the cycle where it breaks:Find where creation or checking loses time or lets errors through, including errors found after release, and fix the cause in the process rather than in one draft.
  • Report what is shipping:Keep throughput, pass rates and rework visible, so the VP of Global Enablement and Support and the academic owners can see where content stands without asking.
If a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.

Requirements

What You Need
We weigh what you have built and run more than the years on your CV. You should be able to point to:
  • International exposure (essential):content you built or led for a curriculum outside India, such as Australian (VCE, QCE, HSC), IB, Cambridge IGCSE or A-levels, AP or SAT, and regular work with academic owners, clients or examiners in another country.
  • Tech-forward, AI-first habits (essential):a content or QA step you moved onto AI or automation, such as drafting, checking, tagging or tracking, and what it did for the team's speed and quality.
  • A content or curriculum department you led, spanning subjects beyond your specialism and held to a bar someone else set.
  • A production schedule you ran from brief to release, where deadlines held without corners cut.
  • A tracker that made a standard visible: a checklist, a KPI, a dashboard or a review step others still use.
  • A content function you grew into a new syllabus, a new format or a larger group, and what you put in place first.
  • Performance conversations you led, including one that changed how someone worked.
  • Writers who stepped up to bigger roles under you, and how you helped them.
  • Hands-on experience in academic content, content development or publishing before you managed it, so you know how a question set or unit actually gets made.
  • Excellent written English and clear, confident communication with academic owners in Australia.
If you have delivered these, or can show us how you would here, apply. If you enjoy hands-on work, this seat will suit you; if your recent years have mostly been signing off other people's work, it may feel small.

Nice to Have

  • Australian curriculum experience (VCE, QCE or HSC) in particular.
  • EdTech or education services background.
  • Curriculum design, instructional design or assessment design experience.
  • Experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n or Apps Script), or building custom GPTs or AI workflows for a team.
What Good Looks Like
  • The cycle holds:output stays on schedule at any volume, with QA never squeezed.
  • Gaps caught early:QA finds the problem before it reaches final sign-off.
  • Marking that agrees:two markers give the same piece of work the same grade and similar feedback.
  • Changes land on time:a study-design update is reflected in Contour's content before the term that needs it.
  • A team that does more with AI:the share of drafting, checking and tagging handled by AI and automation rises each term, with quality held.

Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India, and comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience; we discuss it openly early in the process.
Ready to run the content Contour's students learn from? Apply.

We are seeking candidates who are motivated and enthusiastic to be part of a dynamic team of Health Schedulers. Within this position you will be responsible for answering inbound calls, scheduling, rescheduling and canceling patient appointments as required. Answering patients' questions regarding basic medical questions and procedures. To be successful as a scheduler, you should be helpful and courteous when answering telephone calls and using multiple scheduling systems. Ultimately, an exceptional scheduler should be able to build and maintain a good rapport with physicians and staff.

Department: Hospital Imaging Central Scheduling (HICS)

Scheduling for: Outpatient imaging in the hospitals;X Rays, PET Scans, MRI'S, CT, Nuc Med etc...

Shift M-F 9 AM-5:30 PM/ 9:30AM-6PM -depending on business needs at the conclusion of training.

Training: Monday- Friday 8 AM-4:30 PM- 8 weeks.

This position is REMOTE and will require a hardwired internet connection. More details will be provided during the interview.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for scheduling across the system for physicians, medical facilities and medical practices by coordinating all aspects of scheduling including, but not limiting to, facility resources, physicians, authorizations, insurance verification, benefits and setting payment expectations to ensure an exceptional customer experience at each point of service. Using a broad understanding of customer engagement strategies, clinical procedures and company facilities, this position provides accurate and timely information to create an experience that is easy, empathetic and differentiated in the marketplace.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Schedules medical appointments through coordination of patients, providers, facility resources, ancillary staff, records, referrals, authorizations and payers. Receives and initiates calls to/from patients, providers, provider offices and facilities, while following all established scheduling procedures and protocols to ensure patients receive the care they need, when and where they need it.

2. Effectively schedules appointments, tests and/or procedures leveraging various electronic medical record / scheduling software systems according to protocols established by clinical staff and scheduling standards. Identifies alternative schedule solutions in the event patient’s preference is not available, while adhering to procedures and protocols and ensuring patient safety.

3. Obtains patient demographics, insurance information and necessary documents required to secure authorizations, referrals, or other data as determined by various facilities and insurance carriers. Responsible for obtaining and properly documenting all necessary and accurate data during the intake/registration process. Acquires and documents pertinent patient medical information in accordance with procedural guidelines.

4. Provides patients with information, pre and post-test instruction, provides location of appointment and directions. This position answers questions as necessary within guidelines and protocols. Refers questions to medical offices as appropriate. Ensures patient has “no surprises” at point of service by setting payment expectations, as well as, providing estimated payment detail where applicable.

5. Effectively communicates and builds impactful relationships through written, digital and verbal channels with patients, facilities, providers and other clinical colleagues to ensure an easy, empathetic, solution-orientated patient experience, included but not limited to phone, chat, email, electronic medical record messaging and other digital channels. Anticipates patient and provider needs and responds accordingly.

6. Solicits, labels, stores and manages scanned documents and orders received from physician offices in the document imaging software system. Ensures that all appropriate documents are received prior to appointments and ensures that orders are compliant with each facility’s policy.

7. Where applicable, collects pre-payments and verifies insurance coverage to ensure “no surprises” and enable patient ease.

8. Services inbound and outbound customer and staff communications for all facilities in the states in which they operate. Works with various departments and staff to provide accurate managed care information.

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.

Requires skills and abilities typically attained with minimum of 1 or more years of customer service or related experience in a healthcare setting, such as medical office/clinic or hospital scheduling. Other acceptable experience includes lab, medical transcription, medical assistant or receptionist in a medical setting or other equivalent experience. Demonstrated ability to provide essential customer service and knowledge in a high paced inbound contact center environment Ability to use technology tools to research and obtain accurate information to respond to customer inquiries via incoming calls, emails and/or instant messaging/chat avenues while maintaining a professional solutions and service-oriented demeanor at all times. Effective ability to build customer loyalty through positive customer interactions and provide an easy experience. Demonstrated ability to utilize computer and typing skills.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to maintain a positive and helpful attitude with customers, providers and clinic operations. Must have the ability to follow oral and written directions as they relate to the functions listed above. Must have the ability to acquire and utilize a sound knowledge of the company’s customer information systems. Must possess excellent organizational and time management skills. Accurate and efficient keyboarding skills, the ability to work effectively with common office software are required. Requires effective teamwork skills and the ability to meet deadlines and productivity standards.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience in an in-bound call center or scheduler in a practice management environment preferred. Knowledge of payor contract terms and processes preferred. Some level of familiarity with medical terminology strongly preferred. Knowledge of payor contract terms and processes is preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

jobs.excerpt: Dans le cadre de notre croissance et afin de renforcer notre Squad AI Quality & Evaluation, nous recherchons un.
jobs.description:
Dans le cadre de notre croissance et afin de renforcer notre Squad AI Quality & Evaluation, nous recherchons un.e AI Evaluation Engineer — Agentic Systems.

Intégré.e au sein de nos équipes, en télétravail avec une flexibilité sur la région parisienne, vous interviendrez sur l'un des métiers les plus stratégiques de l'IA : garantir, mesurer et fiabiliser le comportement des agents et systèmes multi-agents avant leur mise en production. Un domaine qui s'invente aujourd'hui, où vous mettrez en pratique vos acquis en QA et développerez de nouvelles compétences à la frontière de l'IA.

MISSIONS:

=> Concevoir des stratégies d'évaluation pour agents et systèmes multi-agents : trajectoires, orchestration d'outils (tool use), raisonnement multi-étapes, gestion de mémoire et de contexte
=> Évaluer au-delà du résultat final : détecter les échecs intermédiaires, la propagation d'erreurs et les dérives de comportement le long de la trajectoire
=> Concevoir et éprouver des workflows agentiques : décomposition de tâches, enchaînement d'agents (planner / executor / critic), points de contrôle et garde-fous
=> Construire des jeux de tests et scénarios de simulation d'utilisateurs : personas, cas limites, tests adversariaux
=> Exploiter le prompt engineering comme levier d'évaluation : prompts de test, LLM-as-a-judge, rubriques d'évaluation
=> Industrialiser l'évaluation dans les pipelines CI/CD : évaluation automatisée, détection de régressions, quality gates avant déploiement
=> Définir les métriques qui comptent pour un agent : réussite de tâche, fidélité, robustesse, sécurité, coût, latence, consommation de tokens
=> Combiner évaluation automatisée et évaluation humaine (human-in-the-loop), et arbitrer entre les deux
=> Documenter et diffuser les bonnes pratiques d'évaluation agentique auprès des équipes

PROFIL:

=> Idéalement une première expérience en évaluation de systèmes IA — en poste, en freelance ou même sur un projet personnel sérieux : ce métier s'invente, nous valorisons ce que vous avez déjà exploré par vous-même

=> Compréhension de ce qui rend l'évaluation d'un agent spécifique : non-déterminisme, comportement probabiliste, trajectoires multi-étapes, échecs intermédiaires, absence de vérité unique — on n'évalue pas une sortie, on score une trajectoire (chaque appel d'outil, chaque état intermédiaire devient une surface d'évaluation)

=> Familiarité avec les approches de scoring : graders à base de règles (code-based), LLM-as-a-judge pour l'ouvert, évaluation humaine — et le bon sens de savoir quand combiner les trois

=> Maîtrise réelle d'au moins un framework ou plateforme d'évaluation IA : DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, Giskard, Maxim AI, Braintrust, Langfuse, Opik ou équivalent

=> Capacité à construire un eval harness et des jeux de tests : cas experts (goldens), minage de traces de production, scénarios adversariaux

=> Bonnes pratiques de prompt engineering appliquées au test et à l'évaluation : conception de rubriques, prompts de test, calibration du juge

=> Maîtrise de Python et de l'automatisation de tests

=> Sensibilité sécurité IA, robustesse et reproductibilité

=> Une connaissance au moins générale du cadre réglementaire IA — EU AI Act(transparence, gestion des risques, littératie IA) et RGPD — et de son impact sur l'évaluation et la mise en production

=> Idéalement certifié.e ISTQB CT-AI (v2.0) et CT-GenAI — à défaut l'une des deux, avec l'envie d'obtenir la seconde

=> Socle solide en QA / test / qualité logicielle, ou en dev/data avec une vraie envie de basculer vers l'IA agentique

=> Anglais professionnel courant

SOFT SKILLS:

=> Passionné.e par les technologies innovantes et le champ de l'IA agentique

=> Rigoureux.se et doté.e d'un fort esprit critique : un tableau de bord tout vert ne vous suffit pas

=> Désireux.se de vous investir dans des projets challengeants et de gagner rapidement en responsabilités

=> Pédagogue, empathique et "Problem Solver" : vous rendez l'évaluation lisible et actionnable pour les équipes

=> Doté.e d'un excellent relationnel, d'un sens prononcé du service et de la qualité

=> Curieux.se et en veille active : un domaine qui évolue chaque semaine, et vous suivez

=> Excellent niveau de français à l'oral et à l'écrit, l'anglais professionnel étant ici indispensable
