jobs.excerpt: About the TeamJoin us at DoorDash, where our people are our most valuable asset.
jobs.description:
About the Team

Join us at DoorDash, where our people are our most valuable asset. As a member of our Architecture and Security team, you’ll play an instrumental role in building simple experiences with technology. We’re looking for a talented Solutions Architect, Business Technology Security to join our team and work closely with our business partners to drive key business decisions and innovate in critical tools such as Workday and the custom tools and dashboards we build on top of it.

About the Role

The DoorDash Architecture and Security team is looking for a Solutions Architect, Business Technology Security with demonstrated experience and knowledge in Workday Security. This role owns the strategy and design of Workday security architecture, and ensures it translates correctly into the custom, in-house tools and dashboards built downstream of it. This is a strategy and design-focused role so success here depends heavily on your ability to gather clear requirements, write them up well, and communicate design decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will interact directly with senior leaders and cross-functional partners across DoorDash to capture requirements and design lasting, secure solutions that hold up across the full ecosystem.

This role will report to the Sr. Manager, Architecture and Security.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own the strategy and design of Workday’s security architecture — data models, security groups, domains, and business process security — that serves as DoorDash’s security source of truth for the People organization.
  • Translate that architecture into clear requirements and design documentation that our build team can implement, and that downstream custom tools and dashboards can be built against safely.
  • Review new or proposed custom tooling and downstream reporting needs to identify security touchpoints and data access implications before they’re built, advising on the right design approach.
  • Partner with process owners to define data security policies, protocols, and procedures that protect sensitive HR data across Workday and downstream systems.
  • Conduct regular audits and risk assessments across Workday and the tools and reporting layers downstream of it, maintaining a forward-looking security and data classification roadmap.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on security, data, and reporting capabilities and limitations, communicating trade-offs clearly to both build teams and non-technical business stakeholders.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 5-7 years of work experience in HRIS implementation and configuration, both domestic and international, with deep expertise in Workday Security.
  • You have extensive experience with one or more Workday HCM modules (Core HCM, Reporting, Payroll, Time & Labor, Compensation, Talent Management, Absence Management) and understand how their security models interact.
  • You are an excellent requirements writer — you can turn an ambiguous business or security need into a clear, detailed design or requirements document that another team can build from without having to guess your intent.
  • You have experience translating Workday security and data architecture into requirements for downstream, custom-built tools and reporting systems.
  • You have a BA/BS degree in a quantitative or business field, or equivalent work experience.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting design recommendations to senior stakeholders and handing off clear specs to a separate engineering or build team.

We expect this position to be filled by 01/14

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. jobs.title: Senior Paid Search Manager, Make & Manage Money
jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

We're looking for the performance marketer who wants to own profitable growth across Google and Microsoft for our Make & Manage Money business, set the plan, and build the campaigns themselves. Our listicles connect people with offers across personal finance, insurance, banking, credit cards, gaming apps, and more, and winning here means understanding how intent, creative, landing pages, offer selection, partner payouts, and lead quality work together. You'll run an eight-figure annual media portfolio with the freedom to put budget wherever it earns, and the trade is that it's yours: you find what's holding growth back, whether it's in the account or not, and you go get it fixed.

Tip: Only apply if you've directly owned and profitably scaled $10M or more a year in paid media for affiliate or consumer lead generation.

Why This Seat

  • Real ownership. You own the portfolio across Google and Microsoft, set the plan, and make the calls. No layers between you and the result.
  • Partners who can move the levers. Yield, account management, and creative work alongside you on payouts, offers, and landing pages, so you're fixing the whole funnel, not just the account.
  • Room to build. Microsoft audience and native inventory, MSN included, is early for us, and budget follows what works.
  • A team that gets better together. We share what works, own what didn't, and turn wins into playbooks the whole paid team uses.
  • An AI-forward stack. Claude is in the daily workflow, with room to automate analysis, concepting, and creative iteration.

What You'll Bring

  • Ownership, Accountability & Strategy. You set the plan, prioritize the tests, and make the call, then bring your manager recommendations, not questions about what to do next.
  • A track record of profitably scaling affiliate or consumer lead gen, with direct ownership of $10M or more in annual media spend.
    • Buying traffic to competitive affiliate listicles, comparison pages, or multi-offer marketplaces.
  • Hands-on depth in Google Ads or Microsoft Ads, and the range to own a portfolio across both. If your strongest experience is in Microsoft Ads, audience buying, or native inventory, we want to hear from you.
    • Scaling across Search, Display, Demand Gen, YouTube, and native placements.
  • A real grasp of affiliate economics: partner payouts, revenue per click, conversion rates, offer mix, traffic quality, ROAS, and margin.
  • A habit of finding the actual constraint. You can tell whether a problem sits in the buying, the creative, the landing page, the offer, the payout, or the measurement, and you go to the team that owns the fix with a clear ask.
  • Clear, direct communication, including short performance updates that say what changed, why it matters, and what you need.

Nice to Have

  • Running across several consumer categories or variable-payout partner programs.
  • Using AI and self-serve creative tools to speed up analysis and asset iteration.
  • Working with competitive intelligence tools and in regulated consumer categories.
  • Building playbooks or mentoring other media buyers.

What You'll Own

  • Strategy and execution across Google Search, Demand Gen, YouTube, and Microsoft audience and native inventory, MSN included.
  • Budget allocation, pacing, forecasting, reporting, and profitability for the portfolio.
  • A prioritized growth plan that names the biggest constraints and the tests most likely to move the business.
  • The case to Sales, Account Management, Yield, Creative, Product, and Analytics for what the campaigns need, and the follow-through until it lands.
  • Campaign architecture, bidding, targeting, conversion signals, exclusions, tracking, and testing discipline.
  • Testing new inventory and platforms with a clear hypothesis and a point where you stop.

What Great Looks Like

  • You run the portfolio on your own and bring your manager recommendations and decisions.
  • Profitable spend and margin grow because of a deliberate, prioritized testing plan.
  • Microsoft grows into a real second source alongside Google.
  • Partner teams know what you need, why it matters, and how their work moves growth, and payouts, offers, or pages change because of the case you made.
  • Your playbooks make the broader paid team better.

This Isn't the Right Seat If You

  • See the ad account as the whole job.
  • Want someone else to set the plan or tell you what to test next.
  • Have mostly managed agencies or reporting rather than building campaigns yourself.
  • Would rather not push other teams for changes you don't control.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Pipeline and Revenue
  • Own a quarterly pipeline and bookings target for GSI-sourced and influenced Microsoft 365 opportunities.

Joint Solutions and Offerings

Microsoft Ecosystem and Go-to-Market

  • Travel of approximately 30-40%.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Background selling backup, data protection, or cyber resilience for Microsoft 365 or SaaS workloads.
  • Experience with Microsoft co-sell, Azure Marketplace, and MACC-based purchasing.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC and partner-led deal registration.
  • Microsoft certifications or equivalent hands-on M365 architecture credibility.
Success Metrics (First 12 Months):
  • Pipeline coverage against target (e.g., 3-4x) and closed-won bookings from GSI-led M365 deals.
  • Number of GSIs with an active joint M365 plan and at least one packaged joint offering.
  • Number of GSI sellers and architects trained and certified.
  • New GSI-led wins, published reference stories, and Salesforce forecast accuracy.

jobs.description:
About Checkmate and Mate. 🛍 📲

Checkmate is a multichannel offers network loved by 100M shoppers and hundreds of leading brands.

mate. is your AI growth teammate, the data network that agentically turns customer intelligence into revenue.

Checkmate is the distribution network, with 100M+ shoppers and 12B+ live intent signals. mate is the AI layer built on top of it: it resolves anonymous visitors, spots the revenue a brand is missing, and builds and executes the campaigns to capture it.

The combination is rare: a consumer product shoppers love and an AI growth engine brands depend on.

We work with leading brands like Everlane, Brooklinen, and Malbon, and we're backed by Google Ventures, Mantis VC, Fuel Capital, and others.

We're a remote-first team with hubs in LA and NYC, and a preference for hiring in or near major cities.

Role Overview 💼

You'll design, build, and ship the core systems behind mate: the pixel, tracking, and ad delivery services that brands plug into and rely on every day. If you've built production systems inside a DSP, an ad platform, or an ad tech company and know how pixels and conversions actually work under the hood, this is a senior seat where you'll own real architecture decisions on a small team that ships fast.

Please note: this role is a US-based role only and we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

What You'll Do ⚡

Build and ship core product

  • Design, build, and ship backend services and APIs that power mate's agents, from spec to production
  • Improve and maintain an identity graph.
  • Own features end to end, partnering with product and design on what to build and how
  • Write clean, well-tested, production-grade code and set the standard for the rest of the team

Ad tech infrastructure

  • Build and maintain our pixel, tags, and server-side tracking, and the conversion integrations with Meta, TikTok, Google, and others
  • Build integrations with DSPs, ad platforms, and partner APIs
  • Build the real-time services that deliver offers across the network, fast and reliably

Architecture and reliability

  • Make architecture calls on how our systems scale: service design, storage, queues, and caching
  • Own reliability in production: monitoring, alerting, debugging, and incident response
  • Improve developer tooling, CI/CD, and pay down tech debt where it slows us down

Engineering leadership

  • Lead design reviews and code reviews, and mentor other engineers
  • Help shape engineering practices and hiring as the team grows

Requirements

Who You Are 🧬

  • You've built ad tech from the inside and know how the pieces connect, from pixel to conversion.
  • You like owning a system end to end, not just a ticket queue.
  • You're pragmatic: you ship fast on a small team without cutting corners on quality.
  • You think about the brand's outcome, not just whether the code ships.
  • You raise the bar for the engineers around you.

What You Bring 🎒

  • 6+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time at an ad tech company (DSP, ad platform, ad exchange, or identity provider)
  • Strong backend engineering skills in Python and Typescript, including designing APIs and distributed services
  • Hands-on experience building pixels, tags, SDKs, or conversion tracking, client-side and server-side
  • Experience building systems that handle high request volume with low latency
  • Comfort with cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD
  • A track record of owning systems in production, from launch through monitoring and on-call

Bonus: Identity resolution / graph networks, ecommerce or Shopify, or early-stage startup experience.

Why This Role Matters

Mate only works if the systems underneath them are fast, reliable, and plugged into the ad platforms brands already buy on. This engineer builds that foundation. Get it right and brands see clearer results, buy more effectively, and spend more with us. It's one of the highest-leverage engineering seats at the company

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits 💸

  • Competitive base salary
  • Equity in a fast-growing, venture-backed company
  • Competitive medical/dental/vision/other healthcare coverage
  • 4 weeks PTO + health days
  • 401k plan
  • Monthly stipend for fitness/wellness activities
  • Company retreats and team get togethers 2x a year 🏝

About the Role

This is a phone-first role. Email and LinkedIn outreach at Forager is automated and run by our Growth team, so the SDR does the part a machine cannot: get prospects on the phone, qualify them properly, and hand our closers meetings that turn into real opportunities. You will work directly with the CEO, Head of Growth, GTM agency, and our commercial Account Executive (AE).

Why join

    • Keep HubSpot accurate on every lead you touch. AI drafts the notes, enrichment and follow-ups; you confirm the facts and the next step.

What you will NOT spend your time on

  • Writing and sending email or LinkedIn sequences. These are automated and owned by the Growth team; you see the replies, not the sends.
    • Building lists or researching accounts. The signal engine and AI do this before a name reaches your call list.
    • Manual CRM data entry, call notes and meeting prep. AI drafts these; you check them.

Tools and systems

  • HubSpot: CRM, lead routing, deal stages and the Demo Accepted gate

• Parallel dialer for outbound calling

    • Clear, confident spoken English and comfort with technical buyers (product, data and engineering leaders)
    • Comfortable learning technical products quickly; you’ll explain enrichment APIs and data feeds to technical buyers
    • Self-managed and comfortable working in a fully remote team.

Nice-to-haves:

    • You have experience with a parallel dialer, and HubSpot
    • You have worked marketplace or partner-sourced leads

Benefits

    • Untracked PTO: take the time off you need, with no accrual to count. We trust you to get the job done

Apply with your CV and a 2-minute audio or video recording about a cold call you made that turned into an opportunity your sales team accepted: what you said, the objection you hit, how you knew it was worth a meeting, and what happened after the handoff . Freight Dispatcher — Load Evaluation & Planning

Full-Time | Remote — United States | U.S. Freight Operations

Evaluate the Load Before the Truck Commits

We are hiring a Freight Dispatcher — Load Evaluation & Planning to support U.S. trucking operations with a focus on freight evaluation, load selection, mileage analysis, trip feasibility, and day-to-day dispatch support.

This position may be a strong fit for transportation professionals, including experienced or former CDL-A drivers, who understand that the advertised freight rate is only one part of determining whether a load makes operational sense.

Previous employment specifically under the title of Freight Dispatcher is not required. Applicants must have relevant U.S. trucking, transportation, logistics, fleet, or closely related operational experience.

Load Evaluation

  • Search DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable U.S. freight load boards for available freight.
  • Compare available loads by lane, equipment type, rate, mileage, appointments, and operating requirements.
  • Calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Evaluate whether pickup and delivery schedules are operationally realistic.
  • Consider driver location, available Hours of Service, equipment, routing, weather, and freight requirements.
  • Identify excessive deadhead, unrealistic transit times, equipment conflicts, or other operational concerns.
  • Compare available freight options before presenting suitable loads for authorized review.

Trip & Freight Planning

  • Evaluate how a proposed load affects the driver's current location and subsequent freight opportunities.
  • Review pickup and delivery appointment requirements.
  • Consider available driver hours when evaluating trip feasibility.
  • Identify potential detention exposure, scheduling conflicts, or inefficient freight movements.
  • Assist with planning freight around equipment availability and operating requirements.
  • Present appropriate freight options for authorized review and booking.
  • Negotiate freight rates only when specifically authorized.

Driver & Broker Communication

  • Communicate professionally with U.S. CDL-A drivers, freight brokers, shippers, receivers, and authorized transportation personnel.
  • Confirm freight details, appointments, equipment requirements, and applicable operating instructions.
  • Clarify incomplete or inconsistent load information before presenting freight for approval.
  • Communicate accurate load information to drivers.
  • Monitor applicable freight updates and operational changes.
  • Escalate safety, compliance, broker-verification, documentation, or service concerns when appropriate.

Transportation Documentation

  • Maintain accurate load and dispatch records.
  • Review rate confirmations for consistency with agreed freight information.
  • Organize bills of lading, proof-of-delivery documents, and related transportation records.
  • Document appointment changes, delays, detention, layover, and applicable freight exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate communication histories and operational notes.
  • Identify missing information requiring follow-up.

Required Transportation Background

Relevant professional experience may include:

  • CDL-A truck driving
  • Freight dispatch support
  • Fleet operations
  • Carrier operations
  • Transportation coordination
  • Logistics operations
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Load planning
  • Owner-Operator operations
  • Comparable U.S. trucking operations

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and freight operations.
  • Familiarity with U.S. freight load boards.
  • Ability to evaluate freight based on rate, mileage, deadhead, equipment, and appointments.
  • Ability to calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, total trip mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Understanding of common CDL-A equipment types.
  • Understanding of pickup and delivery appointments.
  • Working knowledge of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Ability to identify operationally unsuitable freight.
  • Fluent professional spoken and written English.
  • Strong professional telephone and email communication.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Computer and spreadsheet proficiency.
  • Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Work Arrangement & Schedule

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. freight operations.

Primary hiring location: Chicago, Illinois, United States.
Hiring market: Remote — United States.

Qualified applicants may be considered throughout the United States.

The Operations Specialist serves as the execution core for the data and supplier-coordination layer that keeps the platform delivering for enterprise customers. Day-to-day, this role focuses heavily on Excel-based data work—cleaning, structuring, and validating supplier, product, and quantity datasets ~ while supporting live sourcing events and vendor outreach so senior team members can remain focused on high-level strategy. Key Responsibilities

Data Cleaning & Validation

  • Clean, structure, and validate supplier, product, and quantity data using Microsoft Excel.

  • Apply VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX MATCH, pivot tables, and conditional formulas to organize and normalize datasets.

  • Sanity-check data for missing values, inconsistent formatting, and errors prior to modeling, comparing extracted data against source documents.

  • Onboard validated customer data onto the client's deployment platform.

Deployment & Operations Support

  • Proactively flag process gaps and recommend operational improvements.

  • Take on expanded end-to-end account ownership as tenure and performance progress.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on Microsoft Excel experience in a professional work environment (excluding coursework or training), with strong proficiency in pivot tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX MATCH, and IF formulas.

  • Demonstrated experience cleaning, normalizing, and validating datasets using formula-based methods (no hard-coded values) and building replicable models others can follow.

  • Experience conducting outbound phone calls to US-based suppliers, vendors, or business contacts in a professional capacity.

  • C1+ English proficiency (CEFR), both spoken and written, with strong attention to detail.

  • Located in the Philippines and able to work full-time aligned to US Eastern Time (Monday–Friday, within ±1 hour of New York time, including an 8:45 AM ET daily team standup).

  • Nice-to-Have: 1–2 years of experience in management consulting or at a boutique advisory firm, hands-on procurement or supply chain experience, prior exposure to e-procurement/sourcing platforms, or Python skills for data manipulation and automation.

jobs.title: Human Resources - HR & HRIS Operations Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Position Description: Infinite Electronics is seeking an HRIS Analyst to serve as the primary configuration owner of our Dayforce environment.
jobs.description:
Position Description:

Infinite Electronics is seeking an HRIS Analyst to serve as the primary configuration owner of our Dayforce environment. This is a fully remote, hands-on role for someone who has configured Dayforce across multiple modules and can translate a business policy into a working system rule.

Infinite implemented Dayforce recently, and the modules today are largely siloed and under-leveraged. Significant functionality we are already licensed for, including Compensation Management, Performance Management, and Succession Planning, is not yet in production. Numerous processes remain manual and external to the system.

This role owns closing that gap. The successful candidate will interview stakeholders, understand how hiring, compensation, payroll, and reporting actually work at Infinite, and then configure Dayforce to support those processes rather than force workarounds around it. This is ongoing work, not a one-time project. New policies, acquisitions, and business changes will require continuous reconfiguration, and this role is the durable internal capability for that.

The position carries both build and run responsibility. Alongside configuration work, it provides ongoing system support for the recurring processes that run through Dayforce, including weekly payroll and the annual Open Enrollment, Performance Management, and Compensation Review cycles. The successful candidate will be accountable for ensuring each cycle is configured, tested, and ready before it opens, and for resolving system issues while it is live.

General Duties and Responsibilities:

Serve as primary administrator and configuration owner for Dayforce across subscribed modules, including Core HR, Payroll, Time & Attendance, Benefits, Recruiting, Onboarding, and Compensation Management.

Translate business and policy requirements into Dayforce configuration, including pay rules, earning and deduction codes, eligibility rules, workflows, forms, and approval chains.

Diagnose incorrect system behavior by isolating the responsible rule, policy, or configuration element, and implement and validate the fix.

Lead deployment of licensed but unimplemented modules, including Compensation Management, Performance Management, and Succession Planning.

Design, test, and migrate configuration changes through the full release cycle, including regression testing against payroll and time results before production promotion.

Administer security roles, user access, and data governance, maintaining appropriate segregation of duties across HR, Payroll, and Finance.

Build and maintain reporting and dashboards for HR, Finance, and leadership, and improve data quality and consistency across modules.

Manage integrations between Dayforce and downstream systems, including benefit carriers, retirement recordkeepers, and Finance, and monitor interface errors.

Evaluate and test Dayforce quarterly releases, assess impact to existing configuration, and communicate changes to affected stakeholders.

Provide system ownership and support for weekly payroll processing, validating configuration-driven results, resolving calculation and rule issues, and supporting Payroll through pre-commit review and close.

Configure and administer annual Open Enrollment in Dayforce Benefits, including plan year setup, rates, eligibility and life event rules, enrollment workflows, employee-facing content, and carrier file updates, and provide support throughout the enrollment window.

Configure and run the annual Performance Management cycle, including review forms, rating scales, routing and approval workflows, calibration support, and cycle reporting.

Configure and administer the Annual Compensation Review in Dayforce Compensation Management, including merit and bonus cycle setup, budgets, eligibility rules, guidelines, manager worksheets, approval routing, and downstream loading of approved changes.

Maintain the recurring HR systems calendar and ensure configuration for each cycle is built, tested, and validated in advance of the cycle opening.

Partner with HR Operations and Payroll to identify manual and off-system processes and systematically move them into Dayforce.

Document configuration decisions, business rules, test plans, and standard operating procedures so the environment is supportable and auditable.

Serve as escalation point for complex system issues and manage tickets and enhancement requests with Dayforce support and managed services.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Required.

Minimum of three years of hands-on Dayforce configuration experience across multiple modules. Required. Experience limited to end-user or reporting access does not meet this requirement.

Demonstrated ability to translate a written business policy into working system configuration and validate the result.

Working knowledge of payroll mechanics, including pay rules, earning and deduction codes, and how configuration drives calculation outcomes.

Experience managing configuration through a structured test and release process, including regression testing prior to production.

Experience building reports and resolving data integrity issues across integrated HR modules.

Experience supporting recurring operational cycles in an HCM platform, such as payroll processing, open enrollment, performance reviews, or a merit cycle.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work independently and own problems to resolution.

Sound judgment handling confidential compensation and employee data.

Preferred Qualifications:

Dayforce implementation or post-implementation optimization experience.

Configuration experience running annual Open Enrollment, Performance Management, or Compensation Review cycles in Dayforce.

Experience with Dayforce Integration Studio, report writing, or API-based integrations.

Experience in a multi-entity organization or supporting acquisition integration into an existing HCM environment.

Hands-on multi-state payroll processing experience.

Dayforce certification in one or more modules.

Physical Job Requirements:

Ability to work in a remote or office-based setting using standard office equipment, computers, and job-related technology platforms.

Ability to communicate effectively with employees, managers, vendors, and internal stakeholders in virtual and in-person settings.

Ability to view, interpret, and analyze information on screens, documents, and reports for extended periods.

Ability to work extended or adjusted hours as required by payroll close, quarter-end, year-end, and system release cycles.

Reports To: Head of Total Rewards & HRIS

Environment: This role is performed remotely within the United States, with regular virtual collaboration across HR, Payroll, Finance, and Operations. Workload is cyclical. The position requires availability during weekly payroll processing windows, Dayforce release cycles, scheduled configuration deployments, and the annual Open Enrollment, Performance Management, and Compensation Review periods, which carry elevated workload and fixed deadlines.

Accommodation: Infinite Electronics is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. An individual must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Infinite Electronics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and makes employment decisions based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Billing & Revenue Systems
jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer, Billing & Revenue Systems to design, build, and improve the backend infrastructure supporting payments, subscriptions, billing workflows, and revenue operations across Bask Health's telehealth platform.

You'll work on systems that connect merchant configuration, patient checkout, recurring payments, billing records, and financial reporting. Your work will help ensure transactions are processed reliably, subscription changes are handled correctly, and financial information remains accurate across the platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical judgment, experience with complex backend systems, and the ability to independently own projects from architecture through production.

Bask's engineering platform uses TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies including tRPC, Prisma, and Drizzle in our broader stack.

You'll collaborate with product managers, engineers, finance, and operations teams to develop scalable systems that support the financial side of running telehealth businesses.

We're looking for someone who understands that billing systems need more than functional code. They need accurate data, predictable behavior, clear error handling, and reliable recovery when something goes wrong.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services supporting billing, payments, subscriptions, and revenue-related workflows.
  • Build and improve integrations with payment processors and external billing services.
  • Develop APIs and application logic for subscription creation, renewals, cancellations, plan changes, and payment status updates.
  • Help implement pricing, discount, trial, and billing configuration logic across merchant and patient workflows.
  • Design reliable processing for payment events, webhooks, and asynchronous billing updates.
  • Build services using TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases.
  • Use AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, and related services to support event-driven billing workflows.
  • Design database schemas and data models for transactions, subscriptions, invoices, billing events, and financial records.
  • Develop mechanisms to prevent duplicate charges, inconsistent billing states, and lost payment events.
  • Implement retry logic, idempotency, validation, and error handling for payment-related operations.
  • Help build reconciliation processes that identify discrepancies between internal billing records and external payment providers.
  • Improve the reliability, performance, and maintainability of existing billing services.
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to understand billing issues, reporting needs, and operational requirements.
  • Work with product managers and engineers to translate business requirements into technical designs.
  • Develop internal tools and workflows that make billing issues easier to investigate and resolve.
  • Build appropriate access controls, audit trails, and safeguards around sensitive billing information.
  • Create automated tests covering billing calculations, subscription transitions, payment failures, and other edge cases.
  • Investigate production incidents, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes.
  • Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and visibility into billing system performance.
  • Review code, provide technical guidance, and contribute to engineering standards.
  • Take ownership of complex billing initiatives from design and implementation through deployment and production support.
  • Use Cursor, Claude Code, and other AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development while independently validating correctness, security, and maintainability.
  • Help establish reusable billing architecture that supports additional products, merchants, and business models.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on backend development.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining production backend services and APIs.
  • Professional experience integrating third-party APIs, processing webhooks, or building event-driven backend systems.
  • Experience working with AWS services and serverless architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or comparable asynchronous processing infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with SQL databases, relational data modeling, and database schema design.
  • Experience with modern ORM or database access tools such as Prisma or Drizzle.
  • Strong understanding of transactional data integrity, consistency, and reliable backend processing.
  • Experience implementing idempotency, retries, error handling, and recovery mechanisms for critical workflows.
  • Ability to design backend systems that support complex business rules and state transitions.
  • Strong understanding of API security, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of sensitive information.
  • Experience writing automated tests, debugging production systems, and maintaining high software quality.
  • Ability to independently own complex engineering projects from architecture through deployment.
  • Experience making architectural decisions and evaluating technical tradeoffs.
  • Familiarity with Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and modern software development practices.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively while independently validating generated code.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with product managers, engineers, finance, and operations teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with significant ownership and responsibility.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building billing infrastructure, payment systems, or subscription management platforms.
  • Experience integrating Stripe or similar payment processors.
  • Familiarity with payment intents, webhooks, recurring billing, refunds, disputes, or payment reconciliation.
  • Experience working with subscription lifecycle management, pricing engines, or usage-based billing.
  • Experience building financial reporting, revenue tracking, or billing reconciliation systems.
  • Familiarity with transactional database design and payment-related consistency challenges.
  • Experience with SST and serverless application development on AWS.
  • Experience with tRPC, Next.js, React, or full-stack TypeScript applications.
  • Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS platforms or monorepo architectures.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS considerations, payment security, or financial data controls.
  • Experience building internal finance or billing operations tools.
  • Experience supporting e-commerce checkout, merchant billing, or subscription-based SaaS products.
  • Experience implementing audit logs, operational monitoring, and alerting for financial workflows.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or establishing reusable backend architecture.
  • Experience using Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools in production engineering workflows.

jobs.title: Temporary Director, Growth Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Hanna Andersson is seeking an experienced Temporary Director, Growth Marketing, to provide senior-level leadership for the Growth Marketing function during a period of temporary coverage.
jobs.description:
Hanna Andersson is seeking an experienced Temporary Director, Growth Marketing, to provide senior-level leadership for the Growth Marketing function during a period of temporary coverage.

The Temporary Director, Growth Marketing will be responsible for driving strong business performance across paid acquisition channels while providing the strategic judgment, operating leadership, and cross-functional partnership required to sustain momentum and support Hanna Andersson’s growth priorities.

This engagement requires an experienced growth leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution, make sound investment and optimization decisions, translate performance into clear business recommendations, and operate with a high degree of independence.

This role is a temporary 5-6 month engagement.

What You'll Do:

    Growth Marketing Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead paid acquisition strategy across Paid Search, Paid Social, Affiliate, Display, and other relevant or emerging channels.
  • Translate company, marketing, and commercial priorities into focused acquisition plans and channel strategies.
  • Maintain a clear point of view on where to invest, optimize, test, or pull back based on business performance and customer opportunity.
  • Balance near-term performance needs with longer-term customer acquisition quality and sustainable growth.
  • Represent Growth Marketing in appropriate cross-functional and leadership discussions.
  • Surface material risks, opportunities, and investment tradeoffs with clear recommendations.

    • Performance & Investment Management

  • Maintain accountability for core acquisition performance, including CAC, ROAS, traffic, new customer growth, and other agreed Growth Marketing KPIs.
  • Evaluate acquisition performance with consideration for customer quality, LTV, payback, and broader business economics where data is available.
  • Manage paid media budget pacing, forecasting, and optimization.
  • Recommend investment shifts across channels, audiences, campaigns, or partners based on performance and business priorities.
  • Identify material performance variances and take or recommend timely corrective action.
  • Partner with Finance and Analytics as appropriate to strengthen investment and performance decisions.

    • Channel Execution & Optimization
  • Oversee the planning, launch, management, and optimization of campaigns across relevant paid acquisition channels.
  • Ensure channel strategies, audiences, bids, budgets, and campaign structures remain appropriately managed.
  • Maintain visibility into product feed health, pixel tracking, measurement, and other dependencies that may affect media performance.
  • Partner with internal Technology, Analytics, and Ecommerce teams to address material issues affecting execution or measurement.
  • Ensure campaign activity remains aligned with promotional, product, brand, and business priorities.

    • Testing, Learning & Creative Effectiveness
  • Maintain and prioritize the Growth Marketing testing roadmap.
  • Develop clear hypotheses and ensure tests are designed to generate actionable learning.
  • Evaluate performance across audience, channel, offer, message, creative, and landing experience.
  • Translate testing and performance insights into recommendations for future campaigns and investment decisions.
  • Partner closely with Brand and Creative teams to improve the effectiveness of campaign assets and messaging.
  • Ensure performance learning is communicated in a way that strengthens future creative and marketing decisions rather than remaining isolated within media channels.

    • Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Partner closely with Brand, Creative, Analytics, Ecommerce, CRM/Lifecycle, Merchandising, Finance, Technology, and other relevant partners.
  • Support integrated campaign planning for key product launches, promotional moments, and brand initiatives.
  • Ensure Growth Marketing execution reflects broader marketing and business priorities.
  • Bring forward performance insights that may have implications beyond paid media.
  • Create clarity when cross-functional dependencies or competing priorities could affect Growth Marketing outcomes.
  • Maintain strong working relationships and effective decision-making across teams.

    • Agency & Vendor Leadership
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day leader for Growth Marketing agency and vendor relationships.
  • Maintain clear expectations, priorities, and performance accountability.
  • Evaluate agency recommendations critically and ensure decisions remain grounded in Hanna Andersson’s business objectives.
  • Escalate material performance, capability, or service concerns as appropriate.
  • Recommend adjustments to agency or vendor approaches where needed to improve results or effectiveness.

    • Analytics, Reporting & Business Storytelling
  • Maintain appropriate reporting and performance-management cadences for Growth Marketing.
  • Partner with Analytics to ensure reporting supports timely and actionable decision-making.
  • Synthesize performance into clear narratives that explain what happened, why it matters, and what actions should follow.
  • Provide concise, executive-ready Growth Marketing updates and recommendations.
  • Distinguish between short-term channel movement and broader business or customer signals when interpreting performance.

    • Functional Leadership & Continuity

  • Provide senior functional leadership for Growth Marketing throughout the engagement.
  • Own day-to-day leadership and decision-making for the function within established company guardrails.
  • Operate with the judgment and business fluency required to represent Growth Marketing in cross-functional and leadership forums.
  • Provide direction and support to internal team members and cross-functional contributors as appropriate.
  • Maintain continuity of critical Growth Marketing operating rhythms, recurring meetings, agency reviews, planning processes, and decision forums.
  • Ensure key priorities, decisions, risks, performance context, and material learnings are appropriately documented throughout the engagement.
  • Support an orderly transition at the conclusion of the assignment to the appropriate designated leader.

    • Leadership Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop growth marketing team.
  • Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and customer-centricity.

Working Relationships:

    The Temporary Director, Growth Marketing will work closely with the Digital leadership team and key partners across Brand, Creative, Analytics, Ecommerce, CRM/Lifecycle, Finance, Technology, and Merchandising.

    The Temporary Director, Growth Marketing is expected to operate with significant independence while maintaining appropriate alignment with company leadership on material investment, business, organizational, and contractual decisions.

Decision Authority:

    The Temporary Director, Growth Marketing is expected to make day-to-day Growth Marketing decisions and recommendations consistent with approved budgets, business priorities, company policies, and established decision rights.

    Material changes to total investment levels, agency or vendor relationships, contractual commitments, organizational structure, or other significant business decisions require appropriate Hanna Andersson approval.

Engagement Success Measures:

  • Growth Marketing performance and business continuity during the engagement.
  • Effective management of paid media investment and acquisition KPIs.
  • Quality of new-customer acquisition and consideration of longer-term customer economics.
  • Quality and timeliness of optimization and investment decisions.
  • Strength of strategic judgment and commercial recommendations.
  • Strength of cross-functional partnership and leadership.
  • Effectiveness of agency and vendor management.
  • Quality of testing, learning, and performance insights.
  • Clarity and usefulness of executive-level reporting and recommendations.
  • Ability to operate independently while appropriately escalating material risks and decisions.
  • Quality of documentation and transition readiness at the conclusion of the engagement.

You Should Have:

    • 8+ years of progressive Growth or Performance Marketing experience, preferably in ecommerce, retail, consumer, apparel, or a digitally driven brand.
    • Demonstrated experience operating at Director or comparable senior functional leadership level.
    • Deep expertise across Paid Social, Paid Search, Affiliate, Display, and related acquisition channels.
    • Demonstrated experience managing significant paid media budgets and making portfolio investment decisions.
    • Strong fluency in CAC, ROAS, LTV, payback, attribution, incrementality, and customer economics.
    • Experience developing and leading sophisticated testing and optimization programs.
    • Strong creative and customer judgment in addition to quantitative performance expertise.
    • Experience managing agencies and external partners.
    • Strong cross-functional leadership and executive communication skills.
    • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with limited oversight and evolving priorities.
    • Experience stepping into interim, consulting, or senior operating roles strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; and copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work. All of this frontline work is powered by a trusted knowledge base that provides the right information, processes, and systems for every interaction. We also build the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

You are a hands-on knowledge engineer growing into a team lead, well versed in the full knowledge graph development lifecycle. You turn the scattered knowledge behind customer service, such as knowledge articles, policies, product information, troubleshooting guides, and case history, into a single, trusted source of truth that AI agents, service agents, and customers can rely on. You formulate real-world service problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and knowledge graph solutions, working across the lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, and deployment.


You design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, apply current methods with the right architecture, and stay current with knowledge engineering, generative AI, LLMs, and multimodal models, looking for ways to apply them to the problem at hand. You explain the value of knowledge graph and AI approaches in plain language, share what you learn with the team, and begin to guide junior engineers. You collaborate with business users, engineers, architects, and designers to deliver your part of an end-to-end solution.


The work:

  • Assess a client's service knowledge landscape: where knowledge lives today across knowledge bases, document repositories, CRM and ticketing systems, and agent notes, and where it is duplicated, conflicting, or out of date.
  • Build knowledge graph components that consolidate service knowledge into one source of truth and contribute to transforming the client's data architecture.
  • Design and maintain service ontologies and taxonomies that model products, customer issues, symptoms, resolutions, policies, and entitlements, so knowledge can be found, connected, and reasoned over.
  • Build ingestion and curation pipelines that turn unstructured content, such as articles, manuals, policies, and interaction transcripts, into structured, governed knowledge.
  • Make the knowledge base the trusted input for AI, preparing and structuring knowledge for retrieval through knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, and vector search, so virtual agents, agent-assist copilots, and analytics agents give accurate, consistent, and current answers. You work closely with the AI Solution Engineering teams who build those agents.
  • Build governance into the knowledge itself, including ownership, versioning, review cycles, and access rules that separate customer-facing content from internal-only guidance.
  • Mine service interactions to find knowledge gaps, such as questions customers ask that neither AI nor service agents can answer well, and feed them back into content creation and curation.
  • Design, develop, and implement AI and semantic solutions, and make sure your work integrates cleanly with the broader system, working alongside Enterprise AI Architecture teams on connections to service platforms.
  • Build solid working relationships with client counterparts, including knowledge managers and service operations teams, and work alongside the project team and delivery leads.
  • Help assemble the supporting evidence for the recommended semantic layer solution, and support Accenture sales efforts when called on.
  • Keep developing your skills in cutting-edge Data & AI solutions, especially agentic technologies, and share what you learn with the team.

Here's what you'll need:

  • 3+ years of experience working on customer service, contact center, or customer experience projects or operations, with an understanding of how knowledge quality affects service outcomes such as first-contact resolution, average handle time, containment, and CSAT.
  • At least 3 of the following:
    • Minimum 2 years of experience with knowledge graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL).
    • Minimum 2 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, and knowledge graph curation.
    • Minimum 2 years of designing and developing knowledge graph solutions and graph-based ML models (functional and technical).
    • Minimum 1 year of experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementation for AI applications (especially LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration.
    • Minimum 2 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with service knowledge management platforms such as Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow Knowledge Management, eGain, or Zendesk, or with content repositories such as SharePoint and Confluence.
  • Familiarity with Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) or similar knowledge management practices.
  • Experience with GraphRAG or other knowledge-grounded retrieval for AI agents.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • 2+ years of experience in Python, with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch and tools for building ETL pipelines, such as Apache NiFi or Airflow.
  • Practical experience with NLP and/or search techniques, prompt engineering, and LLMs for enterprise-scale applications.
  • Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems.
  • Team lead experience.
  • External client-facing consulting experience.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams in multiple time zones.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara builds software that helps organizations run safer, more efficient physical operations. Our products connect data from vehicles, equipment, and cameras to the people who use it.

The Operational AI team is turning Samsara's safety cameras into tools for understanding everyday operations. Our AI-powered products help customers observe the work, conditions, and events that matter to them, wherever their vehicles travel or their teams operate.

As a senior engineer, you will build agentic solutions that let customers create their own custom detections and workflows. You will own work from the first customer conversation through design, implementation, and production operation. You will work across backend services and customer-facing software, partnering with platform and machine learning engineers on AI capabilities in the cloud and on devices.

This role offers room to shape both the product and its technical direction. You will help decide what to build, learn from customers, and turn early ideas into software they can rely on.

jobs.description:
About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives. We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a dedicated and empathetic Customer Support Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in assisting users with app functionality, resolving their issues, and building trust within the community. This role requires fluency in a regional language, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Respond to customer inquiries promptly and effectively in Telugu / Tamil / Kannada / Malayalam / Gujarati / Marathi / Bengali / Hindi and English.
  • Assist users in understanding app functionality and help troubleshoot any issues they encounter.
  • Provide valuable feedback based on customer interactions to support product and service improvements.
  • Document customer queries and resolutions accurately for internal tracking and reference.
  • Collaborate with other team members to resolve complex user concerns efficiently.
  • Maintain high standards of customer satisfaction through timely and empathetic support.
  • Engage with users to build strong relationships and foster trust in the platform.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Hindi + Telugu and English, both written and verbal.
  • Prior experience in customer support or a related field is highly desirable.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure and handle complaints with professionalism.
  • Familiarity with customer support tools and platforms.
  • A strong commitment to customer satisfaction and a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) – must have access to a personal smartphone and laptop for work.

Why Join Us?

We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

jobs.description:
Leidos is seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Engineer / Information System Security Engineer (ISSE) to support the security engineering, system authorization, compliance, and continuous monitoring of enterprise healthcare technology solutions supporting the Department of Defense (DoD) and Defense Health Agency (DHA).


The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining system security documentation, supporting implementation and validation of cybersecurity controls, preparing authorization artifacts, and coordinating activities required to obtain and maintain an Authority to Operate (ATO). The supported environment includes Salesforce Health Cloud, Amazon Connect, AWS GovCloud, identity and access management services, enterprise integrations, and associated cloud infrastructure.

This position will work closely with Leidos cybersecurity leadership, government security personnel, system administrators, developers, solution architects, and cloud engineers to ensure system development and operations comply with applicable DoD/DHA cybersecurity requirements throughout the system lifecycle.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Support cybersecurity engineering throughout system design, development, integration, deployment, and sustainment of Salesforce Health Cloud, Amazon Connect, and associated cloud services.
  • Develop, maintain, and coordinate required DoD/DHA ATO and Risk Management Framework (RMF) documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), security control implementation narratives, security boundary diagrams, data flow diagrams, and supporting authorization artifacts.
  • Prepare and maintain security control responsibility matrices, hardware/software inventories, ports and protocols documentation, interconnection agreements, and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Coordinate with government Information System Security Managers (ISSMs), Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), security assessors, and Leidos cybersecurity personnel throughout the authorization process.
  • Review system architectures, integrations, cloud configurations, and application designs to identify cybersecurity requirements, risks, and potential compliance gaps.
  • Support implementation and validation of NIST SP 800-53 security controls, secure configuration baselines, access controls, encryption, logging, and monitoring capabilities.
  • Evaluate cloud service security requirements, inherited controls, shared responsibility models, and authorization boundaries for Salesforce, AWS, and associated services.
  • Coordinate vulnerability assessments, security scanning, configuration reviews, and remediation activities across system components.
  • Track cybersecurity findings, vulnerabilities, POA&Ms, and corrective actions through validation and closure.
  • Support continuous monitoring activities, including security control assessments, audit log reviews, vulnerability reporting, and compliance documentation.
  • Conduct security impact assessments for application enhancements, configuration changes, new integrations, and software releases.
  • Collaborate with developers and administrators to implement secure development practices and remediate application security vulnerabilities.
  • Support security incident investigation, response coordination, evidence collection, and corrective action activities in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Maintain accurate security documentation, authorization evidence, compliance records, and technical security procedures.
  • Communicate cybersecurity risks, authorization status, compliance findings, and remediation progress to program management and government stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 4–8 years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 2–6 years of relevant experience. Equivalent experience may be considered in accordance with Leidos policies.
  • At least 3 years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, information assurance, system security engineering, or security assessment and authorization activities.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes and preparing or maintaining system authorization documentation.
  • Experience developing System Security Plans, security control implementation narratives, POA&Ms, and supporting ATO artifacts.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 security controls, DoD cybersecurity policies, and system authorization requirements.
  • Experience reviewing technical architectures, system configurations, data flows, and security control implementations.
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles, shared responsibility models, identity and access management, encryption, logging, and vulnerability management.
  • Experience reviewing vulnerability assessment results, tracking remediation activities, and supporting continuous security monitoring.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to independently manage cybersecurity engineering assignments and coordinate with developers, administrators, cybersecurity personnel, and government representatives.
  • Ability to meet applicable DoD/DHA personnel security and suitability requirements.
  • Ability to satisfy applicable DoD cybersecurity workforce qualification requirements for the assigned position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting ATO activities for DoD, DHA, VA, or other federal healthcare systems.
  • Experience preparing authorization packages for cloud-hosted or SaaS-based enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Government Cloud Plus / Government Cloud Plus – Defense security architecture.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, Amazon Connect, AWS IAM, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, and associated AWS security capabilities.
  • Experience supporting DoD IL4/IL5 environments and understanding of the DoD Cloud Computing

HR GENERALIST (Remote)

Position Type: Full Time; Remote

Start Date: ASAP

Volcanix Automation is seeking an HR Generalist to support our growing organization primarily across North America (Canada and the USA). This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced HR professional to step into a broad, hands-on role supporting employee lifecycle management, HR administration, immigration, employee relations, benefits and compensation, and other key HR initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • HR Documentation & Compliance: Draft and maintain employment agreements, amendments, HR letters, policies, templates, and other employee documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable requirements.
  • Immigration Support: Coordinate U.S. and Canadian immigration matters, working closely with employees, managers, and external immigration counsel to manage documentation, applications, renewals, and key deadlines.
  • Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage and coordinate the end-to-end onboarding and offboarding experience for employees and contractors, ensuring a smooth and positive experience from hire through departure.
  • HRIS (Human Resources Information System) & Employee Records: Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records in BambooHR and other HR systems, including training, compliance, and employment documentation.
  • Benefits, Leave & Compensation: Support the administration of employee benefits and leave programs, as well as salary increases, bonuses, and other compensation-related processes.
  • Employee Relations & HR Support: Serve as a trusted first point of contact for employees and managers, providing guidance on day-to-day HR matters, policies, employee relations, and workplace questions.
  • New Hire Coordination: Prepare offer letters, coordinate background checks and pre-employment requirements, and partner with IT and other teams to ensure new hires are fully prepared for their first day.
  • HR Reporting & Insights: Prepare HR reports and data to support management decision-making.
  • HR Communications & Employee Experience: Coordinate HR communications and employee engagement initiatives.
  • HR Operations & Projects: Provide backup support for payroll and benefits administration and assist with HR projects and initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Five years of progressive, hands-on HR experience, with solid knowledge across core HR functions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management or a related field, or a postgraduate certificate in Human Resources Management.
  • Strong knowledge of HR practices, employment legislation, and HR compliance requirements.
  • Experience with work visas and immigration.
  • Must have strong Spanish and English language skills.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and interpersonal skills, with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while providing responsive support to employees and managers.
Salary: $25,000- $40,000

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Flexcompute is leading the transformation of engineering simulation with our revolutionary ultra-fast simulation technology.
jobs.description:
Flexcompute is leading the transformation of engineering simulation with our revolutionary ultra-fast simulation technology. Our flagship products, including the industry-leading Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software Flow360 and electromagnetic simulation software Tidy3D, are reshaping how simulations are conducted across diverse sectors. Founded by visionaries from Stanford and MIT and supported by top-tier venture capital firms, we are a rapidly growing team dedicated to breaking boundaries and challenging the norms of the multi-billion-dollar engineering simulation market.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to help us design and implement scalable solutions that meet the growing demands of our advanced EM simulation platform.

Additionally, the candidate will help us enhance our data management, frontend-backend API unification, and cloud integration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to general software development efforts, such as API unification, simulation data management (e.g., caching, syncing, storage), and scripting improvements.
  • Collaborate with EM and infrastructure teams to implement simulation-specific solutions, including enhancements to back-end/scheduler integrations and Python front-end functionality.
  • Improve our task pipelines through an innovative design for a web API in a multi-physical simulation context.
  • Develop and maintain hybrid cloud compute and storage solutions, integrating on-premise HPC systems with modern cloud platforms.
  • Optimize and manage high-performance computing clusters equipped with high-speed interconnects

This is a senior seat. We keep the team small and senior on purpose, so you will own real pieces of the platform end to end, with little direction and direct access to the founders.

Requirements

What you need

  • Strong backend engineering in at least one of Java, Python or C++. Deep in one is enough.
  • Real production cloud experience, AWS preferred.
  • Distributed systems you have operated in production, not only studied.
  • Direct ownership of a production backend service, from design through deployment and operation.
  • Fluent professional English, spoken and written.
  • Based in Portugal, with the right to work there without visa sponsorship, and available on Portuguese working hours with about six hours of overlap with our Boston team.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, telecommunications engineering or a closely related field.

What you can learn here

We hire for depth, not checklists. You do not need all of the following on day one: Kubernetes and Docker, Terraform or Ansible, monitoring and observability tooling, Linux troubleshooting, networking and security practices, our simulation stack, and HPC (preferred, not mandatory). We look for people who have entered a new domain before, learned it fast and reached ownership.

Bonus

  • Load balancing, autoscaling, and queues or streaming systems such as SQS, SNS or Kafka.
  • Experience integrating cloud platforms with HPC environments or large compute clusters.
  • Familiarity with job schedulers or batch systems, distributed compute frameworks, or large-scale data pipelines.
  • Experience supporting scientific computing or simulation platforms.
  • Knowledge of GPU infrastructure and resource scheduling.
  • Experience building developer platforms or internal infrastructure tooling.
  • A degree in computer science, computer or telecommunications engineering, mathematics, physics or a related field from a leading university. Hands-on production experience matters more than where you studied.

Innovative Mindset: Ability to learn quickly, adapt to new challenges, and innovate in a fast-paced startup environment.

Example Projects

  • Architect and deploy infrastructure that runs distributed simulation workloads across cloud and on-premise compute
  • Design and implement scalable web APIs for simulation job orchestration and data access
  • Build CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code systems for reproducible deployments
  • Develop hybrid cloud solutions connecting on-prem HPC clusters with AWS compute and storage
  • Implement monitoring and observability systems to track simulation performance and reliability
  • Improve platform scalability to support growing user traffic and compute demand
  • Design secure service architectures, authentication, and licensing systems
  • Optimize infrastructure utilization across CPU and GPU resources

Join Us

By joining Flexcompute, you'll be at the heart of a movement set to redefine the engineering simulation industry. You will play a key role in shaping the future, where our innovations in simulation technology pave the way for groundbreaking advancements. We are committed to fostering an innovative and collaborative culture where boundaries of possibility are re-imagined, driven by creativity, expertise, and a shared vision of transforming the technological landscape.

How we hire

No online assessment. Two to three technical conversations with the engineering team, then a final conversation with a co-founder. Bring your questions: the first conversation is not a pitch you sit through, you are welcome to send questions ahead, and technical disagreement is welcome.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity.
  • Remote within Portugal, on Portuguese working hours with about six hours of overlap with our Boston team.
  • Fully flexible hours and unlimited PTO.
  • Periodic company-paid travel to Boston to work with the core team.
  • Learning sponsorship, a travel allowance, an AI tools budget (we pay for Claude, Cursor and similar) and a fitness benefit.
  • Friendly, thoughtful, and intelligent coworkers.
