jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Health Cloud System Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Leidos is seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Health Cloud System Administrator to support the administration, configuration, operational maintenance, and continuous improvement of an enterprise Salesforce Health Cloud environment supporting Department of Defense (DoD) and Defense Health Agency (DHA) healthcare programs.
jobs.description:
Leidos is seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Health Cloud System Administrator to support the administration, configuration, operational maintenance, and continuous improvement of an enterprise Salesforce Health Cloud environment supporting Department of Defense (DoD) and Defense Health Agency (DHA) healthcare programs.


The successful candidate will serve as a senior technical resource responsible for managing complex Salesforce administration activities, overseeing system configurations, maintaining platform security, resolving escalated operational issues, and ensuring the reliability and performance of the Salesforce environment. This position will work independently to manage assigned administrative processes and collaborate with Salesforce developers, solution architects, cybersecurity personnel, and program stakeholders to implement secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. The Senior Salesforce Administrator will also provide technical guidance, review configuration changes, establish administrative best practices, and mentor junior Salesforce administrators.


Primary Responsibilities

Salesforce System Administration and Operations

  • Serve as a senior technical resource responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, and operational sustainment of the Salesforce Health Cloud environment.
  • Manage complex user administration activities, including user provisioning, role assignments, permission sets, permission set groups, sharing rules, and organizational access structures.
  • Oversee and execute approved moves, adds, and changes (MACs), ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with established configuration management procedures.
  • Configure and maintain standard and custom Salesforce objects, fields, record types, page layouts, Lightning pages, queues, assignment rules, and application settings.
  • Administer Salesforce Health Cloud functionality supporting patient engagement, care coordination, case management, referral management, and healthcare contact center operations.
  • Monitor system health, application performance, scheduled jobs, storage utilization, platform limits, and integration status.
  • Identify operational risks, recurring configuration issues, and opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, and administrative efficiency.

Advanced Troubleshooting and Technical Support

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Tier 2 Salesforce application support incidents that cannot be resolved by junior administrators.
  • Independently investigate and resolve complex configuration issues, access control problems, workflow failures, data discrepancies, and application performance issues.
  • Perform detailed root cause analysis of recurring production incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Analyze Salesforce debug logs, Flow execution errors, system events, and integration error reports to identify and resolve operational issues.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce developers and integration teams to troubleshoot complex application defects, API failures, and external system connectivity issues.
  • Determine when issues require escalation to Tier 3 application developers, solution architects, or external technology providers.
  • Develop and maintain advanced troubleshooting procedures and knowledge base documentation to improve incident resolution efficiency.

Advanced Configuration and Platform Maintenance

  • Design, configure, and maintain moderately complex to advanced declarative Salesforce functionality using Flow Builder, validation rules, approval processes, assignment rules, and other supported platform tools.
  • Evaluate configuration requirements and recommend solutions that maximize standard Salesforce functionality while minimizing unnecessary custom development.
  • Review configuration changes for technical quality, security implications, performance impact, and adherence to established platform standards.
  • Manage complex data administration activities, including bulk data updates, data imports, data quality remediation, and duplicate management.
  • Support Salesforce sandbox management, environment refreshes, configuration synchronization, and release preparation activities.
  • Evaluate Salesforce seasonal releases, platform updates, and feature changes to identify potential impacts on existing functionality.
  • Collaborate with the development team to support deployment, testing, and validation of new application features and enhancements.
  • Maintain configuration baselines and ensure changes are implemented through approved development, testing, and production release processes.

Change Management and Release Support

  • Coordinate and oversee administrative configuration changes in accordance with established change management and release management procedures.
  • Assess the operational impact of proposed system modifications and recommend appropriate testing and deployment approaches.
  • Participate in technical design reviews and evaluate the operational maintainability of proposed application enhancements.
  • Develop and execute configuration test plans and support system integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing.
  • Validate production deployments and assist with post-release troubleshooting and stabilization.
  • Coordinate with Salesforce developers and technical leads to ensure appropriate separation of responsibilities between system administration and custom application development.
  • Support scheduled releases, emergency changes, and corrective maintenance activities.

Security, Compliance, and Access Management

  • Administer and maintain Salesforce security configurations, including role hierarchies, profiles, permission sets, sharing models, and field-level security.
  • Support implementation and enforcement of least-privilege access principles and established identity and access management policies.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of user permissions, privileged access, and application security configurations.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity and information assurance teams to identify, investigate, and remediate configuration-related security findings.
  • Support compliance with applicable DoD/DHA cybersecurity requirements, FedRAMP controls, Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes, and authorized system security configurations.
  • Assist with the collection and maintenance of audit evidence, system configuration documentation, and security assessment artifacts.
  • Ensure administrative activities comply with approved procedures for handling protected health information (PHI), controlled unclassified information (CUI), and other sensitive government information.
  • Support continuous monitoring activities and implementation of approved security configuration changes.

Technical Leadership and Process Improvement

  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior Salesforce administrators.
  • Review work performed by junior administrators to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established technical standards.
  • Establish and maintain Salesforce administration standards, operating procedures, configuration guidelines, and troubleshooting documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative tasks and improve operational support processes.
  • Collaborate with program managers, business analysts, developers, and technical stakeholders to evaluate operational requirements and recommend configuration-based solutions.
  • Support workload planning, task prioritization, and coordination of administrative activities.
  • Contribute to technical planning discussions involving platform enhancements, system scalability, and operational improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical field and 4–8 years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 2–6 years of relevant experience. Equivalent experience may be considered in accordance with Leidos policies.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on Salesforce administration and configuration experience in an enterprise environment.

Job Description

The Role

Agilent Technologies is seeking an experienced Salesforce Solution Architect to lead the design, development, and continuous improvement of Salesforce and its surrounding commercial systems. The role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, engineering, data management, and integration. The right candidate will translate business requirements into technical designs, then design, build, test, and support solutions through the IT-governed delivery lifecycle. They will also leverage deep Salesforce expertise to guide existing teams on platform capabilities, limitations, and nuances. Beyond hands-on delivery, this role advances Agilent's use of automation, AI, and emerging Salesforce capabilities to improve how the business operates.


Business accountability and IT governance

This position sits within Commercial Operations and contributes to the continuous improvement of agreed commercial processes enabled by Salesforce. The role is accountable for its assigned business outcomes, delivery responsibilities, and compliance with enterprise controls.

The business pod owns business requirements, value-based prioritization, functional acceptance, adoption, and benefits measurement within its delegated scope. Qualified pod members may design, configure, develop, test, and document solutions in authorized environments using IT-approved standards and tools.

IT retains accountability for enterprise technical architecture, cybersecurity and identity controls, privileged access, environment and deployment controls, production change and release authorization, and production service operations, in coordination with applicable enterprise control owners.

Business acceptance does not authorize production deployment. Production configuration, code, integrations, security settings, and material data changes must follow the applicable IT-controlled change process. Execution may be delegated through documented, role-based authorization; control ownership and required independent review remain in place. Individuals may not independently approve and release their own changes.

The role will work with the designated IT platform and delivery leads through a shared backlog, agreed delivery arrangements, and defined escalation paths.


Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Lead design and technical delivery of complex Salesforce solutions from discovery through Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL, and API development, aligned to enterprise architecture standards.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs and implementation plans; evaluate platform capabilities to recommend the right mix of configuration, customization, automation, and integration.
  • Propose reusable patterns and contribute to standards approved by IT architecture to help improve platform maintainability over time; review code and solutions for quality, performance, and security.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across Salesforce and connected systems through root-cause analysis, not surface fixes.

Data & Integration Architecture

  • Design and maintain Salesforce data models and integrations with enterprise applications using APIs, middleware, and REST-based system-to-system connections. Partner withrelevant IT owners on Interface contracts, authentication, credentials, middleware patterns, and system-of-record decisions as needed.
  • Partner with data and integration teams to define data flows, dependencies, and integration patterns; resolve cross-system data and process issues as they arise.
  • Support data migration, transformation, cleansing, deduplication, and synchronization, alongside the broader data quality and governance program.
  • Contribute to Salesforce Data Cloud, CRM Analytics, and data warehouse capabilities as needed; identify and address technical debt limiting scalability.
  • Design and implement performance-conscious data modeling, indexing, and archiving strategies for large data volumes (LDV) to keep Salesforce responsive at scale.

DevOps, Release & Governance

  • Use and improve IT-owned delivery tooling and contribute changes through its governance (GitHub, Gearset, Salesforce DX) to ensure deployments are reliable and repeatable.
  • Manage assigned development work and dependencies within the IT-owned environment strategy; maintain technical documentation and release governance standards.
  • Design solutions in line with enterprise security, privacy, and compliance requirements, partnering with IT security on permissions, SSO, MFA, and platform hardening; implement approved controls on behalf of Commercial.
  • Apply Salesforce sharing and security architecture appropriate to the data and business context; identify and mitigate technical and operational risk.
  • Facilitate the required independent review of all changes

AI, Automation & Emerging Technology

  • Identify where AI, automation, Agentforce, and emerging Salesforce capabilities can meaningfully improve business processes, then design, prototype, and implement them.
  • Build proof-of-concept solutions to demonstrate value before wider rollout, applying the same rigor around data quality, governance, and human oversight used elsewhere on the platform.

Technical Leadership & Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to business stakeholders and delivery teams, leading discovery, solution design sessions, estimation, and technical planning for complex initiatives.
  • Collaborate across business analysts, architects, developers, admins, and IT partners; mentor other Salesforce professionals and translate technical concepts for nontechnical audiences.
  • Participate in production support and continuous improvement, providing specialist diagnosis and remediation through IT incident/problem management, closing the loop between what's designed and what actually runs in production.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years designing, developing, and implementing Salesforce solutions, with strong hands-on experience in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into complex technical architecture, and to integrate Salesforce with enterprise applications and external systems.
  • Experience with Salesforce data architecture, migration, quality, and governance, plus security, sharing, permissions, and identity management.
  • Experience with source control, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, and DevOps practices; strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills in a global, matrixed organization.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certification as an Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, System Architect, Integration Architect, Data Architect, or equivalent.
  • Experience with Sales Cloud, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics, or Marketing Cloud, and with Git/GitHub, Gearset, or comparable DevOps tooling.
  • Experience with REST APIs, middleware, ETL, event-driven architecture, or enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience developing Agentforce, LLM, or other AI/automation solutions, ideally at enterprise scale.
  • Experience partnering with enterprise security, identity, compliance, or data governance teams, and in life sciences, healthcare, scientific instruments, or another complex B2B environment.

Key Competencies

• Salesforce Architecture & Engineering

• Data & Systems Integration

• DevOps & Platform Governance

• AI & Automation

• Technical Problem Solving

• Cross-Functional Design

• Continuous Improvement

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to .

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer, Evaluation & Reliability to help ensure that AI-powered features across Bask Health are accurate, dependable, and ready for real-world use.

Bask Health uses software to connect patient experiences, merchant operations, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce capabilities. As AI becomes more integrated into these systems, we need reliable ways to measure model performance, identify failures, and verify that changes improve the user experience without introducing new risks.

You'll help develop the evaluation infrastructure, testing workflows, and performance measurements used to assess large language models, retrieval systems, AI assistants, and automated workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role that combines machine learning evaluation, software development, data analysis, and production quality assurance. You'll work with model outputs, evaluation datasets, automated testing tools, and application telemetry to understand how AI systems perform under realistic conditions.

Your work may include creating evaluation datasets, implementing automated benchmarks, measuring response quality, testing retrieval accuracy, analyzing model failures, and monitoring production behavior.

You'll collaborate with applied AI engineers, machine learning engineers, backend engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to define what successful AI behavior looks like for different workflows. You'll help translate those expectations into measurable tests and actionable engineering improvements.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, AI evaluation must account for accuracy, privacy, appropriate permissions, and the consequences of unreliable responses. You'll help identify situations where AI systems produce unsupported information, expose restricted data, attempt unauthorized actions, or operate outside approved clinical and operational boundaries.

This position emphasizes practical implementation and continuous improvement. You'll contribute to evaluation methodologies and engineering standards while working with senior engineers on broader reliability strategies and more complex technical decisions.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys investigating how AI systems behave, can turn ambiguous quality problems into measurable tests, and understands that reliable AI products require ongoing evaluation—not just successful demonstrations.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain evaluation systems for AI-powered applications across Bask Health.
  • Develop automated testing frameworks for large language models and AI application workflows.
  • Create and maintain representative datasets for evaluating model behavior.
  • Implement benchmarks that measure response accuracy, relevance, completeness, and consistency.
  • Develop evaluation pipelines for prompts, retrieval systems, and model configurations.
  • Test AI assistants and agents against realistic user scenarios and workflow requirements.
  • Build automated regression tests to detect performance changes between releases.
  • Measure hallucination rates, unsupported claims, and other model quality failures.
  • Evaluate retrieval-augmented generation systems for document relevance and answer grounding.
  • Develop tests for structured model outputs and schema compliance.
  • Evaluate tool-calling accuracy and agent action selection.
  • Test AI workflows for unauthorized actions, incorrect permissions, and unsafe behavior.
  • Implement evaluation checks for sensitive patient and operational information.
  • Build dashboards and reports that communicate AI quality metrics to engineering teams.
  • Analyze evaluation results and identify recurring failure patterns.
  • Investigate production incidents involving inaccurate or unreliable AI outputs.
  • Collaborate with applied AI engineers to improve prompts, retrieval logic, and application behavior.
  • Support model comparisons and controlled experiments.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs between model quality, latency, reliability, and inference cost.
  • Develop automated quality checks for CI/CD and AI feature release workflows.
  • Implement monitoring and alerting for production AI performance.
  • Build tools for reviewing, labeling, and analyzing model responses.
  • Help maintain evaluation datasets as products and user behavior evolve.
  • Document evaluation methodologies, test cases, and known model limitations.
  • Work with product teams to define measurable acceptance criteria for AI features.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on evaluation standards and reliability improvements.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering planning.
  • Own assigned evaluation and reliability projects from implementation through deployment and ongoing improvement.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, applied AI, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience building and maintaining production software or machine learning applications.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or comparable languages.
  • Familiarity with large language models and modern generative AI applications.
  • Experience testing or evaluating machine learning models or AI-powered software.
  • Understanding of machine learning evaluation metrics and experimental methodologies.
  • Experience developing automated tests and validation pipelines.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and model output analysis.
  • Ability to analyze structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Experience writing scripts or services for data processing and evaluation.
  • Understanding of model accuracy, precision, recall, and other performance measures where applicable.
  • Familiarity with API integrations and backend application development.
  • Experience working with relational databases or analytical data systems.
  • Ability to identify patterns in model failures and translate findings into engineering improvements.
  • Understanding of regression testing and software quality assurance.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience using Git and collaborative software development workflows.
  • Understanding of the limitations and failure modes of large language models.
  • Ability to design representative test cases and evaluation scenarios.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based development and deployment environments.
  • Experience writing maintainable, well-tested production code.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate technical evaluation results clearly.
  • Experience collaborating with engineers, product managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to independently own assigned technical projects.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building evaluation frameworks for large language models.
  • Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model APIs.
  • Experience with tools such as LangSmith, DeepEval, Ragas, or comparable AI evaluation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LLM-as-a-judge evaluation techniques.
  • Experience creating human-labeled evaluation datasets.
  • Understanding of inter-rater agreement and evaluation consistency.
  • Experience evaluating retrieval-augmented generation systems.
  • Familiarity with embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
  • Experience evaluating AI agents and tool-calling workflows.
  • Familiarity with prompt injection testing and AI security evaluations.
  • Experience implementing automated regression testing for AI applications.
  • Familiarity with experiment tracking and model comparison tools.
  • Experience building dashboards for machine learning performance monitoring.
  • Understanding of statistical analysis and experiment design.
  • Experience working with Python data analysis libraries.
  • Familiarity with TypeScript and Node.js application development.
  • Experience working with AWS or serverless infrastructure.
  • Experience evaluating AI systems used in healthcare or other sensitive environments.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

Application Process

Interested candidates may apply directly through our career portal:

Alonso & Alonso Career Page


Equal Opportunity Employment Statement

Alonso & Alonso Attorneys at Law, PLLC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive organization. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, age, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.


Non‑Attorney Role Disclosure & Limitations of Duties

This position is not an attorney role. The individual hired as a Legal Paralegal Assistant is not licensed to practice law and may not provide legal advice or legal representation under any circumstances. The employee must strictly adhere to the following limitations and escalate matters to a licensed attorney when appropriate.


Non‑Attorney Staff MAY:

  • Provide administrative, clerical, and paralegal support under attorney supervision.
  • Communicate factual case status updates strictly as directed by an attorney.
  • Collect documents and biographical information from clients.
  • Assist in drafting and assembling immigration forms and documents under attorney supervision.
  • Relay attorney-approved information and instructions to clients.
  • Schedule appointments and manage digital/physical case files.
  • Provide government filing instructions that are strictly procedural in nature (e.g., mailing addresses, filing fee schedules, or checklists of required supporting documents as directed by an attorney).

Non‑Attorney Staff MAY NOT:

Under no circumstances may non‑attorney staff:

  • Provide legal advice, legal opinions, or legal analysis to clients.
  • Interpret immigration laws, regulations, or government policies.
  • Advise a client on which immigration benefit, legal strategy, or form to pursue.
  • Advise whether a client qualifies for any immigration benefit or relief.
  • Assess legal eligibility, admissibility, or case risks.
  • Recommend legal strategies or predict case outcomes.
  • Advise on the legal consequences of criminal history, prior immigration violations, or prior denials.
  • Sign legal filings or pleadings on behalf of the firm unless specifically authorized for purely ministerial purposes.
  • Represent clients before USCIS, EOIR, DHS, DOL, or any court or tribunal.
  • Negotiate with government agencies on legal matters.
  • Answer legal questions, even if the staff member believes they know the answer.
  • Translate or explain legal advice independently of a licensed attorney.

Mandatory Escalation to an Attorney

The Legal Paralegal Assistant must immediately escalate a matter to a licensed attorney if:

  • A client asks any legal question.
  • A client asks whether they “qualify” or “should apply” for a benefit.
  • A client asks about legal risks, processing timelines with legal implications, or likelihood of success.
  • A case involves criminal history, prior removal/deportation, unlawful presence, fraud/misrepresentation, prior denials, or complex factual histories.
  • A client requests an interpretation of a Request for Evidence (RFE), Notice of Intent to Deny (NOID), or any other government notice.
  • A client expresses confusion about legal advice previously provided by an attorney.
  • Any situation arises where the staff member is unsure whether their response would constitute legal advice.

When in doubt, always escalate to an attorney.

Compliance Statement

The Unauthorized Practice of Law (UPL) is strictly prohibited by law and firm policy. Violation of these limitations will result in disciplinary action, up to and including immediate termination of employment. All non‑attorney staff are required to acknowledge in writing that they understand and agree to comply with these restrictions as a condition of employment.

We work with clients ranging from startups to well-known enterprise brands such as Dropbox, Rémy Cointreau, and Asana.

At SketchDeck, our values are more than just guiding principles—theyʼre the foundation of how we work and grow together globally. We commit to:

→ Win as a Team.

→ Find Solutions.

→ Take Ownership.

→ Do the Right Thing.

→ Be Human.

Guided by our vision to be the best creative partner, we empower our team to collaborate and innovate from anywhere with a flexible, remote-first culture. Our camera-on, Slack-heavy environment cultivates genuine relationships and collaboration, where we actively seek culture add, not just culture fit.

DIRECTOR OF AI SOLUTIONS ROLE AT SKETCHDECK

About the role:

This is a new role at SketchDeck, helping bring AI impact to our creative work. Key parts of the role:

  1. Consult with clients to understand current approaches and identify opportunities for AI in Creative Work (Key: strong client communication skills)
  2. Design and build AI solutions for our creative operations and clients and support team adoption
  3. Stay on top of the latest AI developments, understand how they can impact our work, and effectively share with the team

Note: In your first six months, about half your time will go to leading AI transformation for one of our enterprise clients, including quarterly trips to Houston, TX (two nights per trip).

You’ll report to the VP, Creative Impact.

How you’ll work with our creative and production leads:
Our Creative Directors and Design Directors own the creative direction and design. You own the AI solution: what’s possible, what to build and how it gets used. They bring you the problem, you build the solution, and together you present it to the client. You’ll bring a strong design eye so the work meets our creative standard.

You’ll also partner with our Production Directors on AI systems that make high-volume client production faster and more consistent.

You’ll often support several leads at once, so clear communication matters as much as technical skill.

Working with clients:
You'll be in front of clients alongside the creative lead. That means consulting with clients on what AI can and can’t do for their brand, training their teams on new tools and workflows, shaping and presenting AI ideas in new business pitches, and joining live projects where the work needs someone who can build it.

As the Director of AI Solutions, you'll have four areas of responsibility:
The percentages are our starting balance. We’ll review them after six months.

CLIENT DEVELOPMENT: (25%)

  • Consult on how a client’s brand system needs to change for AI, and prototype AI-ready brand systems we can train tools on
  • Define client AI governance: usage guidelines, approval flows and brand safeguards
  • Build small client-facing tools and apps (e.g. an on-brand social asset builder)
  • Pressure-test ideas early with the Design Director leading new offerings, then turn what works into repeatable, documented offerings we can sell
  • Join new business and pursuit calls as the AI voice, showing clients where AI fits at a roadmap level

TOOLS TO ENHANCE EXISTING WORK: (35%)

  • Map how client and internal teams work today, and flag which workstreams are ready for AI now, later or not at all
  • Build and test AI workflows for design exploration, variations and templated systems on live accounts
  • Work with Design Directors, Production Directors and Project Managers to find where workflows will stick, and run regular check-ins with leads on embedded programs
  • Set up shared prompt and asset libraries, and document workflows so designers can use them on their own
  • Track the time each workflow saves, so we know what’s worth keeping

EXPERIMENTATION AND ONE-TIME PROJECTS: (25%)

  • Take ideas from Design and Production Directors, tell them early what’s achievable, and build them fast while they’re still relevant to the client
  • Open up new formats, including interactive experiences, AI video and playable pieces
  • Build and present the AI concepts in new business pitches
  • Jump onto live projects that need hands-on technical execution

RESEARCH AND SHARING WITH THE SKETCHDECK TEAM: (15%)

  • Explore new AI tools continuously and bring what’s worth our attention to the team, without waiting to be asked
  • Share findings through short demos, recordings, posts and internal sessions that build the team’s AI fluency
  • Keep a living record of what works, what doesn’t and what we’ve tried

Requirements

  • 6+ years working with creative teams or in agency environments
  • A portfolio or demos of what you’ve built with AI, and how you built it
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools across image, video, text and prototyping, plus light development (prompting, low-code, no-code, building with AI assistance)
  • A strong design eye, with working knowledge of Figma, Canva and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Experience redesigning work processes around AI, and a clear view on where AI fits, including when it doesn’t
  • Comfortable consulting with clients and training teams through new ways of working
  • Aware of the legal and client-permission questions around AI in creative work
  • Self-directed and curious, comfortable with shifting priorities and supporting several leads at once
  • Available during U.S. business hours

Benefits

*Individual compensation packages are based on experience, demonstrated performance, market factors, and other job-related considerations.

  • Salary range: $140,000 - $170,000 per year
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Fully remote working environment (established pre-COVID and continuing forward)
  • Paid time off that grows with tenure
  • Annual company retreat
  • Computer hardware of your choice (up to $2,500)
  • $500 towards your office setup expenses
  • To work with a talented team of designers, team members, and engineers

jobs.excerpt: Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats.
jobs.description:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people livelonger, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.

Position Summary:

The Executive Assistant to the President and CEO is responsible for specialized, complex administrative duties in support of the President and CEO of Resolve to Save Lives. They are a key member of the Office of the President (OTP), ensuring exceptional administrative, coordination, and logistical support to the President and CEO and excellent customer service to internal and external stakeholders of the OTP. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail oriented, and efficient self-starter who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced and collaborative environment. This full-time position is remote. The incumbent may be expected to convene periodically for in-person team meetings and to work during East Coast core working hours.

Work Location: This is a remote position with travel as stated, open to US-based candidates.

Core Duties and Responsibilities:

Front Office, Communications, and Scheduling

  • Staff the office of the CEO and serve as the first point of contact and provide excellent customer service to those who contact the CEO.
  • Create, manage and maintain a complex calendar including a range of internal and external meetings, events, speaking engagements, teleconferences and travel in a highly dynamic environment requiring frequent re-prioritization and shifting appointments. Provide excellent verbal and written customer service to a range of stakeholders for the scheduling of meetings and events.
  • Facilitate smooth and effective communication by reviewing and responding to the President’s official email inbox, mail, and invitations.
  • Receive, screen, and direct emails, phone calls and mail to determine significance and distribute to the CEO, Senior Advisor, or executive leadership accordingly.
  • Prioritize and execute exceptional time management skills pertaining to coordination of the CEO’s activities and activities of the Office of the President; redirect matters to relevant staff to handle, or handle matters personally, as appropriate.
  • Keep the CEO advised of time-sensitive and priority issues, ensuring appropriate follow-up.
  • Some work—including last minute re-scheduling requests—may be required outside standard work hours.

Travel and Expense Management

  • Arrange extensive travel and complex logistics for the CEO and the President’s office, including ground, air or other travel, both nationally and internationally, including visas, lodging, per diem, and travel expenses. 
  • Handle corporate expenses and receipt reconciliation for the CEO’s expenses.

Meeting Coordination

  • Manage and execute logistics for local and international meetings and conferences.
  • In coordination with other staff, prepare and deliver materials and provide IT coordination for meetings and events.
  • Staff meetings as needed, including, but not limited to, greeting guests, coordinating food and beverage services, and troubleshooting IT/logistical issues.
  • Some travel may be required within the US for in-person convenings.

Administrative Support

  • As requested, attend meetings and take notes of discussion; prepare the initial draft of minutes and summaries.
  • Manage and update OTP’s project management tools to support effective and efficient project planning, prioritization, initiation, and execution, and foster collaboration of internal and external stakeholders, as relevant.
  • Oversee the OTP’s contact management system, including adding and updating contact information, and coordinating upcoming communication with other departments.
  • As needed, provide logistical and management support to other OTP functions for organization-wide, governance, or development-related meetings and events.
  • As needed, support contract management for OTP, including contract set up, invoice reviews, and ensuring completion of close out checklists
  • Work on special projects, as needed.
  • Perform other tasks as requested by the President and CEO or Senior Advisor, OTP.

Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in administrative or other support function for a principal in a fast-paced environment
  • Exceptional in the areas of judgment, diplomacy, discretion, and interpersonal skills
  • Exceptional organizational skills, follow through, and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with and highly capable managing multiple and competing demands and shifting priorities
  • Solution oriented, with strong problem-solving skills and ability to work well under pressure and maintain a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to anticipate and inform the Senior Advisor and/or CEO of potential difficulties that have not yet surfaced
  • Highly proficient with MS Office Suite, SharePoint, and familiarity with a range of collaboration, productivity, virtual meeting, and AI (Copilot, Claude) tools
  • Familiarity working in a global organization, managing various time zones
  • Demonstrates sensitivity to cultural norms and ways of communicating across cultures
  • Bachelor’s degree in any field plus 5+ years of relevant experience or equivalent experience
  • Being based in NYC is a plus, but not required

Compensation and Benefits:

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success.

The salary range for this position is $98,000 to $112,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role.

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including:

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD102099

We are looking for a Senior UX Designer based in the United States to join a newly established Autodesk initiative within AEC. The team is building an AI-powered solution to help teams in architecture, engineering, and construction work more efficiently.

This is a 0-to-1 role on a small Autodesk incubation team working across product, engineering, AI, domain expertise, and customer research. The first 1–2 years will focus on finding product-market fit by testing ideas, understanding customer needs, and iterating quickly on prototypes and early releases.

What we are building

The initiative aims to help AEC teams work more efficiently by bringing useful information and AI assistance into their workflows. The product will need to make complex project information, documents, data, and AI-generated insights clear and useful.

Why this team and role are different

This initiative combines startup-like incubation with Autodesk’s scale: a small founding team, close customer access, fast learning cycles, and the opportunity to shape a new product. The initial market focus is the U.S., so this role depends on close engagement with U.S.-based customers, design partners, and industry experts through interviews, workflow observation, usability testing, and in-person collaboration when valuable. If you want a narrowly defined design brief inside an established product, this may not be the right role. If you want to contribute to the product direction, customer needs, interaction model, and design foundations for an emerging product in AEC, keep reading.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end experience design for key workflows, from problem framing and concept exploration through validation and production.
  • Partner closely with product and engineering to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and identify high-value workflows to explore.
  • Build relationships with U.S.-based customers and design partners through interviews, workflow observation, concept testing, usability testing, and in-person sessions when useful.
  • Turn complex project information and workflows into clear experiences that connect context, documents, data, AI insights, and customer actions.
  • Contribute to experience principles, information structures, and interaction models for AI-assisted workflows, including how to communicate sources, confidence, uncertainty, and human judgment.
  • Synthesize research, product data, industry knowledge, and business goals to identify opportunities, guide decisions, and communicate direction through journeys, workflows, information architectures, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
  • Facilitate cross-functional exploration of ambiguous problems and help align product, engineering, domain experts, customers, stakeholders, and partner Autodesk teams.
  • Advocate for customer needs while balancing feasibility, product strategy, business goals, and rapid incubation learning.
  • Share design patterns, practices, and learnings with the team and Autodesk’s Experience Design community.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of relevant design experience
  • Experience designing complex digital products, services, or systems from problem definition through implementation.
  • Strong human-centered design practice, with judgment to adapt research, ideation, prototyping, and validation methods.
  • Systems-thinking skills across workflows, dependencies, actors, information, constraints, and scalable information architectures.
  • Ability to translate complex information into clear interaction models, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma or similar design tools.
  • Experience synthesizing customer research, using evidence to influence direction, and communicating through visual and verbal storytelling.
  • Experience partnering with product managers and engineers on strategy and execution, and helping teams move from ambiguity to action.
  • Interest or experience in AI-assisted products, especially explainability, sources, confidence, uncertainty, recovery, and human judgment.
  • Experience in AEC, architecture, engineering, construction, design documentation, or other complex professional workflows.
  • Experience with Autodesk products, professional tools, incubation environments, or scalable interaction frameworks.
  • Based in the United States, with ability to engage regularly with U.S.-based customers and travel for research, design-partner sessions, and industry engagement as needed.

Ideal Profile

  • Works independently through ambiguity and turns uncertain problems into clear design paths.
  • Combines strong product-design craft, systems thinking, research judgment, and practical influence.
  • Builds credibility across product, engineering, domain experts, customers, and stakeholders through clear reasoning, collaboration, facilitation, and visual storytelling.
  • Moves quickly to learn while maintaining quality for important professional decisions.
  • Collaborates generously, strengthens team practices, and is motivated by helping AEC teams work more efficiently and with greater confidence.
  • You may be a strong fit if you turn complex workflows into clear product experiences, map messy systems, and make difficult decisions understandable and actionable.
  • You start from customer evidence.

Why join us

  • Meaningful senior-level scope: Help shape core workflows, experience principles, and interaction patterns while the product direction is still open.
  • Customers within reach: Work directly with AEC professionals, design partners, and industry experts to learn from real workflows and feedback.
  • A problem that matters: Help improve how teams manage complex work, make decisions, and move projects forward.
  • Thoughtful AI-assisted workflows: Design how AI-generated insights, supporting information, confidence, uncertainty, and professional judgment come together in a product people can rely on.
  • Startup energy with Autodesk reach: Work in an incubation environment with access to Autodesk’s customer relationships, technology ecosystem, and broader design community.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Benefits

From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting


Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $106,000 and $189,970. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

This role is built for an all rounder, comfortable working hand in hand with creative partners and who's technical, data-driven, and always pushing for more efficient, scalable acquisition. We use AI extensively across media buying and creative to drive efficiency, and you'll help us take that further. If you've scaled ASA, UAC, or Google Search in fast-moving environments and are ready to build on a global stage-we'd love to talk. What you'll do

Own creative strategy, testing, and velocity across UAC and Performance Max (PMax), alongside Google Search and Apple Search Ads-for a portfolio of high-priority markets with real global scale. Track testing velocity and learning rate-tests launched, time to significance, win rate, and creative refresh cadence-and document and share learnings across markets. Report on performance and trends across UAC, PMax, and ASA-developing clear creative-level insights and making strategic recommendations to improve results. Bring efficiency metrics to the center-owning CAC, CPAs, ROAS, and marginal return analysis to guide smarter spend decisions. Use AI tools to drive efficiency across media buying and creative-from bid and budget optimization to asset generation and variant testing-and share what works with the wider team. What we're looking for

5-8 years of hands-on experience in paid search, with deep expertise in Google Ads, ASA, and UAC. Hands-on experience running creative tests and scaling Performance Max is essential. Proven track record of scaling campaigns across geographies and optimizing to aggressive CAC/LTV goals. Comfortable owning both strategy and execution-working with large budgets and fast feedback loops. Deep understanding of app install campaigns and app lifecycle optimization (onboarding, retention, monetization). Able to demonstrate hands on use of Ai to assist with day to day management of campaigns and uncover growth opportunities. Strong understanding of how to apply AI to increase creative velocity and quality - from concept generation to asset production and iteration - in partnership with the creative team. Proven experience running high-velocity creative testing across UAC and PMax-building test plans, managing experiments, and iterating quickly based on creative and audience insights. Cross-functional operator-experienced in working with analytics, product, creative, and regional marketing teams. Strong written and verbal communicator, with the ability to clearly share performance results, tradeoffs, and ideas. Based in the US or UK. Comfortable working independently across time zones. Ambitious and growth-minded-this is an IC role with the potential to grow into leadership.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Stitch is the global leader in helping brands drive CRM performance through Braze and Databricks. We work with Fortune 1000 brands to design and execute martech-driven solutions and lifecycle marketing strategies that drive meaningful outcomes. Our fast-growing team spans the US, UK, and Canada.

We’re actively building the best customer relationship marketing (CRM) consultancy in the world. Not the biggest—the best. We’re looking for teammates who are energized by this challenge.

About This Role

Quick translation before we start: inside Stitch, this role’s official title is Associate Director, Technical Producer! As an Associate Director, Technical Producer, you lead a team of Technical Producers (aka Stitch's version of email developers) and set the technical bar. You’re a people leader first and a technical authority a very close second. Both jobs are real, and you do both well.

On the people side, you own the performance, growth, and retention of a team of Technical Producers. On the technical side, you stay close enough to the work to guide the hard stuff: net-new Braze deployments, platform migrations, gamification builds, custom preference centers, API-triggered messaging, and advanced automation logic that makes Braze stretch.

With clients, you operate at the executive level. You navigate org charts, read the room, and build relationships that outlast any single engagement. Inside Stitch, you define the solution patterns that become our standards, push our AI-forward development practices, and grow the next generation of Stitch Technical Producers.

If you want to define what “Stitch-caliber” means and then build a team that delivers it every day, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Lead the Team

  • People Leadership: Manage, coach, and develop a team of Technical Producers across levels. Set clear expectations, give regular and candid feedback (the kind people can use), and build your team's skills
  • Team Performance: Keep utilization, quality, and delivery on track. Make sure every Technical Producer is on work that stretches them and serves clients well.
  • Culture and Connection: Help build a place people are proud to belong to. Shape an employee experience where people feel connected, supported, and part of something, from their first day onward, rooted in our Common Threads and a proactive, solution-first mindset.
  • Onboarding and Enablement: Own onboarding for new Technical Producers. Give them clear standards, a ramp plan, and hands-on support so day one feels like a launch and not a scavenger hunt.
  • Capacity and Staffing: Partner with Delivery leadership, Operations, and Talent on staffing plans, resourcing, hiring profiles, and interviews.

Set the Technical Standard

  • Technical Leadership: Guide the team through complex implementations, including gamification (IAM), custom preference centers, advanced Canvas with AI features (send time optimization, A/B/N testing, context steps), and API-triggered messaging.
  • Standards and Frameworks: Define the solution patterns, rendering standards, QA standards, and development frameworks that become Stitch standards. Build reusable assets and methodologies that scale well past any one engagement.
  • Design Reviews and Quality: Make sure key processes and design reviews actually happen, and happen consistently, so the practice delivers excellent, repeatable work.
  • Advanced Build Skills: Stay hands-on enough to be a credible technical authority in advanced Liquid (complex nested arrays, custom filter combinations, performance optimization), HTML/CSS, JavaScript (custom tracking, interactive components, landing pages, forms), the Braze API, and workspace administration, including webhooks. If your team has a rendering edge case, you’re the one who isn’t scared of it.
  • AI-Forward Development: Champion AI tools like Cursor to work smarter and faster. Set how the team uses them responsibly and effectively.
  • Escalation Leadership: Step into the most complex or at-risk accounts with structured problem-solving, technical expertise, and stakeholder alignment. Partner with Directors and cross-functional teams to get things moving again.

Lead With Clients

  • Executive Relationships: Own executive-level client relationships. Present to the C-suite, navigate stakeholder dynamics, and drive strategic discovery by respectfully challenging client assumptions.
  • Account Growth: Drive long-term client relationships and account growth, and represent the Stitch brand in every interaction.
  • Documentation That Sets the Bar: Make sure your team produces solution designs, technical requirements, QA standards, and audience-adapted deliverables that raise the standard for Stitch.
  • Billable Delivery: Manage your own time to hit your billable target while leading your team.
  • Travel: Occasional travel, up to 20%, for client meetings, workshops, and onsite engagements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Does Success Look Like In This Role?

  • You consistently bill a minimum of 32 hours a week.
  • Your team members consistently hit a minimum of 36 billable hours a week.
  • The Technical Producers you’ve developed are taking on more complex work, and new hires ramp quickly because of the onboarding foundation you built.
  • You make sure key processes and design reviews are happening, because Delivery excellence doesn’t run on good intentions.
  • Your team’s solutions, frameworks, and standards are the ones people across Stitch point to as exemplars.
  • Executive-level clients see you and your team as a trusted partner, not just a vendor.
  • You’ve defined what “Stitch-caliber” means for the Technical Producer practice, and the team lives it.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 7–10 years of hands-on experience with marketing technology and customer engagement implementations
  • 5+ years in consulting, with proven success driving high-impact work for enterprise-level clients
  • 2+ years of direct people leadership experience
  • Experience leading teams of 6–8 direct reports or more
  • A demonstrated ability to build and sustain high-performance teams by setting clear expectations, coaching for growth, and making sure delivery stays excellent
  • Expert-level HTML, CSS, and Liquid, plus working JavaScript knowledge
  • Deep experience with marketing automation or customer engagement platforms, including advanced features like gamification, API integrations, and custom preference centers
  • Preferred: a strong understanding of Braze Canvas, the Braze API, workspace administration, and data troubleshooting for messaging
  • Executive presence and client-facing experience within an agency or consultancy
  • A track record of facilitating cross-functional war rooms for high-risk issues, getting delivery, sales, and product teams pulling in the same direction to restore project momentum
  • Deep, everyday experience with AI code editors (like Cursor), and the ability to lead a team in adopting them
  • Bonus: Excellent email creation using Braze’s Drag and Drop Editor
  • Occasional travel, up to 20%, for client meetings, workshops, and onsite engagements
  • Must have legal authorization to work in the United States or Canada without employer sponsorship, now and in the future

How You Consult and Lead

As an Associate Director, you set the tone for entire engagements and for the team delivering them. Your presence, executive relationships, and strategic thinking shape how clients experience Stitch.

  • Present to the C-suite with confidence. Handle the tough questions without flinching and navigate organizational dynamics gracefully.
  • Work through complex stakeholder environments to drive outcomes.
  • See the big picture across workstreams. Manage dependencies and spot downstream impacts before they find you.
  • Handle ambiguity with sound judgment. Nobody’s going to hand you a playbook for every situation, and you won’t need one.
  • Challenge the status quo. Build reusable assets and frameworks that scale.
  • Multiply your impact by coaching and developing others. Step into leadership gaps when you see them.
  • Take ownership of new hire onboarding and enablement.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 401k with company match
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Monthly tech stipend
  • Paid parental leave
  • In-person onboarding experience at our HQ in Indianapolis, Indiana
  • Mental well-being support

jobs.description:
About Zenlayer

Zenlayer is the first massively distributed edge cloud provider, operating 290+ Points of Presence across 70+ countries. With accolades including PTC “Best Networking Innovation”, “Outstanding Cloud, Data Center, or Interconnection Company”, and Inc. 5000, we enable businesses to deploy and run applications at the edge, thus reducing network latency to the end user. Zenlayer focuses on improving connections worldwide, all while nurturing a unique company culture that values service, growth, and trust. As a “Zenplayer”, you’ll be joining a community of success-driven team players that share the dream of powering a better-connected world.

About the Role:

As the technical lead for inference performance, you will own end-to-end responsibility for the platform's Token Performance. For models ranging from hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters (including MoE), you will continuously reduce cost per million tokens and increase per-GPU Goodput while meeting TTFT/TPOT SLOs, and prove the gain from every optimization with reproducible data.

What You Will Work On

1. End-to-End Performance Attribution and Benchmarking

  • Establish a unified Token Performance metrics framework (TTFT, TPOT, Goodput, GPU utilization, per-token cost), and build load-testing benchmarks that reflect real production traffic (high concurrency, long context, multi-turn Agent workloads)
  • Perform bottleneck attribution for models such as DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, and MiniMax across compute, memory bandwidth, communication, scheduling, and queuing, and let the data determine which layer is the dominant constraint

2. Kernel-Level Inference Engine Optimization

  • Dive deep into the source code of vLLM / SGLang / TensorRT-LLM, customizing and contributing upstream on critical paths such as the scheduler, Continuous Batching, Chunked Prefill, CUDA Graph, and KV block management
  • Clearly define the responsibility boundary between the inference engine and orchestration layers such as Dynamo / llm-d, and reduce tail latency through request routing and load balancing

3. PD Disaggregation and KV Cache Transfer

  • Lead the core design of Prefill-Decode disaggregation: the KV transfer path (NIXL/RDMA/UCX), transfer-compute overlap, and phase-aware autoscaling
  • Define the failure domains and recovery semantics of cross-instance KV transfer, and answer the key question: under which workloads does PD disaggregation deliver gains, and under which does it make things slower

4. MoE Parallelism and Wide-EP

  • Design hybrid TP/PP/DP/EP parallelism strategies and quantify the trade-offs between EP and TP
  • Tackle expert load imbalance and All-to-All communication overhead, and drive Wide-EP into production

5. Kernels and Quantization

  • Write and tune critical CUDA (and ROCm/HIP) operators: memory access optimization, kernel fusion, and Attention / MoE / communication-related kernels
  • Build a closed-loop "quantization – accuracy – throughput" evaluation: the real-world gains and accuracy regressions of FP8/FP4/INT4/AWQ/GPTQ across different engines and hardware

Requirements

  • First-principles understanding of Transformer inference: the compute vs. memory-bound nature of Prefill and Decode, the KV Cache memory model, the differences among MHA/GQA/MLA, and how MoE routing constrains parallelism
  • Source-level, in-depth experience with at least one mainstream inference engine, with real cases of identifying and fixing bottlenecks in scheduling, kernel selection, or KV management
  • CUDA kernel tuning skills (Nsight profiling, memory optimization, fusion, CUDA Graph) with hands-on practical experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field (HPC systems, ML Systems).
  • Minimum 6 years in systems/Performance Engineering, with at least 2-3 years directly on LLM or GPU performance work

Preferred, but not required:

  • Experience with Merged PRs in vLLM
  • Experience operating at cluster sale (hundreds to thousands of GPUs)
Salary: $300,000-600,000 DOE
