You’ll work closely with finance leadership, operations, and accounting team members across general ledger accounting, month-end close, financial statements, reconciliations, audit support, and process improvement.

If you have strong accounting fundamentals, hands-on ERP experience, and enjoy bringing structure and accuracy to financial operations, this role could be a great fit.

What You’ll Own

General Ledger & Accounting Operations

  • Prepare and post journal entries for accruals, prepaids, payroll allocations, depreciation, and intercompany transactions
  • Maintain accurate general ledger accounts
  • Reconcile:
    • Cash and bank accounts
    • Accounts receivable and accounts payable
    • Credit cards
    • Deferred revenue
    • Inventory and other balance sheet accounts
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready accounting records

Month-End & Quarter-End Close

  • Lead monthly and quarterly close activities
  • Maintain close checklists, schedules, and supporting documentation
  • Prepare accruals and adjusting journal entries
  • Complete balance sheet reconciliations
  • Coordinate with internal teams to collect required reporting inputs
  • Help deliver an accurate and timely close within 5–7 business days

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and review:
    • Profit & Loss statements
    • Balance Sheets
    • Cash Flow Statements
  • Perform budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual variance analysis
  • Investigate material variances and provide clear commentary
  • Prepare financial schedules and reporting packages for leadership, audits, and executive reviews
  • Help translate accounting data into useful financial insights

NetSuite, ERP & Accounting Systems

  • Maintain accurate financial data within NetSuite or similar ERP/accounting systems
  • Support improvements to accounting workflows and system controls
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual accounting processes
  • Help improve reporting, reconciliations, and financial data integrity
  • Support ERP optimization and automation initiatives

Audit, Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Support external audits and prepare PBC schedules
  • Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions and reconciliations
  • Assist with applicable tax and compliance reporting
  • Maintain accounting SOPs and internal controls
  • Ensure accounting practices align with GAAP and applicable company policies
  • Keep financial records organized and audit-ready

Team & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Review work completed by staff accountants, bookkeepers, or junior accounting team members
  • Provide guidance on reconciliations, journal entries, and accounting treatment
  • Collaborate with FP&A, operations, sales, and leadership
  • Help improve accounting processes, documentation, and reporting standards

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of financial accuracy
  • You’re highly organized and naturally detail-oriented
  • You understand the reasoning behind accounting entries, not just how to process them
  • You can identify discrepancies and investigate them independently
  • You work effectively under month-end and reporting deadlines
  • You communicate financial information clearly
  • You proactively look for ways to improve accounting processes and controls

Required Experience & Skills

  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • U.S. GAAP
    • General ledger accounting
    • Accrual accounting
    • Financial reporting
    • Account reconciliations
    • Month-end close
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, SAP, or similar accounting/ERP systems
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Pivot Tables
    • VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
    • INDEX/MATCH
    • Conditional formatting
    • Reconciliation and reporting workflows
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • CPA, ACCA, or equivalent accounting qualification
  • Strong hands-on NetSuite experience
  • Multi-entity accounting and consolidations
  • Foreign currency or multi-currency accounting
  • SaaS, real estate, professional services, or other growing-company experience
  • ERP implementation or migration experience
  • Accounting automation experience
  • Experience developing or improving accounting SOPs and internal controls

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing cash activity and completing account reconciliations, then prepare journal entries or investigate discrepancies within the general ledger.

During close periods, you’ll work through the close checklist, post accruals and adjustments, review balance sheet accounts, analyze financial variances, and ensure reporting is completed accurately.

You’ll also collaborate with operations and finance leadership, review junior accounting work, support audit requests, and identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows.

In short: you ensure the company’s financial records are accurate, compliant, organized, and useful for decision-making.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Month-end close completed within established deadlines
  • Accurate and timely financial statements
  • Clean and fully supported balance sheet reconciliations
  • Minimal accounting and reporting errors
  • Audit requests completed accurately and on time
  • Strong internal controls and documentation
  • Improved efficiency of accounting workflows
  • Leadership confidence in financial reporting

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Intro Video via Spark Hire
  3. Practical Accounting Assessment – Reconciliation, Variance Analysis & Reporting
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video completed on your own time and is the final step needed to complete your application.

Instead of repeating your background across multiple screening calls, you get to introduce yourself once and show hiring teams how you communicate before the first interview. If there’s a strong fit, your first live conversation can focus on the role rather than starting from scratch.

Don’t overthink it. You can record your responses multiple times, and discarded takes are not shared.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for the Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have strong GAAP and general ledger accounting experience
  • Have worked with NetSuite or similar ERP systems
  • Know how to manage reconciliations and month-end close
  • Care deeply about financial accuracy
  • Enjoy improving accounting processes
  • Want meaningful ownership within a growing business

We’d love to hear from you.

Job Description

A bit about this role:


At Devoted, our mission is to build trust with our providers and members by ensuring claims are paid accurately and on time with transparent policies. Our Payment Integrity Concept Development team develops and sustains programs that improve payment accuracy, affordability, and provider experience.

As our Senior Payment Integrity Program Development Manager – Operational Excellence, you will help ensure our internal and vendor-supported payment integrity edits and audits are implemented accurately, perform as intended, and continue delivering value over time.

You will combine payment integrity expertise, analytical judgment, and operational leadership to manage complex portfolio activities, investigate performance issues, and develop more effective and scalable ways of working. Partnering across technical and operational teams, you will drive improvements that strengthen program accuracy, financial performance, efficiency, and provider experience.

Success means not only resolving today's problems, but im

proving the systems that prevent them from recurring.


Your responsibilities and impact will include:

  • Portfolio Performance & Optimization: Evaluate the effectiveness of payment integrity edits and audits, independently investigate complex performance or operational issues, identify root causes, and drive improvements in accuracy, financial outcomes, and provider experience.

  • Implementation & Validation Assurance: Ensure new and modified payment integrity programs are appropriately validated and implemented as intended. Partner with technical and operational teams to strengthen testing, quality controls, and implementation reliability.

  • Portfolio Maintenance & Operational Execution: Lead assigned internal and vendor-supported portfolio activities, ensuring effective prioritization, issue resolution, maintenance, and ongoing program performance.

  • Operational Transformation & Scalability: Identify and implement improvements to processes, workflows, and supporting capabilities across validation, monitoring, maintenance, and knowledge sharing. Leverage technology, automation, and operational best practices to improve efficiency, transparency, and scalability.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence: Independently advance complex initiatives, develop evidence-based recommendations, and build alignment across Payment Integrity, Engineering, Data Science, Claims, Compliance, and other stakeholders to achieve measurable results.


Required skills and experience:

  • Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial hands-on payment integrity experience within a health plan or payment integrity vendor.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare claims, payment integrity edits and audits, claims adjudication, Medicare/CMS reimbursement policies, NCCI/CCI edits, and supporting operational processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to investigate complex payment integrity issues, analyze root causes, and drive effective resolution.

  • Strong analytical and technical literacy, including the ability to read and interpret SQL queries, claims data, configuration specifications, validation results, and performance metrics.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing operational improvements, scalable workflows, or technology-enabled solutions that deliver measurable results.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently explore and apply analytical tools, technology, and automation to improve workflows, identify opportunities, and develop scalable operational solutions.

  • Experience collaborating with technical and operational partners to implement, troubleshoot, or improve payment integrity programs.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, multiphase initiatives, exercise sound judgment, and influence cross-functional stakeholders.


Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience with Medicare Advantage and Commercial payment integrity programs.

  • Experience with vendor-supported claims editing platforms or proprietary payment integrity solutions.

  • Professional coding certification (e.g., CPC, CCS) or comparable reimbursement expertise.

  • Experience implementing AI-enabled analytics, automated testing, performance monitoring, or workflow automation to improve payment integrity operations.



Salary range: $110,500 - $150,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

Done building someone else's agency? Come build your own career.

You've put in the work. Now work from anywhere: no office, no territory, no upline looking over your shoulder.

You know the products, you run the appointments and you close the cases. But somewhere along the way the deal changed. The comp grid got thinner, your upline stopped returning calls, and the "family culture" turned into a recruiting quota.

At Taubman Financial Management (TFM), we believe experienced agents deserve better. We're an independent life and annuity agency built on one simple idea: put people first and success follows. Your effort is what gets rewarded here, not your recruiting numbers, your seniority or who you know.

100% remote. Live and work anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation that respects your production

  • Competitive, transparent contract levels from day one, with a clear path to higher levels based on your results
  • You own your book of business
  • No mandatory fees, no hidden splits, and no required lead purchases

Mentorship directly from me, not a call center

Most IMOs promise mentorship and then hand you off to a training portal. At TFM you work directly with me, Scott Taubman. I've spent more than 40 years in financial services and business across finance, sales, operations and organizational development. I founded and ran my own wealth management firm, and I hold a BBA and an MBA in finance and economics. I've been where you want to go, and I'll help you get there.

  • Regular team meetings. We meet as a team to cover policy types, how to underwrite effectively, how to build and run your business, and everything else it takes to make this a successful career. You learn from me and from fellow agents working real cases.
  • One-on-one coaching. Calls with me on your pipeline, your goals and your weekly activity, built around how you work.
  • Case design help. Before you sit down with a client on a complex annuity, IUL or retirement-income case, we'll work through it together so you walk in prepared.
  • Joint work on bigger cases. You learn on real business with real clients, not role-play, and I'm there for the advanced planning conversations.
  • A direct line to me. When you have a question, you call me and get an answer within hours.
  • Support that doesn't stop. Training and coaching continue for as long as you're with TFM, whether you're in your first month or your tenth year.

Everything we do is focused on one goal: helping you build a career you succeed in and reach the goals you set for yourself.

Advanced markets support for your bigger cases

Most agents walk away from complex cases, or hand them off and lose the client. At TFM you get backup from someone who built and ran a wealth management firm.

  • Business owner planning: buy-sell funding, key person coverage and executive benefits
  • Retirement income planning: annuity strategies, income planning and IUL for supplemental retirement income
  • Debt management and financial planning resources that open the door to whole-household relationships
  • Case design and joint work from the first meeting to placement

Bring us your complex cases. We'll help you design them, present them and close them.

Leads on your terms

No forced lead purchases, and no markups.

  • Coaching on building your own lead sources: referrals, centers of influence, community marketing and social media
  • You choose what works for your business and your budget

One fully automated system, from quote to placed policy

Most agents juggle a CRM, a quoting site, illustration software, carrier portals and spreadsheets. At TFM, our proprietary system automates the whole process in one place:

  • Quoting: instant quotes across our carrier partners
  • Illustrations: generated automatically, ready to present to your client
  • Underwriting: pre-qualify clients and match them to the right carrier before you apply
  • Applications: submitted straight from the system, with no re-entering data
  • CRM and automated follow-up: every client and prospect tracked, with timely touches so nothing falls through the cracks
  • Agent portal: training materials, resources and support whenever you need them

You spend less time on paperwork and more time with clients.

A smooth transition from your current IMO

Changing agencies doesn't have to be complicated. We'll walk you through every step:

  • Carrier releases and any waiting periods
  • Contracting and appointments with our carrier partners
  • Planning the timing so your income isn't disrupted
  • Completely confidential from your first call to your first case

A culture you'll actually want to be part of

  • People first, always. We celebrate every win, big or small.
  • A diverse team where success comes from effort, and every background is welcome
  • No pressure to recruit friends and family. Building a team is optional and supported, never required.
  • Live and work anywhere. No office, no territory, no commute. Set your own schedule from home, on the road, or wherever life takes you.

What you'll offer clients

  • Term, whole life and Indexed Universal Life (IUL)
  • Fixed and fixed indexed annuities
  • Living benefits and final expense
  • Access to TFM's financial planning and debt management resources for client households

How to apply

Apply here in about two minutes. A member of our team will reach out to set up a confidential conversation. Your current IMO will not be contacted.

Prefer to talk first? Book a confidential 15-minute call: Meet with Scott

This is an independent contractor opportunity paid entirely on commission. Earnings depend on individual effort and results and are not guaranteed. Taubman Financial Management is an equal opportunity organization. We welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability and veteran status. Arizona insurance license #8413867.

Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust
Salary Range: 80K-90K

LTS is seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Analyst to support cybersecurity, risk management, and security authorization activities across multiple projects within the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Health portfolio.

The analyst will provide hands-on support for the Risk Management Framework (RMF), Authority to Operate (ATO) processes, security control assessments, vulnerability remediation, continuous monitoring, and security and privacy documentation. This role requires independent execution of assigned deliverables and close coordination with Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), technical teams, project managers, and VA stakeholders.

The Health PMO support contract provides IT program management, project management, technical management, financial management, functional planning, and documentation analysis in support of the Enterprise Program Management Office (EPMO) Enterprise Program Management Division (EPMD) Health Portfolio

The VA Health Portfolio is focused on development and execution of quality IT projects that address the needs of Veterans and health care providers through management of healthcare information and sustainment of production software to keep the mission going.

What You’ll Do:

  • Support development, maintenance, and updates of ATO packages, security authorization artifacts, and related documentation.
  • Apply NIST RMF, NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5, VA Handbook 6500, and applicable federal and VA cybersecurity requirements to assigned systems and projects.
  • Review and document security controls; support security control assessments, authorization activities, and continuous monitoring.
  • Coordinate with ISSOs, system owners, engineers, and project stakeholders to identify security risks and address authorization requirements.
  • Develop, evaluate, maintain, and track Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) from identification through documented closure.
  • Review vulnerability scan results, analyze findings, coordinate corrective actions, and track remediation status.
  • Support system scanning, audit readiness, High Value Asset (HVA) reviews, and other mandated security assessments.
  • Prepare and maintain security and privacy artifacts, compliance reports, standard operating procedures, and supporting program documentation.
  • Assist with contingency planning, incident response and disaster recovery documentation, and related exercises or testing.
  • Support Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Privacy Threshold Analyses (PTAs), and other applicable privacy documentation.
  • Maintain accurate records and status updates in ServiceNow, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms, and other authorized tracking tools.
  • Work with application development, operations, security architecture, and engineering teams to integrate security requirements throughout the system development lifecycle.
  • Support security activities for IT modernization, application maintenance, cloud-related initiatives, and Agile delivery teams.
  • Communicate security risks, remediation priorities, deliverable status, and process improvement recommendations to program and government stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple assignments and deadlines independently while collaborating effectively in a remote team environment.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field, plus at least five years of relevant professional experience; an additional five years of relevant experience may substitute for the degree.
  • At least five years of relevant cybersecurity, information assurance, or federal security compliance experience.
  • Hands-on experience supporting ATO processes for systems or applications at the VA or another federal agency.
  • Practical experience applying NIST RMF, including security control documentation, assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring.
  • Strong working knowledge of FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and applicable federal cybersecurity requirements; familiarity with HIPAA and HITECH requirements in healthcare environments.
  • Experience developing and maintaining security authorization packages, assessment evidence, and compliance artifacts.
  • Demonstrated experience creating, evaluating, tracking, and closing POA&Ms, including coordination of remediation actions.
  • Experience analyzing vulnerability findings, coordinating mitigation, and tracking issues through resolution.
  • Experience using enterprise GRC or security compliance tracking tools and a ticketing or workflow platform such as ServiceNow.
  • Experience supporting security control assessments, cybersecurity audits, or compliance reviews.
  • Strong analytical, technical writing, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills; ability to perform hands-on work independently in a collaborative remote environment.
  • Current CompTIA Security+, GIAC GSEC, ISC2 CISSP, ISACA CISM, or another cybersecurity certification approved for the position.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, proactive collaborative environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience supporting VA cybersecurity programs, RMF activities, or ATO processes.
  • Experience with VA-specific GRC tools, ServiceNow Continuous Authorization and Monitoring (CAM), or other VA security tracking systems.
  • Experience using ACAS, Nessus, HBSS, or comparable scanning and security monitoring tools.
  • CISSP or CISM certification.
  • Experience supporting ATOs for cloud-hosted or Software as a Service (SaaS) applications and familiarity with FedRAMP.
  • Experience with cloud migration, cloud security architecture, or federal IT modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery and security integration into the software development lifecycle.
  • Knowledge of VA healthcare applications, including VistA, or experience supporting complex federal healthcare IT environments.

What’s In It for You?

The opportunity to support high-visibility federal missions

A culture that values innovation, growth, and collaboration

Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies

Comprehensive benefits for you and your family

A career path that rewards ambition and performance

If you're ready to push boundaries, sharpen your skills, and join a team that is passionate about building what’s next, we’d love to meet you. Apply today and let’s build a future together!

LTS shares salary ranges to promote transparency. Compensation ranges are provided for informational purposes, and final compensation may vary based on experience, skills, location, and role requirements.

LTS is committed to offering eligible employees comprehensive benefits that will provide them with options intended to meet their needs and the needs of their family.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Backend Engineer to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build, maintain, and improve the backend systems powering our telehealth platform.

You'll work on APIs, databases, application logic, and backend services supporting patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant-facing tools.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with a foundation in backend development who wants to strengthen their technical skills while contributing to real production software.

Our platform uses TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies such as tRPC, Prisma, and Drizzle across our engineering stack.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, participate in code reviews, and gradually take ownership of increasingly complex features.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building software, learns quickly, asks thoughtful questions, and takes pride in writing clean, reliable code.

You don't need extensive professional experience or a background in healthcare. We care about your ability to write code, solve problems, understand how backend systems work, and continue developing your skills.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain backend features supporting Bask's telehealth platform.
  • Develop APIs, backend services, and application logic using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Work with SQL databases to retrieve, update, and organize application data.
  • Help implement functionality supporting patient records, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.
  • Build and maintain integrations between internal services and third-party APIs.
  • Work with senior engineers to understand technical requirements and implement backend solutions.
  • Learn and contribute to serverless applications built using AWS and SST.
  • Assist with background jobs, asynchronous processing, and event-driven workflows.
  • Write clean, readable, maintainable code that follows established engineering practices.
  • Create automated tests to verify backend functionality and help prevent regressions.
  • Debug application issues, investigate errors, and contribute to resolving production problems.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from other engineers.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers to ensure APIs and backend services support product requirements.

Project Highlights

  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

Employment Type: Permanent, Part-Time
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, approximately 20 hours per week (UK business hours)
Salary: Competitive, based on experience and agreed part-time hours
Start Date: Immediate

About the Opportunity

We are recruiting for a UK-based media and advertising business specialising in local community publications and affordable print advertising solutions for small businesses.

The company is looking for a friendly, professional and confident Telemarketer / Lead Generation Caller to join its team on a part-time basis.

This role focuses on outbound calling, introducing advertising opportunities to local UK businesses, verifying contact information and generating qualified leads for the sales team.

The position will initially operate on a part-time basis, with the potential to grow into a full-time opportunity based on performance and business requirements.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Make outbound calls to local UK businesses to introduce the company's advertising services.
  • Engage professionally with business owners and decision-makers, building rapport and establishing interest.
  • Verify and update customer contact information, particularly email addresses.
  • Identify potential interest in advertising opportunities and arrange for relevant media packs to be sent.
  • Schedule callbacks for the sales team with interested prospects.
  • Accurately record call outcomes, contact details and follow-up actions in the CRM system.
  • Maintain clear, professional and friendly communication throughout every interaction.
  • Work independently to manage assigned calling lists and maintain consistent activity.
  • Participate in call reviews and coaching sessions to improve performance and communication quality.
  • Ensure all calls are handled accurately and in line with company guidelines.

Requirements

  • Approximately 1–3 years of experience in outbound calling, telemarketing, appointment setting or lead generation.
  • Previous experience calling UK businesses or working within a UK-facing campaign is highly advantageous.
  • Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and strong communication skills.
  • A warm, patient and professional telephone manner.
  • Ability to build rapport with traditional business owners and decision-makers.
  • Experience using CRM systems to update customer records and track call outcomes.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when verifying contact information.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Willingness to have calls recorded, reviewed and used for coaching and quality assurance.
  • Availability to work approximately 20 hours per week during UK business hours.

Advantageous Experience

  • Previous experience in advertising, media, publishing or print sales.
  • Familiarity with UK small businesses and local advertising markets.
  • Experience generating leads and arranging callbacks for sales representatives.
  • Previous experience in a BPO, contact centre or outbound sales environment.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is personable, reliable and confident on the phone.

The ideal candidate will have a natural conversational approach rather than an aggressive sales style. They should be comfortable speaking with business owners, asking relevant questions and building genuine rapport.

Strong listening skills, patience, accuracy and professionalism are essential.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Consistent outbound calling activity.
  • Accurate validation and updating of contact information.
  • Qualified leads generated and media packs requested.
  • Relevant callbacks arranged for the sales team.
  • High-quality, professional and accurate customer interactions.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit:

  • An updated CV.
  • A short recorded video introduction.
  • A brief mock outbound call demonstrating their telephone manner, ability to introduce a service and verify a prospect's contact information.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced outbound caller seeking flexible, part-time remote work with the potential for longer-term growth.

jobs.description:
Opportunity Type:

Regular

Summary:

The Senior Director, New Business Development is responsible for driving growth in corporate fundraising revenue through the acquisition of new corporate partners, sponsors, and philanthropic investors. As a key leader within the Corporate Fundraising team, this role identifies, develops, and secures strategic corporate relationships that align organizational priorities with the social impact, community engagement, and corporate responsibility goals of prospective partners.

The Senior Director will develop and execute a comprehensive new business strategy, build a robust pipeline of corporate prospects, and lead the cultivation and solicitation of high-value partnerships. This individual will collaborate closely with senior leadership, corporate fundraising colleagues, marketing, and program teams to create compelling partnership opportunities that generate sustainable revenue and long-term engagement.

Key Responsibilities:


New Business Development & Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a strategic plan to acquire new corporate partners and sponsorship revenue.
  • Identify, qualify, and cultivate prospective corporate donors, sponsors, and strategic partners.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of new business opportunities to achieve annual revenue goals.
  • Drive proactive outreach efforts to establish relationships with key decision-makers and corporate executives.
  • Develop innovative partnership opportunities that align organizational priorities with corporate social responsibility, ESG, employee engagement, and philanthropic objectives.

Corporate Partner Acquisition

  • Lead the full business development lifecycle from prospect identification through proposal development, solicitation, negotiation, and closing.
  • Secure six- and seven-figure corporate partnerships, sponsorships, and philanthropic investments.
  • Create customized partnership strategies and value propositions for prospective funders.
  • Negotiate and execute partnership agreements that maximize organizational impact and revenue.

Strategic Relationship Building

  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with senior corporate leaders and community stakeholders.
  • Represent the organization at corporate events, conferences, community engagements, and networking opportunities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to corporate partners by identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement and impact.
  • Engage executive leadership and board members in strategic cultivation efforts as appropriate.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Corporate Fundraising colleagues to ensure smooth transition and stewardship of newly secured partnerships.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, Programs, and Finance teams to develop proposals, presentations, impact reports, and partnership materials.
  • Work closely with organizational leadership to align business development efforts with strategic priorities.
  • Support enterprise-wide fundraising initiatives and campaigns.

Leadership & Performance Management

  • Provide leadership and subject matter expertise on corporate partnership acquisition strategies.
  • Monitor pipeline health, revenue forecasts, and business development performance metrics.
  • Prepare regular reports and presentations for senior leadership regarding growth opportunities and fundraising results.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and relationship excellence.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Nonprofit Management, Public Administration, or related field.
  • Years of Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in business development, corporate fundraising, strategic partnerships, sales, or related fields.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated success securing high-value corporate partnerships or sponsorships.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue-generation goals.
  • Experience engaging and influencing C-suite executives and senior corporate leaders.
  • Experience working within a nonprofit, association, healthcare, higher education, or mission-driven organization preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop new business opportunities and corporate partnerships.
  • Knowledge of corporate fundraising, sponsorships, and revenue-generation strategies.
  • Strong relationship-building and executive stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to negotiate and secure mutually beneficial partnership agreements.
  • Experience managing prospect pipelines, forecasting, and achieving growth targets.
  • Skilled in proposal writing, presentations, and persuasive storytelling.
  • Strategic thinker with strong collaboration and influencing abilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Direct Reports: May supervise Corporate Development Officers/ Managers or other fundraising professionals as assigned.

Culture and Values
At Habitat for Humanity International, you join a community that believes in:
*Humility: We are part of something bigger than ourselves.
*Courage: We do what is right, even when it is difficult.
*Accountability: We take personal responsibility for Habitat’s mission.
*Safeguarding: We protect the rights, dignity, and safety of all people we serve and work alongside.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Outcomes
jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer outcomes are about helping entrepreneurs and businesses turn our software into meaningful results. We value people who understand customer goals, take responsibility for delivering value, and build lasting relationships through strong execution, practical problem-solving, and measurable progress.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Customer Outcomes to lead Bask Health's customer success strategy with a strong focus on measurable customer value, platform adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

This role is responsible for building a customer success function that understands what customers are trying to accomplish and helps them achieve those goals.

You'll lead customer success operations, develop a high-performing team, and establish processes that connect customer engagement to meaningful business outcomes.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll bring a strong understanding of e-commerce businesses, merchant operations, and the challenges entrepreneurs face when building and scaling online businesses.

You'll develop a customer outcomes strategy that aligns customer goals with Bask Health's capabilities and business priorities.

You'll define how the team identifies customer objectives during onboarding and tracks progress throughout the customer lifecycle.

You'll establish a consistent approach to customer success planning, account reviews, adoption strategies, and outcome measurement.

You'll help the team understand the difference between customers simply using the platform and customers achieving meaningful value from it.

You'll develop frameworks for evaluating customer adoption, business engagement, account health, and retention risk.

You'll work with customer success managers to ensure customer goals are documented, understood, and revisited over time.

You'll establish clear expectations for account ownership, customer communication, and proactive engagement.

You'll lead, coach, and develop customer success team members within the approved organizational structure.

You'll help team members strengthen their strategic account management, commercial judgment, and problem-solving skills.

You'll create an environment where team members take ownership of customer outcomes rather than focusing only on completing tasks or responding to requests.

You'll work with leadership to develop appropriate customer segmentation and account coverage strategies.

You'll help determine how the team should support strategic accounts, growing merchants, and smaller businesses.

You'll establish meaningful performance metrics for customer success and customer outcomes.

You'll monitor customer retention, churn, renewals, expansion, product adoption, and other relevant indicators of customer health.

You'll develop reporting that helps leadership understand how customer success activities contribute to business performance.

You'll identify patterns in customer behavior that indicate successful adoption, declining engagement, or potential account risk.

You'll create proactive strategies to address customers who are struggling to achieve their goals.

You'll oversee important customer escalations and ensure issues affecting customer outcomes receive appropriate attention.

You'll build relationships with strategic customer stakeholders, including founders, executives, and business owners.

You'll participate in executive-level customer conversations when leadership involvement can help strengthen relationships or address challenges.

You'll guide the team in conducting meaningful business reviews focused on customer goals, progress, obstacles, and opportunities.

You'll collaborate with sales leadership to support renewal preparation and identify appropriate account expansion opportunities.

You'll help establish processes for identifying customers who may benefit from additional supported platform capabilities.

You'll ensure expansion conversations are grounded in customer needs and demonstrated value.

You'll work closely with product and engineering teams to communicate customer feedback, adoption challenges, and recurring product limitations.

You'll use customer insights to help inform product improvements that strengthen customer outcomes.

You'll collaborate with technical support and customer success engineering teams to address implementation or technical obstacles affecting adoption.

You'll help identify recurring technical problems that prevent customers from achieving important business goals.

You'll support improvements to customer onboarding, product education, and implementation handoffs.

You'll help ensure customers understand how to use Bask Health's capabilities effectively.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll ensure the customer success team understands the platform well enough to connect its capabilities to customer business needs.

You'll establish clear processes for recognizing when customer requests require technical, clinical, pharmacy, or compliance expertise.

You'll coordinate with authorized teams when issues involve regulated healthcare activities.

You'll ensure the team follows appropriate security, privacy, and customer information-handling procedures.

You'll develop scalable customer success playbooks and operational processes.

You'll evaluate existing customer success tools, workflows, and reporting practices to identify opportunities for improvement.

You'll create a consistent approach to documenting customer goals, success plans, risks, and follow-up commitments.

You'll collaborate with leadership on organizational planning, staffing needs, and team development.

You'll participate in hiring and evaluating customer success talent as needed.

You'll establish performance coaching and professional development practices that reinforce accountability for customer results.

You'll help create clear collaboration between customer success, sales, product, engineering, and technical support teams.

You'll work directly with company leadership to communicate customer outcomes performance, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.

You'll help leadership understand how customer value realization affects retention, expansion, and long-term account relationships.

You'll balance customer advocacy with commercial priorities and operational realities.

You'll develop strategies that strengthen customer relationships while supporting responsible recurring-revenue growth.

We're looking for a leader with substantial post-sale customer success experience, proven team management ability, and meaningful e-commerce experience.

You should understand how merchant-facing SaaS businesses operate and how customer outcomes influence retention and long-term account value.

You'll need to be comfortable building processes, coaching teams, managing strategic relationships, and making data-informed decisions.

Success in this role means creating a customer success function that consistently helps customers achieve meaningful results, improves retention, supports account growth, and demonstrates the value of Bask Health's platform.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Bask Health's customer outcomes strategy and customer success operations.
  • Establish processes for identifying and documenting customer business goals.
  • Develop customer success plans focused on measurable results.
  • Build frameworks for tracking customer adoption and value realization.
  • Lead and coach customer success team members within the approved organization.
  • Establish clear expectations for account ownership and proactive customer engagement.
  • Develop customer segmentation and account coverage strategies.
  • Monitor customer retention, churn, renewals, and expansion performance.
  • Establish customer outcomes metrics and reporting practices.
  • Identify customers who are struggling to achieve expected results.
  • Develop proactive strategies to improve adoption and reduce retention risk.
  • Oversee strategic customer relationships and executive-level engagements.
  • Guide customer success managers in conducting outcome-focused business reviews.
  • Support renewal preparation and appropriate account expansion opportunities.
  • Collaborate with sales on account growth strategies.
  • Work with product and engineering on customer adoption challenges.
  • Coordinate with technical support and customer success engineering teams.
  • Improve onboarding and implementation handoffs.
  • Develop customer success playbooks and internal training resources.
  • Establish consistent processes for documenting customer goals and account risks.
  • Build reporting that connects customer success activities to business performance.
  • Identify recurring customer obstacles and recommend improvements.
  • Oversee important customer escalations affecting account health.
  • Coach team members on strategic account management and commercial judgment.
  • Support organizational planning and customer success hiring.
  • Improve customer success tools, workflows, and documentation.
  • Establish clear collaboration between customer success and other departments.
  • Promote accountability for measurable customer outcomes.
  • Ensure appropriate privacy, security, and information-handling practices.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, and compliance matters to authorized teams.
  • Provide leadership with clear updates on customer outcomes, retention, and risks.
  • Take ownership of the customer success function's effectiveness and long-term results.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in customer success, account management, client services, or a closely related post-sale customer-facing function.
  • At least 4 years of experience directly managing and developing customer success or account management teams.
  • Demonstrated ownership of post-sale customer success strategy and operations.
  • Recent, substantive experience working with e-commerce businesses, online merchants, or merchant-facing commerce software.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce business models, direct-to-consumer operations, and merchant needs.
  • Experience developing customer success strategies focused on measurable customer outcomes.
  • Proven ability to lead customer onboarding, adoption, retention, renewal, and expansion initiatives.
  • Experience creating and managing customer success plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and evaluate customer-facing employees.
  • Experience establishing customer success performance metrics and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of customer retention, churn, account health, and renewal performance.
  • Experience measuring customer adoption and value realization.
  • Ability to develop strategies for improving customer retention and long-term engagement.
  • Experience supporting expansion opportunities within existing customer accounts.
  • Strong commercial judgment and understanding of recurring-revenue SaaS businesses.
  • Experience managing relationships with founders, executives, and senior customer stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead strategic account reviews and customer outcome discussions.
  • Experience handling complex customer escalations.
  • Experience collaborating with sales, product, engineering, and company leadership.
  • Ability to translate customer feedback into operational and product recommendations.
  • Experience building customer success playbooks and scalable processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to present customer outcomes and business performance to leadership.
  • Strong analytical thinking and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Experience managing multiple strategic priorities and competing demands.
  • Strong organizational and operational planning skills.
  • Ability to lead teams in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Strong ownership mentality and accountability for customer and team outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading customer success at an e-commerce SaaS company.
  • Experience managing customer success teams serving Shopify merchants.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, Klaviyo, Recharge, Gorgias, Yotpo, or similar commerce platforms.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer brands and online entrepreneurs.
  • Personal experience building or operating an e-commerce business.
  • Experience leading customer success for both SMB and strategic accounts.
  • Experience managing enterprise customer relationships.
  • Experience developing customer value realization frameworks.
  • Experience creating customer outcome scorecards and success plans.
  • Experience improving gross revenue retention and net revenue retention.
  • Experience developing customer health scoring and churn prediction processes.
  • Experience building customer success dashboards and reporting.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, ChurnZero, or similar platforms.
  • Experience designing customer segmentation and account assignment models.
  • Experience building customer success teams during periods of growth.
  • Experience leading cross-functional customer retention initiatives.
  • Experience developing account expansion processes with sales teams.
  • Experience improving technical onboarding and customer implementation handoffs.
  • Familiarity with online storefront, checkout, and payment workflows.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology or telehealth businesses.
  • Experience working directly with founders and senior company leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Data & AI Architect
jobs.excerpt: Are you an experienced Data Architect who enjoys both enterprise-level architecture and hands-on technical design?
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Data Architect who enjoys both enterprise-level architecture and hands-on technical design? Do you want to keep our source systems, data platform and AI use cases working together coherently?

At LGC, we're looking for a Senior Data & AI Architect to take on the day-to-day running of our enterprise data architecture, working under the direction of the Head of Enterprise Data & AI Architecture.

This is a hands-on role that combines classic enterprise data architecture, keeping data coherent across ERP, CRM, Finance, Supply Chain and Laboratory Systems, with technical data architecture on our Snowflake platform, including dbt and integration patterns. You will also help drive our strategic semantic architecture and enterprise ontology, so that analytics and AI are built on trusted, consistent business meaning.

We're looking for someone who can see the bigger picture but isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and get into the detail.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Engage with source systems: Act as the data architecture representative in ERP, CRM, Finance, Supply Chain and Laboratory Systems programmes, assessing the downstream impact of changes, upgrades and new implementations, and profiling source data before integration begins.
  • Design enterprise data models: Create and maintain conceptual, canonical and semantic data models for key domains such as Product, Customer, Supplier, Finance, Employee and Quality.
  • Define patterns and blueprints: Produce reference architectures, integration blueprints, data contracts and modelling standards for ingestion, medallion and ELT patterns.
  • Work with Snowflake and dbt: Design and guide delivery of data models, semantic views and consumption models in Snowflake, with dbt transformations tested for grain, joins and metric correctness.
  • Guide engineering teams: Review data engineering designs for conformity with architectural standards and contribute to engineering guardrails and platform best practice.
  • Shape our semantic architecture and ontology: Help develop the LGC enterprise ontology by linking source metadata and relationships to governed business concepts, and establish consistent, trusted definitions across the organisation. Manage a controlled lifecycle to propose, validate, approve and retire semantic assertions, and turn them into practical Snowflake semantic models.
  • Support AI innovation: Design governed data products and models that enable AI applications, including RAG and GraphRAG.
  • Drive data quality and governance: Ensure data is reliable, traceable and fit for purpose through data governance, metadata management, Master Data Management designs and quality controls.
  • Turn complex ideas into practical solutions: Translate business requirements into clear architectural designs and documentation, represent the Data & AI team in architecture and demand review forums, and work closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • ​​​​​Proven experience in Enterprise Data Architecture, ideally within a complex, multi-system organisation.
  • Experience engaging directly with source systems such as ERP, CRM, Finance or Lab Systems, and translating business data requirements into architectural design.
  • Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, relational and dimensional data modelling.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt for transformation design, testing and lineage.
  • Advanced SQL skills across platforms such as Snowflake, SQL Server or Oracle, and experience developing and testing analytical data models.
  • A solid understanding of ETL/ELT, data integration, data pipelines, and medallion or lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience designing semantic models, with a good understanding of enterprise ontologies, data concepts, relationships and business definitions, and how governed semantic models support analytics and AI.
  • Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, lineage and data quality, including controls for data used by AI and ML models.
  • Experience producing architecture documentation, data models, integration blueprints and technical designs.
  • The ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The following experience would be beneficial:

  • Experience building enterprise ontologies or knowledge graphs, using semantic technologies such as SPARQL or SHACL.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake Semantic Views or Cortex.
  • Understanding of integration patterns (API, event-driven, file-based) and platforms such as MuleSoft.
  • Exposure to Master Data Management (MDM).
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture tools such as Erwin Evolve.
  • Experience supporting AI/ML applications or working with RAG and GraphRAG.
  • A background in life sciences, regulated industries or global organisations.
  • Recognised enterprise architecture, data architecture or cloud platform certifications.

Our values:

Passion: Pride in our achievements engenders passion for our work and it translates into our ambition to make the world a safer place.

Curiosity: We constantly look forward to what's next: our curiosity for today's discoveries makes tomorrow's innovations possible.

Integrity: A commitment to high ethical standards has been at the heart of LGC since we started testing the integrity of products in 1842.

Brilliance: We strive to be the very best in everything we say and do. We exceed customers' expectations through innovation and pioneering science.

Respect: We respect gender, age, nationality, religion and individuality – our diversity is our strength.

We are committed to ensuring that every job applicant and employee is valued for their individual talents. We strictly prohibit discrimination on the basis of age, disability, race, colour, ethnic or national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership, pregnancy or parental status, religion, or belief. We proudly support an inclusive work environment where everyone can compete and succeed based on their merits.

For more information about LGC, please visit our website

#scienceforasaferworld

LGC is an international life sciences tools company, building leading positions in sustainably growing markets. It provides reference materials, genomics solutions and analytical testing products and services, based on its innovation and intellectual property. It works with customers in the pharmaceuticals, agricultural biotechnology, food, environment, and sports sectors as well as with governments and academia to achieve excellence in investigative, diagnostic and measurement science.

LGC has sites across the globe including the UK, the US, Europe, China, and Canada. LGC Group supports the development of clinical diagnostic kits, genomics-based therapeutics, and drought-resistant crops with its genomics capabilities. It offers the most comprehensive range of reference materials available – in total over 100,000 products for analytical laboratories to choose from, ensuring safety of many every day and essential products. Its offering is underpinned by its heritage and expertise in regulation, accreditation, and standard setting. It helps customers conform to international statutory and regulatory standards. Science is at the heart of all it does - for a safer world.

SAP Close Automation Consultant, Latvia

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Latvia. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

We are looking for an SAP consultant to design and build an automated financial close for a client's finance automation programme.

What you will work on

jobs.excerpt: Staff DevOps EngineerWho we areAction1 is a cloud-native autonomous endpoint management platform that helps organizations automate operating system and third-party patching, assess vulnerabilities, and secure endpoints at scale.
jobs.description:
Staff DevOps Engineer

Who we are

Action1 is a cloud-native autonomous endpoint management platform that helps organizations automate operating system and third-party patching, assess vulnerabilities, and secure endpoints at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations managing millions of endpoints globally, we are building the infrastructure that supports our continued growth.

The Role

Working hours

  • Working hours close to the CET time zone are preferred to support regular collaboration with your manager and coordination of the team’s workload.
  • Flexibility to adjust working hours for team coordination, planned production changes, and critical incidents. This includes working US time-zone hours for a couple of days when needed to attend team meetings, participate in cross-training, or support handovers.

Job Scope

  • We are looking for a Senior / Staff DevOps Engineer to build and operate Action1’s AWS infrastructure, improve deployment automation, and strengthen production reliability and security.
  • This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will identify problems, make technical decisions, and carry improvements through implementation and validation, with support and input from your manager and peers.
  • You will join a small, collaborative DevOps team where your ideas help shape how we work. There is room to try new approaches, learn from experienced colleagues, and see your work make a difference in production. You will work closely with R&D and QA on releases and production needs.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evolve our AWS infrastructure. Design and operate secure, resilient infrastructure across multiple accounts and regions. Evaluate architecture decisions against production requirements, operational complexity, performance, and cost.
  • Build infrastructure as code. Develop reusable components, reduce configuration drift, and make environments reproducible. Maintain infrastructure and automation in Git with peer review, testing, documentation, and clear ownership.
  • Improve deployment pipelines. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated checks, deployment controls, and rollback mechanisms to make releases safer and more predictable.
  • Develop reliable automation. Use programming, scripting, and APIs to simplify operations, eliminate repetitive work, and build tooling the team can maintain and support.
  • Apply AI in daily DevOps work. Use approved tools such as Codex or Claude for infrastructure code, scripting, testing, troubleshooting, operational analysis, and documentation. Build reusable workflows, independently review and test outputs, protect sensitive information, and follow established review and change controls.
  • Strengthen observability. Improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts. Investigate performance and capacity constraints, connect telemetry to application behavior, and reduce unnecessary alert noise.
  • Own production reliability. Participate in the on-call rotation and lead incident response when needed. Coordinate recovery, communicate clearly, investigate underlying causes, and verify that corrective changes address the problem.
  • Validate resilience and recovery. Develop and test backup, recovery, failover, and maintenance procedures. Use controlled failure exercises where appropriate to identify weaknesses before they affect customers.
  • Continuously assess AWS platform security. Review access, network exposure, logging, vulnerabilities, and misconfigurations across accounts and environments. Investigate security findings and suspicious activity, prioritize work by risk, and drive remediation through implementation and verification, coordinating with Security and the owners of affected systems.
  • Improve AWS security controls. Evaluate and introduce practical improvements to threat detection, automated security checks, and response workflows. Strengthen least-privilege access, network controls, secrets management, encryption, hardening, and auditability. Integrate technical controls into infrastructure and delivery pipelines to meet security and compliance requirements.
  • Improve cloud efficiency. Understand cost drivers, identify waste, and evaluate capacity and architecture improvements using measured workload behavior. Verify savings alongside performance and reliability.
  • Share operational knowledge. Review infrastructure designs and automation code, document decisions, and maintain useful runbooks and technical documentation.

What we’re looking for

  • Substantial hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure engineering for production SaaS environments.
  • A record of independently identifying and solving problems, prioritizing work, and coordinating dependencies while keeping others informed.
  • Deep AWS knowledge and experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting distributed systems across multiple environments.
  • Strong AWS security operations experience, including assessments, incident investigations, and vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation.
  • Hands-on observability experience using metrics, logs, and traces to investigate production issues and build actionable dashboards and alerts.
  • Strong programming or scripting skills in Python, Node.js, or a comparable language for maintainable automation and API integrations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with both Terraform and AWS CloudFormation, supported by Git, code review, testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Sound understanding of operating systems, networking, DNS, TLS, identity, storage, and database behavior, with the ability to troubleshoot across system boundaries.
  • Experience with production incident response, root-cause analysis, and recovery planning.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in DevOps, including examples of their benefits, limitations, and how you validated and corrected their output.
  • Analytical thinking and sound judgment: test assumptions, distinguish symptoms from causes, weigh trade-offs, verify results, and recognize when broader review is needed.
  • Flexibility to collaborate across time zones and adjust working hours for team coordination, planned production changes, and critical incidents.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on Datadog experience for production troubleshooting and reliability improvement.
  • Experience with Terramate for managing Terraform infrastructure across environments.
  • Experience building operational tools or self-service workflows for provisioning, deployments, and environment management.
  • Practical SRE experience, including service-level objectives, capacity planning, and reliability reviews.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or comparable requirements through technical controls and operational evidence.
  • Experience developing AI agents with appropriate access boundaries, evaluation, and human oversight.
  • Experience mentoring DevOps engineers and leading infrastructure or operational improvements.

What we offer

  • Fully remote work, with flexibility around team collaboration and production responsibilities.
  • Ownership of infrastructure supporting a growing global platform.
  • Challenging DevOps work and opportunities to deepen your technical expertise.
  • Direct collaboration with experienced, supportive peers.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you are part of something bigger, it is because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we have helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you will thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Manager, US Web Strategy and Operations

The Amgen Global Content Excellence Team is seeking a strategic web leader to shape US commercial web strategy and operations across brand and Patient Access & Reimbursement (PAR) teams. As part of Global Customer Capabilities & Innovation (GCCI), the Senior Manager translates business priorities into an integrated web portfolio, operating plans, investment recommendations, and measurable outcomes. Foster an inclusive, accountable team culture and align team capacity to the highest-priority US web needs.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. For the Senior Manager, US Web Strategy and Operations, we seek a strategic leader who combines commercial judgment, operational discipline, financial acumen, and strong people leadership.
