Position Title: Cardiac Device Specialist I, Nights & Weekends Shift
Location: 100% Remote (U.S. – candidates must reside in the contiguous United States)
Shift: This role is for evening coverage, with shifts starting after 4:00 PM EST.

This is a part-time position, working 20-29 hours per week.

About The Role

As a Cardiac Device Specialist at PaceMate, you'll join a team of experienced professionals dedicated to improving outcomes for patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs). Working remotely, you'll use your expertise in cardiac electrophysiology and device management to analyze remote transmission data and diagnostics, interpret complex arrhythmias, and provide the accurate clinical documentation that providers rely on to guide patient care.

This role requires deep technical knowledge. You'll assess device function across multiple manufacturers, recognize abnormalities and arrhythmias, and recommend strategies to address issues. If you're passionate about applying your CIED expertise in a patient-centered environment that values compassion, integrity, and excellence, we'd like to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor patients with CIEDs using PaceMate's proprietary software

  • Analyze and interpret ECG/EGM data and device diagnostics, identifying abnormal device function and complex arrhythmias

  • Document findings accurately and professionally, communicating with providers as needed according to PaceMate's best practice standards

  • Work independently to manage your daily workflow while collaborating closely with teammates and clinical leadership to ensure efficient, accurate, and timely interpretations

  • Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to all HIPAA and PHI protocols

  • Contribute to our patient-centered care philosophy—at PaceMate, every teammate is a caregiver whose role is to meet the needs of the patient

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum two years of recent cardiac device management experience, OR successful completion of a formal cardiac rhythm management program

  • Hands-on experience interrogating and interpreting device diagnostics for at least three of the four major manufacturers: Medtronic, Abbott, Boston Scientific, and Biotronik

  • Proficiency in ECG/EGM interpretation, including complex arrhythmia recognition

  • Moderate to advanced technical skills

  • Dedicated home workspace free from distractions, with reliable internet connectivity and the ability to work independently while engaging actively with your team throughout the day

  • Ability to pass PaceMate's candidate technical assessment during the interview process

Nice-to-Haves

  • Bachelor's or associate degree in a related field (nursing, cardiovascular technology, biomedical engineering, or similar) not required but strongly preferred
  • IBHRE Certification (CCDS, CEPS, CDRMS) not required nut strongly preferred; CCT or CRAT a plus
  • Industry experience with cardiac rhythm management
  • Proficiency with collaboration tools including Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, and Slack

Physical Requirements

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is consistently required to remain in a stationary position, constantly operate a computer or other office equipment, and frequently communicate with customers and employees.

  • Must be able to exchange accurate information, with the ability to effectively utilize voice over internet protocol; and repetitive motions using fingers and forearms in data entry.

  • You must reside within the geography of the territory.

  • You must only work from within the contiguous United States.

  • If working from, residing at a location other than your legal address that PaceMate has on file, employee must inform IT and get approval to do so.

  • Whenever Confidential information is carried by a Pace Mate worker into a foreign country; the information is either stored in some inaccessible form, such as an encrypted external storage media, or always remain in the worker's possession.

  • PaceMate's workers shall not take Secret Pace Mate information into another country unless the permission has been obtained from Physical Security management.

Why Join PaceMate®

Benefits built with heart

Health and wellness
Part-time benefit package includes dental, vision and a Free Employee Assistance Program.

Financial security

Voluntary life insurance, short-term and long-term disability plans. Employee Retirement Savings Plan.

Time to recharge
Paid time off benefits, including 8 paid holidays, and 2 floating holidays.

Extra perks

Employee discount programs.

Compensation: On top of a Robust Benefit Package, we are targeting a compensation range of $34.61 - $44.23 per hour, depending on education, experience, and certifications. This evening shift will also be eligible for an additional $4.00 per hour for certain hours worked, our generous shift differential.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities, who are otherwise qualified, to perform the essential functions.

About PaceMate®

PaceMate® is a patient-centered, tech-enabled cardiac device monitoring platform serving integrated delivery networks and academic health systems nationwide. Vendor-neutral and EMR-agnostic, PaceMate connects every major device manufacturer into a single platform that sits on top of any EHR.

More than 2.3 million patients are managed on the industry’s only research-grade cardiac dataset, validated by 33 peer-reviewed publications, powering AI-driven clinical and operational analytics. A managed patient services model extends clinic capacity and ensures every cardiac device patient is monitored, every time.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are seeking an Order Management Specialist to join our growing Order Management function. This candidate will play a pivotal role in reviewing customer contracts, facilitating timely and accurate processing of orders, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and procedures. Additionally, this candidate will have the opportunity to participate in key initiatives to improve order and data accuracy.

The Order Management department is part of Samsara’s Finance organization. We are a highly collaborative, global team from a diverse range of backgrounds, focused on making Samsara a great place to work and develop our careers. You will work with Sales, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Business Technology, and Order-to-Cash to deliver a seamless order experience for our customers. The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, possesses a strong attention to detail and appreciation for process, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys collaborating with other teams to solve challenges.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Review customer orders prior to shipping, ensuring the products, pricing, and terms are accurate, complete, and compliant with company policy.
  • Reconcile customer order information against the internal system of record.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Sales Ops, and Deal Desk to determine the resolution path for any order discrepancies.
  • Respond to Sales inquiries regarding opportunity status or any questions on the opportunity closure process.
  • Collaborate with your global peers to identify solutions for common order issues and drive global consistency in process.
  • With the support of management, identify and support implementation of improvements to Samsara’s systems and tools to streamline the order review process.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, such as Sales Ops, Order to Cash, and Business Technology, on company projects.
  • Support the generation and ongoing maintenance of reporting dashboards to track order volume and activity.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of professional work experience.
  • Professional-level written and verbal fluency in English.
  • Excellent attention to detail with an emphasis on accuracy and timeliness.
  • Self-motivated and able to work both independently and as part of a larger team.
  • Ability to multitask, adapt, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and openness to feedback.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work during Pacific time zone business hours.
  • Ability to work extended hours during month and quarter end.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • Proficiency with CRM and CPQ platform (Salesforce preferred).
  • Experience in a contract specialist, order management, and/or related Finance role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company.
  • Appreciation for leveraging data to instigate meaningful business process change.
  • Aptitude for building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders and peers.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Job Description

HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Manager, Web Partnerships and Enablement


WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Amgen Global Customer Capabilities & Innovation organization is looking for a Manager, Web Partnerships and Enablement to extend web expertise and scale support for new and emerging demand across Medical, Corporate Affairs, Clinical Trials, R&D, and approved non-commercial needs. The role provides strategy, governance, and delivery leadership so teams can apply enterprise web standards and capabilities to their needs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Portfolio governance and launch readiness - Guide web portfolio governance and provide launch readiness support for Medical, Corporate Affairs, Clinical Trials, R&D, and approved non-commercial web initiatives. Clarify governance requirements, decision points, owners, and readiness needs, and help teams navigate the appropriate web delivery processes.
  • Strategic Web Program Lead - Serve as a subject-matter expert on CMS, Design System, back-end system integrations, pharmaceutical web marketing best practices and emerging trends. Advise business teams on how to apply current web capabilities to business objectives and audience needs, and identify opportunities to strengthen digital experiences. Translate business goals into strategic recommendations and proactively define future-state capability enhancements and roadmaps, partnering with business, technology, content, design, analytics, and agency teams to assess feasibility, value, and dependencies.
  • Standards and platform transitions - Promote adoption of enterprise web standards and governance. Assess externally hosted or custom web platforms and help plan their transition toward global web enterprise standards, including alignment on scope, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder responsibilities.
  • Vendor and procurement enablement - Advise teams on engaging web vendors and agencies. Support statement-of-work development and procurement planning for web services, including Analytics and SEO engagements, in coordination with relevant procurement and business partners.
  • Portfolio Prioritization & Planning: Lead quarterly intake and prioritization of web initiatives with Technology and business stakeholders, aligning investment to enterprise strategy, business value, and resource capacity. Translate prioritized needs into actionable scope, requirements, sequencing, timelines, and delivery plans. Assess cross-project and platform dependencies, clarify ownership, and apply governance to support informed prioritization and delivery.
  • Web Delivery & Release Management: Lead cross-functional web initiatives from approved plans through development, launch, and hypercare. Coordinate creative and content handoffs, development, approvals, QA/UAT, deployment, and production validation. Align timelines, resources, budgets, dependencies, and release requirements; establish launch readiness; facilitate decisions; resolve issues; and communicate status and escalations to support successful, timely delivery.
  • Program Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Monitor program health, governance adherence, documentation, risks, issues, and change impacts across web initiatives. Coordinate business, content, creative, development, technology, analytics, and agency partners to clarify ownership, manage handoffs, and resolve conflicts across concurrent initiatives, platform migrations, technology releases, and regulatory deadlines. Embed legal, regulatory, privacy, accessibility, brand, and operational resilience requirements throughout delivery, escalating material risks as needed.
  • Performance & Continuous Improvement: Partner with analytics and SEO teams to interpret web traffic, user behavior, search performance, and other digital insights, and use findings to recommend website optimization. Lead structured retrospectives and apply performance insights, lessons learned, and emerging trends to recommend improvements to web capabilities, standards, tools, templates, and delivery processes. Scale effective practices to improve consistency, efficiency, collaboration, and speed to market..

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Web Strategist professional we seek is a collaborator with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

OR

Master’s degree and 4 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

Or

Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

Or

Associate’s degree and 10 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

Preferred Experience:


  • Web governance and enablement — Experience establishing or applying web standards, governance, launch readiness, and operating models across multiple business functions, platforms, or markets.
  • Strategy and consultation — Experience advising senior and cross-functional partners, translating business needs into web recommendations, and evaluating platform, vendor, or capability options.
  • Digital Program / Project Management Expertise - 6+ years of experience managing end-to-end digital and website lifecycle projects in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments, including complex, cross-country, and high-impact initiatives.
  • Agile & Program Management - Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (preferably SAFe) with experience managing website roadmaps and continuous improvement initiatives. Proficient in Program / Project Management tools such as Workfront, AEM, JIRA, ServiceNow, Confluence, and Google Analytics.
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Management - Proven ability to negotiate priorities, manage expectations, and build productive relationships across diverse, cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Regulatory & Technical Acumen - Experience operating in regulated industries (preferably pharma) with understanding of compliance requirements. Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG), privacy regulations (GDPR, US consumer laws), web technologies (e.g., HTML/CSS), and industry best practices is a plus.
  • Documentation & Governance - Experience developing detailed project documentation and translating business requirements into technical specifications.

Preferred Competencies:


  • Leadership & Collaboration - Effective communication, relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration skills; able to convey complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinking — Connect enterprise web capabilities and standards to business needs, and identify practical ways to support new demand at scale.
  • Influence and collaboration — Build trusted relationships across functions and organizations; explain technical and governance topics clearly to non-technical partners.
  • Judgment and accountability — Balance business needs, compliance requirements, resource capacity, and platform constraints; surface risks early and follow decisions through.
  • Adaptability & Growth Mindset - Proactive, inclusive, and flexible approach with a willingness to learn, experiment, and continuously improve. Comfortable working across time zones when required.

Praxis partners with external manufacturers to produce life-changing medicines for patients with central nervous system disorders. This role exists to ensure those partners operate with the same urgency, quality, and accountability that we expect from ourselves.

As Director, Commercial Manufacturing Operations, you will serve as the operational leader for commercial manufacturing of an assigned product. Acting as Praxis's "virtual plant manager," you will own day-to-day manufacturing performance across one or more CDMO partners, ensuring reliable supply, operational excellence, and continuous improvement throughout the commercial lifecycle.

This is not a project management or technical transfer role. It is an operations leadership role focused on delivering consistent commercial execution through influence, partnership, and disciplined operational management. You'll build strong relationships across Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, MSAT, Procurement, and our external partners to anticipate risks, solve problems quickly, and continuously raise performance standards.

Success in this role means patients receive uninterrupted access to medicines because our manufacturing network consistently delivers safe, compliant, high-quality product.

Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at

Role Overview

The Cash Applications Analyst serves as the primary point of coordination between the company and an offshore team of Cash Applications Specialists. This role is responsible for the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of cash application processes — ensuring incoming payments (checks, ACH, wire, credit card, and lockbox) are applied correctly and promptly to customer accounts. The Analyst monitors the offshore team's daily production and quality, resolves escalations, and reports on team performance and unapplied cash trends to Finance leadership. This is an individual contributor role with strong functional/matrix oversight of the offshore team, rather than direct people-management responsibility.

Job Responsibilities

Offshore Team Oversight & Reporting

  • Serve as the main point of contact for the offshore Cash Applications team, providing daily direction, clarifying exceptions, and answering process questions.
  • Monitor offshore team productivity and quality against defined SLAs (e.g., same-day cash application, unapplied cash aging, error rates).
  • Conduct regular check-ins (daily stand-up or weekly cadence) with the offshore team lead to review volumes, backlogs, and blockers.
  • Prepare and present recurring status reports to the Cash Applications/Collections Manager summarizing team output, aging unapplied cash, exceptions, and root causes of delays.
  • Escalate systemic issues (bank file failures, remittance data gaps, recurring misapplications) to management with recommended corrective actions.

Cash Application Processing

  • Review and apply complex or exception-based cash receipts (short pays, deductions, unidentified remittances) that the offshore team escalates.
  • Reconcile bank deposits, lockbox files, and electronic payment feeds against the ERP/AR sub-ledger (e.g., NetSuite) and cash application platform (e.g., BlackLine ARM).
  • Research and resolve unapplied and on-account cash, partnering with Collections and Customer Service as needed.
  • Maintain and refine cash application workflows, matching rules, and remittance rules within the cash application system to reduce manual touches.

Process Improvement & Controls

  • Identify recurring exception patterns and partner with IT/Systems to improve auto-match rates and remittance data quality.
  • Document and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and training materials used by the offshore team.
  • Support month-end close activities related to cash application, including unapplied cash reconciliation and reporting.
  • Ensure processes comply with internal controls and audit requirements (e.g., SOX, where applicable).

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 2–4+ years of experience in cash applications, accounts receivable, or order-to-cash operations.
  • Experience working with or overseeing an offshore or outsourced team, including setting expectations and reviewing work product across time zones.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with an ERP system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and a cash application/AR automation platform (e.g., BlackLine ARM) preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize team performance clearly for leadership.
  • Strong attention to detail and a track record of meeting deadlines in a high-volume transaction environment.

Preferred

  • Prior experience managing SLAs or KPIs for an outsourced/offshore finance operations team.
  • Familiarity with lockbox, ACH, and wire payment processing.
  • Experience building or maintaining status trackers/dashboards for team performance reporting.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.

  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.

Lone Wolf builds the software real estate runs on. Brokerages, agents, MLSs, and associations across North America use our products for forms and transaction management (zipForm, Transaction Desk, Transact), e-signature (Authentisign), comparative market analysis (Cloud CMA), listing advertising (Boost), and brokerage back office.

A large share of North American real estate agents use Lone Wolf products, and many of them buy on their own with a credit card: an e-signature plan, a forms upgrade, a CMA subscription, an ad for a new listing. You’ll be the owner that runs it as one system, with one dashboard and a steady stream of experiments along the way.

You’ll wear two hats:

  1. Product manager for Brand Management (Boost). Boost automates listing and brand advertising on Facebook, Instagram, and Google for agents and brokerages. You’ll own its roadmap, its metrics, and the priorities of its engineering team.
  2. Growth lead for every agent-purchased product. You’ll own the path from first touch to purchase to expansion across Boost, Cloud CMA, Authentisign, zipForm and Transaction Desk upgrades, and more.

This is your business to run. You’ll report to the Chief Innovation Officer, who sets direction, holds the number with the executive team, clears cross-functional blockers, and makes the calls that need executive weight: major pricing changes, tradeoffs across product pillars, and scale-or-stop decisions. Everything else is yours: the backlog, the experiments, the funnels, the roadmap, and the weekly review. You won’t be executing someone else’s plan. You’ll write it.

This is a builder’s role with a wide surface. Most of the funnel runs through teams you won’t manage: marketing’s website and SEO, CX’s in-app messaging and onboarding, other product teams’ engineering time, and sales conversations with brokerages. Your leverage is data, speed, and the ability to bring people with you.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the agent revenue number. Build the dashboard yourself (SQL, Metabase), run the weekly review, and make it what everyone else looks at. Bring a monthly readout to the executive team alongside the CIO.
  • Find and fix funnel leaks in landing pages, pricing pages, checkout, trials, and in-product upgrade prompts.
  • Run lifecycle email as a growth channel. Iterable triggers at listing events, onboarding, upgrade, and win-back. Write the copy, set up the tests, and read the results.
  • Ship your own variants. Build landing pages and messaging variants yourself with AI tools. Work hand in hand with Marketing’s website lead on lwolf.com agent pages and SEO, where Boost now sits alongside our other agent products.
  • Run experiments end to end: hypothesis, instrumentation, launch, readout, and decision, at a high tempo.
  • Own agent pricing and packaging: bundles, trials, annual plans, auto-renewal, and cross-product offers. Bring recommendations to the CIO for the big moves.
  • Shape how agents buy Transact. As agents move from zipForm and Transaction Desk to Transact, make sure the products they pay for today, like Authentisign and forms upgrades, still have a clear path to purchase.
  • Run the Boost roadmap. Balance growth work against reliability and commitments to brokerage and partner customers. Sales owns brokerage Boost deals; you make sure the product and the team behind it support them.
  • Test paid acquisition on a small budget, and scale only what pays back.
  • Get things done across the business. Win engineering time from other product teams, in-app placements from CX, page changes from Marketing, and agent offers in Sales conversations, without owning any of them.
  • Stand up lean product analytics that don’t require hand-instrumenting every event.

Requirements:

  • A track record of growing a purchase funnel with a product-led mindset. Bring the before-and-after numbers and explain what you personally did to move them.
  • Range across disciplines. You might come up through product management, growth marketing, or e-commerce. Either way, you’ve done the work of all three: shaping product, writing and testing messaging, and optimizing checkout and pricing.
  • You build things yourself. Landing pages, email variants, dashboards, prototypes. You use AI tools to build what used to take a team, and you can show us.
  • Data self-sufficiency. You write your own SQL, build your own dashboards, and design and read your own experiments without waiting on an analyst.
  • Ownership. You’ve run a number, not just a backlog. You set your own priorities, make the calls in front of you, and bring your manager decisions rather than questions.
  • Influence without authority. Concrete examples of getting important work done through teams you didn’t manage.
  • Experience: typically 7+ years across product, growth, or e-commerce roles, with direct ownership of revenue or conversion metrics.

  • Real estate or proptech experience, or SaaS sold to independent professionals and small businesses.

  • Setting up product analytics from scratch on a budget.
  • Working across multiple product lines, legacy systems, or a post-acquisition portfolio.

Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same-day and next-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e-commerce and product-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S. Location: Remote - This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals. Compensation: The expected starting base pay range for this position is $228,000 - $285,000 with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $228,000 - $342,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan of up to a 35% Bonus Target. Employment Logistics: The Vice President of Technology leads the modernization of the platforms and engineering organization that power OnTrac’s parcel delivery network. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this leader will drive the transition from legacy on-premises and multi-cloud systems to a cloud-native, event-driven, and AI-native architecture on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This hands-on technical leader will oversee software engineering across platform, core, and domain teams, setting direction for how software is architected, specified, built, tested, released, and operated. The role requires deep architecture expertise and proven success leading event-driven, microservices, AI-assisted, and spec-driven development at scale while building an organization that delivers faster, with higher quality, and at peak-season capacity. Unpacking the Benefits: Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance Life and short- and long-term disability coverage 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure-based increases up to 160 hours Two (2) floating holidays per year Paid sick leave* Six (6) paid company holidays Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies. The Must-Haves:

15+ years of progressive software engineering and technology leadership experience, including leading multiple engineering teams and leaders in a complex, high-volume enterprise Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Experience in parcel, last-mile delivery, transportation, logistics, e-commerce, or a comparable high-volume industry with seasonal demand peaks Strong hands-on architecture background designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems Expertise in event-driven and microservices architecture, including domain-driven design, Kafka or Pub/Sub, event sourcing, CQRS, sagas, API management, and monolith decomposition Proven experience leading AI-driven and spec-driven software development, including AI coding agents, contract-first APIs and events, quality guardrails, and impact measurement Deep expertise in CI/CD, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, release management, DevOps, and SRE practices Strong knowledge of generative AI, RAG, AI agents, Model Context Protocol, and model evaluation Experience modernizing legacy environments and migrating on-premises systems to cloud-native platforms, ideally GCP Proven ability to develop leaders, strengthen engineering performance, and lead organizational change Familiarity with technology supporting sortation, scanning, tracking, routing, transportation operations, and customer visibility preferred Experience with GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Vertex AI, and Apigee preferred Experience building an AI center of excellence, internal developer platform, or platform engineering function preferred ​​It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.​

Modernization strategy & target-state architecture: Partner with the CTO to execute the modernization roadmap, migrate legacy on-premises and multi-cloud systems to GCP, and establish the target-state architecture across shared platforms, reusable core services, and domain applications. Event-driven architecture & technical governance: Lead the design of the event-driven and microservices architecture using domain-driven design, canonical event models, status taxonomies, and versioned API and event contracts; govern critical decisions through ADRs, reference architectures, standards, and direct participation in design and code reviews. Scalability, reliability & production health: Design for peak-volume scalability, resilience, and observability using SLOs, distributed tracing, fault isolation, and graceful degradation; establish accountability for production health, incident response, root-cause analysis, and peak-season readiness. CI/CD, quality engineering & performance: Build modern delivery practices using automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, trunk-based development, progressive delivery, and consistent Dev, QA, UAT, and Production environments; embed shift-left quality practices and use DORA and flow metrics to drive continuous improvement. AI-native & spec-driven development: Establish AI-assisted, spec-driven development across the SDLC, using versioned specifications, contracts, and acceptance criteria as the source of truth; implement guardrails for AI-generated code and measure improvements in speed, quality, developer experience, and cost. AI platform & reusable agents: Sponsor the AI center of excellence and agent platform, including Model Context Protocol servers and reusable agents for engineering productivity, operations automation, and product features. Engineering organization & talent: Build stable, product-led teams that own the parcel journey across platform, core, and domain services; hire and develop leaders, architects, and engineers across US and global teams; allocate capacity across run, improve, modernize, and explore work. Financial, investment & vendor management: Manage engineering budgets, resource plans, cloud and AI costs, and vendor relationships; evaluate investments based on business value, total cost of ownership, risk, and feasibility; hold partners accountable for delivery, quality, cost, and service commitments.

You bring strong business judgment and communicate technical decisions clearly to executive and nontechnical audiences. You deliver a business-aligned modernization roadmap, migrating legacy systems to GCP through sequenced milestones and accountable ownership. You establish a reusable, event-driven microservices architecture while reducing duplicate services, integrations, and technical debt. You improve DORA metrics and maintain reliable peak-season performance, including higher deployment frequency, shorter lead times, lower change failure rates, faster service restoration, and achievement of critical-service SLOs.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer, Personalization to build and improve intelligent systems that help Bask Health deliver more relevant and personalized experiences across our platform.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, bringing together merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities. As merchants grow, we want to help them create digital experiences that are responsive to user needs, preferences, and interactions.

You'll develop machine learning models and recommendation systems that support personalized content, relevant platform experiences, and intelligent discovery within approved product workflows.

This is a hands-on machine learning engineering role that combines model development, data processing, backend integration, experimentation, and production monitoring. You'll work with application data, user interaction signals, machine learning algorithms, and platform services to build personalization capabilities that operate reliably at scale.

Your work may include developing ranking models, recommendation algorithms, user preference representations, behavioral feature pipelines, and systems that adapt application experiences based on relevant, authorized signals.

You'll collaborate with product managers, backend engineers, frontend engineers, data specialists, and other machine learning engineers to identify personalization opportunities and translate them into production-ready features.

You'll also help design experiments to measure whether personalization improves user experience, engagement, and relevant product outcomes. You'll evaluate model quality, investigate performance issues, and continuously improve algorithms based on measured results.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, personalization must respect privacy, data access permissions, and clinical boundaries. You'll ensure that models do not independently determine medical eligibility, recommend treatments, change prescriptions, or override approved clinical workflows.

This position emphasizes practical machine learning, strong software engineering fundamentals, and measurable product improvements. You'll contribute to model design, implement production systems, and own features through deployment and ongoing optimization.

  • Analyze engagement and interaction data to identify opportunities for model improvements.
  • Monitor production model performance, latency, and reliability.
  • Investigate changes in recommendation quality and unexpected model behavior.
  • Develop strategies for handling sparse data and new-user cold-start scenarios.
  • Implement appropriate fallbacks when personalization signals are unavailable.
  • Optimize model inference speed and resource usage.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to support scalable model serving.
  • Work with product managers to define personalization goals and success metrics.
  • Evaluate model performance across relevant user groups and application contexts.
  • Implement privacy-conscious data processing and feature access controls.
  • Ensure personalization features respect tenant boundaries and approved platform permissions.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and architecture discussions.

Nice to Have

Network Vulnerability Remediation Engineer – Mid-Level


Program: Army Global Unified Network (AGUN)

Help Secure the U.S. Army's Global Network!


Leidos has an immediate opening for a Mid-Level Network Vulnerability Remediation Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

This is an exciting opportunity to help protect, secure, and modernize the Army's global enterprise network, ensuring critical military communications remain reliable and mission-ready.

In this remote role, you'll focus on identifying, analyzing, and remediating security vulnerabilities across enterprise network devices. You'll work with network engineers, cybersecurity teams, and mission partners to implement security patches, configuration updates, and risk mitigation solutions.

We're looking for someone with strong hands-on network engineering experience, network security expertise, and the ability to resolve vulnerabilities without disrupting mission-critical operations.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze and remediate security vulnerabilities affecting enterprise network devices and infrastructure.
  • Evaluate vulnerability findings, vendor security updates, patches, and recommended mitigation strategies.
  • Develop, test, and implement security patches, configuration changes, and vulnerability remediation solutions.
  • Execute approved network configuration changes and vendor updates through established ASI and change-management processes.
  • Support DoD security requirements, including STIG implementation and network hardening.
  • Collaborate with Information Assurance teams and the AGUN Cybersecurity Service Provider (CSSP) to address security risks and maintain compliance.
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity, performance, and security issues following remediation activities.
  • Perform network device upgrades, patching, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Develop vulnerability assessments, patch/upgrade analyses, mitigation configurations, testing results, and production release plans.
  • Document remediation activities, implementation results, and ticket closure evidence.
  • Maintain network configuration records, technical documentation, and operational procedures.
  • Work independently on assigned engineering tasks while collaborating with senior engineers on complex issues.

What We're Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field with 4–8 years of relevant experience, or approximately 8–12 years of relevant experience without a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (such as Security+) and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Hands-on experience with network device patching, firmware upgrades, configuration management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including LAN/WAN, BGP, TCP/UDP, IPSec, VPNs, Layer 2/Layer 3 routing, MPLS, and firewalls.
  • Experience with at least one network management platform, such as:Palo Alto PanoramaCisco PrimeCisco DNAJunos Space
  • Hands-on experience with at least two of the following:CiscoJuniperPalo AltoDell NetworkingRemote Access VPN (RAVPN)GlobalProtectAppGate
  • Experience implementing DoD STIGs and network security hardening.
  • Familiarity with SFTP, SSH, SCP, SNMP, and NTP.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve moderately complex network issues.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and customer-facing skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with geographically dispersed technical teams.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts when required.
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Army, DISA, or other DoD enterprise networks.
  • CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent networking certification.
  • Experience with network modernization, migration, or infrastructure transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco SD-WAN.
  • Experience configuring or supporting Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW).
  • Familiarity with virtualized network infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.
  • Basic Python scripting experience for network automation.
  • Experience supporting large, geographically dispersed enterprise networks.
  • Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity policies and compliance requirements.
  • Experience creating network diagrams, configuration records, and technical documentation.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to apply your network engineering and cybersecurity expertise to a mission that directly supports the U.S. Army's global operations.

You'll work alongside experienced network engineers and cybersecurity professionals, solve complex security challenges, and help protect critical military infrastructure.

If you're a cleared Network Engineer with hands-on vulnerability remediation, patching, and network security experience, we'd like to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help secure the Army's global network. Apply today!

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

About the Role

This is a hands-on development role for someone who can own a slice of the product across both UI and API. You’ll work with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, relational and graph databases, multi-service architecture, real-time functionality, and Azure infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

AI is changing how our R&D organization builds and runs software. This is a new role: one leader for Samsara's AI bets across the software development lifecycle. You'll own two efforts that started and whatever comes next.

Dev Agents builds in-house and integrates vendors such as Claude and Codex. That includes an Agent Gateway that serves internal MCPs, managed access to skills, and cloud runners that fan work out to cloud agents.

SRE AI is an agent that does the first-line work of an on-call engineer. It already runs on real incidents in production: it writes a root cause analysis, escalates severity when it has proof, and can roll back the deployment it identified as the cause.

This is a new role. You'll lead a team of five to 10 senior engineers, from Senior to Staff. You'll work directly with every R&D leader and with the developers who use what you build.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in North America.

What makes this unique

  • One leader across the lifecycle. You own AI for the whole software development lifecycle, for our R&D organization.
  • Room to try things. Try, fail, learn. One bet in five landing is a good outcome.
  • Already in production. SRE AI runs on live incidents today, and two teams use it as first responder.
  • A senior team. Principal, senior staff, staff and senior engineers who work without a roadmap.
  • Build, don't hand off. This is hands-on leadership. You'll work from the details, not from a PRD.

Why this role matters

Real-world impact at scale

  • Engineers on every team take turns on-call, which costs roughly 10 to 15 percent of headcount. The goal is an agent that is first responder to every page, so people are only woken up when a human is needed, and arrive with the root cause in hand.
  • Make SRE AI first responder for five teams, and the default for every team by the end of 2027.
  • Within 12 months, the median developer ships as fast as today's 90th percentile.

Unique technical challenges

  • Choose which experiments to run for a root cause analysis agent when no playbook exists.
  • Decide when to build, integrate or buy as model prices and capabilities shift roughly every quarter.
  • Earn trust for automated actions, such as severity escalation and rollbacks.
  • Raise output without raising load on engineers, with cost per pull request (token spend plus infrastructure) as the measure.
  • Be on the founding team of AI agent factories: Within three months, stand up an end-to-end system for campaign-style work: backfilling tests, fixing recurring logging problems, and drive changes, etc.

You should apply if:

  • You want to own an AI bet at scale. You'd like one leader's view across how an entire R&D organization builds, ships and runs software.
  • You build to learn. You'd rather try the latest technology than read about it, and you can say what failed.
  • You like working without a roadmap. You set direction yourself, and you move when nobody has told you to.
  • You lead senior engineers by earning their trust. Principal and staff engineers follow you because you're in the details with them.
  • You care what things cost. Tokens and infrastructure are part of the design, not an afterthought.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Dev Agents and SRE AI, and decide what comes next.
  • Set direction and choose the experiments for agent infrastructure: the gateway, internal MCPs, skills and cloud runners.
  • Make build, integrate and buy calls across vendors such as Claude and Codex as models change.
  • Drive cost per pull request down while output goes up.
  • Take SRE AI from two teams to every team, and build the trust that lets it take more automated actions.
  • Work directly with every R&D leader and with the developers who use what you build, without a product manager.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Manage and grow a team of five to 10 senior engineers, from senior to principal, setting a high bar and clear priorities without a roadmap.
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role

Experience:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience.
  • 5+ years of people management experience.
  • Has led a team of about six to 10 engineers. Scope matters more than title.
  • Has led senior and staff-level engineers.
  • Has built something with current AI tools or agents, at work or at home.
  • Has set direction where no playbook existed, without a product manager.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or another technical degree.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A methodical, systems-level mind. You work through problems nobody has solved, with a clear view of which experiments to run.
  • A connection to what industry leaders build. You follow it closely and apply it.
  • Relevant background. Developer productivity, agentic AI, incident response or on-call tooling.
  • Cost awareness. You can reason about token spend and infrastructure as models and prices change.
  • An advanced degree. MS or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.

What makes Samsara different:

  • Mission-driven impact. We improve safety, efficiency and sustainability for the industries that power the global economy.
  • A unique data advantage. IoT data at a scale few companies can match: 10+ trillion data points a year.
  • Fast decisions, limited bureaucracy. Work directly with senior leadership and ship solutions that matter.
  • Growth and learning. Work alongside talented engineers, scientists and operators. We invest heavily in R&D and in building for the long term.
  • Scale with startup energy. A public company (NYSE: IOT) with the resources and reach of scale, and the agility and pace of a high-growth technology company.

See Samsara in action

If you like, we would like to invite you to spend ten minutes getting to know us.

  • A quick video introducing our business (click herefor the Youtube Video).
  • 2026 Agent Studio reveal at Beyond, our annual customer event (click here for the Youtube Video and fast forward to 59:36)

Ready to lead AI across the software development lifecycle?

We would love to hear from you.

This position leads assigned provider organizations through onboarding and launch and continues to provide support alongside clinical model staff to ensure sustainability, fidelity, and customer success.
The Specialist coordinates implementation plans, workforce and referral readiness, technical assistance, project milestones, program monitoring, and partner relationships. The position works collaboratively with EBP model teams, which retain responsibility for model-specific clinical consultation, fidelity coaching, certification, and clinical decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Onboarding and Launch

  • Planning and Project Management: Develop and maintain implementation roadmaps, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and launch-readiness documentation, and coordinate project management and technical assistance to keep launches on time, in scope, and responsive to emerging barriers.
  • Workforce Planning: Collaborate with recruiting and provider leadership to support staffing plans, candidate sourcing needs, role readiness, and workforce preparation for launch.
  • Readiness Assessment: Assess readiness related to leadership, staffing, training, service capacity, operational infrastructure, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Referral and Access: Design and strengthen referral and access processes so appropriate populations can reach available program capacity.
  • Organizational Change: Support operational and organizational change required to adopt new practices and reduce implementation drift.
  • Launch Coordination: Coordinate launch logistics with EBP clinical technical assistance teams while maintaining clear boundaries between operational implementation support and model-specific clinical responsibilities.
  • Documentation and Escalation: Document decisions, risks, action items, and progress; promptly elevate barriers requiring leadership or model-specific expertise.

Sustainability and Customer Success

jobs.title: Senior Google Ads Buyer, DTC eCommerce
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

We are looking for an AI Development Engineer who is passionate about solving complex engineering problems and using AI to improve the speed, quality, and cost efficiency of software development.

Requirement Clarity and Engineering Design

  • Develop a deep understanding of technical requirements and system-level design to minimise rework and reduce the risk of AI-generated errors.
  • Translate ambiguous product and business ideas into clear, structured technical specifications.
  • Create specifications that serve as a reliable source of truth for both engineering teams and AI systems.

Engineering Excellence

  • Establish practices to minimise functional defects and operational issues caused by AI-generated code.
  • Identify and eliminate code bloat, redundant logic, dead code, and unnecessary complexity.
  • Ensure AI-generated code remains understandable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to navigate.
  • Build the right documentation and engineering artefacts so that AI-generated code does not become a black box.
  • Incorporate security best practices into prompts, context, and code-generation workflows.

Agentic Applications

  • Build, maintain, and scale production systems that leverage Generative AI to transform user experiences.

Operational Excellence

  • Build deep observability into services and systems to identify and address production issues.

Cost Efficiency

CRM & Systems Management

  • Keep HubSpot deal stages and booking information up to date.
  • Maintain accurate trip details, pricing, invoicing, and payment status.
  • Reconcile HubSpot data with Xero and other financial records.
  • Organize financial documents and shared accounting folders.

Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use formulas, pivot tables, and data validation to improve reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting tasks.
  • Improve processes to reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, including reconciliation, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.

  • Experience handling international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and account reconciliation.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Convera GlobalPay and international payment workflows.

Remote & Availability Requirements

We're looking for an AI Video Editor to own AI-driven short-form video creative for a well-established clinical skincare brand with a strong presence across Southeast Asia. You will start from a script or outline for each video, storyboard it from the brand's product and video catalog, and turn it into finished social content in the style beauty brands are producing with AI today, matched to the brand's look. The brand team is short on capacity, which is why they are hiring overseas, so they need someone self-sufficient who does not need babysitting. You will study the brand's website and Instagram on your own, pick up its look and voice quickly, and get it right the first time. Constant rework costs time and AI generation credits, so a fast read on the brand matters. If you are fluent in AI video editing, have the tools you need, and can take a loose idea to a polished, on-brand video without hand-holding, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

  • Use AI video and image tools fluently across ideation, generation, editing, and finishing
  • Cut, reformat, and enhance assets into finished, platform-ready content with motion graphics, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound design
  • Produce approximately 100 finished videos per month consistently and on schedule

Quality, Efficiency, and Self-Management

  • Get the brand right the first time to avoid constant rework that burns time and AI generation credits
  • Work with your own AI tools and platforms and keep your workflow current as new tools emerge

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to take a vague concept and turn it into a finished, on-brand video
  • Creative direction instincts including concepting, storyboarding, and the taste to make confident creative decisions

Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact.

Why Join Us?
