Job Description:

Job Title - Senior Project Manager

Location - Remote, UK Based

Type - Permanent, Full-time 37.5 hours


About Velonetic

For more than 100 years, Velonetic has helped keep the London insurance market moving. Our specialist people, proven processes and technology make complex insurance operations simpler, faster and more reliable for more than 400 market participants, across the insurance lifecycle from placement and premium processing to claims and settlement.

Now we are evolving with the market, pairing deep insurance expertise with data, automation and modern technology to reduce friction, improve accuracy and deliver better outcomes for our customers. Our culture is built on collaboration, respect, ownership, boldness and integrity, and you will have the opportunity to do work that matters at the heart of a globally important insurance marketplace.


Role purpose

Join us as Senior Project Manager and lead the technology change that keeps the London market moving. You will take ownership of complex, business-critical projects and programmes across our portfolio, with real accountability for scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, governance, stakeholder engagement and benefits, including work delivered with strategic partners and suppliers. We are looking for a technically credible delivery leader with London Insurance Market experience, who knows how to land change safely for the people who rely on it.

You will work alongside internal teams, market stakeholders, architects, operational teams, suppliers and delivery partners to build realistic, transparent plans, constructively challenge assumptions and keep end-to-end ownership. Your insight will give our leaders the evidence they need to make confident decisions on priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs.


What you will do

  • Lead technology projects and programmes end to end, from mobilisation through implementation, transition and closure.
  • Own integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, issues, assumptions and decisions.
  • Hold strategic technology partners and other third-party suppliers to account for the outcomes they deliver.
  • Connect business requirements, solution architecture, technical design, testing, deployment and operational readiness.
  • Represent Velonetic in market and delivery governance forums, building stakeholder trust and delivering with integrity.
  • Deliver within the standards, stage gates and controls set by the Head of Programme Delivery.

What you will own

  • Give leaders accurate, insight-led reporting on RAG status, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions and change requests, including Steering Committee and board updates that support timely decisions.
  • Manage budgets, forecasts, supplier costs and change control so that spend stays aligned with approved plans and business cases.
  • Lead implementation readiness, testing, cutover, warranty and handover into live service, using phased transition where it reduces operational or market risk.
  • Bring teams, SMEs, architects and suppliers together around clear priorities, keep documentation current, apply proportionate governance, and coach project managers to strengthen delivery practice.

What you will bring

  • Extensive experience delivering complex technology programmes, including software delivery, systems integration, data, workflow and platform change, with a proven record of controlled delivery across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk and benefits.
  • Hands-on technical delivery credibility, with the confidence to engage architects and engineers on requirements, design, integration, testing, release and cutover, challenge estimates and sequencing, and translate technical issues into clear business impacts and choices.
  • Substantial experience delivering technology change within the London Insurance Market (for example Lloyd's, insurers, reinsurers, brokers or market services providers), and a clear understanding of market processes and the impact of change on market participants.
  • Experience managing delivery through outsourced technology partners, including joint planning, supplier challenge, performance management and commercial escalation.
  • The ability to keep delivery on track in uncertain environments by exposing assumptions and risks early.
  • A track record of influencing senior and Executive-level stakeholders, with clear, engaging communication and the judgement to balance pace, quality and operational resilience.

What will set you apart

  • Working knowledge of London Market governance, regulatory and market-body requirements, and the wider insurance, reinsurance and Lloyd's ecosystem.
  • Experience leading transformation or modernisation programmes alongside an outsourced delivery partner.
  • Knowledge of Agile, hybrid and traditional delivery methodologies, ideally supported by a certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP or APM ChPP.

Investment In Training and Development

We offer a comprehensive range of training and career development opportunities, a structured induction programme, tailored job training as well as mentoring and support for relevant sponsored professional qualifications. We’re developing an environment where people can grow and harness their careers and skills to be the best that they can be to focus on the long term.

Our Culture

Here at Velonetic we support with care and compassion. We are constantly evolving our initiatives around equality, diversity, and inclusion to ensure that everyone feels equally involved and supported in the workplace no matter of who they are or what they do. We are proud of the culture we are creating to ensure that our commitment is ongoing and have a diverse mix of employees working within an inclusive environment and culture to create a high performing workforce led by talented leaders. We aspire to be recognised for our innovative and modern thinking approach.

Employee Benefits

As part of our competitive remuneration package, flexible benefits are available. There is an option to “flex up and down” on specific benefits, for example buy or sell annual leave, Private Medical Benefit, Dental and Travel Insurance.

You will also have access to ‘Perks at Work’, a discount store to purchase gift cards at reduced rates and get discounts on holidays, restaurants, activities, groceries and more.

DXC Recruitment Team will be engaging with all candidate applications on behalf of Velonetic. DXC will be managing the recruitment throughout the onboarding process.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Frontend Engineer, Patient Experience & Intakes to help build and improve the patient-facing experiences that power Bask Health's telehealth platform.

In this role, you'll develop intuitive, responsive, and reliable interfaces that guide patients through important interactions, including intake questionnaires, eligibility screening, product selection, checkout, and other steps in their care journey.

You'll work closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and other members of the engineering team to turn complex workflows into straightforward digital experiences. You'll contribute to features used across multiple telehealth businesses, balancing flexibility for merchants with consistency, performance, and ease of use for patients.

This position requires strong frontend engineering fundamentals, attention to detail, and an understanding of how user experience affects completion rates, accessibility, and overall platform reliability.

You'll be involved throughout the development process, from understanding requirements and implementing interfaces to testing, deployment, and ongoing improvements. You'll also help maintain reusable frontend components and identify opportunities to simplify complex patient workflows.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building polished products, solving practical problems, and taking ownership of features that directly affect how people interact with software.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain patient-facing applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Develop intuitive interfaces for patient onboarding, intake questionnaires, and eligibility workflows.
  • Implement dynamic, multi-step forms that adapt to patient responses and product requirements.
  • Build responsive interfaces that work across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Develop reusable components for questionnaires, forms, navigation, and patient interactions.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and platform services.
  • Implement product selection, checkout, and confirmation experiences.
  • Handle form validation, conditional logic, and error states across complex workflows.
  • Collaborate with designers to translate product requirements and designs into production-ready interfaces.
  • Work with backend engineers to define API requirements and data contracts.
  • Improve frontend performance, page loading, and responsiveness.
  • Identify and resolve usability issues that affect patient completion and navigation.
  • Support accessibility improvements across patient-facing applications.
  • Build consistent loading states, error messages, and recovery experiences.
  • Help improve frontend architecture and maintainability.
  • Write clean, readable, and well-tested application code.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests for critical patient workflows.
  • Troubleshoot frontend bugs and investigate issues reported by internal teams or users.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Work with product teams to improve questionnaire flexibility and customization.
  • Implement secure handling of sensitive patient information within frontend applications.
  • Help maintain consistent design patterns across patient-facing features.
  • Collaborate on experiments and improvements to patient engagement and workflow completion.
  • Monitor frontend behavior and help identify production issues.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and component development standards.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while maintaining code quality.
  • Take ownership of assigned features from development through deployment and maintenance.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in frontend or full-stack software engineering.
  • Strong experience developing web applications with React.
  • Professional experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Experience with Next.js or comparable modern frontend frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive web development.
  • Experience building complex, interactive user interfaces.
  • Experience developing forms, validation logic, and multi-step user workflows.
  • Familiarity with frontend state management and component architecture.
  • Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs or comparable backend services.
  • Understanding of asynchronous JavaScript and client-server communication.
  • Experience building reusable, maintainable UI components.
  • Strong knowledge of responsive design and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Familiarity with web accessibility principles and frontend usability best practices.
  • Experience debugging frontend applications and resolving production issues.
  • Understanding of frontend performance optimization.
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Familiarity with frontend testing tools and automated testing practices.
  • Ability to translate design specifications into functional interfaces.
  • Experience collaborating with designers, product managers, and backend engineers.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure frontend development.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering polished user experiences.
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage assigned features independently and work effectively with a remote team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing patient-facing healthcare or telehealth applications.
  • Experience building intake questionnaires, eligibility screening, or patient onboarding workflows.
  • Familiarity with dynamic form libraries such as React Hook Form.
  • Experience with schema validation libraries such as Zod.
  • Experience developing multi-step checkout or subscription purchase flows.
  • Familiarity with Stripe or other payment integrations.
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS or modern component styling systems.
  • Familiarity with component libraries and design systems.
  • Experience with tRPC or strongly typed API integrations.
  • Familiarity with Prisma, Drizzle, or relational data models.
  • Experience with automated end-to-end testing using Playwright or Cypress.
  • Experience with frontend monitoring and error-tracking tools.
  • Familiarity with web analytics, conversion optimization, or A/B testing.
  • Experience developing configurable or white-label SaaS interfaces.
  • Understanding of healthcare data privacy and security considerations.
  • Experience improving accessibility for complex web forms.
  • Familiarity with performance monitoring and Core Web Vitals.
  • Experience collaborating on UX research or usability improvements.
  • Experience working in a product-focused SaaS engineering environment.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

Finding the right place to grow your career isn’t (over) easy, so we’re here to help by sharing a few reasons why the grass is greener at Vital Farms. We think you’ll appreciate our focus on Conscious Capitalism, which drives business decisions that benefit all our stakeholders (leading to even better business results). You might be drawn to our innovative approach and refusal to settle for the “way things have always been done.” Or you could find it exciting to grow your skills while working for an industry-leading brand. Whether you’re into our values, our brand, or our egg-cellent puns, we hope you’ll join our Crew and help us change the world 108 square feet at a time!

At Vital Farms, we’re proud of the diverse communities we serve and the stakeholders who help bring our purpose to life. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where every crew member feels valued. We see this as one of our greatest strengths - and your role is key to helping us build on it.

Your Role:

The Tax Director plays a critical role in ensuring the company's tax compliance and optimizing tax strategies. This position will lead all aspects of the company's tax function, including income tax, sales and use tax, and other indirect taxes. The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated and experienced tax professional with a strong understanding of US tax laws and regulations. 

What You'll Do:

  • Direct Tax:  
    • Oversee all aspects of federal, state, and local income tax compliance, including:  
      • Reviewing and filing corporate income tax returns. 
      • Managing quarterly and annual tax provision calculations in accordance with ASC 740. 
      • Reviewing disclosures for GAAP financial statements. 
      • Reviewing complex tax calculations prepared by third party tax preparers. 
      • Assessing and reviewing quarterly estimated tax payments and tax return extensions. 
      • Responding to tax notices and inquiries from taxing authorities. 
      • Managing tax audits conducted by federal, state, and local authorities. 
      • Coordinating with external auditors and tax consultants to ensure timely and accurate tax filings. 
      • Compiling annual and quarterly information for third party tax preparers. 
      • Oversees tax planning initiatives, including the identification, calculation, and documentation of the R&D tax credit and the tracking of bonus depreciation.
  • Indirect Tax:  
    • Evaluate and determine nexus for US entities. 
    • Coordinate necessary registrations for sales and use tax. 
    • Oversee sales and use tax compliance. 
  • General:
    • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local tax laws and regulations. 
    • Serve as the primary contact for auditors, external tax advisors, and tax authorities. 
    • Manage any related inquiries or audits. 
    • Monitor changes in tax laws and regulations, assess their impact, and communicate necessary changes in strategy or procedures to leadership. 
    • Provide tax related guidance and consultative direction to internal stakeholders.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Tax or Accounting required. Master’s degree in taxation is highly preferred 
  • CPA required 
  • Minimum of 10-12 years of experience in corporate tax 
  • General working knowledge of employment/payroll tax regulations
  • Strong understanding of US federal, state, and local tax laws and regulations
  • Experience with ASC 740 and GAAP financial reporting
  • Proven ability to manage complex tax projects and deadlines 
  • Experience in Agricultural and Manufacturing industries 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
  • Experience with ERP systems (e.g., D365) is a plus. 
  • Ability to travel 10-20% for company meetings, team gatherings and other business needs
  • You’re no hero – You know the power of teamwork and celebrate the work of others before your own.
  • You give a sh*t – You believe in acting like an owner and making Vital Farms a place to be proud of.
  • You raise the standards – You know growth can be hard, but you strive to improve yourself and others each day.
  • You can walk in someone else’s boots – You seek to understand other’s viewpoints and think that you get to better answers by sitting on the same side of the table.
  • You don’t walk on eggshells – You’re not afraid to leave the bullsh*t behind and have honest conversations.
  • We recognize that talent comes in many forms. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may have strengths we haven’t yet considered!

Vital Farms, a Certified B Corporation, offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide.   • Provide clear and accurate review comments and required corrections to applicants
  • Coordinate with engineers, developers, contractors, and municipal staff to resolve plan review comments
  • Maintain thorough documentation and complete plan review reports in accordance with company and jurisdictional guidelines
  • Use VertexPlans for plan review tracking, documentation, and reporting

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer reliability means helping merchants depend on the software they use to operate their businesses. We value careful technical investigation, clear communication, strong follow-through, and people who look beyond immediate fixes to understand and prevent recurring problems.

About the Role

We're looking for a Customer Reliability Engineer to help improve the reliability of customer-facing workflows and resolve technical issues that affect merchants using Bask Health.

This role combines technical troubleshooting, customer-impact analysis, incident investigation, and proactive identification of recurring software problems.

You'll work closely with customer success, technical support, product, and engineering teams to understand where customers experience technical difficulties and help coordinate lasting solutions.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

These customers rely on our platform to support important parts of their business operations.

Bask Health brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a detailed understanding of how these systems interact and where technical problems can disrupt customer workflows.

You'll investigate customer-reported software issues and determine how they affect the customer's ability to use the platform.

You'll help identify patterns in recurring errors, configuration problems, integration failures, and unexpected application behavior.

You'll use available technical evidence, logs, browser diagnostics, and support records to understand reported issues.

You'll reproduce problems when possible and document the conditions under which they occur.

You'll distinguish between customer configuration errors, third-party integration issues, application defects, and broader platform incidents.

You'll evaluate the scope and impact of customer-facing problems to help internal teams prioritize investigation and resolution.

You'll work with technical support teams to understand escalated issues and identify opportunities to prevent repeated customer contacts.

You'll collaborate with customer success managers to understand the business impact of technical problems affecting merchant accounts.

You'll work with customer success engineers to investigate implementation or integration issues that continue after onboarding.

You'll coordinate with software engineers when issues require code-level investigation, infrastructure expertise, or product fixes.

You'll provide clear reproduction steps, technical evidence, customer impact details, and relevant troubleshooting history.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Content Designer to help create clear, useful, and intuitive content across Bask Health's software platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a Junior Content Designer, you'll help improve how people understand and interact with our products through thoughtful interface language, clear instructions, and consistent terminology.

This is an early-career content design role focused on UX writing, product content, information organization, and user-centered communication.

You'll work alongside experienced designers, product managers, engineers, and researchers to create content that makes complex software easier to navigate.

Your work may involve merchant onboarding, patient questionnaires, account settings, administrative dashboards, checkout experiences, and other product features.

You'll write and refine interface content such as button labels, form instructions, helper text, error messages, tooltips, empty states, and confirmation messages.

You'll learn how to approach content as part of the overall user experience rather than as text added after a design is complete.

You'll work with product designers to understand how language, layout, and interaction patterns influence user comprehension.

You'll also collaborate with engineers to understand how content appears in the product and how technical requirements may affect implementation.

A key part of this role will be developing your ability to write concise, accurate, and useful content for different audiences.

For example, merchants configuring their businesses may need clear explanations of software settings, while patients completing questionnaires may need straightforward instructions and reassurance about what happens next.

You'll help maintain consistent terminology across product experiences and contribute to reusable content guidelines.

You'll participate in content reviews, incorporate feedback, and refine your writing through multiple iterations.

You'll also have opportunities to learn from usability research, customer feedback, and product observations to understand where confusing language may be affecting the user experience.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn to approach sensitive information, clinical terminology, and patient-facing content with appropriate care. Content involving medical or clinical meaning will require review by authorized stakeholders.

We're looking for someone with strong writing fundamentals, excellent attention to detail, curiosity about digital products, and a willingness to learn from experienced teammates.

What You'll Do

  • Support content design initiatives across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Write clear, concise interface copy for web-based product features.
  • Create button labels, navigation text, and interface headings.
  • Develop helper text and instructions for digital forms.
  • Support content improvements for patient onboarding experiences.
  • Assist with writing content for merchant onboarding and account setup.
  • Help create understandable error messages and validation instructions.
  • Write confirmation messages and next-step guidance.
  • Develop tooltips and contextual help for product settings.
  • Support content for administrative dashboards and configuration workflows.
  • Review existing interfaces to identify confusing or inconsistent language.
  • Collaborate with product designers to improve content clarity.
  • Work with experienced content designers to understand writing standards.
  • Participate in content reviews and incorporate feedback.
  • Apply plain-language principles to assigned writing tasks.
  • Help maintain consistent terminology across product experiences.
  • Contribute to reusable UX writing patterns and content guidelines.
  • Support accessibility and inclusive writing practices.
  • Assist with content documentation and organization.
  • Collaborate with product managers to understand feature requirements.
  • Work with engineers to ensure interface copy is implemented accurately.
  • Review implemented content for clarity, consistency, and accuracy.
  • Learn how user research informs product content decisions.
  • Help evaluate content based on usability feedback.
  • Explore alternative wording to improve user comprehension.
  • Support content quality assurance before product releases.
  • Maintain organized content files and documentation.
  • Take ownership of assigned writing tasks while seeking guidance when needed.

Requirements

  • Early-career candidate with 0–2 years of relevant experience in content design, UX writing, product writing, technical writing, or a related field.
  • Internship experience, freelance work, academic projects, or substantial independent projects may be considered.
  • Portfolio or writing samples demonstrating clear, user-focused communication.

jobs.title: Director of Finance & Operations
jobs.excerpt: About UsThere are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright.
jobs.description:
About Us

There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore.

It is working, with tens of thousands of active customers, a strong financial position, and investors including the YC Continuity Fund behind us.

We are looking for a hands-on owner of finance and operations: a do-er who makes finance a real partner to every leader in the company and runs the operations that keep it moving. You will put the numbers at the center of how we make decisions including telling us when we should be investing more, not just less. This is not a role for someone who wants to hire a team and manage from above. You will build the model, sit in the budget reviews and negotiate the contracts yourself. If building the financial and operational backbone of the company that brings peace of mind to millions of seniors and their families is how you want to spend the next few years, we'd love to talk.

What you'll own

Make finance a true partner to leadership

  • You'll turn the P&L into something every leader uses. You'll run department budget reviews, track pacing against plan, and make sure each leader knows their numbers and what to do about them.
  • You’ll build and own a clear financial reporting framework, including dashboards and KPIs that connect revenue, customer acquisition and cash flow to ensure leadership has reliable, actionable data to execute strategy.
  • You’ll find the money. You’ll dig into contribution margin by cohort, marginal CAC by channel, payment failures and involuntary churn, processor fees and pricing. You’ll tell us where the next dollar should and shouldn’t go, then work with the owning team until the number moves.
  • You'll maintain the forecast and be the voice of our cash position, so the co-founders make spending and hiring decisions with a clear view of what they cost. You'll build the hiring roadmap and headcount plan, review it with leadership on a regular cadence, and work with our Head of People on compensation strategy.
  • You'll own accounting and the close. You'll manage our third-party accounting firm, hold them to a fast and accurate month-end, and modernize the stack underneath it (you'll likely want to bring on something like Rillet).
  • You'll do the work yourself. For now you are the function: you build the model, pull the data and write the analysis. You'll likely make one hire in 2027, and you'll decide where it helps most, whether that's accounting, operations or something else.
  • You'll establish and maintain financial controls, oversee tax compliance and audit readiness, and ensure our financial processes scale with the business without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Guarantee the capital that funds our growth

  • You’ll make sure we’re investing as hard as the returns justify. We’re cash flow positive with strong margins, so the question is rarely whether we can afford growth. It’s how much more we should be funding, and with what capital. You’ll compare marginal returns with the cost of debt and equity and push us to use capital when the math says go.
  • You'll work with a debt partner, and if we need more, you'll source additional debt or venture partners and manage that process.
  • You'll bring your own relationships with lenders and investors, so those conversations start warm whenever we need them.
  • You'll own investor reporting, so the people backing us always know where we stand.

Take operations off the co-founders' plates

  • You'll own inventory planning, supply chain and our 3PL, so we always have the right hardware on hand without tying up cash in oversized orders.
  • You'll negotiate and manage our vendors. There are many: telecom carriers, our 3PL, our HRIS, software and more. You'll know what we pay, what we should pay, and when each contract is up.
  • You'll own telecom regulatory and tax compliance, legal and insurance. Outside firms do most of the work; you direct them, make the calls, and make sure nothing reaches the co-founders that doesn't need to.
  • You'll own IT and security, making sure a distributed team has the tools and access it needs and our customers' data stays protected.

What we're looking for

  • You've been a hands-on finance lead at a high-growth, venture-backed company, close enough to the work that you built the model and ran the budget reviews yourself. We care more about what you've done than how senior your title was.
  • You’ve run finance for a high-volume consumer subscription business. You think in cohorts, cash payback and marginal returns, not blended averages, and you’ve managed churn, retention and payback as levers rather than reported on them.
  • You've been the finance partner to a large marketing budget. You can tell a growth team which dollars are working, and you've held the line when they weren't.
  • You've run the finance side of both debt and venture raises, and you have lender and venture relationships you can call on.
  • You're a partner, not a scorekeeper. And you’re direct enough to tell a CEO when the numbers don’t support the plan, or when the plan isn’t ambitious enough.
  • You still love doing the work. You'd rather build the model yourself than brief someone else on it, and you're comfortable being a function of one before you hire.
  • You've owned operations beyond finance: vendors, contracts, outside counsel, inventory or logistics. You say "let me figure it out" rather than "that's not Finance's job."
  • You negotiate well. You've taken real cost out of vendor contracts and can show the before and after.
  • You’re comfortable operating with imperfect data, identifying what matters most and making sound decisions without waiting for perfect information.
  • You can balance strategic thinking with execution, moving comfortably between board-level discussions and detailed financial analysis.

Nice to have

  • You've worked at a company that sells both software and hardware, and you've managed inventory, a 3PL and hardware COGS alongside subscription revenue.

No telecom background is needed.

How we work

We're a fast-growing, YC-backed company built on curiosity, a bias toward action, and a founder mindset. We'd rather ship something small and learn than debate it for a month. This role is fully remote; our team is distributed across 12+ countries. You'll report directly to Ellie Lasater-Guttmann, co-founder who runs Growth and G&A. You will sit on the leadership team.

Compensation, equity and benefits

Annual salary range $230-$270k + equity

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, 401k with Employer Match

International offsites 3-4 times per year. Remote work otherwise.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, merchant success is about helping businesses make the most of the platform. We value strong relationships, clear communication, proactive problem-solving, and people who take ownership of helping merchants succeed.

About the Role

We're looking for a Merchant Success Manager to help Bask Health's merchants successfully launch, operate, and grow their businesses using our software platform.

This role is responsible for building long-term merchant relationships, supporting onboarding, driving platform adoption, and helping merchants achieve their business goals.

You'll serve as the primary post-sale relationship owner for a portfolio of merchants using Bask Health to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our merchants include entrepreneurs, online business owners, e-commerce operators, and organizations launching or managing healthcare-related businesses.

You'll work directly with merchants to understand their business models, customer journeys, operational challenges, and growth priorities.

You'll develop a strong understanding of how Bask Health's platform supports merchant operations.

Our software brings together online storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll help merchants understand how these different features work together and how to use them effectively.

You'll guide new merchants through onboarding and help them become comfortable using the platform.

You'll coordinate with internal teams when merchants need technical assistance, additional configuration support, or clarification about available features.

You'll support merchants as they move from initial setup into ongoing operations.

You'll help identify opportunities for merchants to improve their workflows and make better use of existing platform capabilities.

You'll learn how merchants attract customers, manage their online experiences, and evaluate their business performance.

You'll use that understanding to make practical recommendations related to platform adoption and operational efficiency.

You'll maintain regular communication with assigned merchants to understand their progress and identify emerging challenges.

You'll proactively monitor merchant engagement, account health, and product usage.

You'll identify merchants who may be struggling with onboarding, experiencing operational difficulties, or showing signs of disengagement.

You'll work with those merchants to understand their concerns and develop plans to improve their experience.

You'll support merchant retention by building strong relationships, following through on commitments, and demonstrating the ongoing value of the platform.

You'll prepare for renewals and participate in renewal discussions within Bask Health's approved commercial processes.

You'll also identify opportunities for merchants to expand their use of the platform when additional features align with their business needs.

You'll collaborate with sales and leadership when commercial expansion opportunities require additional involvement.

You'll conduct regular merchant check-ins and account reviews to discuss progress, adoption, challenges, and future priorities.

You'll help merchants understand product updates and new platform capabilities that may be relevant to their businesses.

You'll work with technical support and customer success engineering teams when merchants encounter software issues.

You'll coordinate with product and engineering teams when merchants report recurring problems or request functionality improvements.

You'll maintain clear communication during escalations and ensure merchants receive appropriate updates.

You'll gather merchant feedback and share recurring needs, challenges, and opportunities with internal stakeholders.

You'll maintain accurate records of merchant conversations, account health, renewal timelines, and outstanding action items.

You'll use CRM and customer success tools to organize your portfolio and prioritize outreach.

You'll also contribute to improvements in merchant onboarding materials, customer education resources, and internal success processes.

Because Bask Health supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to recognize when an issue requires involvement from the appropriate clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or technical team.

You'll coordinate communication and follow-up without making clinical or pharmacy decisions outside your responsibilities.

You'll work in a remote, cross-functional environment where clear communication, initiative, and personal accountability are important.

We're looking for someone who understands e-commerce businesses and has meaningful experience managing customer relationships after the sale.

You should be comfortable speaking with entrepreneurs, online merchants, and business owners about their operations, challenges, and business goals.

You'll need to be organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple merchant relationships independently.

Success in this role means helping merchants adopt Bask Health successfully, maintain healthy accounts, renew their relationships, and find additional value in the platform over time.

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of merchant accounts throughout the post-sale lifecycle.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for assigned merchants.
  • Build strong relationships with entrepreneurs, online store owners, and e-commerce operators.
  • Guide new merchants through onboarding and platform adoption.
  • Coordinate merchant transitions from sales to customer success.
  • Develop merchant success plans aligned with business goals.
  • Understand each merchant's business model, workflows, and priorities.
  • Help merchants navigate Bask Health's platform and available features.
  • Support adoption of storefront and checkout capabilities.
  • Help merchants understand questionnaires and other supported platform workflows.
  • Conduct regular merchant check-ins and account reviews.
  • Monitor merchant engagement, product usage, and account health.
  • Identify early signs of merchant dissatisfaction or churn risk.
  • Develop proactive retention plans for at-risk accounts.
  • Support merchant renewals and related account conversations.
  • Identify appropriate opportunities for merchant account expansion.
  • Collaborate with sales on commercial growth opportunities.
  • Coordinate technical troubleshooting with support and engineering teams.
  • Manage merchant escalations and maintain clear follow-up communication.
  • Communicate product updates and relevant feature improvements.
  • Gather merchant feedback and share insights with internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and merchant account documentation.
  • Track merchant goals, renewal timelines, and outstanding action items.
  • Help merchants identify opportunities to improve platform utilization.
  • Collaborate with product teams on recurring merchant challenges.
  • Recommend improvements to merchant onboarding and education materials.
  • Support merchant success process improvements and playbook development.
  • Use available merchant data to prioritize outreach and account activities.
  • Coordinate with appropriate operations stakeholders when necessary.
  • Escalate clinical and pharmacy concerns to authorized teams.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with merchants.
  • Take ownership of merchant outcomes and follow through on commitments.

Requirements

  • At least 2 full years of genuine post-sale customer success or merchant success experience.
  • Demonstrated ownership of customer or merchant relationships after the initial sale.
  • Direct experience with customer onboarding, product adoption, retention, renewals, or expansion.
  • Recent, substantive experience working directly with e-commerce merchants, online businesses, or merchant-facing commerce software.
  • E-commerce experience within approximately the past 4 years.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce business models and merchant operations.
  • Experience managing an assigned portfolio of merchant or customer accounts.
  • Ability to build and maintain long-term relationships with business owners.
  • Experience guiding customers through software onboarding.
  • Ability to help merchants adopt and use SaaS products effectively.
  • Experience identifying customer concerns and retention risks.

Nice to Have

  • Experience improving merchant onboarding processes or education materials.
  • Familiarity with healthcare technology or telehealth software.
  • Experience working in an entrepreneurial SaaS environment.
  • Experience using merchant data to guide account management decisions.

Director, Operations Instructional Design

College Board - Operations

Location: This is a fully remote role.

Role Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team

College Board Operations Division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is leading exciting work to advance customer experience using innovative solutions, emerging technologies, and integrated products to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support.


The Knowledge, Learning & Operational Effectiveness team collaborates across all operational functions to design and deliver integrated solutions that power our core operations. Our mission is to create a connected ecosystem that supports College Board digital experiences, enabling operational efficiency and exceptional customer outcomes. From backend systems to educator-facing content, every solution we deliver is purposefully crafted to enhance the customer journey, ensuring seamless, intuitive, and impactful interactions at every stage.  

About the Opportunity

The Operations Division is modernizing how we deliver learning solutions to enable high-impact, user-centered experiences. We are seeking a Director of Operations Instructional Design to lead the design, development, and continuous improvement of digital learning experiences that prepare both our internal Operations teams and our external partners, including test administration partners, as they prepare to do their operational activities across the customer journey.


This role will establish and lead a Learning Experience Design Center of Excellence (COE) within Operations, responsible for building best-in-class design standards, templates, and tools that elevate the quality and impact of all learning experiences. You’ll collaborate across Operations, Product, Program, and Technology to ensure that every learning program is both engaging and measurable in its impact on performance, readiness, and customer experience.


You use instructional design to drive innovation in digital learning through evidence-based practices, human-centered design, and the thoughtful application of learning science. You bring experience with Adobe Captivate, Articulate Storyline 360, SCORM Cloud, Global Meet, and PowerPoint to create lessons and modules, and coding skills with JavaScript extensions and other tools to produce interactive elements.


In this role, you will:

Strategize Learning Journeys, Develop and Deliver Training, Templates, and Artifacts (40%)

  • Create detailed design principles and templates for the team to use in creating individual training artifacts like webinars, live learning, async lessons and modules.
  • Create complex training experiences and deliverables using tools like JavaScript extensions, xAPI, cmi5, and Blender.
  • Plan, script, and build engaging, interactive, targeted, and efficient learning artifacts for internal Operations staff who support the delivery of College Board products and assessments.
  • Create visual elements like graphics, exercises, videos, printables, and assessments to make artifacts engaging to learners.
  • Use Articulate Storyline 360, Articulate Review SCORM Cloud, and PowerPoint to create and update training artifacts.

Learning Strategy and Standards (30%)

  • Anticipates future learning needs by staying current with design trends and research. Balances prioritization and delivery of new strategies and approaches with current business needs.
  • Leverage AI technologies to develop learning solutions that deliver high business value to materially transform Ops learning experiences
  • Make necessary adjustments and add required elements (like closed-captioning) to ensure all artifacts are ADA compliant when required.
  • Ensure final artifacts are compatible with organization’s LMS and broader knowledge management infrastructure.

Continuous Improvement and Evolve Content (30%)

  • Deliver strategies that connect learning programs to business results using data and evaluation models to prove the impact and value of learning initiatives.
  • Establish and monitor key learning performance metrics to measure and enhance business impact, using data to drive continuous improvement
  • Implement feedback loops to gather user insights and measure satisfaction, leveraging this data for iteratively refining learning solutions
  • Maintain governance processes for content updates in collaboration with SMEs and overall Knowledge and Learning Operations team.

About You

  • Expertise in digital learning with 5+ years designing and creating digital training programs. Experience providing digital learning to K-12 educators is preferred but not required.
  • Outstanding knowledge of emerging trends and best practice in digital learning
  • Expertise in authoring and publishing systems, including Articulate Storyline 360, Adobe Captivate, and SCORM Cloud to create multimedia solutions is required.
  • Proven capabilities to develop complex learning materials, including simulations, JavaScript extensions, and multimedia.
  • Expertise in instructional technologies is required; operational experience with LMS technologies and capability to maintain expertise with emerging technologies and standards, xAPI, and cmi5.
  • Adept problem-solving skills, including using data to inform decisions and actions   
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence others to action
  • A passion for supporting educational and career opportunities for millions of students   
  • Excellent PowerPoint, Word, and Excel skills
  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business.
  • Authorization to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

About Our Process

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000 to $135,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DOTruvani is a health and wellness brand that has one clear mission: create products people use in their daily lives with CLEAN, simple ingredients.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO

Truvani is a health and wellness brand that has one clear mission: create products people use in their daily lives with CLEAN, simple ingredients.

Many companies claim it. We actually mean it.

As a leading provider of high-quality supplements, protein powders, and snack bars, we are committed to transparency, purity, and sustainability. Our mission is to provide products you can trust, with ingredients you can pronounce, and to inspire healthier living for all.

If you’re a talented, ambitious person who wants to create the best health and wellness products, apply to join our team!

ABOUT THE POSITION

Truvani is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator to support our growing logistics and distribution operations. In this role, you will work closely with the Director of Logistics to coordinate inventory movements between vendors and third-party logistics (3PL) warehouses, as well as transfers between warehouse locations.

This role requires strong communication skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to manage multiple shipments and moving pieces simultaneously. You'll play an important part in ensuring inventory moves efficiently, shipment records remain accurate, and our internal teams have clear visibility into inventory movements and shipment statuses.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, stays ahead of potential issues, and understands that accuracy and follow-through are critical to successful logistics operations.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS/IS

  • Has at least 3 years of experience in transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations.
  • Is exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple shipments, deadlines, and priorities at once.
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows tasks through to completion without needing constant oversight.
  • Has hands-on experience with NetSuite, preferably with at least 1 year of experience.
  • Is proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Google Sheets, including basic formulas and pivot tables.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
  • Is comfortable working directly with external partners, including 3PL warehouses and freight forwarders, to coordinate shipments, request updates, and resolve issues.
  • Is proactive and resourceful when it comes to identifying problems and finding solutions.
  • Understands the importance of accurate data entry, documentation, and timely follow-through.
  • Works well independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

  • Coordinate Inventory Movements: Work with the Director of Logistics to execute distribution plans, including inventory transfers from vendors to 3PL warehouses and between 3PL warehouse locations.
  • Manage Shipment Setups: Access 3PL partner platforms to create and manage inbound and outbound shipments, ensuring all required shipment details are entered accurately.
  • Coordinate Freight Transportation: Work directly with freight forwarders to arrange transportation once inventory is staged and ready for shipment. Provide all necessary warehouse details and shipment information to facilitate timely pickups and deliveries.
  • Maintain Accurate Inventory Records: Record all inventory movements and transfers in NetSuite, including processing fulfillment transactions when shipments are initiated and receiving transactions once inventory arrives at its destination. Accuracy and timeliness in this process are essential.
  • Resolve Inventory Issues: Collaborate with internal Truvani team members to troubleshoot and resolve inventory discrepancies or allocation issues within NetSuite, including SKU and lot availability.
  • Troubleshoot Shipment Issues: Communicate with warehouses and freight forwarders to proactively address transportation challenges, including delays, missed pickups, missed deliveries, and other shipment-related issues.
  • Track Open Shipments: Maintain an up-to-date shipment tracker that provides Truvani team members with clear visibility into outstanding shipments and their current statuses.
  • Organize Shipment Documentation: Maintain organized records of all shipment-related documentation, including packing lists, Bills of Lading (BOLs), and other relevant paperwork.
  • Take on additional logistics and operational responsibilities as needed.

THE NITTY GRITTY

  • Full time market-based compensation based on experience
  • Fully remote with flexibility and autonomy
  • Collaborative and innovative team culture
  • Health (medical, dental, vision) benefits and 401k benefits offered after 60 days
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Remote Work and Education Stipend
  • Truvani Monthly Store Credit
  • Position is available immediately and will remain open until filled
  • This is a permanent position with an opportunity to grow within the company (so we would like to hire someone that is awesome and is excited about being a part of our team).

Packetlabs was built by an ethical hacker after seeing vulnerability assessments presented as penetration tests. Our slogan "Ready for more than a VA scan?" drives at the importance of not providing our clients with a false sense of security.

We are a passionate team of highly trained, proactive, penetration testers. We provide expert-level penetration testing services that are thorough and tailored to help foster a safe digital space where everyone has the right to privacy and security. Packetlabs consultants find weaknesses others overlook and continuously learn new ways to evade controls. We hold ourselves to a very high standard.

To do so, we only hire individuals with the same drive and passion.

Who we are looking for

  • Core values:
    • You have a customer-first mentality. Is a great communicator with clients, project managers, and teammates. Rapid responses and on time.
    • You deliver work that you take pride in. Your work is an autograph of your excellence.
    • You dig deeper into every finding. Doesn't stop until impact is proven.
    • You are comfortable being uncomfortable. Goes towards obstacles, not away from them. Consulting isn't your typical job and requires adapting to rapidly changing environments.
    • You are always learning. Cybersecurity is changing every day, and you need to keep up or want to keep up. Be deeply aware of your skillset and be willing to improve.
    • You are Self-motivated and dependable.
    • You are humble. Egos don't have a place at Packetlabs.
  • Education and experience:
    • We are looking for an experienced developer/application security tester to join our team:
      • Solid working knowledge of programming languages, including C, C#, Python, Objective-C, Java, JavaScript, SQL, and frameworks like AngularJS.
      • Familiarity with web services and data exchange formats such as XML, JSON, SOAP, REST, and AJAX.
      • Understanding of AI/LLM weaknesses and flaws in applications.
      • Extensive experience/expertise in using an attack proxy (e.g. Burp Suite)
    • Preferred if you have 3 - 5 years of experience working in penetration testing and consulting
    • A graduate of a post-secondary college or university degree program.
    • Has at least two years of experience dealing with information security-related tasks.
    • Has professional qualifications (one or more): OSCP, OSWE, BSCP.

What you’ll be doing

  • Your primary role is to perform penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, thick clients, and APIs.

Why us?

  • The opportunity to work on high-stakes hardware engagements where your judgment and bench skills genuinely matter

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, the patient experience is an important part of how telehealth businesses operate. We value thoughtful communication, attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and people who can help patients navigate administrative and technical challenges while respecting the responsibilities of licensed healthcare professionals.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Patient Experience Specialist to help deliver a clear, responsive, and supportive experience for patients using telehealth services powered by Bask Health.

This role focuses on patient communication, administrative assistance, service-related troubleshooting, and coordinating the resolution of complex patient experience issues.

You'll help patients navigate supported platform workflows and understand the next steps in their service experience.

Our platform supports direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses by connecting patient experiences, online questionnaires, checkout processes, clinical workflows, and pharmacy-related operations.

You'll develop a strong understanding of how these workflows connect and where patients may encounter confusion, delays, or technical difficulties.

You'll respond to patient questions through approved communication channels and provide accurate information within established support guidelines.

You'll assist patients with nonclinical questions related to account access, platform navigation, questionnaire completion, checkout processes, and administrative status updates.

You'll help patients understand what information they need to provide and where they can find relevant instructions.

You'll investigate reported platform difficulties and work with internal teams to identify appropriate next steps.

As a senior member of the patient experience function, you'll take ownership of more complex service cases that require additional coordination or careful communication.

You'll help resolve situations involving multiple teams, unclear responsibilities, or repeated patient contacts.

You'll be expected to remain organized and communicate clearly when patients are frustrated or uncertain about what happens next.

You'll coordinate with technical support teams when patients encounter software errors or difficulties completing supported platform workflows.

You'll work with authorized clinical or pharmacy stakeholders when a case involves medical, prescription, medication, or dispensing-related questions.

You'll understand that patient experience specialists do not provide medical advice, make clinical decisions, determine treatment eligibility, or independently resolve prescription-related clinical concerns.

You'll follow established procedures for escalating safety concerns, urgent clinical questions, and other matters outside the patient support team's scope.

You'll provide administrative updates only when the information is verified and appropriate to share.

You'll maintain accurate records of patient communications, reported issues, actions taken, and follow-up commitments.

You'll use approved systems and follow internal privacy and security procedures when handling patient information.

You'll help identify recurring patient questions, common points of confusion, and workflow challenges that affect the overall experience.

You'll share those findings with customer success, product, technical support, and operations teams.

You'll contribute to improvements in patient-facing instructions, support resources, and communication templates.

You'll help develop clear responses to frequently asked questions and identify where additional guidance may reduce unnecessary support contacts.

You'll support quality improvement efforts by reviewing common service issues and recommending practical changes to support processes.

You'll assist with identifying cases that require escalation because of repeated delays, unresolved technical problems, or communication breakdowns.

You'll coordinate follow-up activity so patients receive consistent information and understand the status of their administrative requests.

You'll help establish consistent standards for case documentation, escalation, and communication quality.

You'll also support the training and guidance of less-experienced patient support team members when appropriate.

You'll be expected to demonstrate sound judgment when deciding whether an issue can be resolved through standard support procedures or requires specialist involvement.

You'll work closely with internal stakeholders while maintaining clear boundaries between administrative support and licensed healthcare responsibilities.

You'll contribute to a patient experience that is organized, respectful, and responsive without making promises about medical outcomes, prescriptions, treatment timelines, or pharmacy fulfillment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with responsibility for complex patient experience cases and support process improvement.

It is not a licensed clinical position, pharmacy position, or formal people-management role.

We're looking for someone with strong customer or patient support experience, excellent communication skills, and a proven ability to manage sensitive situations professionally.

Experience supporting healthcare-related services, digital health platforms, or other complex service environments is particularly valuable.

You should be comfortable working with multiple systems, managing detailed case records, and coordinating across teams.

Success in this role means helping patients receive accurate administrative support, reducing avoidable confusion, improving issue resolution, and identifying opportunities to strengthen the overall service experience.

What You'll Do

  • Provide high-quality administrative and technical support to patients through approved communication channels.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex patient experience cases.
  • Help patients navigate supported telehealth platform workflows.
  • Assist with account access, platform navigation, and general usability questions.
  • Support patients experiencing difficulties with online questionnaires.
  • Help investigate checkout and other nonclinical platform-related issues.
  • Provide accurate administrative status information when authorized and available.
  • Identify when patient questions require clinical, pharmacy, or specialist involvement.
  • Escalate medical and treatment-related questions to authorized healthcare professionals.
  • Route prescription and dispensing concerns to the appropriate authorized teams.
  • Follow established procedures for urgent or safety-related concerns.
  • Coordinate with technical support teams on patient-facing software issues.
  • Work with operations stakeholders to resolve administrative service challenges.
  • Take ownership of assigned complex cases and coordinate appropriate follow-up.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with patients experiencing frustration or uncertainty.
  • Maintain accurate records of patient communications and support actions.
  • Follow privacy and security procedures when handling sensitive patient information.
  • Use approved support systems to track cases and escalation activity.
  • Identify recurring patient questions and sources of confusion.
  • Recommend improvements to patient-facing instructions and help resources.
  • Assist with developing and updating support communication templates.
  • Support quality reviews of patient experience interactions.
  • Help improve case documentation and escalation procedures.
  • Coordinate internal follow-ups to reduce repeated or unresolved patient contacts.
  • Track recurring service issues and share findings with relevant teams.
  • Collaborate with product teams on patient-facing usability concerns.
  • Work with customer success teams when patient experience issues affect merchant operations.
  • Help develop internal patient support knowledge resources.
  • Provide guidance to less-experienced support specialists when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service consistency and communication quality.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between administrative support and clinical responsibilities.
  • Take ownership of patient experience issues through appropriate resolution or handoff.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in customer support, patient experience, healthcare administration, customer service, or a closely related service role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex customer or patient support cases.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and respectfully with people experiencing frustration or uncertainty.
  • Experience resolving service-related issues through established support processes.
  • Ability to identify when a case requires escalation to another team.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience maintaining accurate customer or patient case records.
  • Ability to manage multiple active cases and follow-up commitments.
  • Experience using customer support, ticketing, or case management systems.
  • Comfortable learning and navigating software platforms.
  • Ability to troubleshoot basic account access and platform navigation issues.
  • Strong judgment when handling sensitive or confidential information.
  • Understanding of the importance of patient privacy and appropriate data handling.
  • Ability to follow documented procedures and communication guidelines.
  • Ability to distinguish administrative support from clinical decision-making.
  • Willingness to escalate medical, prescription, and pharmacy-related concerns to authorized professionals.
  • Ability to communicate accurate information without making unsupported promises.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple internal teams.
  • Ability to document recurring problems and recommend process improvements.
  • Comfortable handling challenging conversations professionally.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Commitment to consistent service quality and appropriate follow-through.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in telehealth, digital health, or healthcare technology.
  • Background supporting patients through online healthcare services.
  • Experience working in healthcare customer service or patient coordination.
  • Familiarity with patient intake and online questionnaire workflows.
  • Experience supporting subscription-based healthcare services.
  • Familiarity with customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or similar tools.
  • Experience handling escalated or high-priority service cases.
  • Experience developing patient support documentation or knowledge base articles.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare privacy considerations.
  • Experience coordinating with clinical or pharmacy operations teams.
  • Experience supporting online checkout or payment-related administrative issues.
  • Experience working with customer success or technical support teams.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance reviews for customer support interactions.
  • Experience tracking support metrics and recurring service issues.
  • Experience improving escalation workflows or case management processes.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior support specialists.
  • Familiarity with patient experience improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working in a fast-changing SaaS or healthcare services environment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with diverse patient populations.
  • Experience identifying opportunities to reduce repeat support contacts.

Opportunity for Growth

This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in construction technology, B2B SaaS, product marketing, and growth marketing.

The specialist will receive strategic guidance from marketing leadership while maintaining meaningful ownership of content execution, with opportunities to expand into campaign strategy, content performance optimization, and broader marketing initiatives over time.

jobs.description:
• Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
  • Workplace: Remote
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM PST

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals with U.S. and Canadian companies looking to build high-performing global teams. For this opportunity, we are recruiting on behalf of a privately owned Southern California real estate investment and operating company managing residential and commercial properties across multiple legal entities. You will work remotely from the Philippines while collaborating directly with the U.S. team and an onshore CPA.

About the Role

You will take day-to-day ownership of the electronic accounting cycle across multiple properties and legal entities, with Yardi Voyager at the center of your work. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who can move confidently from transaction posting and reconciliations through month-end close, financial statements, tenant accounting, and management reporting.

The right person communicates early when something is missing, follows through without repeated reminders, and wants to become a dependable long-term part of a small, owner-led real estate business.

Responsibilities

  • Own the general ledger across multiple residential and commercial properties and legal entities, keeping accounts accurate, complete, and ready for review.
  • Complete month-end and year-end closes, including account reconciliations, supporting schedules, adjusting entries, and investigation of unusual balances.
  • Manage the accounts payable cycle by reviewing and coding vendor invoices, recording approved payables, preparing authorized electronic payments, monitoring aging, and resolving discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate tenant accounting for residential and commercial leases, including rent charges, collections, delinquency reporting, move-ins, move-outs, security deposit calculations, and refunds.
  • Reconcile bank and credit card accounts each month and escalate unresolved variances before they affect reporting deadlines.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports, including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow reports, rent rolls, and AP/AR aging.
  • Support property and company budgeting by providing accurate historical data, schedules, and accounting insights.
  • Process semi-monthly payroll through Paychex within established permissions and approval controls.
  • Support tax preparation, 1099 reporting, insurance-related accounting, and CPA reviews by maintaining organized and audit-ready records.
  • Record recurring ACH payments.
  • Spot checks that need a stop payment and alert management.
  • Handle returned and NSF tenant payments with late and NSF fees in Yardi.
  • Send monthly lease statements to commercial tenants.
  • Prepare a Common Area Maintenance (CAM) evaluation, checking the lease against the expense pool.
  • Serve as the day-to-day Yardi Voyager expert, using advanced Excel to analyze information, identify discrepancies, and communicate potential issues before deadlines are at risk.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 5+ years of U.S. real estate or property management accounting experience; candidates with 10+ years are especially encouraged to apply.
  • Hands-on Yardi Voyager experience across general ledger, AP, AR, tenant ledgers, reconciliations, and financial reporting. Yardi Voyager experience is required.
  • Strong residential property accounting experience plus working familiarity with commercial property accounting; training can be provided on the weaker side.
  • Demonstrated full-cycle accounting ownership, from transaction posting through reconciliations, close, and preparation of financial statements across multiple properties or entities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field, advanced Excel skills, and clear written and spoken English.
  • Ability to work independently while communicating proactively, acknowledging requests and files, following up consistently, and flagging delays or discrepancies before deadlines are missed.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with QuickBooks Online and/or AppFolio.
  • Experience processing payroll through Paychex and preparing 1099s.
  • Experience supporting privately owned U.S. real estate companies with multiple LLCs or other legal entities.
  • Experience collaborating with both U.S.-based and offshore colleagues.
  • CPA qualification, although it is not required.

You will define and execute the sector strategy, build market presence, shape strategic opportunities, sponsor key clients, and ensure our industry propositions translate into successful customer outcomes.
