About MakeUseOf

MakeUseOf is one of the largest online technology publications on the web today. We equip millions of readers—from everyday consumers to seasoned tech enthusiasts—with practical guides, explainers, product recommendations, and deep feature analysis to help them make the most of their technology.

About the Role

MakeUseOf is looking for Freelance Features Writers across our core tech verticals. While we cover everything from desktop operating systems to smart home tech, we are actively looking for specialized writers who can turn complex technical subjects, hands-on builds, and practical home tech into clear, engaging features.

Priority Coverage Areas:

  • Home Automation & Practical DIY Tech: Smart home sensors (motion, occupancy, contact), smart hubs/protocols (Matter, Zigbee, Z-Wave), power tool ecosystems (Ryobi, Milwaukee, DeWalt), and AV/networking cabling infrastructure (Cat 6/6a, Ethernet drops, HDMI standards).
  • AI & Local Language Models: Writers with dedicated hardware rigs excited to test, benchmark, and write about open-source local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio), local AI workflows, custom agents, and practical consumer AI applications.
  • Homelab & Advanced Networking: Deep knowledge of home networking infrastructure, Proxmox, NAS builds, self-hosting, network management tools, routers, radio networks, and home network security.
  • PC Hardware & Linux: Hands-on experience with CPUs, GPUs, benchmarking, custom PC building, hardware testing, and the Linux ecosystem.
  • Maker Projects & Hardware Hacking: Smart home automation, Raspberry Pi, ESP32 microcontrollers, DIY hardware builds, and practical workshop tech.
  • Core Operating Systems & Software: Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, security/privacy tools, productivity software, and web utilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively pitch creative, original feature ideas while regularly claiming assigned topics from the editorial board.
  • Write clear, engaging, and structurally sound feature articles that simplify complex technical concepts.
  • Test software, hardware, or workflows hands-on to provide authentic, step-by-step guidance and technical analysis.
  • Input, format, and structure articles inside our in-house CMS according to style guidelines (including screenshots, formatting, and link insertion).
  • Work collaboratively with section editors to refine pitches and incorporate feedback.

Application Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Track record writing technical guides, hardware deep-dives, or software features in English.
  • Access to the physical hardware, custom rigs, microcontrollers, homelab environments, or testing setups required for your primary coverage areas.
  • Strong drive to consistently pitch fresh, relevant article ideas that match current tech trends.
  • Ability to break down technical jargon into accessible, practical advice for tech enthusiasts and everyday readers alike.

How to Apply:

Please submit the following materials in your application:

  1. Your CV / Resume
  2. A Cover Letter addressing: Which specific topics/verticals above match your hands-on expertise, and what setups/gear (e.g., home networks, tool ecosystems, test rigs) do you currently use?
  3. 2–3 published writing samples (preferably long-form tech features, explainers, homelab guides, or hardware breakdowns).

We will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you'd make a solid addition to the team.

VP Sales Europe

Based out of the UK.

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton is focused on scaling its presence across Europe. We operate through a Country Director model across three established territories - the Nordics (Copenhagen), UK&I (London), and the DACH region (Zurich) - selling into both public hospital systems and care home operators. This is a rare opportunity to lead an established multi-country commercial organisation, bring consistency and governance across territories, and open Teton’s next European markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop Teton’s European sales organisation in the Nordics, UK&I, and DACH, holding each territory accountable to its new business targets.

  • Own and optimise Teton’s European commercial operating cadence across pipeline generation, tender and bid qualification, deal progression, forecasting, CRM governance, performance management, and team accountability - creating a consistent governance structure across territories while respecting local market differences.

  • Act as a hands-on deal leader on Europe's largest opportunities, across both public tenders and complex private enterprise deals - joining critical customer meetings, site visits, and executive presentations to bring deals over the line.

  • Optimise go-to-market in each territory: segmentation, coverage model, territory design, resourcing, and partner strategy across public hospital systems and private and public care home operators.

  • Evaluate and open new core European markets, such as the Benelux region - building the market-entry case, the operating model, and the initial commercial footprint.

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop commercial leadership and talent as Europe scales, while raising the effectiveness of the existing teams.

  • Represent Teton at major European industry conferences, national associations, while helping refine go-to-market strategy, messaging, pricing, and commercial execution across the region.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience selling and leading teams that sell large and complex contracts won through public sector tenders and RFPs - a genuine command of the public procurement motion is essential for this role.

  • Equivalent enterprise experience closing large, complex contracts with private organisations, as both motions exist across Teton’s European territories.

  • A demonstrated track record as a highly successful individual contributor, consistently exceeding significant new business quotas and closing complex, high six-figure ACV opportunities across long sales cycles.

  • Proven sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing sales leaders and net-new business teams carrying significant new business quotas, ideally across multiple European countries or territories.

  • The ability to operate as a true player-coach: strategic enough to optimise the sales organisation and operating model, but hands-on enough to actively influence and close critical deals.

  • Deep experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive buyers, procurement, legal, and ownership groups.

  • A rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, CRM accuracy, qualification, performance management, and sales governance.

  • Experience building or scaling sales teams, segmentation models, territories, processes, methodologies, and repeatable go-to-market motions, including entering new markets.

  • Exposure to healthcare, hospital systems or senior living is a strong bonus, but not a requirement.

  • 12+ years in enterprise sales, with at least 5 of those spent leading sales teams.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with a willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A high-impact leadership position with significant influence over Teton’s European go-to-market strategy, territory structure, and commercial execution.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment

At Bask, product marketing plays an important role in connecting what we build with the businesses that use it. We value clear communication, a strong understanding of our customers, and the ability to turn complex product capabilities into practical value.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Marketing Intern to support product marketing initiatives across Bask Health's software platform.

This internship is an opportunity for someone interested in technology, business, customer research, and marketing to gain hands-on experience working with a software product team.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together merchant tools, website creation, clinical and pharmacy workflows, AI-enabled features, analytics, and monetization capabilities.

A major part of this internship will involve learning about our platform and helping turn product information into clear, useful marketing materials.

You'll support the development of feature descriptions, product overviews, presentations, launch announcements, and customer education resources.

You'll help research the businesses that use Bask Health, including entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, healthcare providers, and organizations building direct-to-consumer telehealth experiences.

You'll learn how customers evaluate software products, which problems influence their decisions, and how product marketing communicates value.

You'll conduct competitive research on SaaS, e-commerce, and healthcare technology platforms.

You'll help identify how competitors describe their products, which capabilities they emphasize, and how they differentiate themselves.

You'll organize research findings into summaries, spreadsheets, and presentation materials that the team can use.

You'll assist with product launches by preparing draft content, organizing deliverables, tracking deadlines, and gathering feedback.

You'll work with product managers to understand upcoming features and help document their intended use cases.

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.

You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with demonstrated experience building, debugging, and shipping real projects through professional work, open source, self-directed learning, or ambitious personal projects.
  • Ability to create clear, useful developer-facing materials, including code samples, demos, tutorials, docs, blog posts, videos, talks, and workshops.
  • Deep curiosity about how systems work, especially across networking, infrastructure, security, identity, cloud, open source, AI, or developer tooling.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems, such as production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, homelabs, local AI setups, networking experiments, or open source contributions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly, creatively, and practically.
  • Experience presenting to technical audiences, whether through conferences, meetups, livestreams, workshops, podcasts, videos, or internal engineering forums.
  • Comfortable working in public through GitHub issues, pull requests, community forums, social channels, open source projects, and developer feedback loops.
  • Strong developer empathy, emotional intelligence, and product sense; you notice friction, understand why it matters, and help translate it into better docs, APIs, examples, workflows, and product experiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing, support, community, and other technical stakeholders while operating independently and driving high-impact projects from idea to execution.
  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, meeting regular publishing, event, or launch deadlines, discussing technical tradeoffs in detail, and traveling for events, conferences, and community moments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go, networking, VPNs, WireGuard, identity, access controls, infrastructure automation, or security products.
  • Experience building developer education programs, sample apps, workshops, technical video content, or conference talks.
  • A visible history of technical writing, talks, demos, open source contributions, or community work.
  • Experience with homelabs, self-hosting, local AI models, infrastructure experiments, or other “I wanted to understand how this works, so I built it” projects.
  • Familiarity with secure AI access, privileged access management, zero trust, or modern infrastructure security patterns.
  • Familiarity with open source contribution workflows and technical collaboration in public.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, whether gained through formal education, professional experience, open source work, self-directed learning, or building ambitious projects on your own.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems. This could include production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, open source contributions, homelab experiments, local AI setups, networking projects, or anything else that shows how you think.
  • If your background is less conventional, we still want to hear from you. Bring us your GitHub repos, blog posts, diagrams, configs, talks, demos, lab notes, or the deeply specific story of why your homelab is built the way it is.
  • Comfort discussing technical tradeoffs in detail such as explaining what you built, why you built it, what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently next time.

Level

📊 This job is an IC5. You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

Compensation

💸 We pay you an above-average salary because we want to hire the best people who are fully focused on helping Sourcegraph succeed, not worried about paying bills. As an open and transparent company that values competitive compensation, our compensation ranges are visible to every single Sourcegraph teammate. To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources, along with your location zone, and target the high-end of the range to ensure we’re always paying above market regardless of where you live in the world.

💰The compensation for this role is outlined below:

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join the EverPro Marketing team, supporting Joist.

Joist helps solo contractors and small, growing service businesses run and grow through easy-to-use tools for estimating, invoicing, payments, and job management. Our solutions help contractors save time, stay organized, get paid, and manage their businesses more efficiently.

In this role, you'll own lifecycle marketing initiatives that drive customer activation, conversion, product adoption, retention, and revenue growth. You'll work closely with Product, Product Marketing, Growth, and Data to translate business priorities and customer insights into meaningful customer experiences.

This role is ideal for a marketer who combines strategic thinking, analytical skills, and hands-on execution to build effective customer journeys and deliver measurable business impact in a Product-Led Growth (PLG) environment.

Responsibilities:

Customer Lifecycle Strategy & Growth

  • Own lifecycle strategy and experience direction across assigned customer journeys, segments, or products.
  • Identify opportunities to improve activation, conversion, engagement, retention, reactivation, and expansion.
  • Translate business priorities and customer insights into lifecycle initiatives with clear hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on expected business impact, customer value, and feasibility, using data and directional estimates to inform decisions.

Customer Journey Development & Execution

  • Design, launch, and optimize personalized customer journeys across email, push notifications, in-app messaging, and other relevant channels.
  • Define target audiences, customer needs, desired behaviors, segmentation, and behavioral triggers to deliver timely, relevant lifecycle experiences.
  • Manage evergreen lifecycle programs and support product launches, feature adoption, and growth initiatives.

Performance Analysis & Experimentation

  • Design and execute experiments to improve lifecycle performance and business outcomes.
  • Analyze customer behavior, journey performance, and experiment results to identify drivers of success and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for ongoing optimization and growth.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Ownership

  • Partner across Product, Product Marketing, Growth, Payments, Data, Marketing Automation, and Creative teams to align lifecycle messaging with product experiences, customer needs, and business priorities.
  • Own lifecycle initiatives end to end, coordinating timelines, dependencies, and cross-functional execution while adapting to evolving business priorities.
  • Use customer insights and performance data to influence decisions, align stakeholders, and share learnings that improve lifecycle marketing effectiveness.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 5+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, customer marketing, growth marketing, or related roles.
  • Experience owning customer journeys tied to measurable business outcomes, not just channel execution.
  • Experience working in SaaS, subscription-based, or Product-Led Growth (PLG) environments.
  • Strong analytical skills, including experience with segmentation, experimentation, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working with marketing automation or customer engagement platforms.
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally, manage multiple priorities, and independently drive initiatives.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, or similar customer engagement platforms.
  • Exposure to subscription monetization, feature adoption, payments, upsells, or reactivation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with behavioral event data, product analytics, and customer economics.

Where: Canada Remote
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. Job Title: Admin Assistant (Bookkeeping & Inventory Management)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and proactive Admin Assistant to support the financial and operational backbone of a creative, service-driven business. This role plays a critical part in maintaining accuracy across bookkeeping, payroll, inventory tracking, and vendor management while ensuring day-to-day operations remain organized, efficient, and reliable.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role ideal for someone who enjoys working with systems, numbers, documentation, and operational processes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, dependable, and capable of independently managing multiple responsibilities in a remote environment.

You will help create operational clarity by ensuring financial records, inventory systems, vendor relationships, and reporting processes are consistently maintained with precision and professionalism.

Responsibilities

Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

  • Manage daily bookkeeping activities and maintain organized, accurate financial records
    • Process invoices, expenses, reconciliations, and transaction tracking
    • Support payroll calculations and ensure timely and accurate payment processing
    • Prepare and organize required financial and tax documentation
    • Assist in maintaining compliance with financial processes and reporting standards
    • Support implementation and optimization of accounting systems and workflows
    • Maintain organized digital records for financial reporting and audit readiness

Inventory Management

  • Monitor inventory levels, stock movement, and usage trends
    • Coordinate inventory ordering and restocking processes
    • Maintain accurate inventory tracking systems and documentation
    • Identify shortages, overstocking, or inefficiencies and proactively recommend solutions
    • Generate inventory reports and cost tracking summaries as needed

Vendor & Expense Management

  • Build and maintain professional vendor relationships
    • Track vendor invoices, contracts, payment schedules, and obligations
    • Execute expense management and vendor optimization initiatives
    • Coordinate vendor communications regarding orders, billing, or service issues
    • Support cost control and operational efficiency efforts

Administrative & Operational Support

  • Maintain organized documentation across bookkeeping, inventory, and vendor systems
    • Create and update spreadsheets, trackers, and operational reports
    • Support internal process consistency and administrative workflows
    • Ensure data accuracy across reports, systems, and operational records
    • Assist leadership with administrative and operational support tasks as needed

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly detail-oriented with strong accuracy and organizational discipline
    • Reliable, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment
    • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities calmly
    • Enjoys creating structure, maintaining systems, and improving operational processes
    • Communicates professionally and effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders
    • Process-driven with strong ownership and follow-through

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in bookkeeping, accounting support, or financial administration
    • Hands-on experience with inventory management and vendor coordination
    • Strong proficiency with QuickBooks, Square, or similar accounting/payment systems
    • Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting, analysis, and tracking
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
    • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage workflows independently

Preferred Experience & Tools

  • Previous experience supporting small businesses, creative agencies, or service-based businesses
    • Familiarity with U.S. small business tax processes and compliance requirements
    • Experience with inventory management systems and operational reporting
    • Exposure to payroll processing and vendor contract management
    • Experience creating operational SOPs or process documentation

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
    • Relevant certifications or bookkeeping/accounting training are a plus

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

An Admin Assistant in this role focuses on maintaining operational accuracy and supporting efficient business workflows. You will:

  • Manage and reconcile financial transactions and bookkeeping records
    • Process payroll-related tasks and maintain compliance documentation
    • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate restocking activities
    • Communicate with vendors and manage payment tracking
    • Update spreadsheets, reports, and operational documentation
    • Support process organization and improve administrative efficiency

In essence: you ensure financial accuracy, operational consistency, and organized systems that help the business run smoothly every day.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and timeliness of bookkeeping and payroll processing
    • Inventory accuracy and stock availability
    • Vendor performance and expense optimization
    • Compliance with reporting and documentation requirements
    • Organization and reliability of operational systems and records
    • Timely completion of administrative and financial workflows

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Recruiter

  • Practical Assessment (Bookkeeping or Inventory Management Scenario)
    • Final Interview

About Mashgin
Mashgin powers the world's best checkout experience for over 40 million users. Customers just place their items on our kiosks and our AI rings up their entire order in less than a second. With Mashgin, lines are now optional.
Mashgin's technology powers over 1 billion transactions at your favorite locations, including over half of all US professional sports teams, 4,000 convenience stores, major airports, universities, and more.
We’re not just building cutting-edge AI—we’re creating real-world impact and unforgettable experiences. Backed by a well-funded Series B, we’re also one of the rare AI startups that’s already profitable.
Our secret? A culture of extreme ownership, autonomy, and customer obsession. At Mashgin, we are building something extraordinary by challenging conventional wisdom. We’ve thrown out the old rules to focus on what truly matters: creating a kickass product that makes people say, 'Wow'. We don’t care about short-term wins; we build systems that stand the test of time. If you thrive in a culture of excellence without compromise and want to see your work have an immediate, remarkable impact, you’re in the right place.

Position Overview

Mashgin is seeking a technically skilled, resourceful, and customer-focused Sales Engineer to support both prospective and existing customers throughout their journey with Mashgin. This is a full-lifecycle, customer-facing technical role spanning discovery, solution design, technical demonstrations, integrations, pilot execution, deployment readiness, and complex technical initiatives.

You will collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, Engineering, deployment teams, and external technology partners to evaluate requirements, resolve technical challenges, and align Mashgin solutions with customer workflows. The ideal candidate combines technical curiosity and independent problem-solving with clear communication and sound business judgment.

What We Value:

  • Impact: You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day.
  • Simplicity: Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work.
  • Hard Work: Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation.
  • Humility: No task is beneath you. Whether it's high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
  • Customer Innovation: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.
  • Efficiency: Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work.

What You'll Do

    Technical Discovery & Sales Enablement

  • Partner with Sales and existing account teams to understand customer workflows, technical requirements, infrastructure, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead technical discovery, product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, and feasibility discussions with operational and IT stakeholders.

  • Identify technical dependencies, limitations, and potential blockers early; recommend appropriate configurations or alternatives.

    • Solution Design & Third-Party Integrations

  • Collaborate with internal Product teams to design and validate customer workflows involving Mashgin hardware, software, cloud services, and third-party platforms.

  • Coordinate integration requirements and testing payments, POS, loyalty, stored value, campus dining, and other enterprise systems.

  • Collaborate with external providers and internal Product and Engineering teams to resolve integration issues and establish repeatable testing practices.

    • Pilots, Deployments & Existing Customer Initiatives

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for pilots, complex implementations, account expansions, and new capabilities for existing customers.

  • Coordinate technical validation and readiness checks with customers, deployment teams, Support, and third-party providers.

  • Identify and help resolve technical blockers before go-live; participate in onsite testing or customer visits when needed.

    • Complex Technical Escalations

  • Investigate high-impact issues beyond standard support procedures, including configuration, connectivity, and integration problems.

  • Use logs, diagnostics, API testing, and issue reproduction to distinguish operational issues, defects, and enhancement requests.

  • Coordinate escalations with Support, Product, Engineering, and partners; communicate findings, workarounds, and next steps.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

  • Translate customer needs and field observations into actionable technical requirements and product feedback.

  • Help prioritize technical dependencies and communicate feasibility, tradeoffs, and customer impact across teams.

  • Create and maintain integration guides, testing procedures, troubleshooting notes, and reusable implementation documentation.

  • Share technical knowledge with internal teams and contribute to scalable Sales Engineering processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Technical ownership: independently move complex technical work toward a clear outcome.

  • Integration quality: validate workflows thoroughly and surface issues before customer impact.

  • Deployment readiness: identify and resolve technical blockers early.

  • Communication: provide timely, accurate, actionable updates and dependable handoffs.

  • Customer trust: build credibility with IT teams, operators, and external partners.

  • Scalability: create documentation and repeatable processes that reduce recurring work.

  • Product impact: surface recurring needs and help validate improvements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, systems integration, customer-facing technical support, or a related role.

  • Strong analytical troubleshooting skills and ability to independently investigate unfamiliar technologies.

  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and firewalls.

  • Experience with APIs, web services, or third-party software integrations.

  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple initiatives across teams and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, pilots, events, or onsite technical validation as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, authentication, and tools such as Postman.

  • Experience with Linux, command-line diagnostics, logs, or scripting (Python/Bash).

  • Experience in retail, hospitality, foodservice, sports and entertainment, healthcare, or higher education technology.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers and multiple external technology providers.

Growth & Development

    Growth & Development

    This role offers exposure to enterprise customers, diverse technical systems, and cross-functional initiatives. Growth may include greater ownership of strategic integrations, technical mentorship, Senior Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Sales Engineering leadership responsibilities. Advancement does not require transitioning into account management.

The role leads the strategic planning process, drives operational rigor, and orchestrates cross-functional execution to deliver on growth, profitability, and transformation priorities. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. The Opportunity

Montera is seeking a VP, Deputy General Counsel (Energy) to lead the company's energy legal work, negotiate commercial agreements across the business, and support the continued development of the legal function as we scale our hyperscale data center portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, this position is one of three planned functional roles, each ultimately responsible for a distinct area of the business (Job Level M7 — VP or SVP).

Power is a critical-path factor in the development of every campus, influencing site viability, energization timelines, and the commitments Montera can make to its customers. This position is responsible for the agreements that secure power, the regulatory engagement that protects it, and the allocation of power-related risk within customer agreements. The role is broad rather than specialized: in addition to energy matters, the Deputy General Counsel is responsible for commercial contracts across development and operations, support for customer agreements, and certain templates, playbooks, outside-counsel panel, and systems that enable a small team to support a growing portfolio. The position partners with the Development, Design & Construction, Delivery, Procurement, Finance, and Commercial teams.

  • Lead energy regulatory strategy before FERC and state commissions — large-load tariff proceedings, cost-allocation dockets, interventions, and regulatory audit and information requests.
  • Negotiate and close commercial agreements across the business (MSAs, equipment procurement, technology and vendor, consulting and professional services, confidentiality and teaming), and support customer-facing agreements in partnership with the CLO and the Real Estate & Development DGC — allocating power risk inside customer agreements (capacity and availability commitments, SLA exposure, utility cost pass-through, curtailment and demand response, excusable delay tied to utility performance).
  • Support power and real estate diligence on site acquisition and land enablement; support lender, sponsor, and customer diligence across the contract portfolio (consents, direct agreements, assignability, change of control); provide training to the business on key terms and escalation protocols; and contribute to Board and sponsor reporting on contracted capacity, energy risk, commercial exposure, and the development of the legal function.

Requirements

What You Bring

Required

  • J.D. from an accredited law school; admitted to practice and in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar, and able to register as in-house counsel where required in the state of residence.

  • Deep energy transactional and regulatory experience, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of interconnection, electric service, and power purchase agreements as the responsible attorney rather than in a supporting role.
  • Strong command of U.S. wholesale and retail power markets, FERC and state-commission practice, and large-load tariff structures.
  • Demonstrated commercial negotiation ability across a broad range of agreement types, with a track record of taking on unfamiliar subject matter and reaching a defensible answer quickly.
  • Sound judgment on when to bring in outside counsel and when to decide, with the discipline to run specialist firms to defined scope and budget.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to balance legal risk, schedule, and commercial priorities.
  • Exceptional negotiation, drafting, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-moving, founder-led environment without established precedent or process.
    •

Preferred

  • Data center, large-load, or other energy-intensive industrial development experience.
  • Experience negotiating directly with investor-owned utilities, cooperatives, or municipal providers.
  • Experience with behind-the-meter, bridge, or on-site generation, including gas, storage, or fuel cells.
  • Experience building legal-department infrastructure, including templates, playbooks, delegation of authority, contract lifecycle management, and outside-counsel panel management.
  • Hyperscale leasing exposure, from either side of the table.
  • Project finance and lender diligence.

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you’ll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We’re a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

Compensation:

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

Benefits

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.

What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.

  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage.

Requirements

What we’re looking for:

  • Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

  • Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team.

  • Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act.

What we offer

  • Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow.

  • Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities.

  • Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement.

  • Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories.

  • Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany).

  • Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones.

  • Together: team meetups and company-wide events.

Location

We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom.

About RemotePass
RemotePass is a global employment, payroll, and spend platform that helps companies hire, pay, and support talent in 150+ countries. Recognised as one of G2’s Top 100 Fastest Growing Software Products, we’re on a mission to break down geographical barriers and create a world where exceptional talent can thrive anywhere.

From hiring and onboarding to payroll, compliance, and financial services, we give organisations everything they need to build high-performing global teams, and give workers worldwide access to opportunities that were once out of reach.

We’re backed by world-class investors including EBRD Venture Capital, 500 Global, Endeavor Catalyst, BECO Capital, Wamda Capital, 212 VC, Oraseya Capital, Khwarizmi Ventures, and Access Bridge Ventures.

About the Role
Every month, employees across the GCC rely on us to pay them accurately and on time, mostly through our network of EOR partners. We’re hiring a Senior Payroll Specialist to own payroll operations across the GCC, led by Saudi Arabia and the UAE, along with Egypt and Jordan. You’ll report to our Payroll Team Lead for APAC & GCC.

This isn’t a pure payroll processing role. GCC payroll is simple on paper, with no income tax and limited statutory contributions. The real complexity sits around it: managing several EOR partners per country, reviewing invoices, handling immigration costs for a largely expat workforce, and making sure partners are funded before payday.

You’ll be the main point of contact for your partners and work closely with Payroll, Finance, Employee Experience, Customer Success, and EOR Partnerships.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the monthly payroll cycle. Collect client inputs by the cutoff, send them to partners, and get outputs and invoices back on a tight timeline. Deliver accurate client invoice breakdowns to Finance by their monthly deadline.
  • Manage partners, don’t wait on them. Set clear timelines with each EOR partner, chase early, and push back when needed. Some countries have more than one partner, so you’ll often handle several payroll outputs for the same market.
  • Keep invoicing accurate. Review partner invoices, payroll outputs, and immigration-related costs. Reconcile them, spot errors, and resolve them before anything is billed or paid.
  • Plan funding backwards from payday. Work with Finance so partners receive funds in time, accounting for cross-border transfer times.
  • Resolve issues fast, and escalate early. Own discrepancies and employee queries through to resolution. Flag blockers to your Team Lead as soon as they appear, not on deadline day.
  • Get employees payroll-ready. Make sure banking details, payroll profiles, and visa and immigration requirements are in place before an employee’s first pay run.
  • Improve how payroll runs. Spot recurring partner issues and workflow gaps, share them with Product and Operations, and help document processes that scale as headcount grows.

Requirements

  • 5 years+ in payroll operations, ideally including at least 2 years in an EOR or global payroll environment.
  • A clear understanding of how EOR works: the partner is the legal employer, funds must reach them before payday, and timelines run backwards from there.
  • Hands-on experience managing EOR partners or third-party payroll providers.
  • Experience reviewing payroll outputs and payroll invoices for accuracy.
  • Highly organised, able to prioritise when every deadline lands in the same week.
  • Independent: you own your countries without needing every step checked.
  • Advanced written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical payroll topics in plain language.
  • Willing to work Gulf Standard Time (Dubai) hours.

Nice to Have

  • Arabic, which is a strong plus.
  • Payroll experience in the GCC or APAC, including visa and immigration costs.
  • Experience in a high-volume, multi-client payroll environment.
  • Experience with payroll platforms, HRIS, or operational systems.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If

  • You’d rather set a partner’s deadline than wait on it.
  • You tackle the hardest work first instead of leaving it to the last day.
  • You raise your hand early when something looks off.
  • You like fixing the process, not just the one-off error.

Benefits

Why Join RemotePass?

  • See every side of global payroll, from partner management and invoicing to funding and product, not just processing.
  • Shape how payroll scales across the GCC, one of our highest-volume regions.
  • Profitable, and still scaling fast. We reached profitability in 2025 and just raised a $17.4M Series B led by EBRD, with 500 Global joining. You get the pace of a scale-up with the stability of a business that works.
  • Real global scale. We support 35,000+ workers in 150+ countries and have processed over $800M in cross-border payroll for companies like Logitech, Tata Group, and Careem.
  • Big bets ahead. We’re expanding across Europe and the US, building financial products for distributed teams, and investing heavily in AI. There’s a lot to build, and room to grow with it.
  • Remote-first, for real. We don’t just sell remote work, we live it. Work from anywhere.
  • Inclusion matters. We value different perspectives and empower everyone to bring their authentic self to work.

That means you get to do the best work of your life and build the skillset of a senior leader.

This leader will be responsible for all aspects of accounting and controllership, as well as commercial influence over the organization. Reporting to the CFO and with broad exposure to both executive leadership and our private equity sponsors, this role will be a key member of the Emergent leadership team.

Highlights & Benefits of working at Emergent Software

jobs.excerpt: About From Day One:The business landscape is changing fast.
jobs.description:
About From Day One:

The business landscape is changing fast. From Day One is a media outlet and conference series that helps companies navigate all that change in ways that put people first.

Since our beginning in 2018, we've reached over 150,000 attendees, hosted over a thousand speakers, and produced conferences in more than 20 major U.S. cities–and counting. We take a unique, cross-disciplinary approach, convening leaders in CSR, HR, marketing, and communications, as well as civic leaders, authors, and journalists, to share business strategies that benefit workers, customers, and communities.

We also publish reporting and opinion pieces by a network of notable journalists, led by the company's editor in chief, veteran journalist Stephen Koepp.

At From Day One, we hire people who have a high degree of self-motivation and the potential to grow into active leaders. We call team members like these "drivers". If you are a passenger, From Day One will not be a good fit for you.

As you apply, think about whether these attributes describe you:

  • You motivate and energize colleagues rather than waiting for inspiration.
  • You're relentlessly resourceful and take ownership rather than seeking excuses. .
  • You look to consistently deliver great outcomes, and work to improve processes as you engage with them.
  • You are excited about your work and bring urgency to your mission.
  • You approach challenges with enthusiasm and optimism.

Our work is driven by our mission to improve the relationship between business and society, and our efforts are intended to contribute to a brighter future. By maintaining this optimistic outlook, we not only motivate ourselves but also uplift those around us. We believe that believing that the future will be better is the first step towards making it better -- for others, and for ourselves personally.

Please note that diversity and inclusion are absolutely core to our mission, and we are committed to those values in our hiring process.

About This Role:

The Event Production & Client Success Manager manages the logistical needs of our production calendar for both live and virtual events, and owns the relationships with the sponsors who attend them.

Production is the larger share of the job, and volume is what defines it. In the next twelve months we are producing thirteen live conferences and a virtual conference every month. Several events sit at different planning milestones at once, and you would carry them without being told what is due next.

Key tasks include managing A/V teams on visual and audio production needs, review and management of rental orders, vendor requirements and temporary staff hiring, creation of venue layouts and detailed run-of-show schedules, execution of vendor contracts, and construction of the event budget. Much of the work is reconciliation — the A/V order against the current slate of content, the final catering guarantee against the projection it came from, the printed program against the website and the run of show.

Alongside production you would be the point of contact for a roster of our sponsors, administering their deliverables and making sure their experience on site earns a renewal. Producing the event and serving the client are the same job here, done by the same person, which is what makes both halves work.

This is a remote position, and also includes regular travel to other cities for in-person events.

Responsibilities:

Event Production

  • Run the full production process for assigned conferences from the 180-day milestone through post-event wrap-up, and lead the milestone production meetings along the way
  • Create detailed run-of-show schedules and venue layouts, and manage room capacity against the final slate of content and expected attendance
  • Manage A/V teams on visual and audio production needs, walking the order line by line as content changes
  • Review and manage rental orders and vendor requirements, and hire and coordinate temporary event staff
  • Own vendor contracts across venue, catering, A/V, rentals, video, and photography, including deadlines and certificates of insurance
  • Manage catering selections and final guarantees, and compare final numbers against projections
  • Build and maintain the event budget from signed contracts and estimates, and track costs against it as scope changes
  • Place badge, program, and signage orders against their drop-dead dates, and coordinate shipping and staff travel
  • Produce our virtual events on platforms such as Zoom — setting up templates, managing schedules, and ensuring staffing of key roles

Client Success

  • Act as point of contact for a roster of sponsors on their event logistics, escalating as needed
  • Administer all sponsor deliverables — advance materials, shipping of display items, presentation media
  • Assign sponsor table locations, and confirm sponsor and speaker registrations against the production plan
  • Conduct post-event feedback calls, and contribute to renewal rate and customer satisfaction scores

Requirements

  • This position requires a 4-year college/university degree at minimum
  • Candidates should have a strong academic background and a minimum of 3 years of full-time, professional post-graduation experience
  • Direct experience producing complex events — corporate or marketing events, executive gatherings, conferences, trade shows, festivals, or arts events — where you were accountable for the event coming off
  • Experience as a named point of contact for external clients, sponsors, or partners
  • Experience working in-house at a corporation at some point in your career, in any function. Our sponsors are corporate leaders, and the people who serve them best here have worked inside that environment themselves.
  • Experience carrying many concurrent events against fixed deadlines, and owning event budgets and vendor contracts
  • Comfort with project management software such as ClickUp, Asana, or Monday as a daily working tool
  • Outstanding organizational and time management skills, and excellent verbal and written communications skills
  • Willingness to travel regularly for events

Benefits

  • This is a full-time salaried position. Starting salary is $75,000 CAD per year with opportunities for regular advancement and raises.
  • This position is remote, but please be available to meet with stakeholders based in or near the greater Toronto area if requested.

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience coding and maintaining LookML semantic models (views, explores, derived tables) in Looker.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.

About the role

You'll own the full sales cycle, focused on mid-market companies, our core customers. New deals typically land at $5K–$30K in annual value with 30–90 day cycles, and you'll also help grow accounts across our full customer base. Your pipeline comes from three places: inbound leads, expansion opportunities from our Customer Success team, and your own outbound prospecting.

You'll run discovery through close and work with Customer Success to grow existing accounts. Many of your buyers will be IT and security leaders evaluating cloud versus on-premise deployment, so you'll be comfortable in technical conversations and procurement processes.

The role is remote, but we get together in person every so often, so we'd prefer candidates near Austin, TX.

What you'll do

Win new business

  • Run the full cycle: prospecting, discovery, demo, business case, negotiation and close.
  • Get past features in discovery: uncover the business impact for the customer and the event or deadline that drives a decision through true curiosity.
  • Multi-thread every deal: engage IT, security, finance and the budget holder, and equip your champion with a written business case they can take to the decision-maker.
  • Qualify rigorously and set honest expectations, so the customers you sign stay and grow.
  • Protect deal value: trade concessions for commitments such as contract length or agent minimums rather than discounting.
  • Guide IT, security and procurement stakeholders through on-premise and hybrid deployments.

Build pipeline and grow accounts

  • Work inbound leads and expansion opportunities from Customer Success, and generate your own pipeline through outbound prospecting and marketing-supported campaigns.
  • Partner with CSMs on expansion, from upgrades to cross-selling into new departments: build on their handoff notes, treat these opportunities with the same urgency as inbound, and hand the account back cleanly.

Run a disciplined pipeline

  • Keep many deals moving at once, with agendas, recaps and prompt follow-up. Keep every deal current in HubSpot (use case, timeline, success criteria, risks and forecast).
  • Build a working knowledge of the help desk, ITSM and self-hosted software market, and share what you hear with product and marketing.

Requirements

What you'll bring

  • 2–4+ years as a quota-carrying AE closing $5K–$30K deals with 30–90 day cycles.
  • A track record of hitting quota that you can walk us through.
  • Real examples of the pipeline you created yourself, not only meetings booked for you.
  • Examples of deals you won by working several stakeholders and equipping a champion.
  • Comfort selling to technical buyers: IT, security, infrastructure and procurement.
  • Experience with land-and-expand selling, including cross-selling into new departments, and working closely with Customer Success or Account Management.
  • A consultative style built on the customer's problem, its business impact and what's driving their timeline, not feature tours.
  • Discipline with CRM, forecasting and a qualification framework such as BANT, SPICED or MEDDPICC.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling help desk, ITSM, customer service or other self-hosted / hybrid software.
  • Experience with public-sector or regulated buyers.
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience.

Benefits

Compensation & benefits

  • $200K OTE: $100K base salary plus $100K variable at target.
  • Ramp support while you build pipeline: your quota steps up gradually, you earn commission on every deal you close, and monthly activity bonuses tied to goals you set with your manager make up the difference.
  • Commission on both New Business and Expansion deals.
  • Benefits: health, retirement, PTO and equipment.

Why join Deskpro

We're sharpening our focus on the customers we serve best and investing in our product to serve them even better. You'll join an agile team with a direct line to leadership and real room to shape how we work.

You'll also have a quota built around deals you can actually win. If you sell honestly, like owning your pipeline, and want your work to visibly move the business, we'd like to talk.

About Deskpro

Deskpro helps organizations deliver exceptional customer and employee support with modern help desk software that brings ticketing, automation, self-service, and AI capabilities together in one platform. We help support teams work more efficiently without losing the human element that makes great service possible.

Equal opportunity

Deskpro is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive team.

jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Risk Governance Officer to help strengthen and embed effective risk management across Our Future Health.

Working closely with the Risk Governance Manager, you'll play an important role in identifying, assessing, monitoring and reporting on strategic, enterprise and organisational risks that could affect our ability to achieve our objectives.

This role focuses on the bigger picture of organisational risk, including financial sustainability, data security, delivery of strategic objectives, funding, operational resilience, regulatory obligations and reputational risks. You'll work with stakeholders across the organisation to ensure risks are understood, appropriately managed and considered in decision making.

Despite big improvements in healthcare in our lifetimes, today millions of people in the UK still live in poor health as they get older. Diseases like cancer, dementia, diabetes, and heart disease affect the lives of many people in our communities. Our goal is to create a world-leading resource for health research, to improve our understanding and spot the patterns of how and why common diseases start, so treatments can begin sooner and be more effective.

Our Future Health is the UK’s largest ever health research programme, bringing people together to develop new ways to detect, prevent, and treat diseases. We are a charity, supported by the UK Government, in partnership with charities and industry. We work closely with the NHS and with public authorities across all nations and regions of the UK.

This is a Fixed Term contract position for 18 months.

What you’ll be doing:

In this role, you’ll work collaboratively with colleagues across Our Future Health to coordinate risk governance processes and help embed a positive and pragmatic approach to risk management.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Coordinating day-to-day risk governance activities and regular risk review and reporting cycles.
  • Working with risk owners and stakeholders to maintain accurate risk information, monitor agreed actions and follow up on progress.
  • Supporting the implementation and ongoing embedding of Our Future Health’s Risk Management Framework.
  • Facilitating risk identification, assessment and review workshops with teams and stakeholders.
  • Coordinating the development, maintenance and review of organisational and operational risk registers, including tracking actions and escalating risks through the appropriate governance routes.
  • Reviewing risk information for completeness, consistency and alignment with the Risk Management Framework, providing constructive challenge where appropriate.
  • Producing clear, high-quality risk reporting, analysis and management information to support governance forums and decision making.
  • Supporting assurance activities and maintaining accurate governance records and documentation.
  • Building effective relationships across the organisation and helping colleagues take a pragmatic and proportionate approach to risk.
  • Supporting continuous improvement across risk governance and the wider Assurance function.

What this role is not focused on:

This is a risk governance role, not a specialist health and safety or clinical safety assessment role. It does not primarily involve carrying out technical assessments such as COSHH or infection prevention and control assessments, workplace safety inspections or site-level assessments. Experience managing clinical or healthcare risks through risk registers, agreed actions, review and escalation is relevant.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone with practical experience in enterprise, corporate or organisation-wide risk management. This could include experience in a clinical or healthcare setting, provided it involves managing risks and supporting risk governance, rather than focusing mainly on carrying out specialist health and safety or clinical safety assessments

We recognise that candidates may have developed relevant experience through different career paths and welcome applications from those who can demonstrate many, though not necessarily all, of the skills and experience listed below:

  • Experience in enterprise risk management, corporate governance or organisation-wide risk and assurance activities, with an understanding of how risks can affect strategic objectives and organisational performance.
  • Experience coordinating recurring governance, risk review or reporting processes.
  • Experience facilitating meetings, workshops or stakeholder discussions.
  • The ability to review and analyse risk information, identify gaps or inconsistencies and provide constructive challenge.
  • The ability to analyse information and communicate it through clear, concise reports and recommendations.
  • Experience producing management information, reports or governance papers.
  • Effective organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow activities through to completion.
  • Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and work collaboratively with stakeholders across an organisation.
  • Excellent attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to recognise when issues need to be escalated.
  • A proactive, curious and adaptable approach, with an interest in continuous improvement.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence would be advantageous.
  • A relevant professional qualification, or working towards one such as those offered by the Institute of Risk Management (IRM), would be advantageous but is not essential.

Hiring Process

We feel hiring should be transparent and give you a real sense for what Our Future Health is like. Here's what you can expect from our remote process:

  • Initial chat with our Talent team (30 min) to get to know each other, discuss the role, and answer any questions you have.
  • Competency based interview with a small cross-functional panel with your potential new manager and some of your stakeholders (60 min). It is designed to get a sense of how you collaborate and with stakeholders, and how you'd approach the real-world responsibilities of this role.

Benefits

  • From £40,000 per annum basic salary.
  • Generous Pension Scheme – We invest in your future with employer contributions of up to 12%.
  • 30 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays – Enjoy a generous holiday allowance with the flexibility to take bank holidays when it suits you.

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer success plays an important role in helping businesses get value from the platform. We value clear communication, strong customer relationships, proactive problem-solving, and people who take ownership of customer outcomes.

About the Role

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager, Strategic Accounts to build and manage long-term relationships with some of Bask Health's most important merchant customers.

This role is responsible for helping strategic accounts successfully adopt the platform, achieve their business goals, maintain healthy relationships, and identify opportunities for continued growth.

You'll serve as the primary post-sale relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of strategic customers using Bask Health to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, business owners, and healthcare businesses that rely on our platform to support important parts of their operations.

You'll develop a strong understanding of each customer's business model, goals, operational challenges, and priorities.

You'll build relationships with founders, executives, business owners, and other key stakeholders.

You'll help customers understand how Bask Health's platform can support their businesses and improve their operational workflows.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a working understanding of these features so you can help customers adopt and use the platform effectively.

You'll guide strategic customers through onboarding and coordinate with internal teams to support successful implementation.

You'll help customers establish clear goals and develop account success plans aligned with their business objectives.

You'll maintain regular communication with strategic accounts to understand their progress, challenges, and future priorities.

You'll conduct structured account reviews to evaluate adoption, discuss business outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement.

You'll proactively monitor customer engagement, product usage, and account health.

You'll identify early signs of dissatisfaction, operational difficulties, or potential churn.

You'll work with customers and internal teams to address those concerns before they become larger retention issues.

You'll help prepare accounts for renewals and participate in renewal discussions within Bask Health's approved commercial processes.

You'll also identify opportunities for account expansion when additional platform capabilities align with customer needs.

You'll collaborate with sales and leadership when expansion opportunities require additional commercial involvement.

You'll be expected to understand the business impact of customer issues and prioritize communication accordingly.

You'll coordinate with technical support and customer success engineering teams when customers encounter complex platform problems.

You'll work with product and engineering teams to communicate recurring customer challenges and product feedback.

You'll help customers understand product updates and how new features may support their goals.

You'll manage customer escalations while maintaining clear communication and accountability.

You'll follow through on commitments and keep customers informed about relevant updates and next steps.

You'll maintain accurate records of customer conversations, account health, renewal timelines, and outstanding action items.

You'll use CRM and customer success tools to organize your portfolio and track important account information.

You'll work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure strategic customers receive coordinated support.

You'll help identify recurring challenges across strategic accounts and recommend improvements to customer success processes.

You'll contribute to customer education resources, account management playbooks, and retention initiatives.

Because Bask Health supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to recognize when a concern requires involvement from the appropriate clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or technical team.

You'll coordinate communication and follow-up without making clinical or pharmacy decisions outside your responsibilities.

You'll work in a remote, cross-functional environment where clear communication, initiative, and accountability are important.

We're looking for someone with meaningful post-sale customer success experience and recent, substantive experience supporting e-commerce businesses or merchant-facing software.

You should be comfortable working directly with entrepreneurs, business owners, and executive stakeholders.

You'll need to be organized, proactive, commercially aware, and capable of managing important customer relationships independently.

Success in this role means helping strategic customers adopt Bask Health effectively, maintain healthy accounts, renew their relationships, and find additional value in the platform over time.

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of strategic merchant accounts throughout the post-sale lifecycle.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for assigned strategic customers.
  • Build strong relationships with founders, executives, and business decision-makers.
  • Guide strategic customers through onboarding and platform adoption.
  • Coordinate customer transitions from sales to customer success.
  • Develop account success plans aligned with customer business goals.
  • Understand each customer's business model, workflows, and priorities.
  • Help customers navigate Bask Health's platform and available capabilities.
  • Support adoption of merchant storefront and checkout features.
  • Help customers understand questionnaires and other supported workflows.
  • Conduct regular strategic account check-ins and business reviews.
  • Monitor customer engagement, product adoption, and account health.
  • Identify early signs of customer dissatisfaction or churn risk.
  • Develop proactive retention plans for at-risk strategic accounts.
  • Support customer renewals and related account conversations.
  • Identify appropriate account expansion opportunities.
  • Collaborate with sales on strategic commercial opportunities.
  • Coordinate technical troubleshooting with support and engineering teams.
  • Manage customer escalations and maintain clear follow-up communication.
  • Communicate product updates and relevant feature improvements.
  • Gather customer feedback and share insights with internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and strategic account documentation.
  • Track customer goals, renewal timelines, and outstanding action items.
  • Help customers identify opportunities to improve platform utilization.
  • Collaborate with product teams on recurring strategic account challenges.
  • Recommend improvements to customer onboarding and education materials.
  • Support customer success process improvements and account management playbooks.
  • Use available customer data to prioritize outreach and account activities.
  • Coordinate with appropriate operations stakeholders when necessary.
  • Escalate clinical and pharmacy concerns to authorized teams.
  • Maintain professional communication with customer executives and stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of strategic account outcomes and follow through on commitments.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of relevant customer success, strategic account management, or closely related post-sale experience.
  • At least 2 full years of genuine post-sale customer success ownership.
  • Demonstrated responsibility for customer onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, or expansion.

Nice to Have
