  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in commercial field role or medical affairs at a local level from larger country, with recognized success internally and externally. Experience in Patient Access, Community Engagement or Diagnostics will be a plus
  • Strong business acumen and presentation / communication skills across all levels of organization within and outside country
  • Multi-stakeholder project management and leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver results on time and within budget
  • Strong project management skills and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Point and other Microsoft Office programmes
  • Working knowledge of EFPIA regulations and compliance requirements with demonstration of highest ethical standards
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Highly motivated and self-driven with ability to think innovatively & strategically, skillfully plan, manage and prioritize multiple projects independently; demonstrates resilience and flexibility
  • Ability to work independently, while still maintaining a team and corporate approach to the function
  • Proactive, open minded, experienced leader, able to identify and carry out strategic initiatives with high patient impact in launches and life-cycle management
  • Strong business and scientific acumen, leadership skills, project management and scientific communication skills.

Additional requirement

  • Frequent regional and international travel is required, approximately 40% of working time.
  • Availability for external meetings, congresses and internal meetings outside standard hours with advance notice.
  • Valid driver's license may be required depending on local role set-up.
  • The role may be home-based or hybrid depending on country, local employment set-up and business requirements.
  • All activities must comply with applicable laws, regulations, industry codes, internal SOPs and Sobi policies.

Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day.

Sobi is a global company with over 2000 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.
We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.
As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are giving preference to candidates in the US, then in Canada.

Bitovi is looking for an Atlassian Practice Lead to grow our capabilities as a solution partner, build on our Jira expertise, and work with enterprise clients to transform their delivery processes using the Atlassian suite.

As our Atlassian Practice Lead, you will build upon our foundational Jira expertise and own this practice from the ground up. You will set the strategy, develop the service offerings, grow the team, and serve as the face of our Atlassian expertise to clients and to Atlassian itself. This is a high-visibility leadership role that combines technical depth, client advisory, and business development.

If you have ideas for making technology delivery more collaborative, validation-driven, and swift, we want to work with you!

WHO YOU ARE

Recognized Atlassian expert. You have hands-on, deep experience with Jira, Confluence, and the broader Atlassian suite. You know what good looks like at enterprise scale and can explain why.

Strategic builder. You are energized by creating something new: defining a practice, packaging services, and turning a partnership into a growing line of business.

Trusted advisor. You are equally comfortable in a workshop with a client’s engineers and in a boardroom with their VP of Engineering or CIO. You translate business goals into platform strategy.

Relationship builder. You know how partner ecosystems work and can build credibility with Atlassian’s partner, sales, and solutions teams.

Leader and mentor. You raise the skill level of the people around you and take pride in developing consultants. Pragmatic and outcome-focused. You care less about tool configuration for its own sake and more about whether teams deliver better work as a result.

You’ll excel in this role with Bitovi if you have:

  • 8+ years of technology product, project and/or program management experience (multiple of these disciplines strongly preferred), using Jira & Confluence as the Application Lifecycle Management platform
  • 3+ years of experience as a delivery architect or consultant at an Atlassian Solution Partner
  • Proven experience designing and delivering complex Atlassian solutions for large organizations, including workflow design, permission schemes, governance, and multi-team or multi-instance scaling
  • Deep proficiency in Jira administration, Confluence configuration, Jira Service Management (JSM), user permissions, workflows, and cloud/data center migrations
  • Rovo and AI capabilities, Compass, Jira Product Discovery, and Atlassian Forge or Marketplace app development
  • Experience with project and portfolio management, including Advanced Roadmaps (Plans) and enterprise reporting
  • Team leadership & mentoring background in guiding and managing a team of Atlassian specialists (administrators, engineers, and consultants), encouraging upskilling and knowledge sharing
  • Proven skill set in leading or guiding digital transformation at a multi-team scale with executive-level stakeholders
  • Skilled in analyzing processes and identifying pain points to deliver operational efficiencies
  • Excellent oral and written communication, along with strong interpersonal skills, negotiation experience, decision-making, analysis, and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with matrix working relationships and best practices of Agile methodologies like Scrum, Kanban, and XP

WHO WE ARE

Bitovi works with companies that want a true partner in building outcome-focused apps. Our collaborative approach is driven by validation to deliver the swiftest route to the most valuable solution. We’re driven by the desire to provide value to our clients, the technology community, and our incredible team.

Every day, we design and build a wide variety of high-profile applications with tests, full docs, and a deployment process in place. We discuss and design architectures, review code, and research new front-end technologies. We talk to our clients directly, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

We help one another freely. We keep a Slack channel called ask-help, which is constantly used. We develop new skills, build better developer tools, and work on new types of projects regularly—and we take the time to present at conferences, give training, and run meetups. We’re huge devotees of open source, and our developer community is second to none.

Our fully remote team comprises about 70 developers and designers in the US and Canada. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into professions - we want the right person, not the right collection of tech keywords.

You can learn more about us with this short read: Hello Potential Bitovian.

WHAT YOU’LL DO AT BITOVI

Build and lead the practice

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Atlassian practice, including target markets, service lines, and growth goals.
  • Develop repeatable service offerings, such as Jira and Jira Service Management implementations, Cloud and Data Center migrations, enterprise-scale workflow design, governance models, and process optimization.
  • Create delivery methodologies, templates, accelerators, and best practices that make engagements consistent and scalable.
  • Own practice financials, including pricing models, utilization, and revenue and margin targets.

Grow the Atlassian partnership

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner with Atlassian’s partner and field teams.

  • Pursue partner program tiers, certifications, specializations, and Marketplace opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Atlassian on co-selling, joint pursuits, and go-to-market initiatives.

Drive business development

  • Partner with sales and account leadership to identify opportunities, shape proposals, and win new enterprise engagements.
  • Lead technical discovery and solution design during pre-sales, and present to client executives.
  • Contribute thought leadership through webinars, conference talks, case studies, and content that establishes our firm as an Atlassian authority.

Deliver excellence for clients

  • Provide architectural oversight and quality assurance across Atlassian engagements.
  • Advise clients on platform strategy, governance, scaling, automation, integrations, and agile and ITSM transformation.
  • Step into critical engagements to resolve complex challenges and protect client outcomes.

Build and support the team

  • Recruit and hire new consultants, in consultation with Bitovi leadership, as the practice grows.
  • Establish a training and certification path to build a strong base across the firm.
  • Foster a community of practice that shares knowledge.
  • Present at conferences and run other training at meetups and local groups.

Travel. Travel averages 3-5 days per quarter, and we’ll always work with your schedule.

WHAT WE OFFER

First and foremost, you’ll be part of a thoughtful, talented, and amazing team that supports and challenges one another to do their most exceptional work. You’ll contribute to and lead a diverse array of projects, expand your skills and stature in the tech community, and build a track record you’re passionate about and proud of.

You’ll also enjoy excellent benefits, including:

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity
  • Completely remote work with flexible hours
  • 401(k) matching
  • 4 weeks of paid vacation in addition to 8 paid holidays
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance offerings

  • STD, LTD, and Life Insurance coverage

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a UX Writing Intern to join Bask Health and gain hands-on experience creating clear, intuitive, and useful content for digital products.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a UX Writing Intern, you'll work alongside product designers, content designers, product managers, and engineers to help improve how users understand and interact with our software.

This internship is designed for students, recent graduates, and aspiring UX writers who want to develop practical skills in interface writing, content design, and user-centered communication.

You'll support writing projects across different parts of the platform, including merchant onboarding, patient questionnaires, account settings, administrative dashboards, and other product features.

Your work will involve writing and refining interface content such as button labels, form instructions, helper text, tooltips, error messages, confirmation messages, and empty states.

You'll learn how UX writing differs from traditional marketing or editorial writing, with a focus on helping users complete tasks and understand what to do next.

You'll work with experienced team members to understand how content fits into the overall product experience.

You'll learn how interface language, visual design, and interaction patterns work together to make software easier to use.

You'll also develop an understanding of how different audiences interact with Bask Health's platform.

For example, merchants configuring their businesses may need clear explanations of software settings, while patients completing questionnaires may need straightforward instructions that help them understand each step.

You'll learn how to write concise content, maintain consistent terminology, and communicate complex information in plain language.

You'll participate in content reviews and have opportunities to refine your writing based on feedback.

You'll also learn how usability research and customer feedback can reveal confusing language or unclear instructions.

You'll become familiar with content guidelines, reusable writing patterns, and the documentation practices used by product teams.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn why accuracy, privacy, accessibility, and appropriate review processes are especially important for patient-facing content.

You'll receive guidance on assigned writing projects and have opportunities to take increasing ownership of clearly defined tasks as your skills develop.

We're looking for someone who enjoys writing, pays close attention to detail, asks thoughtful questions, and wants to build a career in UX writing or content design.

What You'll Do

  • Support UX writing projects across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Assist with writing interface copy for web-based product features.
  • Create button labels, navigation text, and interface headings.
  • Help develop clear instructions for digital forms.
  • Support content improvements for merchant onboarding experiences.
  • Assist with writing content for patient questionnaires.
  • Help create helper text and explanations for account settings.
  • Write draft error messages and validation instructions.
  • Assist with confirmation messages and next-step guidance.
  • Develop tooltips and contextual help for product features.
  • Review existing interfaces to identify confusing or inconsistent language.
  • Collaborate with product designers to improve interface comprehension.
  • Work with experienced content designers to understand writing standards.
  • Participate in content reviews and feedback sessions.
  • Apply feedback to improve clarity, tone, and consistency.
  • Learn and apply plain-language writing principles.
  • Help maintain consistent terminology across product experiences.
  • Support the documentation of reusable UX writing patterns.
  • Contribute to content guidelines and terminology references.
  • Learn how accessibility principles apply to interface writing.
  • Collaborate with product managers to understand feature requirements.
  • Work with engineers to understand how interface copy is implemented.
  • Assist with reviewing implemented content for accuracy and consistency.
  • Learn how user research informs content design decisions.
  • Help identify opportunities to simplify complex instructions.
  • Support content quality assurance before product releases.
  • Maintain organized writing files and documentation.
  • Complete assigned writing tasks with guidance and regular feedback.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed studies in writing, communications, English, UX design, content design, journalism, human-computer interaction, or a related field, or equivalent independent learning and project experience.
  • No prior professional UX writing experience required.
  • Writing samples, academic projects, or personal work demonstrating clear communication skills.
  • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading abilities.
  • Ability to communicate information in simple, understandable language.
  • Interest in UX writing and content design.
  • Basic understanding of user-centered design concepts.
  • Familiarity with digital products and web applications.
  • Willingness to learn interface writing principles.
  • Ability to write concise instructions and messages.
  • Strong attention to grammar, consistency, and terminology.
  • Interest in how language affects product usability.
  • Willingness to learn Figma or comparable product design tools.
  • Basic awareness of accessibility and inclusive communication.
  • Ability to follow writing guidelines and established standards.
  • Willingness to receive feedback and revise written content.
  • Ability to collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Curiosity about how people interact with software.
  • Interest in solving communication and usability problems.
  • Ability to explain writing choices clearly.
  • Comfortable asking questions and seeking guidance.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Enthusiasm for developing a career in UX writing or content design.

Nice to Have

  • Previous internship or project experience involving UX writing.
  • Coursework in content design, UX design, or digital communication.
  • Experience writing content for websites or mobile applications.
  • Familiarity with Figma.
  • Portfolio projects involving interface copy or content design.
  • Experience writing instructions for forms or onboarding flows.
  • Interest in healthcare technology or telehealth products.
  • Familiarity with SaaS platforms or administrative software.
  • Understanding of e-commerce or direct-to-consumer products.
  • Experience developing writing guidelines or style references.
  • Familiarity with plain-language writing principles.
  • Understanding of information architecture.
  • Experience collaborating with designers on academic or personal projects.
  • Familiarity with usability testing concepts.
  • Basic understanding of WCAG accessibility principles.
  • Experience writing for different user audiences.
  • Familiarity with localization and internationalization concepts.
  • Experience using content management or documentation tools.
  • Experience using AI-assisted writing tools while reviewing outputs for accuracy.
  • Participation in writing clubs, design projects, hackathons, or collaborative product initiatives.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a Creative Quality & Compliance Specialist, you’ll play an integral part in the overall quality and regulatory integrity of creative output across the Healthcare division, serving as the quality and compliance checkpoint within the creative production workflow. In this role, you’ll report directly to the Creative department and work alongside Creative Project Managers who own delivery timelines and task trafficking.

You will act as the gate through which every piece of creative passes before it reaches client Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) reviewers and again before it goes live. You'll review ads, landing pages, emails, social content, and video for MLR regulatory compliance, brand and design standards, and copy accuracy. Additionally, you’ll operate hands-on inside Veeva Vault PromoMats—managing claims, annotations, references, and submission packages—while building and refining the quality standards the creative team works against to raise the bar across the healthcare portfolio.

While your primary authority is quality and compliance, you’ll also support the creative production workflow by maintaining deliverable trackers, coordinating feedback cycles with client stakeholders, and trafficking tasks between the creative team and client POCs. As the Creative Project Manager and Account PM lead delivery management at scale, you will keep the creative lane organized and moving while ensuring nothing ships that shouldn’t.

The Role

As Senior Manager, Pre-Sales you support complex software sales cycles by delivering compelling product demonstrations, responding to technical and functional requirements, and building reusable pre-sales assets. You combine solid product knowledge with strong client-facing skills to accelerate pipeline conversion — working across direct client engagements, partner-supported opportunities and industry events.

What You Will Do:

Pre-sales support and solution delivery

  • Support the end-to-end pre-sales process for assigned opportunities: discovery, demos, RFP responses, solution scoping and proposal preparation.
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations to mid-level and senior client stakeholders, translating features into business value.

Partner and event support

  • Support channel and technology partners in pre-sales engagements: provide product demonstrations and technical guidance, build their confidence in positioning the solution, and assist on partner-led opportunities when additional pre-sales depth is required.

Asset development and enablement

Collaboration and reporting

  • Work closely with the sales lead and AD Pre-Sales to align on opportunity strategy and solution approach.
  • Maintain accurate records of pre-sales activities and solution configurations; support pipeline reporting as required.
  • Participate in win/loss reviews and apply learnings to improve proposal quality and demo effectiveness.

PRODUCT AND INDUSTRY FIT

  • Deep functional understanding of AI-native architecture beyond agents: Ability to articulate and demonstrate the foundational AI concepts that make SCOS technically differentiated, not just as an agentic platform, but as an AI-native system grounded in structured intelligence. This includes hands-on familiarity with Ontologies (the formal supply chain entity and relationship models that agents reason over), Knowledge Graphs (how SCOS traverses multi-hop relationships across suppliers, inventory, demand, and logistics nodes using semantic graph queries), and Semantics (how meaning and context are embedded into data so agents can reason over intent, not just retrieve records). Ability to demonstrate why agents without a semantic foundation produce brittle, unexplainable decisions, and how SCOS's living ontology, which agents actively write back to with decision nodes and confidence weights, produces decisions that are auditable, improvable, and enterprise-grade.
  • Deep functional knowledge of Supply Chain OS: Demand sensing and forecasting, inventory optimization, supply planning, procurement orchestration, logistics management, supplier collaboration and supply chain control tower.
  • Ability to demonstrate SCOS across a representative supply chain scenario: Skill to run a compelling, end-to-end product demonstration across a realistic supply chain scenario: demand signal ingestion, forecast generation, inventory recommendation, supply plan creation, exception alert surfacing, and the management dashboard, tailored to the buyer's industry and pain points. Ability to handle live questions and pivot the demo in real time.
  • Experience scoping proof-of-concept engagements: Skill to scope a credible supply chain AI PoC: defining product families and planning horizon, configuring forecast models, running a retrospective accuracy test, and presenting results to a supply chain and finance evaluation panel.
  • Design and present a SCOS deployment architecture: Ability to design and present a full solution architecture for SCOS deployment, including integration with ERP (SAP, Oracle), WMS, TMS, supplier portals, IoT sensors, and financial planning systems. Competency to translate architecture diagrams into business value narratives for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Supply chain data requirements & quality: Understanding of supply chain data requirements: demand history, BOM, lead times, supplier performance data, IoT telemetry, and the data quality remediation typically needed before AI planning models can run reliably. Ability to scope a data readiness assessment.
  • SAP IBP integration patterns & migration: Familiarity with SAP IBP integration patterns and migration approaches: how SCOS coexists with or replaces SAP IBP, data synchronisation design, and transition planning for supply planning teams — a critical objection-handling topic.
  • Supply chain planning methodology: Understanding of statistical forecasting, machine learning demand sensing, multi-echelon inventory optimization (MEIO), constraint-based scheduling, and the S&OP process, enabling credible conversations with supply chain practitioners, not just technology buyers.
  • Agentic supply chain decision-making: Familiarity with agentic supply chain design: autonomous replenishment agents, dynamic safety stock agents, carrier selection agents, including goal definition, tool use, constraint handling, and human-in-the-loop approval design for enterprise governance.
  • Target Personas: Comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder technical evaluations where IT leadership, enterprise architects, and supply chain systems owners all have a vote. Ability to meet each persona at their level, from API integration detail with architects to planning methodology with supply chain teams to data governance with CDOs.

Travel may be required for role - 0-80% depending on client and business needs

Here's what You Need:

  • Minimum 8+ years of pre-sales, solution consulting or technical sales support experience in enterprise software including a track record of contributing to complex sales opportunities, including RFP responses and solution demonstrations.
  • Minimum 8+ years of enterprise software delivery models (SaaS, license, managed services) and integration approaches.
  • Minimum 12 months of demonstrated experience supporting pre-sales for AI-native software products — solutions built on LLMs, agentic workflows or machine learning platforms — with evidence of demos delivered or RFP contributions.

Successful PGLs combine financial credibility with strong relationship-building skills, intellectual curiosity and commercial instinct. They know how to identify the executives who belong in a room together, engage them around compelling issues and create an environment where candid exchanges produce insights and connections that members cannot easily find elsewhere.

The role requires both a deep understanding of today's finance challenges and a point of view about what comes next. AI, automation, data and emerging technologies are reshaping finance organizations, operating models and leadership expectations. The PGL will help members navigate these changes by connecting them with relevant peers, practical examples and opportunities to learn from one another's experiences.

The PGL will also help members address challenges that cross traditional functional boundaries, including finance, technology, procurement, global business services, supply chain and corporate development.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in business finance or the broader Office of the CFO, along with the confidence, presence and relationship-building ability to engage senior executives.   • Create a sense of community and belonging that makes members want to return, deepen their involvement and advocate for NeuGroup.
  • Partner with NeuGroup's member growth team to identify qualified prospects, referrals, membership expansion opportunities and potential new communities.

Serve as a Trusted Advisor and Chief Connector

  • Establish credibility with senior finance leaders through informed conversations, sound judgment and a strong understanding of the issues shaping their roles.
  • Maintain an ongoing understanding of members' strategic priorities, transformation initiatives and professional objectives.
  • Proactively make high-value introductions within and across peer groups, connecting members with people who can help them solve problems, validate decisions or explore new opportunities.
  • Recognize connections that may not be obvious to members themselves, including opportunities to learn across functions, industries and career paths.
  • Help members navigate complex challenges by asking thoughtful questions, offering relevant perspectives and connecting them to the expertise of the network.
  • Serve as relationship manager for assigned member accounts, working to strengthen engagement, satisfaction, retention and the value members receive throughout the year.

Design Compelling, Forward-Looking Programs

  • Develop distinctive, relevant agendas that give senior executives compelling reasons to prioritize NeuGroup gatherings.
  • Combine member priorities, market developments, research and network intelligence to identify the issues finance leaders should be addressing today and preparing for tomorrow.
  • Bring a proactive editorial perspective to programming, introducing important emerging topics rather than relying solely on members to identify what they want to discuss.
  • Curate the right mix of participants, member case studies, outside expertise and perspectives to create unusually valuable peer exchanges.
  • Frame sessions around specific challenges, questions and decisions, with a clear understanding of the value members should take away.
  • Work with members, hosts, sponsors and internal colleagues to develop differentiated in-person and virtual experiences.

Facilitate Exceptional Peer Exchanges

  • Lead candid, highly interactive discussions among approximately 25 to 35 senior finance executives.
  • Establish the trust and credibility needed for members to share sensitive challenges, difficult decisions, failures and lessons learned.
  • Create a dynamic environment in which members contribute actively, challenge assumptions and learn from different perspectives.
  • Draw out the most relevant experiences and insights, making connections between participants and ideas in real time.
  • Balance thoughtful preparation with the ability to adapt to the needs, interests and energy of the room.
  • Move discussions beyond information sharing toward practical conclusions, stronger relationships and meaningful next steps.

Turn Connections and Insights into Lasting Value

  • Identify opportunities for members to continue valuable conversations and collaborate on shared challenges between formal meetings.
  • Facilitate targeted introductions, focused follow-ups and small-group collaboration that help members apply what they have learned.
  • Recognize when a member challenge would benefit from a more structured approach, such as a Continuation Circle or Execution Sprint, and help connect the right participants and resources.
  • Capture important member priorities, commitments and opportunities for further engagement.
  • Work with NeuGroup's Content and Intelligence team to distill valuable exchanges into practical insights, member-validated frameworks, research and other reusable resources.
  • Help members recognize and articulate the business value generated through their participation in NeuGroup.

Advance Finance Transformation and Thought Leadership

  • Maintain a strong understanding of how AI, automation, data and emerging technologies are changing finance functions, leadership roles and operating models.
  • Engage members in substantive conversations about practical adoption, implementation challenges, governance, scaling and business value.
  • Identify relevant use cases, successful approaches and common challenges across companies and industries.
  • Connect members who are exploring similar transformation priorities, including opportunities for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Contribute ideas and member intelligence that inform NeuGroup's broader research, programming and strategic direction.

Contribute to Network Growth and Continuous Improvement

  • Take ownership of the health, participation and long-term value of assigned communities.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen relationships with existing member companies and expand participation across the Office of the CFO.
  • Generate qualified introductions and referrals in partnership with NeuGroup's member growth team, which leads the membership sales and conversion process.

About NeuGroup

NeuGroup is the premier membership network for forward-looking leaders across the Office of the CFO, including treasurers, heads of FP&A, chief accounting officers, chief audit executives and other senior finance executives at the world's most iconic companies and those shaping what comes next.

For more than three decades, we have brought together senior practitioners in trusted peer communities where they exchange ideas, challenge conventional thinking, validate decisions and solve problems that matter.

Why Join NeuGroup?

NeuGroup is entering a new chapter as we expand our reach across the Office of the CFO, strengthen our research and intelligence capabilities, and use technology to create more valuable connections and outcomes for members.

This is an opportunity to play a central role in that growth by building communities of influential finance executives, shaping the conversations that matter to them and creating relationships that lead to lasting business value.

jobs.description:
Application Developer - Grant Management System Remediation & Workday Integration

Position Summary

The Application Developer is responsible for the remediation, enhancement, maintenance, and integration of the organization's Grant Management System (GMS) with Workday and related enterprise applications. This role will design, develop, test, and support Windows desktop applications, web services, data integrations, reports, and database components that support grant lifecycle management, financial compliance, budgeting, cost allocation, and reporting functions.

The Developer will work closely with business stakeholders, project managers, database administrators, and Workday integration teams to modernize and maintain a mission-critical application environment. The position requires strong expertise in Microsoft technologies, including C#, .NET Framework, WPF, SQL Server, SSRS, SSIS, and enterprise integration services.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Application Development

  • Remediate, enhance, and maintain the organization's Grant Management System to support evolving business and compliance requirements.
  • Design, develop, and support Windows desktop applications using C# and .NET Framework 4.6.2.
  • Develop and maintain user interfaces utilizing Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF), Ribbon controls, and WinForms components.
  • Implement and support Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) architecture using SimpleMvvmToolkit.
  • Develop reusable application components, business logic, and service layers.

2. System Integration

  • Design and maintain integrations between the Grant Management System and Workday.
  • Develop and support WCF (SOAP) services utilizing FSADataService and related enterprise service components.
  • Design and consume APIs, web services, and data exchange processes.
  • Utilize Newtonsoft.Json for data serialization and JSON processing.

3. Database Development

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases.
  • Create and support T-SQL stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, and queries.
  • Manage and maintain SSDT database projects.
  • Design and troubleshoot database performance issues and data integrity concerns.
  • Develop and maintain ADO.NET data access layers using typed DataSets.

4. Reporting & Analytics

  • Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) reports.
  • Support embedded reporting solutions utilizing Microsoft ReportViewer controls.
  • Develop data extracts, dashboards, and operational reports supporting grant management activities.

5. Data Integration & ETL

  • Design, develop, and maintain SSIS packages for ETL processes and data feeds.
  • Support data migration, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot automated integration processes.

6. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Create and execute MSTest unit tests.
  • Participate in code reviews and application testing activities.
  • Develop documentation, deployment procedures, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure adherence to software development lifecycle (SDLC) standards and best practices.

7. DevOps & Source Control

  • Utilize Visual Studio, MSBuild, and NuGet package management tools.
  • Manage source code through Azure DevOps, TFS, or equivalent version control platforms.
  • Participate in release management, deployment automation, and application support activities.

8. Production Support

  • Analyze and resolve application defects, incidents, and performance issues.
  • Provide technical support for business users and operational teams.
  • Participate in after-hours support activities as required for critical system releases or production incidents.

  • Equivalent combination of education and directly related experience may be considered.

  • Three (3) years of Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL development experience.
  • Experience building and supporting Windows desktop applications using WPF and/or WinForms.
  • Experience with enterprise system integrations and web services.

  • MVVM architecture using SimpleMvvmToolkit
  • WCF (SOAP) services
  • ADO.NET and Typed DataSets
  • Microsoft SQL Server
  • T-SQL Stored Procedures
  • SSDT Database Projects
  • SSRS and ReportViewer
  • SSIS ETL Development
  • Newtonsoft.Json
  • Visual Studio

  • MSTest Unit Testing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with financial reporting and governmental grant administration.
  • Experience working in public sector, higher education, healthcare, or nonprofit environments.

As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Software Engineer - Full Stack drives measurable business impact by building scalable, secure, and high-performing digital platforms that accelerate product delivery, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.

This role owns end-to-end development across modern web frontends, APIs, microservices, and data layers, ensuring resilient architecture and seamless cloud integration. Leveraging AI as a force multiplier, the engineer enhances development speed, code quality, system reliability, and data-driven decision-making.

Operating within Empower's hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A/503B environment, this position ensures compliance, scalability, and innovation coexist. The role demands talent characterized by strong strategic thinking, disciplined execution, and continuous learning agility, enabling rapid adaptation to evolving technologies, regulatory expectations, and business priorities while consistently delivering high-impact, enterprise-grade software solutions that support mission-critical healthcare operations and long-term digital transformation objectives.

RESPOSIBILITIES

Platform Engineering

  • Full Stack: Design, develop, and optimize end-to-end applications using C#, Python, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and GraphQL. Integrate modern frontends, APIs, and microservices-based backend services while leveraging AI-assisted coding and testing tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable system architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  • API Development: Build and enhance RESTful APIs that enable seamless data exchange across systems. Apply AI-driven monitoring and performance tuning to improve latency, reliability, and scalability while ensuring compliance with security and regulatory standards within a highly controlled healthcare technology environment.
  • Cloud Architecture: Engineer cloud-native solutions across AWS and Azure using Infrastructure as Code. Leverage AI-powered optimization tools to enhance resource utilization, system resilience, and cost efficiency while maintaining high availability and compliance in a rapidly scaling, regulated ecosystem.

DevOps and Automation

  • Pipeline Automation: Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps. Integrate AI-driven automation to streamline build, test, and deployment processes, reduce cycle times, and ensure consistent, reliable software delivery across environments with strong governance and traceability.
  • Infrastructure Management: Implement Terraform-based infrastructure automation, utilizing AI insights for predictive scaling, anomaly detection, and performance optimization to ensure stable, efficient, and compliant infrastructure that supports continuous delivery and evolving business demands.
  • Release Engineering: Drive release quality through automated testing, monitoring, and rollback strategies enhanced by AI, ensuring minimal downtime, rapid issue resolution, and consistent deployment outcomes aligned with enterprise reliability and regulatory expectations.

Collaboration and Innovation

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, data, and engineering teams to design integrated solutions. Use AI-enabled collaboration tools to enhance decision-making, accelerate problem-solving, and ensure alignment between technical execution and strategic business objectives.
  • Technical Leadership: Contribute to architectural decisions, promote engineering best practices, and mentor peers by leveraging AI-assisted insights. Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and high-performance delivery within a fast-paced, growth-oriented organization.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify system inefficiencies and implement enhancements using AI-driven analytics. Improve performance, scalability, and developer productivity while ensuring solutions remain adaptable to evolving regulatory, technical, and operational requirements.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Proficiency in C#, .NET Core, Angular, React.js, Next.js, Python, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and microservices architecture, with a strong understanding of full stack development, API design, and cloud-native application development.
  • Expertise in Terraform, Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes for scalable and automated deployments.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS and Azure services, including cloud architecture, monitoring, and security best practices in regulated environments.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools for coding, testing, optimization, and decision-making to enhance engineering productivity and system performance.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • A minimum of four years of professional experience in backend development with expertise in C# and .NET Core, or equivalent hands-on experience demonstrating the ability to deliver high-quality software solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience demonstrating strong software engineering capabilities.
  • Strong leadership, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively across teams and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Experience developing headless web applications using REST APIs, with a strong understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes and microservices architecture.
  • Nice to have: Experience with React Native for cross-platform mobile application development.
  • Familiarity with healthcare standards and regulations such as Health Level Seven International (HL7) and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) is a plus.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

VALUES:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS, HEALTH AND WELLNESS:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:Atreides helps organisations turn large, complex, multimodal datasets into detailed geospatial data, that can be used for a wide range of use cases. At present, Atreides focuses on providing high-fidelity data that allows customers to make decisions quickly.

We are a fast-moving, high-performing start-up. We value having a diverse team and believe that inclusion helps us perform better. We trust our people to work independently, as we believe this leads to better results and greater job satisfaction. With a mission-driven mindset and an entrepreneurial spirit, we are building something new and helping to harness data on a massive scale to make the world safer, stronger and more prosperous.

Team Overview: Our teams are made up of engineers and technologists that solve hard problems. Between us, we have decades of experience in defence, operational intelligence, law enforcement, hyperscalers, big data processors and cyber security operations. We obsess about designing products that will change the way governments, international companies and non-profit organisations protect themselves from external threats and hostile adversaries.

Position Overview:We are seeking a Support Engineer to provide customer-focused Level 1 and Level 2 support across secure, defence-oriented cloud environments. This role is central to the day-to-day operational success of our customer platforms and external platform integrations, with a primary focus on responsive support, clear communication, and disciplined execution.

You will support and administer Azure Landing Zone environments, handle incidents and service requests, and become a recognised internal “application champion” for the suite of Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) platforms we deliver to customers (modern ways of working and CI/CD enablement tooling). By owning the operational delivery and application administration workstream end-to-end, you ensure platform stability, user productivity, and a high-quality customer experience, while enabling the wider team to maintain momentum across the broader programme of delivery and improvement.

This role suits someone who takes pride in operational excellence, enjoys solving customer problems, and is motivated to learn and grow within a security-conscious environment.

Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 1 and Level 2 customer support, including triage, troubleshooting, resolution, and escalation with clear handovers where required.
  • Act as a frontline point of contact for customer and partner queries and operational issues, maintaining a professional and calm approach under pressure.
  • Administer and support Azure Landing Zone environments, including:
  • Identity and access administration (RBAC and privileged access workflows where applicable)
  • Policy and compliance support (understanding and applying guardrails, reporting, remediation)
  • Subscription and resource administration (resource groups, tagging standards, cost controls, hygiene)
  • Core networking operations (VNets, NSGs, private connectivity components, routing concepts)
  • Monitoring and alert response (alert triage, diagnostics, evidence capture, escalation)
  • Become an internal “application champion” for customer-facing enterprise platforms (modern collaboration, productivity, and CI/CD enablement), developing strong capability in platform administration, configuration, and user support.
  • Perform routine operational tasks consistently and accurately, including access changes, configuration updates, health checks, and documentation updates.
  • Maintain high-quality customer-facing and internal documentation, including runbooks, support procedures, known errors, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Support security-first operations by following secure handling practices, working within customer constraints, and maintaining strong awareness of risk and assurance requirements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues, proposing automation opportunities, and improving support workflows.
  • Collaborate with distributed teams and customer stakeholders, ensuring expectations, status, and outcomes are communicated clearly.

Required Expertise

  • Experience providing Level 1 / Level 2 technical support in a customer-facing environment, with strong ticket discipline and a focus on resolution quality.
  • Practical exposure to Microsoft Azure administration with willingness to learn and develop capability quickly.
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and practices (e.g. Terraform or Bicep), including the ability to review, run, and apply controlled changes under guidance.
  • Solid understanding of general networking fundamentals (IP addressing, DNS, routing concepts, firewalls, troubleshooting approach).
  • Strong troubleshooting mindset: ability to gather evidence, form hypotheses, isolate causes, and document outcomes.
  • Comfort with scripting and command-line tooling (PowerShell and/or Bash), including basic automation for repeatable operational tasks.
  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to following procedures, especially in secure or regulated environments.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce customer-ready updates and maintain accurate documentation.
  • Strong security awareness and judgement when operating in sensitive environments (data handling, least privilege, change control mindset).
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and remain effective during busy support periods.

Desired Qualifications

· AZ-104

· AZ-900

· SC-900

· ITIL Foundation

Eligibility

You must have the right to work in the Denmark or the United Kingdom. Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship.

Security Clearance

This position requires the successful candidate to have an active security clearance.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive salary, annual bonus, and equity package
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Pension contribution; Life, disability, and AD&D insurance
  • Flexible work environment and flexible hours
  • Paid parental leave
  • Competitive paid time off and company holidays
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Opportunities for travel and professional growth

jobs.description:
As a leading provider of AI-powered extended managed detection and response (MXDR) services, Ontinue is on a mission to be the most trusted, 24/7, always-on security partner that empowers customers to embrace the future by using AI to operate more strategically, at scale, and with less risk. We believe that the combination of AI and human expertise is essential for delivering effective managed security that is tailored to a customer’s unique environment, operational constraints, and risks.

Our MXDR service combines powerful proprietary AI with a one-of-a-kind collaboration model to continuously build a deep understanding of our customers’ environments, informing how we prevent, detect, and respond to threats. Our unrivaled Microsoft expertise allows customers to achieve these outcomes with the Microsoft Security tools they already own. The result is highly localized managed protection that empowers security teams to be faster, smarter, and more cost efficient than ever before.

Continuous protection. AI-powered Nonstop SecOps. That’s Ontinue.

As the Sr Manager, Cyber Security Advisory, you will lead a team of Cyber Security Advisors responsible for helping customers strengthen their security posture, maximize the value of Ontinue’s services, and achieve measurable security outcomes. This role combines people leadership, customer-facing advisory expertise, operational execution, and strong technical understanding of modern security operations and Microsoft security technologies.

You will be responsible for day-to-day leadership of the Cyber Security Advisory team within the Customer Success organization, ensuring consistent delivery quality, proactive customer engagement, and effective collaboration across Customer Success, Security Operations, Sales, Product, and Engineering. You will serve as a trusted leader for the team and a strategic escalation point for customers.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Cyber Security Advisors, helping them deliver high-quality customer guidance and grow their technical and consultative skills.
  • Provide regular feedback, performance management, mentoring, and career development support.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, customer obsession, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Customer Advisory & Escalation Management

  • Ensure customers receive proactive, strategic security guidance that aligns to their business priorities and risk profile.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex customer issues, advisory concerns, and service delivery challenges.
  • Support executive business reviews, customer health discussions, renewal planning, and strategic account engagements.
  • Partner with Customer Success leaders to drive customer satisfaction, retention, adoption, and long-term value realization.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage team capacity, workload balance, customer coverage, and prioritization across the advisory portfolio.
  • Drive consistent use of advisory methodologies, engagement standards, documentation practices, and reporting expectations.
  • Monitor customer health indicators, service delivery trends, risks, and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Support process improvements that increase team effectiveness, scalability, and customer impact.

Technical & Advisory Leadership

  • Provide guidance to advisors on complex customer security challenges, threat detection strategies, incident response considerations, and security operations maturity.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of emerging cyber threats, attacker tactics, security best practices, and managed security service delivery.
  • Promote effective adoption and optimization of Microsoft security technologies, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Security services, and KQL.
  • Contribute to advisory playbooks, reusable customer guidance, best practices, and service improvement initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Security Operations, Product, and Engineering to resolve customer needs and improve service delivery.
  • Share customer feedback, recurring themes, risks, and product or service improvement opportunities with leadership.
  • Support account planning, expansion discussions, and renewal readiness through advisory insight and customer context.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in cyber security, including advisory, consulting, security operations, incident response, or managed security services.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience leading technical, advisory, consulting, or customer-facing security professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach teams, manage performance, develop talent, and drive accountability.
  • Strong customer-facing skills with experience managing escalations, executive conversations, and strategic customer engagements.
  • Solid understanding of security operations, threat detection, incident response, threat hunting, risk management, and security frameworks.
  • Excellent communication, prioritization, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience using operational metrics, customer health data, and service delivery insights to improve team performance and customer outcomes.

Technical Expertise

jobs.excerpt: About DemandBridge DemandBridge builds the e-commerce and ERP software that print, promotional products, and marketing-services distributors run their businesses on, from order entry and inventory to procurement and online storefronts.
jobs.description:
About DemandBridge

DemandBridge builds the e-commerce and ERP software that print, promotional products, and marketing-services distributors run their businesses on, from order entry and inventory to procurement and online storefronts. Hundreds of distributors across North America rely on our platform to serve their clients faster, keep costs under control, and grow.

DemandBridge is part of Fluent Software Group (a Valsoft Corporation operating group), a global acquirer and operator of vertical market software businesses. We focus on specialized industries where expertise creates lasting advantages.

The Opportunity

Help shape the next version of DemandBridge’s e-commerce product. As our Senior Commerce Engineer, you’ll own its technical evolution: identifying what needs to change, deciding how to improve it and building those improvements across the stack.

You’ll work with an established platform and take it forward, making decisions about what to build, refactor or replace to improve performance, scalability and the customer experience. Your work will span architecture, services, the database and the front end, giving you the scope to turn your recommendations into working software.

Working closely with R&D, product, support and leadership, you’ll connect customer needs with engineering priorities and guide how the product evolves. This is a hands-on technical leadership role without people-management responsibilities, with ownership of both new development and production reliability.

Location: Canada (remote)

The salary range for this role is $120,000 CAD–$135,000 CAD per year. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location.

What You’ll Own

The e-commerce product

  • Own the product’s technical evolution across Java and Spring Boot services, Oracle, JavaScript and server-side templates.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize legacy Java EE/EJB components and decide where refactoring, replacement or new development will deliver the most value.
  • Design and build new capabilities, from technical approach through implementation and release.
  • Own architectural decisions and technical trade-offs to improve performance, scalability, security and maintainability.
  • Develop and improve integrations with ERP, payment, shipping and partner purchasing systems.
  • Turn recurring production issues and customer feedback into lasting product improvements.
  • Document architectural decisions and share knowledge across the team.

Sprints and deployments

  • Contribute working code within your first weeks and participate in the current three-week sprint cycle.
  • Plan and coordinate sprint work for the e-commerce product with R&D.
  • Own release planning, deployments and rollbacks through Concourse to Cloud Foundry on Azure.
  • Use Bitbucket for source control.

Production support and security

  • Lead technical resolution of production incidents, including service restoration, root-cause analysis and corrective fixes.
  • Resolve support escalations requiring engineering involvement and communicate progress through resolution.
  • Respond to platform security incidents and remediate identified vulnerabilities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong, current hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience working with legacy Java EE/EJB applications.
  • Experience building and maintaining REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Solid SQL skills.
  • Previous engineering ownership of a product, including responsibility for production reliability.
  • Full-stack development experience with JavaScript and server-side templates
  • The ability to navigate an unfamiliar codebase and contribute without an extended ramp-up period.
  • A track record of resolving production incidents calmly and effectively.
  • Clear communication with support, product and leadership, particularly during incidents.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience developing and supporting e-commerce platforms.
  • Experience with B2B integrations.
  • Experience integrating payment or shipping APIs.
  • Experience with container and cloud platforms, infrastructure and basics devOps
  • Experience working with Oracle.
  • Working knowledge of web application security practices.
  • Experience with B2B or distribution software.

Why DemandBridge?

  • Build what comes next: Take an established product forward through new development and meaningful modernization.
  • Own your decisions: Identify improvements, choose the technical approach and carry the work through to production.
  • See your impact: Improve the software distributors use every day, with direct visibility into how your changes affect customers.
  • Stay hands-on: Write code across the stack while helping guide the product’s engineering direction.

Join Us

Bring your Java and full-stack experience to DemandBridge and take ownership of the engineering decisions behind our e-commerce platform.

We use AI-powered tools (including transcription and automated note-taking) during portions of our interview process to support a consistent and thorough candidate experience. Candidates who require alternative accommodation may request it at any stage of the recruitment process.

Fluent Software Group is committed to building diverse, equitable, and inclusive teams. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and all qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer, Sites & Studio to help build and improve the tools that Bask Health merchants use to create and customize their online experiences.

Bask enables entrepreneurs and healthcare businesses to launch direct-to-consumer telehealth brands. Our Sites and Studio experiences help merchants configure their websites, customize their storefronts, and manage how their businesses appear to customers.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
